messages.从渡槽侧面跃上高位观景台。检修门需要丝壁攀附。: Jump from the side of the aqueduct to the overlook. The service door opens with Silk Wall Grip.
messages.渡槽侧跃、门后取宝: Jump to the overlook and return for the reward
messages.门后保存着心结。: A Heart Knot lies behind the door.
messages.高位水塔检修门后。: Behind the service door of the Upper Water Tower.
messages.借丝壁攀附登上井顶钟龛。: Use Silk Wall Grip to reach the shrine at the top of the shaft.
messages.沿错开的书架托板侧跳，落到上一级。: Jump around the edges of the staggered bookshelves to climb.
messages.沿错开的书架托板侧跳，落到上一级。 西侧二层上方还有一层孤架，单跳够不着。 塔底: Jump around the edges of the staggered bookshelves to climb. A lone shelf above the western second floor is beyond a single jump. An old bell plate over the tower floor waits for a resonance.
messages.从藤台空出的一侧起跳，绕过台沿再落脚。: Jump from the open side of each vine ledge and land around its edge.
messages.沿枕木两侧的开口交替起跳。: Alternate sides as you jump up the cableway sleepers.
messages.沿塔梯左右错开的落点向上跳。: Jump up the tower using the staggered landings.
messages.绕过肋板边缘，逐级跳向王冠前厅。: Jump around the edge of each rib to reach the Crown Antechamber.
messages.\n确认后将写入这次旅途；取消可以继续探索。: Confirm to record this choice in your journey, or cancel to keep exploring.
messages.BOSS TRIAL COMPLETE: 苔钟守母已被击败: Boss trial complete. The Moss Bell Matriarch has fallen.
messages.Boss 前的短路已经留好，别把长回跑当成难度。: There's a shortcut before the boss. You don't have to make the whole long run back.
messages.Boss 前短跑存档点: Short-run save point in front of the Boss
messages.Boss 试炼完成：苔钟守母已被击败。: Boss trial complete. The Moss Bell Matriarch has fallen.
messages.DEMO COMPLETE: 灰冠螳将已被击败，盐白失声印记已回收: Demo complete · Ash-Crowned Mantis Warlord defeated and Saltwhite Silent Mark recovered
messages.DEMO COMPLETE: 百钥守门人已被击败，王冠失声印记已回收: Demo complete · Hundred-Key Gatekeeper defeated and Crown Silent Mark recovered
messages.DEMO COMPLETE: 绯线执剪者已被击败，铁匠印记已回收: Demo complete · Crimson Thread Scissor Apostle defeated and Smith's Mark recovered
messages.DEMO COMPLETE: 苔钟守母已被击败，王冠裂片已回收: Demo complete · Moss Bell Matriarch defeated and Crown Shard recovered
messages.DEMO COMPLETE: 铜根主教已被击败，断弦失声印记已回收: Demo complete · Copperroot Bishop defeated and Broken String Silent Mark recovered
messages.DEMO COMPLETE: 镜池新娘已被击败，黑曜失声印记已回收: Demo complete · Mirrorpool Bride defeated and Obsidian Silent Mark recovered
messages.E 会把绯线拉紧，打出重击。别把能量全花在贪刀上。: E will tighten Crimson Thread and deliver a heavy strike. Don't spend all your energy on Greedy Blade.
messages.ENDING ROUTE OPEN: 百钥守门人之后，绯线真结局等待选择。: ENDING ROUTE OPEN: After the Hundred-Key Gatekeeper, the Crimson Thread true ending awaits the choice.
messages.F 继续交谈；也可以询问道路或心愿。: Press F to keep talking, or ask about the road or a wish.
messages.Shift 冲刺拨开计时栅闩。: Shift Dash to Disrupt Timing Gate.

messages.worker_badge 与已开始的带名字支线: worker_badge with the start of a name feed
messages.“旗可以放下。名字留下。”: “The flag can come down. Let the name remain.”
messages.“自愿”旁的纸纤维翘着，“后嗣”的墨更深。我没有把盐粉擦掉，书记也把自己抄出的副: The fibres lift beside “voluntary.” The ink of “descendants” is darker. I left the salt dust on the page. The scribe laid the copy he'd written alongside it.
messages.……抬头。整座城，都住在一口钟的里面。: …Look up. The whole city lives inside a bell.
messages.一个人留下它，但背面的每一道铆痕都在提醒我们，还有别人的手。: One person left it. Every rivet mark on the back reminds us that other hands worked here too.
messages.一件工具的用途会变，不能只凭铜管的走向判断是谁同意了它。: A tool can change its purpose. The direction of a copper pipe alone cannot tell me who consented to it.
messages.一份归还名字的记录有自己的价值，不必拿它冒充另一处守门者的证言。: A record of giving names back has value of its own. There's no need to pass it off as another Gatewarden's evidence.
messages.一口钟也会疼，只是没人问过。我学了这么多年，仍不知道该怎么先说出来。: A bell can hurt too. No one's ever asked. After all these years I still don't know how to be the first to say it.
messages.一句话离开页边，很容易又被用成命令。: A line taken out of its margins can all too easily become another order.
messages.一场胜利不会替我们修好每一只阀。: One victory won't mend every valve.
messages.一截打过死结的绯线。集齐四截，编成一个心结：最大生命 +1。: A section of Crimson Thread with a dead knot. Collect four sections to form a Heart Knot: Max Life +1.
messages.一把还能开门的钥匙，为何被带进肋骨里？: Why would someone take a key that could still open a door into their own rib cage?
messages.一本书可以同时有两种读法吗？: Can a book have two readings at once?
messages.一枚回声针只碰一个目标。已有盐记在治疗完成时只能延长一次，不能拿治疗无限拖住敌人: An Echo Needle hits only one target. Finishing a heal can extend an existing Salt Mark once. You can't hold an enemy forever by healing.
messages.一次救助不赋予救助者持续的安排权。: Helping someone once gives no continuing right to arrange their life.
messages.一种连接让声音在这里继续，另一种把它带到别处；别只因为都叫弦就算成同意。: One connection keeps a voice going here. The other takes it somewhere else. Calling them both strings doesn't mean anyone agreed to both.
messages.三处敌群分别盘踞在上桥、下庭和上层钟廊。: Three enemy groups are stationed on the upper bridge, the lower court, and the upper bell corridor respectively.
messages.三张盐页换一段真名，少一张也能换一个更好听的谎。: Three salt pages replace a segment of real name. A few less can replace a better-lipped lie.
messages.三短一长，是撤离的灯号。没有人再等钟令：灯是自己点的，路也是自己走的。: Three short, one long, it's a signal of evacuation. No one waits for the bell commander anymore: the lamp is lit by oneself, and the path is walked by oneself.
messages.三钟祈愿碑与殿前烛台: Three Bells Praying Monument and Candle Stand in Front of the Hall
messages.上下两线处理盾卫: Fight the shield guard from the upper or lower path
messages.上去的人总盯着高处，下来时才发现石阶另一面没有标记。: On the way up, everyone's eyes are fixed on the heights. Only coming down do they see the other face of the steps has no marks on it.
messages.上层有一段湿苔颜色不对。: There's a section of wet moss with incorrect color on the upper layer.
messages.上层能走以后，回旧钟庭看看。我们封住的东西，未必都该一直封着。: Once you can reach the upper level, look in on the old court. Some of what we sealed away deserves to be opened.
messages.西边的踏板连接两层环廊，东边的铜栅桥接住深廊回程。: The west ledges connect the two levels. The bronze grate in the east catches the climb out of the deep hall.
messages.环廊西缘通向下层。: The western edge of the ring leads down.
messages.上层齿架可以借力。: The upper moss framework can be used for support.
messages.上方夹层有一间不下雨的房间。: There's a room without rain on the upper layer.
messages.上游检修路要用攀壁线结，水轮下面也能绕回。别忘了回来把消息告诉孩子。: You'll need the Wall-Cling Knot for the upper maintenance path. You can also circle back under the waterwheel. Don't forget to tell the child what you find.
messages.上面给人看路，下面才照得见漏口。我吃过只把门面照亮的亏。: A high lamp shows the path. A low lamp shows the leak. I've paid for lighting up just the front before.
messages.下一次军号响时，谁能让那一拍继续空着？: Who can leave that beat empty the next time the bugle sounds?
messages.下一盏若要请你帮忙，我们重新谈价。: If I need your help with another lamp, we'll agree on a new price.
messages.下劈发亮棘球可刷新空中状态。: Lowering the sharp spiky ball can refresh the aerial state.
messages.下劈棘球反弹到高台。: The spiky ball bounces onto the high platform.
messages.下劈棘球续航，黑弦平台只踩一次。: The downward strike of the thorn ball has endurance. The Black String platform can only be stepped on once.
messages.下劈棘球，你会被弹起来。下劈我，我会骂你。: Downward Prong Ball, you will be bounced up. Downward me, I will curse you.
messages.下劈棘藤盾兵破甲后可穿过地板裂缝。: The spiky ball shield soldier can break through the floor cracks after armor damage.
messages.下劈破甲复考。: The downward strike of the armor-breaking test again.
messages.下劈能开旧根封。看准下面是什么，有些壳会碎，有些是还活着的家。: A downcut will open the old root seals. Look at what's underneath first. Some shells break. Others are still someone's home.
messages.下回也许还是会怕。但我想先吃饭，吃完再说去哪。: Maybe I'll be frightened next time too. Right now I'd like to eat. After that I can think about where I'm going.
messages.下回再遇见，我们仍可以先问候，不必先算谁该修哪盏灯。: Next time we meet, we can say hello before we start counting whose job it is to mend which lamp.
messages.下工钟又响了。它还是叫编号；我会继续告诉他们爹叫阿禾。: The shift bell's ringing again. It's still calling numbers. I'll keep telling them my dad's name is A-He.
messages.下方盐雾持续扣血。: The salt fog below continues to deplete health.
messages.下次你经过，若听见我替他们应，叫住我。: If you pass next time and hear me answer for them, stop me.
messages.下次修钟时，我想先问他们愿不愿意听，而不是先告诉他们应该唱什么。: Next time we mend a bell, I'd like to ask whether people want to hear it before telling them what they ought to sing.
messages.下次有人说孩子本来就欠钟一班，我至少能把纸拿出来。: Next time someone says a child is born owing the bell a shift, I can at least bring out the paper.
messages.下行练习下劈反弹，脚下的裂口通向西苔脉。: Lower moss practice with downward penetration and rebound, with cracks underfoot leading to the West Moss Vein.
messages.下面那层枝台能站，我看见了。你把西门灯的位置指给我，不必背我走完每一步。: I see the branch ledge below. It'll hold me. Show me where the west gate lamp is. You don't have to carry me the whole way.
messages.不。我想让人知道我来过，也知道我是哪天走的。: No. I want people to know I came. I want them to know the day I left, too.
messages.不会再把没回答算作答应了。可这事得我亲自去做。: I won't count silence as consent again. But I must go there myself.
messages.不同的证词有矛盾时怎么办？: What if the testimonies contradict one another?
messages.不回答会不会也是一种伤害？: Can leaving someone unanswered hurt them too?
messages.不回答军号就算背叛吗？: Is refusing to answer the bugle a betrayal?
messages.不循残迹、不敲钟可照常取花粉蜡、与根笼囚徒对话、拉根库拉杆离开，经树心继续；主线: Without following the traces or ringing the bell, you can still pick up pollen wax, talk with the Root Cage Prisoner, pull the Root Vault lever to leave, and continue through the heartwood; the main storyline does not depend on this hunt. The seal is only sealed at the entrance of the East Root Gallery, and you can still evacuate from the bottom of the west library. Abandoning this room will terminate this trial. Open the seal, reset the lingering bell, and you can return at any time to ring it again.
messages.不循残迹、不敲钟可照常取证词离开；主线不依赖此猎。离开此房即中止本次试炼，封门打: Leave without following traces or knocking on bells; the main line does not depend on this quest. Leaving this room terminates this trial. Open the door, reset the lingering bell, and you can return at any time to knock again.
messages.不循残迹、不敲钟可照常取黑曜碎片、拉缆车拉杆离开，经缆车井回营地；主线不依赖此猎: Do not follow the traces, do not strike the bell, you can still take the black crystal fragments and pull the cable car lever to leave, returning to the camp through the cable car shaft; the main storyline does not depend on this hunt. The door is only sealed at the west side of the Old Foothill Road/wellhead entrance, and the east side of the pit can still be evacuated. Abandoning this room will terminate this trial, the door will be opened, and the residual bell will be reset, allowing you to return at any time to strike again.
messages.不想再看见后来者重复自己的错误。: Doesn't want anyone else repeating his mistake.
messages.不想再被当作材料，但仍害怕主角拿走印记后裂缝醒来。: Wants an end to being treated as raw material. Fears the fissure will wake when the Pilgrim takes the mark.
messages.不想看见后来者在第一座庭院就被王冠消耗掉。: Hopes to spare newcomers from being spent by the Crown before they even leave the first court.
messages.不敲钟可拿冠下回声碎片、与旧王钟舌对话、拉西环拉杆离开，经西环廊或王座前廊继续；: Without ringing the bell, you can obtain the echo fragments under the crown, talk with the old Crown Tongue, pull the West Ring puller to leave, and continue through the West Ring Gallery or the Throne Approach. The main storyline does not depend on this room. The door only seals the entrance of the West Ring Gallery on the west side, and the eastern storage area and the falling front corridor can still be evacuated. Leaving this room means ending this trial. The door opens, the Echoing Bell is reset, and you can come back at any time to ring it again.
messages.不敲钟可拿沉默军令／黑曜碎片与暗灯离开，经旗桥回营地；主线不依赖此房。封门只封东: Without striking the bell, you can take the Silent Military Order/black crystal fragments and leave through the Banner Bridge, returning to the camp; the main storyline does not depend on this room. The door is only sealed at the east entrance of the Banner Bridge, and the west side of the tomb area can still be evacuated. Abandoning this room will terminate this trial, the door will be opened, and the residual bell will be reset, allowing you to return at any time to strike again.
messages.不敲钟可拿花粉蜡与暗灯离开，继续东藤壁；主线不依赖此房。封门只封西侧根须南廊入口: Without ringing the bell, you can take pollen wax and leave through the dark lamp, continuing to the East Vine Wall; the main storyline does not depend on this room. The seal is only sealed at the entrance of the West Root Gallery South Gallery, and you can still evacuate from the east. Abandoning this room will terminate this trial. Open the seal, reset the lingering bell, and you can return at any time to ring it again.
messages.不敲钟可拿走地图残页离开；主线不依赖此房。水轮内的暗格可选。离开此房即中止本次试: You can take the map fragment without knocking on the bell; the main line does not depend on this room. The hidden compartment inside the waterwheel is optional. Leaving this room terminates this trial. Open the door, reset the lingering bell, and you can return at any time to knock again.
messages.不敲钟可直接离开；主线不依赖此房。冲刺门后的暗格可选。封门只封东侧冲刺门方向，西: You can leave without knocking the bell; the main storyline does not depend on this room. The hidden compartment behind the sprint door is optional. The door only seals the sprint door on the east side, and you can still evacuate on the west side. Leaving this room terminates this trial, and the door opens, and the remaining bell resets, allowing you to return and knock again at any time.
messages.不是。工牌记的是湛的手，剪口留下的是另一种力道。: No. The work badges remember Zhan's hand. The cuts from the shears show a different kind of force.
messages.不是同一件职分就能算成同一个人。有人守着删改后的秩序，也有人留下删改的痕迹。: Sharing an office needn't mean sharing an identity. Someone guarded the altered order. Someone else kept the traces of the alteration.
messages.不是怕你偷。要是你回来说有一枚查不到，我至少知道该接着等哪一个。: I don't think you'd steal one. But if you come back and say one couldn't be traced, I'll know who I'm still waiting for.
messages.不是所有床都要朝着出发的方向摆。今天我才想起这事。: Not every bed needs to face the road out. I only thought of that today.
messages.不是放心，是屋里再也没人出去。我修好它，搁回去，第二天又拿起来。: It wasn't that I was certain. No one else in the house ever left. I'd mend the needle, put it back, and pick it up again the next morning.
messages.不是留给谁的后人。谁来了，谁坐；不想听，就搬到背风处去。: Not for anyone's heirs. Whoever comes can sit. If they don't feel like listening, they can move it out of the wind.
messages.不替它们编名字，只让后来的人知道这里曾被动过。: I'm not making up names. I only want the next reader to know someone altered this place.
messages.不用再从军号里分辨召回线了；潮边少一个回答，我也得去找。: I no longer have to pick the recall signal out of the bugle call. But if a voice is missing at the water's edge, I still have to go and look.
messages.不用钟令调水了，今晚谁守阀？: Without the bell directing the water, who takes the valve tonight?
messages.不看旧号怎样召人，只换一个亮法，很可能还会把同一批人叫回来。: If we merely change the flash without seeing how the old signal called people, we may summon the same people back again.
messages.不能前头说“帮个忙”，后头就当你会一直帮。下一盏得重新问你。: I can't ask for a favour once and then take your help for granted. For the next lamp I'll ask again.
messages.不能因为这一件纪念旧人，就让后面的全穿同一件。: One coat made in someone's memory shouldn't make everyone who comes later wear the same thing.
messages.不能这样说。衣领能留下他们来过的痕迹，不能把已经过完的一生再缝出来。: I wouldn't say that. A collar can show that someone was here. It can't stitch a life already lived back into being.
messages.不要把夺得总锁，当成所有选择都已经归还。: Taking the master lock doesn't mean you've given all the choices back.
messages.不要报我的名字。先看看这只手，它写过命令，现在连握笔都不太稳。: Don't say my name. Look at my hand first. It used to write orders. Now it can hardly hold the pen.
messages.不要替我带礼物。带一句从上面说下来、也肯等我回答的话。: Don't bring me a present. Bring a few words from up above, from someone who'll wait to hear my answer.
messages.不说明白，旧军册里那套读法还会替我们发令。: Leave it unclear and the old muster roll will read the lights for us and give orders again.
messages.不说话会让别人替我把话写完吗？: If I keep silent, will someone finish the words for me?
messages.与修女校正归途灯号: Calibrated the Homeward Signals with the Lantern Sister
messages.与修女校正检修信号: Signal with the Sister for Correction and Maintenance
messages.与修女校正灯号: Signal with the Sister for Correction
messages.与断弦歌者对话，确认守门者真相。: Dialogue with the Broken-String Singer to confirm the truth about the Gatewardens.
messages.与王冠发生共鸣不构成继承其统治的义务。: Resonating with the Crown places me under no duty to inherit its rule.
messages.与盐白书库偏旁拼出第七签署者名的一半。: Match the snippet of the Saltwhite Archive with the seventh signer's name to form half of his name.
messages.与盲钟骑士对话，取得失败巡礼者证词。: Dialogue with the Blind Bell Knight to obtain testimony from defeated pilgrims.
messages.与蜂蜡商人交易并取得蜂巢支线。: Trade with the Wax Merchant and obtain the beehive side mission.
messages.与蜂蜡商人交谈、补给和寻找暗灯，再进东藤壁: Talk to the beeswax merchant, restock and find the hidden lamp. Then enter the eastern vine wall.
messages.与西侧夹层断开，1670至1890为首访登楼开口。: Disconnect from the western mezzanine, with openings for visiting the tower from 1670 to 1890.
messages.与逃旗手支线共同推进，拼成终章入口凭证。: Advance together with the Deserter Standard-Bearer side story to form the entrance credential for the final chapter.
messages.世界地图也应当容得下日常生活。: A map of the world ought to have room for ordinary life.
messages.世界观的一致性不要求抹平人物的不同视角。: People can see the same world differently. Their differing accounts need room on the page.
messages.世袭契约继续生效，后人仍要承担并未亲自同意的失声。: The hereditary covenant remains in force. Those who come after will still lose their voices without their consent.
messages.世袭强制终止，名字和声音归还众人。: Hereditary service ends. The people recover their names and voices.
messages.东侧深廊被钟隙封住。: The east side of the deep corridor is sealed by the bell gap.
messages.东壁的竖井要墙跳才能上去。: The vertical shaft on the east wall requires a wall jump to reach.
messages.东沿可以一路坠回水线站厅。: The eastern edge allows you to fall back to the waterline hall.
messages.东沿可以一路坠回水线站厅。 可见旧检修入口：「双层水位记录室」。在门前腾空，再按: The eastern edge allows for a fall back to the waterline station hall. The old maintenance entrance can be seen: "Double Water Level Record Room". Fly through in front of it, then jump again to connect the double thread lock.
messages.东端通向阀顶眺台。 回廊上残留第二道渠影。: The eastern end leads to the Valve Lookout. There's a second canal shadow remaining in the corridor.
messages.西端石坡通向钟骨升降笼，东端回廊通向露台。: The west ramp leads to the Bellbone Lift. The east gallery leads to the terrace.
messages.东角地面空洞——将来能劈开。: The ground at the east corner is hollow—it will be split in the future.
messages.丝壁攀附与回声钩索: Silk Wall Grip and Echo Hook Rope
messages.两件事完成后回灯影修女处完整交谈。: After completing two tasks, have a complete conversation with the Lantern Sister.
messages.两敌并排，一罐炸两只: Two enemies side by side, one bomb to kill two.
messages.两种用途缠在同一套装置里，并不说明它们从来是一回事。: Two uses are tangled in the same device. That doesn't mean they were always one thing.
messages.两边都需要光，可检修的人得先看得清自己的脚，才能看根哪里坏了。: Both need light. Whoever's doing the repair needs to see where to put their feet before looking for the damaged root.
messages.个人誓言的回收，应当落到共同生活中。: Taking back one person's oath will have consequences for everyone who shares their life.
messages.中速近战，考验二段跳后的落点。: Medium-speed close combat, testing the landing spot after a double jump.
messages.为什么不直接把铜管全砸断？: Why not smash all the copper pipes?
messages.为什么把西门的事托给我？: Why trust me with the west gate?
messages.为什么要先核对军册再改灯号？: Why check the muster roll before changing the signals?
messages.为什么要我帮你辨认军令？: Why ask me to help identify the order?
messages.为根笼囚徒打通退路: Opened a Way Out for the Root Cage Prisoner
messages.主教不催灯数了，我想一盏盏试，看哪盏真照到人的脚。: The Bishop isn't counting lamps anymore. I'd like to test them one by one and see which ones really light someone's feet.
messages.主教不再命令树根生长，我也该有停下来听雨的时刻。: The Bishop no longer orders the roots to grow. I should have a moment when I can stop and hear the rain.
messages.主教不在了，我想把指挥的位置先空出来。: With the Bishop gone, I'd like to leave the conductor's place empty awhile.
messages.主教不在以后，我想先在西门坐一会儿。: With the Bishop gone, I'd like to sit at the west gate for a while.
messages.主教不讲了，树还在长。我们要做的是解开根，不是烧光根。: The Bishop's sermon is over. The tree's still growing. We need to loosen these roots. We needn't burn them all.
messages.主教倒下了，门边还是有活要干。你要去别处就去吧，我得留在这里把铰链看住。: The Bishop has fallen, but there's still work by the gate. Go on if you have somewhere to be. I'll stay here and see to the hinges.
messages.主教倒下以后，我会先看哪处已经能自己承力。: Now the Bishop has fallen, first I'll see which parts can take their own weight.
messages.主教倒下以后，我或许会回来看看。: Now the Bishop has fallen, I might come back and see it.
messages.主教倒下后，修灯仍值得做。: Mending lamps is still worthwhile now the Bishop has fallen.
messages.主教倒下时，我以为自己会替她哭，嗓子却只觉得松。: When the Bishop fell, I thought I'd weep for her. All I felt was my throat loosening.
messages.主教倒了，也不能把所有后来长出的枝都判成错。: The Bishop is down. That doesn't make every branch grown since the beginning a mistake.
messages.主教停下，蜂群却还忙。我给他们多留些花，不再把每滴蜜都换成钱。: The Bishop has stopped. The bees are still busy. I'll leave them more flowers. No need to sell every last drop of honey.
messages.主教停了以后，树有机会按自己的速度愈合。: With the Bishop still, the tree can heal at its own pace.
messages.主教停了，我仍会先看通往西门的那段路。: Even now the Bishop has stopped, I'll look first at the stretch that leads to the west gate.
messages.主教停了，灯也不能只照那一处大树。: With the Bishop still, the lamps can't just shine on the one great tree.
messages.主教已经停下了，我却不想替他唱一段和解。: The Bishop has stopped. I have no wish to sing a reconciliation on her behalf.
messages.主教的命令停了，我得学着让新枝长到我没画过的地方。: With the Bishop's orders stilled, I must let the new branches grow where I haven't drawn them.
messages.主教的声音断了，笼子松了。我想自己站起来，你在旁边等一等就好。: The Bishop's voice stopped and the cage went slack. I'd like to get up on my own. Wait beside me for a moment.
messages.主教的指令没有了，我们可以重新约定哪些声是警告，哪些是在找人。: With the Bishop's commands gone, we can agree afresh which sounds mean danger and which mean someone's looking for you.
messages.主教的藤鞭与花粉风覆盖全场。: The bishop's vine whip and pollen wind cover the entire area.
messages.主母巢厅1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Matriarch's Nest Hall 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.主母巢厅2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Matriarch's Nest Hall 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.主母巢厅3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Matriarch's Nest Hall 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.主母巢厅4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Matriarch's Nest Hall 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.主母巢厅5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Matriarch's Nest Hall 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.主母巢厅6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Matriarch's Nest Hall 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.主角与他人的理解来自往返确认。: To understand one another, we have to ask and listen in turn.
messages.主角也可以练习休息，而非只练习推进。: Rest is something I can practise, too.
messages.主角由初代巡礼者的线结唤醒，但不会替众人作无代价的选择。六份独立证词可以按任何顺: The protagonist is awakened by the knot of the first-generation Pilgrim, but does not make costless choices for others. Six independent testimonies can be found in any order.
messages.主角的沉默也应具有可以被尊重的边界。: My silence, too, has a boundary someone else can respect.
messages.主角的行动用途可以由旅途重新定义。: I can find new uses for my gifts along the road.
messages.也许学过，也许还缺一段你没找到的来历。我只看见你现在确实能把这一击接住。: Maybe you were taught. Maybe there's a part of the story you haven't found. All I saw was you catch that blow, here and now.
messages.也许明天有人能在这声音里叫我，今天还没有。: Maybe tomorrow someone will call me out of all that sound. No one did today.
messages.书堆会滑，落点选书脊不选书页。: The book pile will slide; choose the book spine instead of the page as the drop point.
messages.书堆会滑，落点选书脊不选书页。 可选旧路：「运书铜环索道」。瞄准上方铜环施展钩索: Book piles will slide, choose the book spine instead of the page. Alternative route: "Book Transport Copper Ring Cable". Aim at the upper copper ring and use the hook cable to open the cable lock.
messages.书库刮掉名字，人就像从来没活过。我不想拿同一把刀给自己找自由。: When the Archive scraped out names, it looked as though those people had never lived. I won't use that same blade to find freedom for myself.
messages.书库只保存被允许保存的事。: The library only stores what is allowed to be stored.
messages.书库只保存被允许保存的事，你先记住路。: The library only stores what is allowed to be stored; remember the path first.
messages.书库回访路线的运书吊环；不改变首次取得双线跃的阶梯。: Book storage return route's book suspension rings; do not change the steps where double thread jumps are obtained for the first time.
messages.书库没有因钟响而合上柜门。我把“自愿”的抄页留在最外层。: The Archive didn't shut its cabinet when the bells returned. I left the copy that says “voluntary” at the very front.
messages.书库的封面，是从我们这里剪走的活皮。: The cover of the library is living leather cut from here.
messages.书库证词告诉我们改字真的伤过人，不只是解释不同。: The archive testimony tells us changing the words really hurt people. It wasn't just a difference of interpretation.
messages.书库说没有阿禾，你还记得他什么？: The Archive says there was no A-He. What do you remember about him?
messages.书库门厅管理员，负责检查誓牌，也把不合规的问题引向假索引。: Keeper of the Archive vestibule. Checks oath plaques and sends questions deemed improper to a false index.
messages.书架托板是单向的，可以从下方穿过。: The shelf board is one-way and can pass through from below.
messages.书架托板是单向的，可以从下方穿过。 西侧二层上方还有一层孤架，单跳够不着。 塔底: The bookshelf ledges are one-way and can be jumped through from below. Above the western second tier sits an isolated shelf out of reach of a single jump. Overhead at the tower base sits a sealed old bell plate that will not ring, as if awaiting an echo.
messages.书脊上的回路通向雨渠；如果决定把名字带回去，请走那条路。: The route along the book spines leads back to the canal. If you decide to take the names home, go that way.
messages.书脊长廊尽头就是中庭书塔。烛台和阅览廊叠在头顶，封存书堆却在另一侧向下延伸；先看: At the end of the Bookspine Gallery stands the courtyard tower. Candelabra and reading galleries rise overhead. The sealed stacks reach down on the far side. Look at the shelves before you take my word for it.
messages.书脊长街可以走，上层是倒置书廊。管理员的指路也请在地图上核对，别全信我。: You can walk the Bookspine Gallery. The Inverted Stacks are above. Check even my directions against your map. Don't just trust me.
messages.书记不是一直站在柜外的人。我把这段话也放进他交来的名单旁。: The scribe hasn't always stood on the outside of the cabinet. I kept these words beside the list he gave me.
messages.书记没有先信我。他让我保住页边，再把取页的位置说了一遍。: The scribe didn't take my word for it at once. He told me to preserve the edges and asked me to describe again where I found the page.
messages.书记留下一个空框。我把它原样带走，等能认出那一字的人来。: The scribe left one square blank. I'll take it with me as it is until someone recognizes the missing character.
messages.书记的帮助源于对记录的责任，也保留判断的边界。: The scribe feels responsible for the records, but knows the limits of what he can verify.
messages.书页决斗者会从架顶俯冲。: Page duelists will dive from the top of the shelf.
messages.书页剑客守护竖井书梯。: The vertical shaft ladder protected by the page swordsman.
messages.书页虫吞掉目录边角，让第七签署者更难被找到。: The page worm eats up the edges of the catalog, making it more difficult to find the seventh signer.
messages.买一枚静靴吧，盐刺听得见鞋底。: Buy a Quiet Boots, the salt thorns can hear the soles of your shoes.
messages.互助可以支持自主行动，不必建立新的依赖命令。: Help can give someone the room to act for themselves without setting up another order to obey.
messages.五个回声室全部无伤通过——王冠自己贴的愿望，板上唯一一条白金色。: All five echo chambers passed without injury - the wish of the crown itself, the only white gold on the board.
messages.五个回声室复考前五章能力，证明印记不是凭证，而是仍在跳动的守门者残心。: The abilities of the five Echo Chambers before the fifth chapter prove that the mark is not a credential, but the remaining heart of the gatewardens who are still beating.
messages.五枚印记会在门上依次亮起，缺少任意主线印记会被门弹回。: The five marks will light up on the door in sequence. Missing any main line mark will cause the door to bounce back.
messages.五枚失声印记和沉默军令全部满足后进入终章。: After satisfying all five Silent Mark and the Silent Military Order, enter the final chapter.
messages.五站快旅网络的水线层站厅，封存态可参观。: The waterline level of the five-stop fast travel network, which can be visited in sealed state.
messages.五章线索拼出第七签署者真名。: The clues from the five chapters reveal the true name of the seventh signatory.
messages.井下传来潮声，像很多人同时呼吸。: The sound of the tide comes from below, like many people breathing at the same time.
messages.井下面有潮水，也有人。别把这两种声音当成同一个敌人。: There's water down the well. There are people too. Don't hear those two sounds as a single enemy.
messages.井又安静下来。安静里仍有没被问过就抵押出去的声音。: The well is quiet again. In the silence are voices that were pledged before anyone asked them.
messages.井口的潮声退了下去，来打水的人照旧一言不发；钟声替他们报时，也替他们沉默。: The sound of the tide at the well mouth has faded away, and those who come to draw water remain silent as before; the bell time signals them, also keeping them silent.
messages.井喉也有证词？那我记下。光记怎么杀，不能算把一个地方看明白了。: Testimony in the well throat too? I'll write that down. You haven't understood a place if all you've recorded is how to kill something in it.
messages.井喉冠门后的旧声；沿井壁抵达井喉深处，取证后循接通的低路返回。: The old sound behind the Well Throat Gate; reach the depths of the Well Throat along the well wall, collect evidence, and return along the low path that connects back.
messages.井喉冠门后，真结局收集品。: Behind the Well Throat Gate, true ending collection items.
messages.井喉只抵押守母自己的心，书库却添了后嗣。世袭不是原约，它是后来加上的条款。: The Well Throat only mortgages its mother's heart, while the library has added descendants. Heredity is not part of the original agreement; it is a clause added later.
messages.井喉的后添刻线，与书库里更深的“后嗣”墨迹放在一起。我终于能指着两处痕迹说，这不: I set the lines added to the throat of the well beside the darker ink of “descendants” in the Archive. At last I can point to both and say this wasn't the original pledge.
messages.井喉那份刻痕我搬不动，只好等你带出来。等人的时候，我把这段路又走了三遍。: I couldn't carry the carving out of the well throat. I had to wait for you. While I waited, I walked this stretch three more times.
messages.井壁上先刻了一颗心，后来才添上细线与小人形。我把两道刻痕分别描下，没有把它们读成: A heart was carved into the well wall first. The thin lines and small figures came later. I traced the two cuts separately. I could not read them as a single promise.
messages.井壁上那些小轮廓，学徒也算一个吗？: Those little figures carved into the well wall. Did they count apprentices too?
messages.井壁刻痕与试音模能互相核对，但我还是不能把师父没说的话补上。: You can check the well carving against the tuning mould. That still doesn't give me words that Master never spoke.
messages.井壁刻的是一颗心，后添的细线却从它牵向许多个更小的轮廓；旧约与世袭并非同一刀刻下: The well wall is engraved with a heart, but the thin line added later leads to many smaller outlines; the old agreement and heredity were not carved by the same knife.
messages.井壁后来添的线很细。细到让人误以为它原本就在那颗心旁边。: The line added later on the well wall is very fine. Fine enough to look as though it had always been beside the heart.
messages.井壁湿滑，无法攀回。: The well wall is slippery and cannot be climbed back.
messages.井壁留下的是承诺的边界，不是一张胜利凭证。: What's carved on the well wall sets bounds to a promise. It's no certificate of victory.
messages.井壁的一颗心牵向许多人；若只画心，不画后来添的线，图就帮人藏了事。: On the well wall one heart is linked to many people. Draw only the heart and leave off the later lines, and the map helps hide what was done.
messages.井底托板裂开一道缝，下面传来钟舌的嗡鸣。: A crack opens in the well-bottom ledge, and the hum of a bell clapper rises from below.
messages.井底有人敲三下，不要回答第四下。: There's someone at the bottom of the well who asks three times; don't respond to the fourth time.
messages.井盖下有话在翻身。线绷紧了——它不想靠近，又不肯离开。: Words stir beneath the well cover. The thread draws tight. It won't come closer. It won't leave.
messages.井边的人开始轮流报潮。每个人都能回答，也能说这一班轮不到我。: The people by the well are taking turns calling out the tide. Everyone can answer. Everyone can say, “This isn't my shift.”
messages.井里的刻痕说守母押上自己的心，没说衣领里每个孩子都要跟着抵押。: The well carving says the Matriarch pledged her heart. It says nothing about pledging every child in every collar too.
messages.井里的声像孩子，我该答应它吗？: The voice in the well sounds like a child. Should I promise it anything?
messages.井里的托板只接得住一次落点。: The board in the well can only withstand one drop point.
messages.井里的证词说清了当事人的边界，你也可以给自己留一道边。: The testimony from the well tells us where one person's promise ended. You're allowed to draw a line of your own.
messages.井里的话原来一直没散。替我留一段空白吧，有些名字我还没有想起来。: Those words in the well never did fade. Leave a bit of cloth blank for me. There are names I still can't remember.
messages.井里那份同意有自己的边界，路上的人也该有停下的边界。: The consent recorded in the well had limits. A traveller should be able to say where they stop too.
messages.井顶的苔灯: Moss lamps at the top of the well
messages.交付将消耗一份信物。: Giving this offering consumes one token.
messages.交付检修灯所需的花粉蜡: Delivered Pollen Wax for the Maintenance Lamps
messages.交班时，下班的人念出接班人的名字，接班的人应一声再上去。水轮的节拍没变，换的是谁: During the shift change, the person leaving reads the name of the person taking over, and the person taking over responds and goes up. The rhythm of the water wheel remains unchanged, but who is guarding it has changed.
messages.交给半沉工头，换取 Boss 前捷径情报。: Give it to the Half-Drowned Foreman to exchange for information on the Boss shortcut.
messages.交给逃亡书记，换取第七签署者偏旁线索。: Give it to the fugitive scribe to exchange for clues about the seventh signer's components.
messages.交谈已经结束，请回到人物身边。: The conversation has ended. Return to the speaker.
messages.交还逃旗手的召回军令: Returned the Recall Order to the Deserter
messages.亮法只差一拍。我从前嫌撤离的人走得慢，补过那一拍，想叫他们快些。: The two signals differ by one beat. I once thought the people evacuating walked too slowly and added that beat to hurry them on.
messages.人从哪班接手，哪只阀修过，都写在水位旁边；那是互相照看的办法。: Who took over from which crew, which valve was mended. We wrote it all beside the water levels. It was how we looked after each other.
messages.人们终于能喊出名字。我要把防潮衣缝结实，新的守夜不能只靠一句自由。: People can finally call one another by name. I'd better sew some stout coats against the tide. A promise of freedom won't keep the night watch warm.
messages.人到西门了。我给他腾了座，差点张嘴问明天能搬几盆苗。: They've reached the west gate. I made room for them to sit and nearly asked how many seedlings they could carry tomorrow.
messages.人声回来了，黑潮也得靠人盯着。灯芯省一省，今夜照路比照货架要紧。: Our voices are back. Someone still has to watch the Blacktide. Save the wicks. Tonight the road needs light more than my shelves do.
messages.人手不够就少开炉，得把这笔账明摆出来。: If we're short of people, we'll run fewer furnaces. Put that cost where everyone can see it.
messages.人物关系应当在任务结束后继续生长。: A relationship should have room to grow after an errand ends.
messages.人物可以带着恐惧行动，不必靠无畏证明正义。: A person can act while afraid. Justice doesn't require a show of fearlessness.
messages.人物的好意与伤害可以同时留下。: Good intentions and injury can leave their marks together.
messages.人物的生活不应只在等待任务交付时存在。: People still have lives to lead while they wait for an errand to be done.
messages.人物的谋生与公共维护可以相连，交付仍应有边界。: Making a living can be part of keeping public things working. There must still be limits to what one delivery asks.
messages.人走了，床位就该空出来；木条能拿下，才分得清是在等人还是只在清点床。: When someone goes, their bunk ought to stand empty. Lift out the slat and you can tell waiting for a person from merely counting beds.
messages.今后的守门册要有签名和退值日期。路过的人不再生来欠这一班。: We'll put signatures and leaving dates in the gate book from now on. No one passing this way is born owing us a shift.
messages.今天先不用给过去起名字。把磨破的那处包好，明天还得用。: No need to give your past a name today. Wrap that sore spot. You'll need your hand tomorrow.
messages.今天先这样。等她愿意说了，我问问旧弦该怎样接。: Leave it at that today. When she wants to talk, I'll ask how best to reconnect the old string.
messages.今天我会先去住处敲门，再回来看阀。多走一趟，水不至于立刻淹上来。: Today I'll knock at the houses before I come back to check the valve. An extra walk won't bring the water over our heads at once.
messages.今天我想去门外再坐一会儿。能从外面看这间屋子，感觉还很陌生。: Today I'd like to sit outside the door a little longer. It's still strange seeing this room from out there.
messages.今天我留到吃完饭再走。饭后想去哪，饭后再定。: Today I'm staying for supper. Where to go afterward can wait until I've eaten.
messages.今天我自己挑了西门这盆苗。明天也许换一盆，也许只坐一会儿。: Today I chose this seedling by the west gate myself. Maybe I'll choose another tomorrow. Maybe I'll just sit.
messages.今天搬苗的人进出，我每回都抬头看一眼，怕自己又只顾着数盆。: Whenever someone came through carrying seedlings today, I looked up. I was afraid I'd start counting only the pots again.
messages.今天有人问我能不能搬水，我说能，两桶。第三桶递来前，他又问了一次。: Someone asked if I could carry water today. I said yes, two buckets. Before handing me a third, they asked again.
messages.今天灯暗时我没有补召集号。桥那边过了很久才回一闪。: When the lamp went dark today I didn't add the muster call. A long time passed before someone flashed back from across the bridge.
messages.今天点到空位，我把那一拍留了出来。很长，长得我差点又开口。: When I reached the empty place today I left a beat open. It felt so long I nearly spoke again.
messages.今天能不等一声命令再起身，对我已经够多了。: Today just being able to stand when I choose without waiting for an order is enough.
messages.今天能把“离队”两个字写全了。我写得很慢，怕手一快又落成“归队”。: Today I wrote out “left the ranks” in full. Slowly, lest my hand slip back into writing “rejoined.”
messages.今天若留在营地，得是我自己留下。让我先想想晚饭想吃什么。: If I stay in camp today, let it be because I chose to. Let me decide what I want for supper first.
messages.今天这页没有刀，也没有命令。我读了很多遍，怕把它忘掉。: No blades on today's page. No orders. I've read it over and over for fear of forgetting it.
messages.今天靠人传递水位。我不召大家献声，只问谁愿帮忙关闸。: Today the water levels will pass from voice to voice. I'm not calling for people to give up their voices. I'm asking who'll help close the sluice.
messages.今晚我去替他站前半夜。他若没听见，我再敲一次。: I'll take the first half of the night for them. If they don't hear me, I'll knock again.
messages.今晚没有钟声，你怎样叫人换班？: How do you call the next watch without the bell tonight?
messages.今晚营地还有地方。你可以先睡，醒了再看要不要追那道光。: There's room at camp tonight. Sleep first and decide when you wake whether to follow that light.
messages.仍有尚未发现的证言。: Some testimony has yet to be found.
messages.从中庭地缝坠入泵井。: Fall into the pump well from the courtyard fissure
messages.从中庭西沿下探立管井口。: Probe the Riser Mouth from the western edge of the courtyard
messages.从前有人敲后门求宿，我嫌钟龛太挤，让他去前殿登记。后来再没听见他敲门。: Someone once knocked at the back gate for a bed. I thought the shrine too crowded, so I sent them to register at the front hall. They never knocked again.
messages.从哨站出发，沿山根古道向东。: Depart from the sentry station, heading east along the Old Foothill Road.
messages.从塌落的湿苔板坠入听潮暗室。: Fall into the Hidden Tide Room from the collapsed wet moss boards
messages.从塌落的湿苔板坠入听潮暗室。 可选：潮影检修室。: Fall into the Hidden Tide Room from the collapsed mossed boards. Alternative: Shadow Maintenance Room.
messages.从环廊西缘下探，找到隐藏石穴。: Descend from the west edge of the ring to find the hidden hollow.
messages.从旧观雨台辨认东侧钟隙渡口。: Identify the Bellgap Crossing on the east side from the old observation tower.
messages.从暗渠尽头穿过水幕，沿暗壁攀回立管井底。: Cross the water curtain from the end of the hidden channel, climb back to the Riser Mouth bottom along the hidden wall
messages.从树冠缺口坠回树心，保持下方枝台可判断: Drop through the gap in the canopy toward Heartwood. Keep the branch platforms below in sight.
messages.从树冠跃入大树内部。: Jump into the interior of the big tree from the crown.
messages.从核心竖井落下后，沿库底折返。: After falling from the Core Shaft, turn back along the basement.
messages.从棚架东角登上树冠步道。: Climb the crown path from the East Corner Trellis.
messages.从水轮内部向上爬。 余响钟可开启挑战房。: Climb up from inside the waterwheel. The lingering bell can be used to open the Challenge Room
messages.从水面突袭，测试墙面攀附的起跳时机。: Launch a surprise attack from the water surface and test the jumping timing while clinging to the wall.
messages.从盐晶门厅出发，向右进入白书脊长廊。: Starting from the Salt Crystal Foyer, head right into the White Bookspine Gallery.
messages.从破旗哨站沿山根向东，灰烬绞盘接通升降笼；西侧砌道绕回营火，再沿上段石路登瞭望塔: Head east from the torn-banner watchpost, along the foot of the mountain. The ash winch connects the lift cage. The west stone road loops to the campfire. Take the upper road to the watchtower. Mirrorpool Gate lies beyond the warm light at the top.
messages.从背面打开的捷径会长期有效。 余响钟可召唤可选首领。: The shortcut opened from the back will be valid for a long time. The Echo Bell can summon an optional boss.
messages.从背面打开的捷径会长期有效。 余响钟可开启追踪狩猎。: The shortcut opened from the back will be valid for a long time. The lingering bell can be used to start a tracking hunt.
messages.从苔钟庭的排水钟管落进上闸口，跟着水走。: Fall into the Upper Sluice from the Moss Bell Court Drainpipe, following the water
messages.从西门读懂温室的呼吸，向下进入根须南廊。: Understand the breath of the greenhouse from the west door and enter the Root Cage South Gallery downward.
messages.从走廊裂口坠入西苔脉。: Fall into the western moss vein from the corridor crack.
messages.从这里能看清你爬过的每一段砌道。: From here, you can see every section of the path you have climbed.
messages.从这里能看清你爬过的每一段砌道。 落旗台上方的旧龛还存着军械碎片，要再跃一次才能: From here, you can see every section of the masonry path you have climbed. The old niche above the flag platform still contains fragments of military equipment, which requires another jump to reach.
messages.从这里能看见首领法庭的白顶。: From here, you can see the white roof of the Covenant Court.
messages.从这里能看见首领穹顶的裂缝。: From here, you can see the cracks in the chief dome.
messages.从钟庭地缝降入根须水窖。: Descend into the root water cellar through the ground fissure of the Bell Court.
messages.他们回了一闪。我先回给他们，不急着朝更远处照。: They flashed back once. I'll answer them first. No hurry to shine beyond them.
messages.他们真的回来了。回来得太整齐，没人再问路。: They really did come back. Back in such neat ranks that no one asked for directions again.
messages.他们终于能说话，第一声却像洪水。: They can finally talk, but the first sound is like a flood.
messages.他们终于能说话，第一声却像洪水。你切断了世袭钟令，六城必须一起承担失去镇潮器的代: At last they can speak. The first voices sound like a flood. You've broken the hereditary bell decree. The six cities must now face the loss of their tideworks together.
messages.他们能说出自己经历的事，也能与你重逢；那并不会变出缺失的原始证词。: They can tell you what happened to them. You can meet them again. That won't bring a missing original testimony into existence.
messages.他们说我是灾难，可我只是在井底学会了说话。: They say I am a disaster, but I only learned to speak at the bottom of a well.
messages.他们说树快活了，叫我再唱一会儿。后来我连“一会儿”有多长都听不清了。: The tree was nearly saved, they said. Sing just a little longer. In the end I could no longer hear how long a little longer was.
messages.他们说没名字的人就不会回答，可你听见我了。: They said someone without a name couldn't answer. But you heard me.
messages.他到了西门，我没先问愿不愿意帮忙。先给他腾了坐的地方。: When they reached the west gate, I didn't ask if they'd help. First I made a place for them to sit.
messages.他只答应搬两桶。我没有把第三桶递过去。: He agreed to carry only two buckets. I didn't hand him the third.
messages.他已经替这里熬过太久。先把茶放着，等他自己说。: They've endured long enough for this place. I'll set down the tea and wait for them to speak.
messages.他已经能离开，我就不该又用修园的需要把他叫回来。: They can leave now. I shouldn't call them back because the garden needs mending.
messages.他把西门低处的苗盆一只只搬上台阶，声音还生涩，先喊你让一让。: He moves the pots from the low ground to the west steps one by one. His voice is still rusty as he calls to you to make way.
messages.他抱我过水沟时，总先把鞋倒过来。里面有水，就倒在自己脚边。: When he carried me over the ditch, he turned his shoes upside down first. If they held water, he tipped it out beside his feet.
messages.他抱我过水沟，总先把鞋里的水倒出来。这样一个人，怎么会没登记就没有了？: When he carried me over the ditch, he'd always tip the water out of his shoes first. How can someone like that be gone just because his name isn't in a book?
messages.他的三连斩结束后，屋里有一段真正的安静。你可以在那时走近，也可以离开。: After his third cut there's a moment of real quiet in the room. You can step closer then, or you can leave.
messages.他终于不再拦着，门外等过的人却未必还在。: At last he's no longer in the way. Whoever waited outside may be long gone.
messages.他讲了太多年，终于有人能插一句话。今晚我让囚徒先唱，不替他们定调。: He preached for years. At last someone can get a word in. Tonight the prisoners sing first. I won't pitch the note for them.
messages.以书塔为枢纽：西二层是阅览廊，东三层是反页廊，塔底盐门通向东侧地面。: With the book tower as a hub: the second floor to the west is the reading gallery, the third floor to the east is the reverse page gallery, and the salt gate at the bottom leads to the eastern ground.
messages.以六份原始证词重立契约，将世袭改回自愿。: Use six original testimonies to draw up a covenant that replaces hereditary duty with voluntary service.
messages.以前会。我说前面更安全，他就跟我走了；其实我也没去看过后面。: I used to. I'd tell them it was safer ahead and they'd follow me. Truth is, I hadn't even looked behind.
messages.以前多亮一拍就能把队伍叫回来。现在我宁肯一遍遍照出能落脚的石头。: One extra beat used to bring the whole column back. Now I'd sooner light each stone they can step on, again and again.
messages.以前我数工时，现在数回来的人。换了本账，日子才好过一点。: I used to count working hours. Now I count the people who come back. Life's a little easier with a different ledger.
messages.以后想不起时可以回来。地图放这儿，不用每次都跳得更高。: Come back when you can't remember. The map will be here. You needn't jump higher every time.
messages.以后我读出声吧。孩子们若问错了字，我会改，不会责备他们。: Perhaps I'll read aloud from now on. When children get a character wrong, I'll help them with it. I won't scold.
messages.以后有人来接手，得让他知道哪一种照料曾经把树弄伤。: The next person who takes over should know what kind of care once injured the tree.
messages.以后有人来问怎么签，我先给他看退出的那一行。: When someone asks how to sign, I'll show them the line about withdrawing first.
messages.以后若你找到自己的东西，也可以先给我看。我不会先问它能做什么。: If you find something of your own, show it to me first if you like. I won't start by asking what it's for.
messages.以后若我没来，你可以找我说话，但别一开口就问为什么没上工。: If I don't come one day, come and talk to me if you like. Just don't begin by asking why I haven't shown up for work.
messages.以后还会等得心慌。你若经过，替我看看是不是又在催了。: The waiting will still frighten me sometimes. If you're passing, look and see whether I'm hurrying them again.
messages.以大树之心为枢纽：下有根库拉杆，西有断弦辐桥，上可回树冠。: With the Heartwood as the hub: there is a Root Vault lever below, a Broken String Spoke Bridge to the west, and you can return to the crown above.
messages.以大树之心为枢纽：下有根库拉杆，西有断弦辐桥，上可回树冠。 可选：棘线下劈练习工: Using Heartwood as the hub: there is a Root Vault pull rod below, a Broken String Spoke Bridge to the west, and a return to the tree crown above. Alternative: Thorn Downstrike Practice Workshop.
messages.以泵房中庭为枢纽：上读水表、西攀立管、下探沉渠、东讨锤炉。: Use the Pumphouse Atrium as a hub: read the water meter, climb the Riser, probe the sink canal, and seek the Hammerforge
messages.以泵房中庭为枢纽：上读水表、西攀立管、下探沉渠、东讨锤炉。 可选：泵房上检修舱。: Using the Pumphouse Atrium as the hub: read the water meter above, climb the pipe to the west, explore the sinkhole below, and search for the hammer furnace to the east. Alternative: Pumphouse Upper Maintenance Cabin.
messages.以自己的名字参加温室修复。: Signs up to repair the Greenhouse under their own name.
messages.以营火为枢纽：东侧砌道通向瞭望塔，升降笼回山根，头顶旗桥通往军墓。: With the campfire as the hub: The east path leads to the watchtower, the lift cage returns to the Old Foothill Road, and the flag bridge above leads to the military tomb.
messages.以营火为枢纽：东侧砌道通向瞭望塔，升降笼回山根，头顶旗桥通往军墓。 可选：灯影相: Using the campfire as the hub: the eastern masonry path leads to the Watchtower, the lifting cage returns to the mountain root, and the banner bridge above leads to the military tomb. Alternative: Lantern Phase Practice Workshop.
messages.以钟庭为枢纽：上攀钟塔、下探水窖、西寻苔脉、东讨守母。: Use the Bell Court as a hub: climb the Bell Tower, explore the water cellar below, search for the moss vein to the west, and seek out the Moss Bell Matriarch to the east.
messages.仰望盐白档案馆的风口。: Look up at the Saltwhite Archive's wind entrance.
messages.任务完成可以带来变化，也应容纳未消失的悲伤。: Finishing an errand can change things without taking away the grief that remains.
messages.会。一直发令的人，也可能忘记怎样让一句令结束。: Yes. Give orders for long enough and you may forget how to bring one to an end.
messages.会。困住我的根旁边也长着我认得的叶，我没法把记忆分得那么齐。: Yes. Leaves I know grew beside the roots that held me. I can't sort my memories into neat piles.
messages.会。所以我不能替每个人决定把工牌挂到哪面墙上。: Yes. That's why I can't choose for everyone which wall their badge should hang on.
messages.会先看最后确认过的位置。以前我只数到齐没有，从没记谁在哪儿停过。: I'll check the last place they were seen first. I used to count only whether everyone was there. I never recorded who stopped where.
messages.会把那条路留着，也会把仍被压住的名字念给你听。: I'll leave that road open. I'll also read aloud the names it would leave bound.
messages.会有人这样做，所以我会在页边留下疑问，而不把没听到的部分编成回答。: Someone might. That's why I'll leave a question in the margin instead of making up an answer I never heard.
messages.会错过一段路，也可能看见脚边漏掉的台阶。我没法替你算哪样更值。: A stretch of road, perhaps. You might also see a step you missed by your feet. I can't tell you which is worth more.
messages.传承技艺要与继承债务分开。: Passing down a craft is different from handing down a debt.
messages.但今晚的潮不会因为这一声高兴就自己退下去，衣缝还是得结实。: But tonight's tide won't go out by itself for the joy of that sound. The seams still need to hold.
messages.但你右手收得急。无论以前谁教过，今天这一下会伤手腕。我能替你改的是这个。: But you snap your right hand back too quickly. Whoever taught you, today that will hurt your wrist. That's something I can help you change.
messages.但你要我把它举起来，我会怕。怕一举，又有人以为我替他们答应了。: But ask me to raise it and I'm afraid. Once it's up, someone might think I've agreed on their behalf again.
messages.但压页台的用途能被改，我也不能因为怕，就把手里能核对的东西全藏死。: The press was turned to a different use. I can't let fear make me lock away everything I could help to check.
messages.但想念不能替铜箍辩解；我看过它接向哪里。: Missing this place doesn't excuse the copper hoop. I've seen where it's connected.
messages.但稳定的水声，不能盖过还没归还的那些话。: But a steady sound of water mustn't drown out the words that still haven't been returned.
messages.低照度，孢虫巢就在头顶。: Low light, with the spore worm nest right above you.
messages.低照度，水面下有影子。: Low illumination, with shadows under the water surface
messages.低路通行，高台眺望: Follow the lower path and survey the area from the high platform.
messages.低身位贴地咬，逼玩家练习下斩和后撤。: Lie down close to the ground and bite, forcing players to practice chopping and retreating.
messages.低顶通道，无法起跳。: The low ceiling leaves no room to jump.
messages.住处、工坊、井边的落脚处，少画一个，走错路的人可不会摔在纸上。: Houses, workshops, a foothold by the well. Leave one out and the one who takes a wrong turn won't land on paper.
messages.住处。我若先保炉火，屋里的人就得替我涉水。可炉子一熄，明天修闸的铁也得等。: The houses. If I put the furnace first, people will have to wade through their rooms. But if the furnace goes out, the iron for tomorrow's sluice repairs will be late.
messages.住处还靠它进水。管子替人做过坏事，不代表把它砸了就没人挨饿。: The houses still get their water through them. The pipes were put to cruel use. Break them all and people may go hungry.
messages.住处那一支阀还在，我们仍要给活着的人留水。: The valve for the houses is still here. We still have to leave water for the living.
messages.余响钟 · 冠隙试炼: Bellgap Test: The empty cavity of the inverted giant bell.
messages.余响钟 · 封蜡库可选首领: Echo Bell · Sealing Wax Vault optional boss
messages.余声针匣原本装的是补旗的针，不是军令。交给你多放一件战具，但每次特殊技能会多费一: This Echo Needle Case held mending needles for the flag. No orders tucked away in it. It'll give you room for one more combat tool, but each special skill will cost a little more energy.

messages.你一直保管契约，为什么没把它交出去？: You've kept the covenant all this time. Why didn't you hand it over?
messages.你不必为了让别人认得，就一直留在他们第一次看见的位置。: You don't have to stay where people first saw you just so they'll recognise you.
messages.你不必为了证明往前走过，就再走一遍危险的高台。: You needn't cross those dangerous high platforms again just to prove you once went forward.
messages.你不用唱。让它别把我的指头勒紧，就已经帮上忙了。: You needn't sing. Keeping it from biting into my fingers is help enough.
messages.你为什么一定要先看军册？: Why must you see the muster roll first?
messages.你为什么不自己去拿军令？: Why don't you go and get the order yourself?
messages.你为什么只读页边，不读大字？: Why read only the margins and leave the big print alone?
messages.你为什么愿意替陌生人核对名字？: Why would you check names for a stranger?
messages.你为什么把师父的针交给陌生人？: Why give your master's needle to a stranger?
messages.你为什么盯着页边看？: Why do you look so closely at the edges?
messages.你为什么认得不同的敲击？: How do you recognize all the different knocks?
messages.你为什么让我去听，而不是带一件宝物？: Why ask me to listen instead of bringing back a treasure?
messages.你也别急着把自己分成门前门后两个人。先看看今天还想往哪走。: Don't rush to divide yourself into a person before the gate and someone else after it. See where you'd like to go today first.
messages.你今晚给谁回光？: Who are you signalling back to tonight?
messages.你仍得看清手里握住了什么，以及哪些不该继续由一只手握着。: See clearly what you're holding, and which things should no longer be held in a single hand.
messages.你从压页台走来，应该知道保存与删去有时只隔一个动作。: You've been to the press. You know preservation and erasure can be a single gesture apart.
messages.你以后再来，也可以什么都不带。那把椅子不按交货的次数算。: Come empty-handed another time if you like. That chair doesn't go by number of deliveries.
messages.你以后可以只来坐一会儿，不必每次都带回一件结果。: Another time just come and sit. You needn't bring proof of something done on every visit.
messages.你会不会把回头的人再送回队里？: Would you lead someone who turns back into the ranks again?
messages.你停在西门，等他自己走出那一步。: You wait at the west gate until they take that step themselves.
messages.你先别走，替我按住这一角。别拉紧，布会皱。: Don't go just yet. Hold this corner down for me. Gently, or the cloth will pucker.
messages.你先问他要接在哪一头，再递出绳端。: You ask which end needs extending before handing over your rope.
messages.你击败的是执剪者；水下留下的名字才是湛想让人带走的。: You defeated the Apostle. Under the water are the names Zhan wanted someone to take away.
messages.你刚来时也不知道往哪走。我就把它交了，像是这样我们两个都能往前挪一点。: You didn't know which way to go when you arrived either. I handed it to you. It felt as though we might both move a little if I did.
messages.你别替我把这本烧了。我还想把祖母写的小字找完。: Don't burn this book for me. I still want to find all the little notes Grandmother wrote.
messages.你别笑。我还不太习惯门真的会放我过去。: Don't laugh. It still feels strange that the gate really will let me through.
messages.你去书库，先说他的名字。要是他们问编号，你回来问我，别随便挑一个。: Say his name first at the Archive. If they want a number, come back and ask me. Don't just choose one.
messages.你去问书库。要是他们还问编号，就回来找我，别随便挑一个。: Go ask the Archive. If they want a number again, come back to me. Don't just pick one.
messages.你可以先停下来，重读手里的话，再决定怎样承担。: You can stop here, reread what you hold, then decide what you're prepared to take on.
messages.你可以去看完再决定带不带。我怕你也被叫住，更怕自己假装这点不重要。: Go look and decide afterward if you want to bring it back. I'm afraid the call might catch you too. More afraid still that I'll pretend it doesn't matter.
messages.你可以失望。但先站稳，再想；别在半空追一个不肯落地的答案。: You're allowed to be disappointed. Find your footing first and think afterward. Don't chase an answer in midair if it won't come down.
messages.你可以把我看见的这一把小钥匙带着想；别说你已经听懂了整口井。: Think about that little key I saw. Don't say you've understood the whole well.
messages.你可以拿告解与钥位核对，不必把猜测也当成铁铸的事实。: Check the confession against the key slot. No need to treat guesswork as though it were cast iron.
messages.你可以用能力打开问题，不必让能力替你回答问题。: You can use a gift to open up a question. You needn't let it answer for you.
messages.你可以等自己想清楚再回来。井口的绳子会留着。: You can come back when you've made up your mind. We'll leave the rope at the mouth of the well.
messages.你可以骂他，也可以替他难过。可缺的那一个名字，别替告解补上。: Curse him if you like, or grieve for him. But don't fill in the missing name for his confession.
messages.你同我试过的那段信号用上了。三短一长，先报平安，再说下一步。: We used the signal we tested together. Three short, one long. First let them know you're safe. Then work out the next move.
messages.你听见我了吗？以前只有他们往井里说话，我往上说的，总被当作水声。: Can you hear me? People used to call down into the well. Whenever I called back, they thought it was water.
messages.你听见的我，和我听见的一样吗？: Do you hear the same person I hear in myself?
messages.你听见的我，是什么声音？: What do I sound like to you?
messages.你听见雨，说明你还没听见铁。: If you hear the rain, it means you haven’t heard the iron yet.
messages.你告诉园丁把灯留着就好。我看得见，走得动的时候会去。: Just ask the gardener to leave the lamp. I can see it. I'll go when my legs will carry me.
messages.你回来了。我想了一路的谢辞，真见到名单却一句也没用上。: You're back. I've had a whole speech of thanks in my head. Seeing the list, I can't use a word of it.
messages.你在井壁找到的那根细线，比献心的刻痕新。师父没教过我怎样把它拆开。: The fine line you found on the well wall is newer than the carving of the pledged heart. Master never taught me to unpick it.
messages.你在听。我停下说爹的时候，你没有马上走。: You listen. When I stopped to talk about Dad, you didn't go straight away.
messages.你在这里坐一会儿就好。等烦了可以走，不必替我把安静守成一项差事。: Just sit here a while. Leave if you get bored. You needn't turn keeping me company in silence into a duty.
messages.你在问是谁说话，还是在问为什么听起来像你认识的谁？这两句不一样。: Are you asking who's speaking, or why the voice sounds like someone you know? Those are different questions.
messages.你坐下，我就翻慢一点。书不嫌读者慢，嫌读者不肯看完。: Sit down and I'll turn the pages more slowly. A book doesn't mind a slow reader. It minds one who won't read to the end.
messages.你坐到他看得见的地方，留出一段安静。: You take a seat where he can see you and leave a little room for silence.
messages.你坐到针案旁，把空着的手放在膝上。: You sit beside the sewing bench, empty hands resting on your knees.
messages.你学会架铃了。若有人要你立刻签字，先像面对刀那样，替自己挡一下。: You've learned to raise the bell guard. If someone tells you to sign on the spot, protect yourself as you would against a blade.
messages.你将六枚线结并排，针尖轻触共同的回声。: You lay the six knots side by side and touch the needle to their shared echo.
messages.你已找到部分证词。背包中的每份原话都对应一座城，缺页可以逐城回访。: You've found some of the testimony. Each voice in your pack belongs to a city. For the missing pages, Return those cities one by one.
messages.你已拿到铃护。架住一次攻击后别急着反击，螳将会用第二刀询问你。: You have the Bell Guard now. Don't rush your counter after a parry. The Mantis Warlord likes to ask a second question with his blade.
messages.你已经会先问这一句了。可我不能拿它给你发一张不会犯错的凭据。: You've learned to ask before you set it down. I can't give you a certificate saying that means you'll never make a mistake.
messages.你已经看过根系怎样把养护接成命令，不该再接一次。: You've seen the roots turn care into an order. Don't join them that way again.
messages.你师父的针，为什么一直没缝名字？: Why have you never used your master's needle to stitch a name?
messages.你带回工牌以后，我们又多了一件能一起看的东西。: Now you've brought that work tag back, we have one more thing we can look at together.
messages.你带回来的刻痕至少留下了一件能核对的事：她押的是自己。: That carving you brought back leaves us one thing we can check: it was herself she pledged.
messages.你带回的刻痕把两件事分开了：押上自己的心，与替后人答应，不是同一次承诺。: The carving you brought back separates two things: pledging your own heart and making a promise for your children. They weren't the same pledge.
messages.你带回的名字如今能在人声里再说一遍，我很想听。: The names you brought home can be spoken in human voices again. I'd like to hear them.
messages.你带回的名字已经有了各自的位置，不必再挤成一段无人认领的声。: The names you brought back each have their own place now. They needn't crowd together into a sound nobody claims.
messages.你带回的名字已经留在线结里，它们没有因为钟响就失去意义。: The names you brought back are in the knots now. The bells ringing hasn't made them meaningless.
messages.你带回的名字曾经被刮掉过。现在有人撤签，我会保留他曾经签过的那一行，再记撤签的日: The names you brought back were scraped out once. Now if someone withdraws, I'll keep the line they signed and add the date they withdrew.
messages.你带来六个彼此独立的声音，冠不能再假称无人反对。: You've brought six independent voices. The Crown can no longer pretend no one objects.
messages.你带来的井壁刻痕也只说清一段承诺，没要求它替人讲完一生。: Those marks you brought back from the well testify to one promise. No one asked them to tell a whole life.
messages.你带来的军册让我们能说清，是哪一声把归途改成队列。: The roll you brought lets us name the call that turned a road home into a column of soldiers.
messages.你带来的原页能说明被改过什么，不能替每个人决定谁有权翻看他。: The original you brought shows what was altered. It can't decide for each person who has the right to read about them.
messages.你带来的是六城的事，不能只在这间屋子里听见自己的回声。: What you've brought here concerns six cities. Don't listen only to your own echo in this room.
messages.你带来的每份话都从住处、工坊、书架和路边来，不能只在门前才算有用。: Every voice you've brought came from a home, a workshop, a shelf or a roadside. They weren't spoken just to be useful at the gate.
messages.你带来的证词又给我们一条能核对的线。: The testimony you brought gives us another thread we can check.
messages.你带来的证词说明哪里把养护改成了索取。: Your testimony shows where tending turned into taking.
messages.你带着原件，目录就不能再替我回答了。: You're holding the original. The catalogue can't answer for me now.
messages.你带走副本，先回到有权说你做错的人那里。: You take the copy back to the people with the right to tell you where you went wrong.
messages.你帮忙把名字送回去，让我至少不用再说这里只有班次。: By helping take the names home, you at least spared me having to say all we have here are shifts.
messages.你帮的是这一次辨认，不必往后每声军号都替我挡住。: You helped me recognize it this time. You needn't stand between me and every bugle call to come.
messages.你应该这样问。拿工牌来，同雨渠孩子念的音、柳认出的铆痕一起对。: That's the right question. Bring the badges. Check the sounds the canal child spoke against the rivet Liu recognized.
messages.你当时肯等我把左脚放稳，我才有机会走到这里。: You waited for me to steady my left foot back then. That's how I got the chance to walk this far.
messages.你循着那声呼喊转身，把第一块挡潮板递过去。: You turn toward the call and pass over the first flood board.
messages.你怕这次核对又带来麻烦吗？: Are you afraid another check will bring trouble?
messages.你想把自己的名字从军册里抹掉吗？: Do you want your name erased from the roll?
messages.你想让我向外面的人说什么？: What would you like me to tell the people outside?
messages.你想讲别的路，我也会听。: If you want to talk about another road, I'll listen.
messages.你愿意交还决定权，而不是成为替众人作答的新王吗？: Will you hand the decision back to the people, even when you could become the new ruler who answers for them?
messages.你愿意以延续旧约，换取眼前的安稳吗？: Will you renew the old covenant for the sake of the peace it offers now?
messages.你愿意切断旧约，并与六城承担自由之后的险境吗？: Will you break the old covenant and share with the six cities the dangers that follow their freedom?
messages.你愿意唱，就代表愿意永远唱吗？: Does agreeing to sing mean agreeing to sing forever?
messages.你愿意改的时候告诉我，我再学着叫。: Tell me if you want to change it. I'll learn the new one.
messages.你手里有书库证词，就把能核对的那一页添到图旁。: With the archive testimony in hand, you can set one page we can verify beside the map.
messages.你手里的告解又添了一处能核对的痕。: The confession in your hands gives you another mark to check.
messages.你手里的改字页提醒我们，方便的补写也可能变成伤害。: That altered page you're holding reminds us what harm a convenient addition can do.
messages.你手里的页要与具体的刮痕相认，不能只与一个官衔相认。: Match the page you're holding to marks you can see, not just to an official title.
messages.你打倒的灰冠螳将是这座书库眼下的守门者。: The Ash-Crowned Mantis Warlord you brought down was the Archive's present guardian.
messages.你打开井盖时用的是叩，不是砸。井里的声音会记得这一点。: You knocked on the well cover before you opened it. You didn't smash it. The voices down there will remember.
messages.你打开后门以后，回 Boss 的路会短很多。: After you open the back door, the way back to the Boss will be much shorter.
messages.你打断了那场礼拜。我想先把衣领缝松一点，让人能抬头。: You've interrupted that rite. I'd like to start by sewing the collars a little looser so people can look up.
messages.你打败看守后，我能把旧表取下来核对。: Now you've beaten the guard, I can take the old roster down and check it.
messages.你扶稳高处的灯架，等她调好灯芯。: You steady the lampstand on the high ground while she adjusts the wick.
messages.你找到的军册已经说明了军令的代价。我的灯号不会替你决定结局。: The muster roll you found shows what the orders have cost. My lights won't choose your ending.
messages.你找到的刻痕比我可靠：一颗心是旧的，小人形是后添的。先把这两样分开带走。: The carvings you found are better witnesses than I am. The heart is old. The little figures came later. Take them away as two separate things.
messages.你找到的白边，比一段写得很整齐的结论更让我停下来。: That white edge you found stops me longer than any neatly written conclusion.
messages.你找到花粉蜡了。看，灯芯不再被雨打灭。: You found the pollen wax. Look! The rain can't put the wick out now.
messages.你找回的原页让我知道，留白不会把一座城弄坏；擅自补字却会。: From the original page you brought back I learned that a blank won't break a city. Putting words in without leave can.
messages.你把两处的话带回来了，我能开始缝，仍不能说他们因此全都回来了。: You brought me words from both places. I can begin to sew. I still can't say everyone has come home because of it.
messages.你把六份证词铺开，将自己的线结放在空白处。: You lay the six testimonies out and set your own knot in the empty space.
messages.你把名字交出去了，我也得把自己的那一笔交出去。: You gave the names back. I have to own my own stroke of the pen too.
messages.你把名字带回去了，查验也因此有了人能接住的地方。: You brought the names home. Now there are people who can receive what we find.
messages.你把名字带回来，我得让它真在这里被叫上一声。: You brought the names home. I have to make sure we actually call them here.
messages.你把孩子说的那一处针脚指给学徒，没有替他许诺一个回家日期。: You point out the stitch the child mentioned. You make no promise about when their father will come home.
messages.你把它带来，我才知道该剪断哪根召集线。我会去巡礼营地，不再替王冠举旗。: Now you've brought it here I know which muster thread to cut. I'll go to the Pilgrim Camp. I won't carry the Crown's flag anymore.
messages.你把工具放在门边，给他留出离开的位置。: You set the tools beside the door and leave them a clear way out.
messages.你把工牌捞上来，我才又敢说这里住过人。别急着把他们留下的东西也一并砸了。: It was when you fished up that badge that I dared say people used to live here. Don't rush to smash the things they left behind as well.
messages.你把布角翻到刻名的一面，没有替空格补字。: You turn back the corner that bears the names. You leave the gaps unfilled.
messages.你把灯罩转向她指的根缝。: You turn the shade toward the gap she points to.
messages.你把爹的工牌拿稳了，我就把它交给你。: You held Dad's badge carefully. That's why I handed it to you.
messages.你把空着的手摊给商人看，他挪开灯旁一只凳子。: You show the merchant your empty hands. They clear a stool beside the lamp.
messages.你把空着的灯钩递回她手里。: You put the empty lamp hook back in her hand.
messages.你把空着的那一栏留好，等下一次回答。: You leave the space open for their next answer.
messages.你把第三只桶留在地上，在他旁边坐了一会儿。: You leave the third bucket on the ground and sit beside him for a while.
messages.你把纸放下，我才敢看它。第一次读完，没有立刻收旗。: Only once you set the paper down could I bear to look at it. For the first time I read to the end without furling the flag at once.
messages.你把线端递给囚徒，指向西门。: You pass the end of the thread to the prisoner and point toward the west gate.
messages.你把衣领翻到刻名的一面，交还给学徒。: You turn the collar to show the name and hand it back.
messages.你把记号停在空格外，没有替她添下一班。: You keep your mark outside the empty square, leaving her next shift unwritten.
messages.你把轮值纸按稳，只留下他亲手写下的一行。: You hold the rota steady. Only the line he wrote himself stays on the page.
messages.你把这段带去王冠吧。别只写“温室供弦”，写下唱的人叫徽。: Take that to the Crown. Don't just write “strings supplied by the Greenhouse.” Write down that the singer was called Hui.
messages.你把那只险些落井的桶扶稳，抬头等了一阵。: You steady the bucket before it slips into the well, then look up and wait.
messages.你把那截松线留在他够得到的位置。: You leave the loose thread within reach.
messages.你把针横在掌心，点头，收进还留着空处的行囊。: You lay the needle across your palm, nod, and slip it into the space you've kept in your pack.
messages.你拿到的伤口说明，树活着也有好几种接法。旧箍最省事，未必最能让它活久。: The scar you found shows there's more than one way to keep a tree alive. The old hoop is easiest. It may not keep the tree alive the longest.
messages.你拿走印记，黑曜巡礼军就会听见你。: If you take the mark, the Obsidian Pilgrimage Army will hear you.
messages.你按住布角，给搬挡潮板的人让出一只手。: You hold the cloth so the person moving the flood boards has a hand free.
messages.你按那段灯号回了一次光。: You answer once with the same pattern.
messages.你握住修好的铜徽章，向工匠欠身。: You close your hand around the mended copper badge and bow to the smith.
messages.你收花粉蜡，是为了多做生意吗？: Are you collecting pollen wax to sell more goods?
messages.你收起军令，把灯转向回程的石阶。: You fold away the order and turn the light toward the steps home.
messages.你收针，沿来时量过的台阶下去。: You put your needle away and go down the steps you measured on the way up.
messages.你曾把名字带回相识的人那里，知道一份记录怎样才会有人接住。: You took the names home to people who knew them. You know what lets a record find someone to receive it.
messages.你替她遮住侧面的风，等下一个人报平安。: You shelter the lamp from a crosswind and wait with her for the next person to call back.
messages.你替我留下能再联系的方法就好，不必许诺永远护着我。: Just leave me a way to reach you again. You needn't promise to protect me forever.
messages.你有冲刺，我得把几条红线擦掉。但冠裂隙的残页，我这双手还取不到。: Now you can dash, I'll have to erase some of these red lines. But my hands still can't reach the torn page in the Crown Fissure.
messages.你每次点名，是在等谁回答？: When you call the roll, whose answer are you waiting for?
messages.你没拔刀，我听得出。甲叶碰针刃的声音，和普通脚步不一样。: You didn't draw your blade. I can hear it. Armour brushing a needle blade doesn't sound like footsteps.
messages.你没有收起改字原页，把它放在新送来的班表旁。: You leave out the altered original and lay it beside the new rota.
messages.你没有替他把那段线重新接上。: You leave the broken ends of his thread apart.
messages.你添好灯里的蜡，等下一位守夜者来取。: You top up the wax and wait for the next night watcher to collect the lamp.
messages.你现在就可以试着在营地停一会儿。: You can try it now. Stay at camp a little while.
messages.你用针尖指向原件，把空白处留给名字。: You point your needle at the original and leave the blank space for a name.
messages.你留下回声，是想让我替你做完吗？: Did you leave an echo so I could finish what you started?
messages.你的下劈够利了。敲蜡时轻一点，我卖的是封灯的料，不是练刀的靶子。: That downcut of yours is sharp enough. Go gently with the wax. I sell it to seal lamps, not to give you something to try your blade on.
messages.你的共鸣碰到裂缝了。这一次声音不是命令，我需要一点时间习惯。: Your resonance touched the crack. This time the sound isn't an order. Give me a moment to get used to it.
messages.你的图为什么把钟殿画得这么小？: Why is the bell hall so small on your map?
messages.你的检修灯为什么总往低处挂？: Why do you always hang the maintenance lamps down low?
messages.你的灯影过了我肩头。用它绕过军阵也好，勇敢不只是在正面站着。: Your shadowlight passed over my shoulder. Go round the ranks with it if you like. Standing right in front of them isn't the only kind of courage.
messages.你的线会唱歌，碰到我不疼。“不疼”这个词，我今天才真的学会。: Your thread can sing. It doesn't hurt when it touches me. Today I finally learned what “doesn't hurt” means.
messages.你的线能往下斩了。别把每次断开都当成伤害，有的东西等着被放出来。: Your thread can cut downward now. A severed tie isn't always a wound. Some things are waiting to be set free.
messages.你的线能挂住墙了。顺便看看高处那班工人留下的徽章，他们没来领。: Your thread holds to the wall now. See if you can find the badges the crew left up high. They never came to claim them.
messages.你看完水尺，把自己能守的时段说清，没有填满剩下的空栏。: You read the water gauge and say which hours you can keep, leaving the other spaces free.
messages.你看见的养根槽已经有好几次接续；不存在一层毫无改动的现在。: You've seen the trough. The joins come from several times. There is no single, untouched layer we could call the present.
messages.你看过养根槽，检修的人得先看清伤处，才不至于越帮越紧。: You've seen the root trough. Anyone repairing it must see where the wound is first, or their help may only tighten its grip.
messages.你看过模子，也看过井壁；一处问人听不听见，一处替人答应了。: You've seen the mould and the well wall. One asked if the people could hear. At the other, someone answered for them.
messages.你看，“自愿”旁的纤维翘着，“后嗣”的墨却沉进去了。不是同一次落笔。: See the raised fibres beside “voluntary”? The ink in “descendants” has sunk deep. Those words weren't written at the same sitting.
messages.你看，我的手已经能伸出来一点。根以为抱住就是保护，我一直没能解释。: Look, I can get my hand out a little now. The roots think holding tight is the same as keeping me safe. I've never managed to explain.
messages.你离开后还会想念温室吗？: Will you miss the Greenhouse when you leave?
messages.你第一次在我这儿拿针，先看了针眼，再看自己的手。我记得的只有那一次。: The first time you took a needle from me, you looked at the eye and then at your hand. That's the only time I remember.
messages.你等他们读完，在自己准备守的时段系下一结。: You wait until they've finished reading, then tie a knot beside the hours you mean to keep.
messages.你等他把最后一盆苗挪稳，才收回线端。: You wait until his last pot sits steady before winding in the end of your thread.
messages.你等他点头，才把水桶递过去。: You wait for him to nod before passing him a bucket.
messages.你等她收光，才回了一次表示收到的短光。: You wait until she lowers her lamp, then flash a single short acknowledgement.
messages.你等那一轮灯号过去，没有跟着钟声抬手。: You wait for the lights to finish their round without raising your hand to the bell.
messages.你给我讲讲路上吧。这回先不找名单，也不派下一件事。: Tell me about the road. We can leave the list alone for a while. I haven't another errand for you.
messages.你能用它越过一处裂口，也能停下来听一段歌。用途不是在醒来那天就写尽了。: You can use it to cross a cleft. You can also stop to hear a song. The day you woke up didn't settle every use you might find for it.
messages.你能破根封了？那别急着试在我身上，先找笼子的结，结比枝条怕疼。: You can break the root seal now? Don't try it on me just yet. Find the knot in the cage. The knot gives more easily than the branches.
messages.你能穿过影门，也看过军册。现在才有条件区分求救灯与集合令。: You've passed the shadow gate and seen the roll. Now we can tell a distress light from a call to muster.
messages.你能穿过暗封了。若路上遇见被困的兵，告诉他们，离开不必先证明自己勇敢。: You can pass the dark seals now. If you find soldiers trapped there, tell them no one needs to prove their courage before they're allowed to leave.
messages.你能让她停下眼前的动作。那份约如何改变，还得靠能核对的文字与人。: You can stop what she's doing before your eyes. Changing the pledge still takes words and people whose accounts can be checked.
messages.你能过那道裂缝了？好。回来时别冲太快，我这把骨头躲不开。: You can cross that gap now? Good. Take it slowly on the way back. These old bones can't jump aside.
messages.你能进门了。我最后再说一次：潮会不会退，和谁失去声音，是两栏。: You can pass. I'll say it once more: whether the tide recedes and who loses their voice belong in separate columns.
messages.你若先碰到他们，别替我把师父说得太好了。我连他发脾气的样子都快忘了。: If you meet them first, don't make Master sound too good on my account. I've almost forgotten what he was like in a temper.
messages.你若全拿走，后来的人会不会以为这里没有工人？: If you take every one, will people coming after think there were never any workers here?
messages.你若去雨渠，先看落脚处，再看对岸。别只看对岸。: If you go to the canal, look at your landing before you look across. Don't just stare at the other bank.
messages.你若去雨渠，问问等下工钟的那个孩子，再去书库核对。先把查到的带回来，不必替我保证: If you go to the canal, ask the child waiting for the shift bell. Then check the Archive. Bring back whatever you find. You don't have to promise you'll find them all.
messages.你若只来歇脚，也能进门。别每次看见我就觉得该往行囊里找东西。: You're welcome to come in just to rest. Don't start rummaging in your pack every time you see me.
messages.你若听见安静，先别急着替我把弦拉紧。: If you hear silence, wait before tightening the strings for me.
messages.你若愿意听，我们就再坐一会儿。: If you're willing to listen, let's sit together a little longer.
messages.你若愿意，我仍叫它归途；不必给归途另设一场考验。: If you like I'll still call it the road home. There's no need to invent another trial for taking it.
messages.你若找到关于自己的记录，也可以先问它是谁写、为何写。: If you find a record about yourself, you can start by asking who wrote it, and why.
messages.你若找见盐晶，请留一粒给灯芯。档案室还会等一些迟到的读者。: If you find a salt crystal, save one grain for the wick. The records room will stay open for a few late readers.
messages.你若没有带来六处证词，就只能做一个干净的错误选择。: If you don’t bring six testimonies, you can only make a clean mistake.
messages.你若肯去，先问他还能不能站，别只替我带句原谅回来。: If you'll go, first ask if they can still stand. Don't just bring me word of forgiveness.
messages.你若要我帮忙，直接叫我。别叫旗手，先叫我一声。: If you want my help, call me directly. Leave off “standard-bearer.” Call me first.
messages.你若要走，不必替我说他一定会回来。: If you must go, you needn't promise me he'll come back.
messages.你若见到没人接，回来骂我也好，别以为是自己走错了。: If no one meets you, come back and curse me if you like. Don't assume you took the wrong road.
messages.你若觉得在催，伸手告诉我。我宁肯多等一阵。: If it feels as though I'm hurrying you, raise a hand. I'd sooner wait.
messages.你若觉得自己终于被认出来了，也先看看这把锁还扣着谁。: If you feel someone has finally recognized you, first look at who else that lock is holding.
messages.你若还不会，就先走能走的路。歌守留下的证词在别处，不用困在这里等我。: If you haven't learned it, go where you can for now. The Songwarden's testimony is elsewhere. You needn't stay here waiting with me.
messages.你若还在，听我停一次。别敲铃，也别提醒我该唱了。: If you're staying, listen to me stop once. Don't ring a bell or remind me to sing.
messages.你要喊我逃兵也行。但先让旗靠在墙上，我背它太久了。: Call me a deserter if you like. First let me set the flag against the wall. I've carried it too long.
messages.你要我替你决定回不回营地吗？: Do you want me to decide whether you go back to camp?
messages.你要把自己的名字也从军册里刮掉吗？: Do you want to scrape your own name off the muster roll too?
messages.你要是见我又把盆摆到门口，提醒我一声。我答应过这次先修门。: If you see me put a pot in the doorway again, remind me. I promised to fix the door first this time.
messages.你要继承什么，不能只问它愿不愿给。还得问自己准备把谁关在外面。: Before you inherit something, don't ask only whether it's yours to take. Ask whom you're prepared to leave locked outside.
messages.你要走了吗？那先把“阿禾”念一遍给我听。: Are you going? Say “A-He” for me once before you do.
messages.你见过分钥架，也带着吞钥的告解；门如何连接，比钥匙有多少更要紧。: You've seen the separate key rack and you carry the confession about the swallowed key. How the doors connect matters more than how many keys there are.
messages.你见过压页台，工具与保管的人都需要说明自己做过什么。: You've seen the press. Both the tools and the people who kept them must tell what they did.
messages.你见过总锁怎样把分开的用途并成一次决定，别让知识也变成那样的锁。: You've seen the master lock turn separate tasks into one decision. Don't let knowledge become that kind of lock too.
messages.你见过试音模。铜管最初分到街巷，我就该把那些街巷也画出来。: You've seen the tuning mould. The copper pipes originally branched into the lanes. Those lanes belong on my map too.
messages.你见过钥位如何被接回总锁，就该知道一条路也会被讲成只剩一个方向。: You've seen how separate keys were linked to the master lock. Tell a road a certain way and it too can seem to lead in only one direction.
messages.你解开最后一圈松线，把它放在门边。: You undo the last loose loop and leave it by the door.
messages.你认得这枚磨圆的铆钉？: Do you know this rounded rivet?
messages.你让开台阶，把空盆接到身侧。: You clear the steps and take an empty pot into the crook of your arm.
messages.你让泵井的看守停了；接下来每一格水位都得重新看。: You stopped the guard at the pump well. Now we need to check every new level ourselves.
messages.你让锤停了。至于她最后听见什么，我没有站到那么近。: You stopped the hammer. I wasn't close enough to know what she heard at the last.
messages.你让镜池的点名停了。现在有人能把纱摊开，慢慢认字。: You stopped the muster at Mirrorpool. At last someone can spread out the veil and read each character slowly.
messages.你试着扣好领口，再当着学徒的面把它解开。: You fasten the collar, then undo it in front of the apprentice.
messages.你走以后，我会记你带了几枚。: When you go, I'll count how many you've taken.
messages.你走过影门，知道一阵暗就能把人隔开。下回别硬追光，站稳，让我回光找你。: You've crossed a shadow gate. You know one dark spell can separate people. Don't race after the light next time. Stand steady and let me signal back to you.
messages.你走过的回路，也是这座城的一部分。: The loops you've travelled are part of this city too.
messages.你轻拨绯线，让余音接住那段未完的清唱。: You pluck the Crimson Thread softly, letting its echo catch the unfinished melody.
messages.你送回去的名单已经有人认了。往后若副本不一样，不能拿我一句“抄错了”压过去。: People have recognized the names you took home. If the copies ever differ, I can't just say “copyist's error” and close the matter.
messages.你逐个念出找回的名字，最后把名单转向学徒，没有替空着的一格添字。: You read each recovered name aloud and turn the list toward the apprentice. You leave the empty square alone.
messages.你量回程的步数，是怕忘路吗？: Are you counting the steps back because you're afraid you'll lose the way?
messages.你问我，我能说出次序；水真响起来时，我还得照次序做。: When you ask, I can tell you the order. When I hear that rush of water, I still have to follow it.
messages.使用沉默军令和五枚失声印记打开终章门。: Use the Silent Military Order and the five Silent Mark to open the door of the final chapter.
messages.使用沉默军令和五枚失声印记打开终章门。 -> 选择五个回声室顺序。: Use the Silent Military Order and five Silent Markings to open the final chapter door. -> Choose the order of the five Echo Chambers.
messages.保存历史不应要求生命持续受伤。: Preserving history shouldn't demand that something living stay wounded.
messages.保存契约是在同意契约吗？: Does keeping a covenant mean consenting to it?
messages.保存文本与认可文本应当分开说明。: When I keep a text, I should say separately whether I endorse it.
messages.保存设施不等于沿用它最后的命令。: We can preserve the workings without preserving their last order.
messages.保存证物还应保存它与地点的关系。: Keeping evidence should also mean keeping its connection to the place it was found.
messages.保持中距离，留 60 能量用右键回血。: Maintain a distance, save 60 energy, and heal with the right mouse button.
messages.保留镇潮设施，归还名字与退出权，由六城知情轮值。: Preserve the tideworks. Restore names and the right to withdraw. The six cities take turns on watch with their eyes open.
messages.保留镇潮设施，解除强制世袭，六城轮值且可退出。: The tideworks remain. Hereditary service ends. The six cities take turns on watch and anyone can withdraw.
messages.保管制度需要把可查与不可查说明白。: An archive should say what's available to check and what isn't.
messages.信号的意义需要在使用者之间重新确认。: The people using a signal should check its meaning together.
messages.修复温室会成为你新的笼吗？: Will repairing the greenhouse make another cage for you?
messages.修复温室要恢复到哪一天？: Which day are we trying to restore the Greenhouse to?
messages.修复的目标应当面向活着的处境。: The aim of repair should start with what is living here now.
messages.修女不是缺一盏更亮的灯。她先要知道自己的灯叫回过谁。: The sister didn't need a brighter lamp. She needed to know whom her lamp had summoned.
messages.修女把你们校正过的检修信号分给愿意接班的人，最后一盏仍空着。: The sister hands out the maintenance lamps you calibrated to the people who've agreed to take a shift. The last hook is empty.
messages.修女把光停在断桥边。有人慢慢挪过来，没有踩成同一段拍子。: The sister held the light beside the broken bridge. People edged across slowly, each at their own pace.
messages.修女把检修灯转向高路，让刚能出声的人按自己的步子报平安。: The sister turns her lamp toward the high road. People just finding their voices can call back when they're ready.
