messages.修女把长短两种划痕指给我。我看着她说不下去的那一截，没有替她接话。: The sister pointed out the two kinds of marks. When she couldn't go on, I didn't try to finish for her.
messages.修女点亮与你校正过的三短一长。灯号没有召来军队，先把一队撤离的人带过断桥；你们提: The sister signals three short flashes and one long, just as you practised. No army answers. Instead, the light guides people fleeing across the broken bridge. The maintenance you did together has given them a real way out.
messages.修女认得多出的那一拍。军册上的编号，终于有了她不敢再回避的来处。: The sister recognized the extra beat. Now she had to face where the numbers on the roll had come from.
messages.修女重数了一遍校正过的灯号，旧钟又催着各处归拍，她没有把检修信号改回召集。: The sister counts through the signals you calibrated. The old bell is calling everyone back into step, but she keeps the maintenance signal as it is.
messages.修好温室，你最想恢复哪一样？: When you mend the Greenhouse, what do you want working first?
messages.修好灯以后还需要做什么？: What is there to do once the lamps are repaired?
messages.修灯确实要用蜡，可灯照着大家走的地方，我不能把每一寸光都算成柜台的货。: I do need wax for mending the lamps. But they shine on roads everyone walks. I can't count every inch of light as stock on my counter.
messages.修过的地方要看得到。若被新铜箍盖住，病从哪里起就很难分清。: People should see where a repair was made. If a new copper band covers it, the source of rot is hard to trace.
messages.俯冲无回头路。: There's no way back when diving
messages.俯瞰整条锤炉长堤，找到俯冲的落点。: Overlook the entire Hammerforge Embankment and find a landing spot for the dive
messages.倒悬巨钟的空腔: The tilted observation arch and moss vines.
messages.倒置书廊绕向印契厅，残件藏在高处。别只拿通行的钥匙，那里还有被删掉的原文。: Follow the inverted stacks around to the covenant hall. The fragment is hidden up high. There's more than a key to take there. Look for the words they erased.
messages.倒置档案塔1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Inverted Archive Tower 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.倒置档案塔2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Inverted Archive Tower 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.倒置档案塔3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Inverted Archive Tower 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.倒置档案塔4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Inverted Archive Tower 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.倒置档案塔5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Inverted Archive Tower 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.倒置档案塔6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Inverted Archive Tower 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.倾斜观雨拱与苔藤: The moss shell deep within the collapsed pit, a optional exploration reward.
messages.假死塌穴深处的苔壳，可选探索奖励。: The fake moss floor collapses with just a step.
messages.假箱子会喷蒸汽，靠近前先观察阀门颜色。: The fake box will emit steam. Observe the valve color before approaching.
messages.假苔地板一踩就塌。: The entrance will be closed during battles.
messages.做完心愿以后，我们还会聊什么？: When the wish is fulfilled, what will we talk about?
messages.停一下，你脚上的苔色不在我这张图里。很好，又有一处空白能填上。: Wait there. That shade of moss on your boots isn't on my map. Good! Another blank I can fill.
messages.偷名者的暗格: The secret compartment of the name thief
messages.偷走第七签署者线索的书记，躲在契约索引室暗格。: Stole a clue to the Seventh Signatory and hid in a secret compartment in the covenant index room.
messages.允许解释并存，也要保留证据的差别。: We can keep several readings while distinguishing the evidence behind each.
messages.充分知情仍应保留选择和暂缓的空间。: Even fully informed, I should have room to choose and time to wait.
messages.先不要一群人。我怕他们都伸手，自己又不知道往哪走。: No crowd for now. I'm afraid if they all reach for me, I won't know where to walk again.
messages.先与囚徒交谈，向东处理猎手，再接通根库回环: Speak to the prisoner first. Face the hunter to the east, then reopen the loop through the root vault.
messages.先停在暖灯或听歌者，再进入猎手领地；根据根网前摇换位置: Pause at the warm lamp or listen to the singer before entering the hunter's territory. Move when the root net starts to form.
messages.先别信我。把契约原件的残片找来，同我这份副本摆在一起。只有我的话，他们会说我又写: Don't take my word for it. Find the scrap of the original covenant and set it beside my copy. On my word alone, they'll say I've written another pretty lie.
messages.先别叫他们改口。把各自站在哪里、听见哪一段写清楚。: Don't ask either side to change their story yet. Write down where each stood and what part they heard.
messages.先别扶我。水退了反倒容易摔，我得重新学一遍哪一半身体是自己的。: Don't help me up just yet. It's easier to fall over now the water's down. I have to learn which half of this body is mine again.
messages.先别把它当成换门的票。看清它说了什么，再去找与你谈过这件事的人。: Don't treat it as a ticket through the gate. See what it says first, then find someone who spoke to you about it.
messages.先别拉，左脚还在细根里。这里要用棘丝下劈，从上往下割。: Don't pull yet. My left foot's caught in the little roots. Use the Thornthread Downcut here. Cut from above.
messages.先别擦盐粉，边上的东西也要留下。: Leave the salt dust alone for now. What lies along the edge is worth keeping too.
messages.先别跟着铃接拍。我还想听一会儿没有人催的声音。: Don't take your cue from the bell just yet. I want to hear for a while what it sounds like when no one hurries me.
messages.先去找他是不是看不见，或是不是想停一停。不能直接把没回应写成逃亡。: First find out whether they couldn't see it or wanted a rest. Don't write “desertion” beside a missing answer.
messages.先听纸船故事，再越过坠钟；炮手驻守后方高差平台: Hear the paper boat's story before crossing the falling bell. The gunner guards the raised platform beyond.
messages.先在殿前钟龛歇脚。守母抬冠时退，贴地钟波要跳；根刺亮起后换落脚点。: Rest at the shrine outside the hall. Back away when the Matriarch raises her crown. Jump the ground-hugging bell wave. When the root spikes light up, find a new place to land.
messages.先坐。你每次到门口都像等人派活，我看着也不敢多说一句。: Sit first. Every time you're in my doorway you look as though you're waiting to be put to work. It makes me afraid to say another word.
messages.先找到军册，再学会穿过影门。两件事谁先完成都行，回来时我会校正灯号。: Find the muster roll and learn to pass the shadow gate. Either can come first. When you're back, I'll correct the signals.
messages.先把一个被登记抹去的名字送回等候者手里；沿六城找到收声与改约的痕迹，再决定怎样处: First, send a name that has been registered and erased back to the waiting person; find traces of silence and contract modification along the six cities, and then decide how to deal with the Crown that is still in the town tide.
messages.先把不相合的地方记住，再找另一页来对照。我没出声，不等于我点了头。: First remember what doesn't fit. Find another page to compare it with. I didn't speak. That doesn't mean I nodded.
messages.先把人的路腾开。我说出口时还盯着那几盆老苗，舍不得。: Clear the people's path first. Even as I said it I was staring at those old seedlings, hating to leave them.
messages.先把它们原来挂在哪里记下吧。: First record where they used to hang.
messages.先把左脚挪出来。我太久没站在地上了，别一下把我拉走。: I'll move my left foot out first. It's been so long since I stood on the ground. Don't pull me away all at once.
messages.先把手伸过来。你的线还热，能缝伤口，也能割断旧锁。别急着把它用光。: Give me your hand. Your thread's still warm. It'll stitch a wound or cut an old lock. Don't use it all at once.
messages.先把手护好，不必为了证明过去一直站在刀口前。: Look after your hands first. You don't have to stand under a blade to prove you had a past.
messages.先把手放松，再找一块不会把脚拉住的地方。别急着问我接下来能帮上什么。: First open my hands. Find somewhere to stand that won't catch at my feet. Don't rush to ask me what I can do for you next.
messages.先把正受伤的地方松开，再慢慢商量留下什么。: First loosen what's hurting the tree now. Then we can take our time deciding what to keep.
messages.先把水尺交到接班的人手里，确认他会读。自由第一晚，我也不想叫人白淹一次。: First hand the gauge to the next watcher and make sure they can read it. I don't want anyone drowning needlessly on the first night of freedom.
messages.先把还在等点名的人安顿下来，再谈该怎样称呼他。: First find a place for those still waiting to be called. We can discuss what to call their commander later.
messages.先按住这块布角，我把第一个名字缝上。后面认不清的地方，留着等人来认。: Hold down this corner while I sew the first name. Where we can't make out the writing, we'll leave room for someone who can.
messages.先替我把这截断弦按住。松一点，对，就是这样。: Hold this length of broken string for me first. A little looser. Yes, like that.
messages.先清点，不先判决。你带来的印记、证词和意愿，都应当各有一栏。: Take stock before passing judgment. The marks, the testimony and your own wishes each deserve their own space.
messages.先清远程抄写手，再处理重甲执行者。: Clear the remote scribe first, then deal with the heavy armor executor.
messages.先照有人要走的地方，营床旁、转弯口，还有能看清台阶的那一盏。: Light the places people need to walk. Beside the camp beds, around the bend and where they can see the steps.
messages.先牵动近侧闩环；开闩后面向高位吊环，向上牵引并落在吊篮台。: First, pull the nearby lock ring; after opening it, face the high suspension ring and pull upwards to land on the basket platform.
messages.先牵动近侧闩环；开闩后面向高位吊环，向上牵引并落在吊篮台。 回声针：单次单目标，: First, pull the nearby lock ring; after opening it, face the high suspension ring and pull upwards to land on the basket platform. Echo Needle: Single target at a time, stop when touching the wall; apply salt marks for hit recording. Practice · Echo Needle
messages.先用双线跃拨闩，再以地面起跳和空中二跳抵达高台；单跳够不到奖励层。: First, use double thread jumps to open the lock, then use ground jumps and aerial two-jumps to reach the high platform; a single jump does not reach the reward level.
messages.先用盐雾罩住远程法警: First, cover the distant law enforcement officer with salt mist
messages.先由还想唱的人试一段，再让听的人说听见了什么。: First let someone who still wants to sing try a verse. Then ask the listeners what they heard.
messages.先看分流箱，认清哪条是水、哪条牵着收声的旧装置。: Look at the junction box first. Find out which line carries water and which one connects to the old voice collector.
messages.先看各自在说哪一个时刻、哪一处设施。有时相反的判断指向的是后来添的一层。: First check which moment and which piece of machinery each describes. Sometimes the difference in their accounts points to a layer added later.
messages.先看腐叶地床和孢囊，南廊出口花灵提供单独交战空间: Look for the rotting leaf bed and spore sacs. The flower spirit at the south gallery exit can be fought on its own.
messages.先看那道根在承什么。能切开，不表示每次切开都能让人好过。: First see what the root is holding up. Being able to cut doesn't mean cutting will make anyone's life easier.
messages.先站稳，再缝伤口。庭兽收住口的时候，你也能收住自己的线。断枝祭坛那边，还留着一段: Find your footing before you stitch a wound. When the court beast closes its jaws, draw your thread in too. There's still a length of it stretched tight by the Broken Bough Altar.
messages.先给井边搬板的人补袖口。他刚才一边骂我针钝，一边把破口递过来，我竟听得想笑。: I'll mend a cuff for the person shifting boards by the well. They complained that my needle was blunt even as they handed over the tear. Hearing them, I nearly laughed.
messages.先给今晚还要挡潮的人，也给准备离开这里的人。衣领里的名字终于可以由他们自己念。: Someone holding the tide back tonight. And someone getting ready to leave. At last they can speak the names in their own collars.
messages.先给住处供水会耽误炉火吗？: Will sending water to the houses first set the furnace back?
messages.先缝阿禾。孩子把那个“禾”字念了三遍，我还是绣歪了。: A-He first. The child said that last syllable three times. I still stitched it crooked.
messages.先补住处那根细管。旧班表又送来了，我想把工牌翻过来再念一次。: First mend that narrow pipe to the houses. The old rota has arrived again. I want to turn the badges over and read them once more.
messages.先让今晚过去，再问明天需要几盏灯。: Get through tonight first. Tomorrow we can ask how many lamps we need.
messages.先让西门能从里面推开。以前搬苗的人抱着盆，得拿肩膀顶很久。: Make the west gate open from the inside first. People carrying seedling pots used to heave against it with their shoulders for ages.
messages.先钩铃环再墙跳，水位涨到第二格后不要回头。: Hook the bell ring first, then jump over the wall. Do not look back when the water level rises to the second grid.
messages.先问它在叫谁。我在井边听过自己的名字，也听过别人哭。不是每一声都能牵住手。: First ask who it's calling. By the well I've heard my own name and I've heard other people cry. You can't take every voice by the hand.
messages.先问还活着的人今天需要什么。: First ask the living what they need today.
messages.入口会在战斗时封闭。: The entrance to the Bellgap still requires a Crimson Dash; there's no forced fall into the well under the base.
messages.西侧钟隙需绯线冲刺。: The west bell gap requires Crimson Dash.
messages.沉钟基座由绯线冲刺门封锁。: A Crimson Dash gate seals off the sunken bell plinth.
messages.入庭先观察上下分叉；庭兽在西岸远端，保留入口缓冲: Look for the upper and lower paths as you enter. The court beast waits at the far end of the western bank.
messages.入渠后的第一座钟龛。: The first bell shrine after entering the canal
messages.全章最大的水轮: The largest waterwheel in the entire chapter
messages.公共协作不只有一种声音可以发起。: More than one voice can call people to work together.
messages.六份原话终于进了同一页。见证已经完成，这根线结交还给你。: Six voices on one page at last. My witness is complete. Take this knot back.
messages.六份原话都在。它们不要求你宽恕守门者，只证明无人替后人答应过。: All six voices are here in their own words. They don't ask you to forgive the Gatewardens. They prove that no one gave consent for their descendants.
messages.六份告解没替你补出身世，它们把六个不能省略的人带到了这里。: Six confessions haven't filled in your past. They've brought six people here whom you cannot leave out.
messages.六份证词为什么不能互相替代？: Why can't one of the six accounts stand in for another?
messages.六份证词之一：井喉里封着的第一句真话。: Crown Fissure, behind the Dash Gate.
messages.六份证词之三：禁书夹层里被封存的守门者採选名录。: Three of six testimonies: the sealed list of gatekeepers in the forbidden book compartment.
messages.六份证词之二：沉没档案舱里泡了三十年的点名册。: The second of six testimonies: The roster that had been soaked in water for thirty years in the Sunken Archive Cabin.
messages.六份证词之五：朝圣者冢碑背拼合的拒令条款全文。: Five of the six testimonies: The full text of the refusal clause assembled on the back of the pilgrims' tombstone.
messages.六份证词之六：冠下回廊里初代巡礼者签约当夜的回声。: Six Testimonies, Number Six: The echoes of the first-generation pilgrims' signing night in the Crown Underpass.
messages.六份证词之四：枯萎母株的最后一段歌，第四守门者的遗音。: Four of the six testimony: the last song of the withered mother plant, the last sound of the fourth gatewardens.
messages.六份证词没有替我选好结局。我得自己说出愿意让谁继续承担什么。: The six testimonies didn't choose an ending for me. I have to say what burden I'm prepared to leave, and on whose shoulders.
messages.六份证词铺在旧约旁。刮痕露出原字，新页的签名栏留着空处。有人挪来笔，有人先问怎样: Six testimonies lie beside the old covenant. The original word shows through the scrape. On the new page there is room to sign. One person brings a pen. Another first asks how to withdraw. The keeper reads the withdrawal clause to the end, then waits for the first pen stroke.
messages.六份证词齐了。现在每一笔后面，都有人能说“我也在场”。: All six testimonies are here. Now behind every stroke there is someone who can say, “I was there.”
messages.六份证词齐全才能把世袭改回自愿。缺哪一份，就回那座城寻找；门会等。: It takes all six testimonies to make service voluntary again. If one is missing, return to its city and look. The door will wait.
messages.六份都在。清单热了一点，规程上没有这一条；我先写作“值得等待”。: All six are present. The list feels a little warmer. The procedure doesn't cover that. I'll file it under “worth the wait” for now.
messages.六份都齐了，你还会让我重鸣吗？: Even with all six, would you still let me choose Retolling?
messages.六位守门者最初自愿献心镇潮，后来被篡改为后嗣世袭。暂借改永纳与自愿改世袭，是同一: The six-door gatekeepers initially volunteered to contribute their hearts to the tide, but later it was changed to hereditary by descendants. Temporarily borrowing hereditary and voluntary hereditary are the same period and object of the usurpation.
messages.六位守门者被当作材料继续生长，封印系统不可原样继承。: The six Gatewardens are used as materials for continued growth, and the sealing system cannot be inherited in its original form.
messages.六印前廊的钟壳上多了六道签名。: There are six signatures on the bell shell of the Six Seal Front Courtyard.
messages.六印前廊的钟壳合拢如初。: The bell shell of the Six Seal Front Courtyard is closed as before.
messages.六印前廊的钟壳裂开一道缝，潮声从下面传上来。: A crack appears in the bell shell of the Six Seal Front Courtyard, and the sound of the tide comes from below.
messages.六城曾请守门者镇住黑潮；愿意押上心的人有名字。: The six cities once asked the Gatewardens to hold back the Blacktide. Those who pledged their hearts had names.
messages.六城曾请求六位守门者以心镇守黑潮，契约原本仅约束自愿签署者。: The six cities once requested that the six Gatewardens guard the Black Tide with their hearts. The contract originally only bound those who signed voluntarily.
messages.六城证词齐全。它们并不要求收集某人的谢礼，也不依赖先听哪一位说话。: All six cities have given testimony. No one's thank-you gift is needed. It doesn't matter whom you heard first.
messages.六枚印记曾是六位活人守门者心脏。: The six marks were once the hearts of six living gatewards.
messages.六枚印记曾是活人心脏，王冠系统不可原样继承。: The six marks were once the hearts of living people, and the crown system cannot be inherited in its original form.
messages.六枚印记曾经有名字，后来只剩用途。: The six markings once had names, but now only their purpose remains.
messages.六枚失声印记的守望接口，像存档点，也像审判前清单。: The keeper of the six Silent Marks. Part shrine, part checklist before judgment.
messages.共同改变不能用一部分人的经历代替全部。: In making a change together, one group's experience can't stand for everyone's.
messages.共鸣与你合上了。它能替你开门，但要写什么，仍得你自己决定。: Your thread has found its resonance. It can open a door for you. What you write is still yours to decide.
messages.共鸣已记入。我确认的是你拥有它，不是你必须使用它。: Resonance recorded. I confirm only that you have it. Whether to use it is up to you.
messages.共鸣让我听见回应。我把手收回来，又看了一眼锁后面的路。: The resonance let me hear an answer. I drew back my hand and looked once more at the road beyond the lock.
messages.关键遗物不应被过度解释成完整内心。: Even an important relic can't reveal a person's whole mind.
messages.养根槽上的旧切口与新外箍，要用不同的办法看。: The old cut and the new hoop on the tending trough need different kinds of attention.
messages.养根槽为什么把切口露在外面？: Why leave the cut exposed in the root trough?
messages.养根槽可以让根慢慢承力，人也该有自己能承受多少的说法。: The tending trough lets a root take weight slowly. People ought to get a say in how much they can carry, too.
messages.养根槽提醒我，照料也可能把人留得太紧；这次先替他看退路。: That root trough reminds me how care can hold someone too tightly. This time, first see if there's a route out.
messages.养根槽教过我们怎样接续，也提醒过我们别把支撑勒成命令。: The tending trough taught us how to join things so they live. It also warns us not to pull a support so tight it becomes a command.
messages.养根槽旧伤露在灯下，比擦得发亮的外箍更诚实。: The old wound lit up in the root trough tells the truth more plainly than the polished outer hoop.
messages.养根槽的弦能接续生命，外箍却把它牵去别处；你已经看见选择怎样发生。: The trough's strings can sustain a life. An outer hoop led them somewhere else instead. You've seen where a choice came into it.
messages.养根槽的旧切口与新外箍并排着，像两种回答叠在一起。: The old cut in the trough and the new hoop beside it look like two answers laid one over the other.
messages.养根槽能让受伤的根慢慢承力，我也想有这样的时间。: In the trough a wounded root can slowly learn to carry weight again. I'd like time for that too.
messages.养根槽里有些支撑让它活着，有些连接却让它没法停下来。: Some supports in the trough keep it alive. Some connections won't let it rest.
messages.内侧的弦沿着旧伤接回树心；外箍后来接上钟网。你从切口能看见它们不是同时长出的。: The inner string rejoins the heartwood along an old wound. The outer hoop was connected to the bell network later. The cut shows they didn't grow at the same time.
messages.写一行“可以离开”容易。真让人披着衣服走出去，手上还得改几针。: It's easy to write “you may leave.” To let someone actually walk out wearing the coat, there are a few more stitches to change.
messages.写完再去搬水。搬水是我自己答应的，军册管不着。: Then I'll carry water. I said yes to that myself. The roll has no say in it.
messages.写新契约时，把学徒也写进去。我们还小，不该一上来就被算作代价。: When you write the new covenant, put the apprentices in it too. We're young. We shouldn't be counted as part of the price before we've even begun.
messages.军令圈的边缘会先亮半拍。: The edge of the military command circle lights up for half a beat first.
messages.军令找到了？别让灰盖住它。山风会替人忘事，你不能学它。: Found the orders? Keep the ash off them. The mountain wind is good at forgetting for people. Don't learn that trick from it.
messages.军令把失败者列成空位，下次点名又会把他们填回来。: The orders list the fallen as vacancies, only to fill those places with them at the next roll call.
messages.军令拿回来了，你还留着这面旗做什么？: You have the orders back. Why keep the flag?
messages.军令纸就在衣里，可纸挡不住耳朵。我得一回一回提醒自己，不要立刻应声。: The paper order is inside my coat. Paper can't cover my ears. Every time I hear the call, I'll have to remind myself not to answer at once.
messages.军令读给我。我想确认，当年让我们守到最后的，究竟是谁的字。: Read the orders to me. I'd like to know whose hand it was all those years ago that told us to hold to the last.
messages.军册上的重编记录，把我最怕的猜想坐实了。: The entries showing people mustered again confirmed my worst fear.
messages.军册写我离队，我拿回来读了三遍。那三个字没把以前的我抹掉。: The roll says I left the ranks. I took it back and read those words three times. They didn't rub out the person I was before.
messages.军册把停下的人又编回队里。你现在停着，恰好不用替它补一员。: The muster roll puts people who stop back into the ranks. Sitting here now, you don't have to fill a vacancy for it.
messages.军册把被叫回的人记在哪一行，我得先认清，才敢改那一拍。: I need to see which line of the roll holds the ones we called back before I dare change that beat.
messages.军册证词把这种强行归位写得很清楚。: The muster roll shows plainly how people were forced back into place.
messages.军号回来，你的手又去碰旗了吗？: When the bugle came back, did your hand go to the flag again?
messages.军号断了。我先学会听人叫自己的名字，再问哪里需要帮忙。: The bugle's gone quiet. First I'll learn to hear someone call me by name. Then I'll ask where I'm needed.
messages.军号无声但会让敌人整队。: The military bugle is silent, but it will make the enemy line up.
messages.军号里没有问我是否愿意，所以我的沉默也不能被写成答应。: The bugle never asked whether I was willing. My silence can't be entered as assent.
messages.军墓安静得能听见旗子自己动。: The military tomb is so quiet that you can hear the flags moving on their own.
messages.军墓首清：取得军墓灯影证据，并得额外碎钱与材料。: Military tomb head clean: Obtain evidence of the military tomb's lamp shadow and get extra coins and materials.
messages.军旗落阵: The military flag falls in battle
messages.军阵冲锋覆盖半场。: The military formation charge covers half of the field.
messages.军阵背后的坟场有旧令，换班小路绕回营地。走得慢一点，旗和伏兵的颜色很像。: Behind the ranks is a graveyard with an old order. The change-of-watch path loops back to camp. Go slowly. Banners and soldiers in ambush look much the same from a distance.
messages.冠下回廊的肋骨内侧留着锁钥磨痕。第一百零一把钥匙没有断，它是被主动吞下的。: There are lockmarks on the inner ribs of the Under-Crown Corridor. The tenth set of keys is not broken; it was actively swallowed.
messages.冠下回廊肋骨顶层，真结局收集品；地图重做后迁至 crown_resonance: On the top layer of the ribs in the Crown Underpass, collect items for the true ending; after redrawing the map, move it to behind the crown_resonance gate.
messages.冠下回廊肋骨顶层；以王冠共鸣开启冠门，检查顶层告解，沿原门返回。: The inner ribs of the Under-Crown Corridor; open the Gate of the Crown Resonance, examine the confession on the top floor, and return along the original door.
messages.冠下肋骨的锁钥痕: Lockmark on the ribs of the Under-Crown Corridor
messages.冠下面有三条路。别只听要你开门的人，也听听仍得留在井里的人。: There are three paths beneath the Crown. Listen to the ones who want that door open. Then listen to the ones who'll still be down this well.
messages.冠停了，桌上这些话还在争。: The Crown is silent, but the voices on this table still disagree.
messages.冠后的那道小门里有人一直藏着钥匙。把他的声音和另外五句放在一起。: Behind the Crown there's a little door. Someone has kept a key hidden there. Lay his voice beside the other five.
messages.冠已裂开，镇潮设施还在。重鸣会续行旧约，断冠会归还声音却失去钟网。: The Crown is cracked. The tideworks still stand. Retolling will renew the old covenant. Crownfall will give the voices back, but the bell network will be lost.
messages.冠核外环1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Outer Crown Ring 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.冠核外环2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Outer Crown Ring 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.冠核外环3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Outer Crown Ring 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.冠核外环4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Outer Crown Ring 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.冠核外环5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Outer Crown Ring 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.冠核外环6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Outer Crown Ring 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.冠核外环7：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Outer Crown Ring 7. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.冠肋吞钥告解: Confession of the Swallowed Key in the Crown Rib
messages.冠肋连着六城的回声，最深处才是钥座。先回看漏下的证词，再决定要开哪扇门。: The Crown ribs hold echoes of all six cities. The Key Seat is at the very bottom. Look again for any testimony you missed before deciding which door to open.
messages.冠肩的骨板逐级向下。: The bone plates of the East Crown shoulder descend layer by layer.
messages.冠脊索道穿过影闩，先在黑曜营地获得灯影相位。: The Crown Ridge Cableway passes through the shadow lock, where you can obtain the Lantern Phase at the Black Obsidian Camp.
messages.冠门松了，总轨还在。别因为握得动它，就以为非握在自己手里不可。: The Crown gate has loosened. The master rail is still there. Being able to grip it doesn't mean you must keep it in your own hands.
messages.冠隙试炼: First clearing of the Crown Gap: obtain evidence from the Crown Gap, and get extra coins and materials.
messages.冠隙首清：取得冠隙余响证据，并得额外碎钱与材料。: Cross through the Crown Gap to retrieve the Map Fragment.
messages.冠页斜射: The page of the crown slopes
messages.冲刺够你穿过一次横扫，别接着往它脚底钻。落点比起点危险。: One dash will get you through a sweep. Don't keep going under her feet. Where you land is more dangerous than where you start.
messages.冲刺拨开计时闩后，离开低梁区，再沿错层台登上物资架。: After Disrupting the Timing Gate with a Dash, leave the low beam area and climb the miscellaneous shelves along the stepped platform.
messages.冲刺拨开计时闩后，离开低梁区，再沿错层台登上物资架。 绯线穿刺：直线突刺不穿墙，: After Disrupting the Timing Gate with a Dash, leave the low beam area and climb the miscellaneous shelves along the stepped platform. Crimson Thrust: Linear thrusts that do not penetrate walls, not invincible by default; practice preparation and recovery. Practice · Crimson Thrust
messages.冲刺拨开计时闩后，离开低梁区，再沿错层台登上物资架。 钟鸣震波：必须站在地面；钟: After Disrupting the Timing Gate with a Dash, leave the low beam area and climb the miscellaneous shelves along the stepped platform. Bell Shockwave: Must stand on the ground; the bell pressure increases the impact but does not break the explored terrain. Practice · Bell Shockwave
messages.冲撞、身体碾压、震地，无远程法术。: Collisions, physical crushing, ground shaking, no ranged spells.
messages.冲过冠隙取回地图残页。: Cross through the Bellgap to retrieve the relics of the Thread Weaver.
messages.冲过淤水间隙，读取沉没档案舱里的证词。: Crossing the muddy water gaps, reading the testimonies in the Sunken Archive Cabin.
messages.冲过钟隙取回织线者的遗物。: Cross through the Bellgap to open a shortcut to the top of the Rustcrown Hall.
messages.冲过钟隙取回织线者的遗物。 可选：纺线检修仓。: Cross the bell gap to retrieve the relics of the weaver. Alternative: Thread Maintenance Cabin.
messages.冲锋敌，要求钟壳格挡。: Charge against the enemy, requiring bellshell guard.
messages.决定时把井里的人也算上。他们很久没被问过想怎样，不该再漏一次。: When you decide, remember the people in the well. It's been so long since anyone asked what they wanted. Don't leave them out again.
messages.减少花粉雾遮挡，降低平台难度。: Reduce the obstruction of pollen fog and lower the difficulty of the platform.
messages.出口通往第二章。: Defeat the moss vein guard and retrieve the Crimson Dash.
messages.出口通往第五章：黑曜巡礼道。: The exit leads to Chapter 5: Obsidian Pilgrim Road.
messages.出口通往第六章：无声王冠。: The exit leads to Chapter 6: Silent Crown.
messages.出口通往第六章：无声王冠。 可选旧路：「黑曜沉睡钟」。旧钟在等某种回声；在钟下施: The exit leads to Chapter 6: Silent Crown. Alternative route: "Black Obsidian Sleeping Bell". The old bell is waiting for some kind of echo; perform Crown Resonance under the bell.
messages.出口通往第四章：断弦温室。: The exit leads to Chapter Four: Broken String Greenhouse.
messages.出口通往第四章：断弦温室。 可选旧路：「盐白沉睡钟」。旧钟在等某种回声；在钟下施: The exit leads to Chapter 4: Broken String Greenhouse. Alternative route: "Saltwhite Sleeping Bell". The old bell is waiting for some kind of echo; perform Crown Resonance under the bell.
messages.出水口铁声隆隆。: The sound of iron clanging as it emerged from the water outlet.
messages.击败井底守卫，取回丝壁攀附。: Defeating the guard at the bottom of the well and obtaining the Silk Wall Grip.
messages.击败删名执行者并取得契约碎页。: Defeat the de-named executor and obtain the covenant fragment.
messages.击败号令兵再清小兵，优先烧掉复活旗。: Defeat the Ordering Soldier and clear out the minions. Burn the resurrection flag first.
messages.击败断弦园主。: Defeat the Master of the Broken String Garden.
messages.击败无声王冠后，玩家按线索进入三结局：重铸钟声、切断王冠、或用第七真名改写契约。: After the Silent Crown falls, the clues lead to three possible endings: reforge the bells, sever the crown, or use the seventh true name to rewrite the covenant.
messages.击败无声王冠并实际持有六份独立证词。第七签署者与绯线解释见证资格，不增加真名碎片: Defeated the Silent Crown and actually held six independent testimonies. The seventh signer has the qualification to witness the Crimson Thread, without increasing the real name fragments or the hard threshold of optional tasks.
messages.击败无声王冠并选择结局。: Defeat the Silent Crown and choose an ending.
messages.击败水轮守卫并打开 Boss 前路。: Defeat the waterwheel guard and open the boss path.
messages.击败灰冠螳将，取回契约原本，开启通往断弦温室的后门。: Defeat the Ash-Crowned Mantis Warlord, retrieve the original contract, and open the back door to the Broken String Greenhouse.
messages.击败百钥守门人后，玩家按线索进入三结局：重铸钟声、切断王冠、或用第七真名改写契约: After defeating the Hundred-Key Gatekeeper, players enter three endings according to the clues: Recast the Bell, Cut off the Crown, or rewrite the contract with the seventh true name.
messages.击败百钥守门人并选择结局。: Defeat the Hundred-Key Gatekeeper and choose an ending.
messages.击败百钥守门人，补全第六枚印记，唤出三道结局门。: Defeat the Hundred-Key Gatekeeper, complete the sixth mark, and summon three endings doors.
messages.击败绯线执剪者。: Defeat the Crimson Thread Scissor Apostle.
messages.击败绯线执剪者，取回铁匠誓牌。: Defeating the Crimson Thread Scissor Apostle and retrieving the Smith's Oath Plate.
messages.击败苔脉守卫，取回绯线冲刺。: Defeat the Moss Bell Matriarch and obtain the Crown Shard.
messages.击败苔钟守母，取回王冠裂片。: The front courtyard is crowded with enemies.
messages.击败铜根主教，取回断弦印记，打开东琉璃台的出口。: Defeat the Copperroot Bishop, retrieve the Broken String mark, and open the exit of the East Glass Terrace.
messages.击败铸雨渠 Boss 后进入书库。: Enter the library after defeating the boss of the rain canal.
messages.击败铸雨渠 Boss 后进入书库。 -> 认识迟影机关。: Enter the library after defeating the Boss of the Rain Foundry Canal. -> Meet the Late Shadow Mechanism.
messages.击败镜池新娘，取回沉默军令，打开缆降索道。: Defeat the Mirrorpool Bride, retrieve the Silent Military Order, and open the Descent Cableway.
messages.刀笔的主人停了手，我终于能把书翻慢一点。: The hand holding the blade and pen is still. At last I can turn the pages more slowly.
messages.分开的钥位是线索：许多事原先可以各自办理。: Those separate key slots are a clue. Many things once could be managed independently.
messages.分散保存与明确来历应当同时进行。: Keep copies in different places and keep track of where they came from.
messages.分流箱为什么还留着轮班记号？: Why are the shift marks still on the junction box?
messages.分流箱只有三根管，修女却在每一根后面都看见了人。我没有替她转阀。: There are only three pipes in the junction box. The sister saw the people at the far end of each. I didn't turn the valve for her.
messages.分流箱把水送到不同的地方，可每个屋里听到的水声也不全一样。: The junction box sends water to different homes. Even the sound of it isn't quite the same in every house.
messages.分流箱本来就分着住处和炉膛；往后不能只按炉子的需要催人。: The junction box has separate pipes for homes and furnaces. We can't keep hurrying people along for the furnace's sake alone.
messages.分流箱本来把三路分开，才看得出哪家会先断水。: The junction box kept its three lines separate so we could see whose water would be cut off first.
messages.分流箱的旧榫能告诉我怎样承力，却不能单凭它认出每一位做榫的人。: An old joint in the junction box shows me how it takes a load. It won't tell me every hand that shaped it.
messages.分流箱继续供水，我会修；修的时候，也要记谁在承担。: The junction box keeps supplying water. I'll repair it. And while I'm at it, I'll record who's bearing the load.
messages.分流箱还分得清哪条管供住处，工牌也该分得清谁曾在这里生活。: The junction box still shows which pipes supply the houses. A badge ought to show who lived here too.
messages.分流箱连着住处，铁匠的誓言也不只关乎炉膛。: The junction box connects to the houses. The smith's oath also reached far beyond the furnace.
messages.分流箱通向住处的时候，这些话也该有一条出去的路。: When the junction box sends water to the houses, there ought to be a way for these words to travel out as well.
messages.分钥架上还留着分列的槽。我把“快”字记在旁边，也把后来打不开的小门记下。: The old separate slots are still in the key rack. I wrote “faster” beside them. I also noted the little doors that would no longer open.
messages.分钥架把许多动作接成一个，我不想把你的每次安静也接成我的回答。: The key rack joined many actions into one. I don't want to treat your every silence as the answer I'd like to hear.
messages.分钥架旧有的分工还看得出来，后来接上的铜轨也还在。: You can still see how the work was divided on the key rack. You can still see the copper rail they added later.
messages.分钥架的旧用途与后来接线都留着，决定前可以把它们再看一遍。: The key rack still bears its old uses and the wiring that came later. You can look at them again before deciding.
messages.分钥架的旧钥列与新铜轨就能同时留在眼前，不必抹掉其中一种。: The old rows of keys and the newer copper rail can stand before us at once. Neither needs to be rubbed away.
messages.分钥架的每列仍能辨清各自用途，这比把旧清单换一个封面更要紧。: You can still see the purpose of every row on the key rack. That matters more than putting a new cover on the old list.
messages.分钥架的每列原本通向不同的事，旅途也有许多仍在继续的地方。: Each row of keys once served a different task. Along your journey, life goes on in many places too.
messages.分钥架的空位也一样：它记得一种用法，并不命令你照做。: An empty slot on the key rack is much the same. It remembers a use. It doesn't order you to do the same.
messages.分钥架的铜轨把许多决定并成一个，别让共鸣替你把它们一并接下。: The bronze rail on the key rack rolled many decisions into one. Don't let resonance hand them all to you.
messages.分钥架还分得清每列钥位，我们核对证词时也得保留这些分别。: We can still distinguish the rows in the key rack. We should keep the same distinctions when we check testimony.
messages.切断王冠与六城的征声钟令。: Sever the orders that let the Crown levy voices from the six cities.
messages.切断钟舌释放六枚印记，王冠封印崩塌，城市获得自由但黑潮涌出。: Cut off the bell tongue to release six marks. The Crown's seal collapses, and the city gains freedom, but the black tide surges out.
messages.刚出来时，我连往左还是往右都想先问你。: When I first got out, I wanted to ask you even whether to turn left or right.
messages.刚才那声不是下工钟。我听得出来，你不用说“也许是”。: That wasn't the shift bell just now. I know the difference. You don't need to tell me it might have been.
messages.初代巡礼者回声揭示第七签署者就是第一位巡礼者，他把真名藏进绯线等待后来者拒令。: The First Pilgrim's Echo reveals that the seventh signatory is the first pilgrim. He hid his true name in the Crimson Thread waiting for later renouncers.
messages.初代巡礼者留下的同位体，警告真名代价。: The doppelgangers left by the first-generation pilgrim, warning of the cost of the true name.
messages.初代巡礼者的回声守在这里，听完再动身。: The echoes of the first-generation pilgrims are here to listen before moving on.
messages.初期基础针击可用；完成旧支线后才开放线势: Initial basic needle strikes are available; line potential is only open after completing the old branch task
messages.初鸣苔灯旁的小钟停了，井口垒起了沙袋。: The small bell next to the First Chime Moss Lamp stops, and sandbags are built up at the well mouth.
messages.初鸣苔灯旁的小钟又按时响了。: The small bell next to the First Chime Moss Lamp rings again at the right time.
messages.初鸣苔灯旁立起了一块轮值牌。: A duty card is erected next to the First Chime Moss Lamp.
messages.删名契约暗柜保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的声: The Nominative Decree Secret Cabinet stores work records: the facility was once maintained by residents, later changed to transport contracts, military orders, and voices that have been erased.
messages.删名契约暗柜：完成能力动作后穿过专属立体检修路线，收回两件物资并安全退出。: Nominative Decree Secret Cabinet: After completing the ability action, pass through the exclusive maintenance route to retrieve two items and exit safely.
messages.删名执行者保护契约原本。: The de-named executor protects the original covenant.
messages.利用棘球反弹躲过二阶段推进棘墙。: Use the spiky ball bounce to avoid the second-stage advancement of the spiky wall.
messages.别一直在下庭绕圈，上层钟廊会把你带回后门。: Don’t keep circling in the courtyard; the upper corridor will bring you back to the back door.
messages.别保证。若你不知道，就告诉我不知道，再把真的听见的那一段说给我。: Don't promise. If you don't know, tell me you don't know. Then tell me the part you actually heard.
messages.别叠着拿，会把背面的铆痕磨平。柳叔会生气。: Don't stack them. You'll rub off the rivet marks on the backs. Uncle Liu would be cross.
messages.别只带一句。带走它在什么页、旁边被刮去什么、我们依据什么这样读。: Bring more than a line. Which page it was on, what was scraped off beside it, and why we read it this way.
messages.别因为它曾被用作命令，就再把上面的人一并抹去。: Don't wipe out the people written there because their names were once used to give orders.
messages.别因为有人把你当作一件工具，就先替他答应。: Just because someone sees a tool when they look at you, don't go agreeing on their behalf.
messages.别急着把一场战斗写成所有问题的结尾。: Don't be too quick to make a battle the end of every question.
messages.别急着认我。先看看手上的线，我们曾在同一处打结，也在同一处勒住过人。: Don't be too quick to recognize me. Look at the thread in your hand. Once we tied a knot in the same place. In that same place we drew it tight around someone.
messages.别把急着反抗的力气，全落到还要使用工具的人身上。: Don't let the whole force of your resistance land on people who still need the tools.
messages.别把我当成最后一个要讨好的人。我要核对的是原件。: Don't think of me as the last person you need to please. It's the originals I'm here to check.
messages.别把救我的绳结留在我手腕上。放在门边吧，要用时我会自己拿。: Don't leave the rescue knot around my wrist. Put it by the door. If I need it, I'll take it.
messages.别替我找新的书。替外面的人找一次能安静读完旧书的晚上。: Don't go looking for new books for me. Find the people outside an evening quiet enough to finish an old one.
messages.别的我还不知道。你要是想说一件自己的事，我也能坐在这儿听。: I don't know much else yet. If you want to tell me something of your own, I can sit here and listen too.
messages.别盯着前面那盏灯，它是诱饵。我在这里摔过两次，笔记比脸皮先学会了。: Don't stare at the light ahead. It's bait. Fell for it twice myself. My notebook learned faster than my face.
messages.别相信干净的水，那里面没有活人的倒影。: Don’t trust clean water; there is no reflection of living people in it.
messages.别碰那道缝，我刚补好。师父试钟时，总叫我站到最远的巷口；我举起手，他才敢说这一口: Mind that seam, I just mended it. When Master tested a bell, he sent me to the furthest lane. Only when I raised my hand would he say the bell was finished.
messages.别让一个铃声又替所有人回答所有事。: Don't let one ring give everyone's answer to everything again.
messages.别让军阵替你选路。这里保存的是第五位守门者的证词。: Don't let the ranks choose your road. The fifth Gatewarden's testimony is kept here.
messages.别说他很勇敢才配被记住。他有时候怕水，下雨还会抱着鞋跑。我也记得。: Don't say he deserves remembering because he was brave. Sometimes he was afraid of water. He used to run with his shoes in his arms when it rained. I remember that too.
messages.别跑太直，迟影会记住你的直线。: Don’t run too straight; the Late Shadow will remember your straight line.
messages.刮刀能把墨带走，纸受过的压痕却还在。把页斜过来，两个时刻就不再重合。: A scraper can lift ink, but the pen's pressure stays in the page. Tilt it and you can see two moments instead of one.
messages.到达中庭先识别水表层、西岸长梯和下探泵井: On reaching the central court, look for the water gauge level, the long western ladder and the pump shaft below.
messages.刻痕与试音模让同一个问题有了两面：谁承担，又是谁决定。: The carvings and the tuning mould give the question two faces. Who bears the cost? Who decides?
messages.前人的巡礼能替我走完这一步吗？: Can an earlier pilgrim take this step for me?
messages.前人经历可以提供参照，却不接管当下选择。: Those who came before can offer guidance without taking over today's choice.
messages.前代巡礼者的失败回声。: The failed echoes of the previous pilgrims.
messages.前庭中段有灯影存档点。: There is a Shadow Archive Point in the middle of the Forecourt.
messages.前庭敌人密集。: Break through the brittle bell floor and retrieve the testimony clues in the Bell marrow.
messages.前廊有六印守望者的常明灯。: There is a constant light in the front courtyard of the Keeper of Six Marks.
messages.前廊有暖灯存档点。: There is a warm lamp archive point in the front corridor.
messages.前廊风口敌人密集。: The enemy is dense at the front corridor wind.
messages.前面军阵长枪会挑空，钟轮低波要跳。螳将的刀能等，镜池的迟影要离开落点。: Spearmen in the ranks ahead thrust upward. Jump the low bell-wheel waves. You can wait out the Warlord's blade. Get clear of the landing when Mirrorpool casts a late shadow.
messages.剪东西的那个不在了，我还是会等到最后一班。: The one with the shears is gone. I'll still wait until the last shift.
messages.剪刀使徒坛1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Altar of the Scissor Apostle 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.剪刀使徒坛2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Altar of the Scissor Apostle 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.剪刀使徒坛3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Altar of the Scissor Apostle 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.剪刀使徒坛4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Altar of the Scissor Apostle 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.剪刀使徒坛5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Altar of the Scissor Apostle 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.剪刀使徒坛6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Altar of the Scissor Apostle 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.剪声停了，雨又听起来像雨。我能再放一条船吗？这次不写求救。: The snipping's stopped. Rain sounds like rain again. Can I send another boat? I won't write “help” on this one.
messages.剪子停了，断口还得补。别把那东西的残片混进工牌里。: The shears are still, but the cuts need mending. Don't mix fragments of that thing in with the work badges.
messages.剪掉坏枝不难，难的是承认自己也浇过让它生病的水。: It's easy to prune a sick branch. The hard part is admitting I watered it with what made it sick.
messages.剪线使不再下令了，阀还是不会自己选。: The Scissor Apostle's orders have stopped. The valve still won't choose for itself.
messages.劈开脆钟地板，取回钟髓中的证词线索。: The climbing ladder is long; don't let go midway.
messages.劈开脆钟地板，取回钟髓中的证词线索。 可选：钟髓封蜡室。: Break through the brittle bell floor and recover the testimony clue in the bell marrow. Optional: Bell Marrow Wax Chamber.
messages.包得太紧会烂。我年轻时嫌它丑，缠过一回，拆开的时候连好根也伤了。: Wrap it too tightly and it rots. When I was young I thought it ugly and bound it up. When I took the wrapping off, I'd hurt the good roots too.
messages.升台失了钟力，梯子比以前长。我会把能走的路重画一遍。: Without bell power for the lifts, the ladders are longer than they used to be. I'll draw the routes you can still take.
messages.升台恢复了，我仍在图边标出被钟令封住的去处。: The lifts work again. I'll still mark the places barred by the bell's orders in the margins.
messages.升梯上去能看见整条渠，下面则有旧工坊。缺血就回钟龛，不用逞强赶到炉门。: The lift gives you a view of the whole canal. The old workshop is down below. If you're hurt, go back to the shrine. No sense trying to limp all the way to the furnace gate.
messages.升梯很长，别在中途松手。: Once the ladder is cleared, it remains valid for a long time.
messages.半沉工头想找回三枚工牌。: The semi-drowned foreman wanted to retrieve three work badges.
messages.半沉工头想找回三枚工牌。 可见旧检修入口：「淤泥排压室」。Shift 冲刺拨开计: Half-Drowned Foreman wants to retrieve three work badges. The old maintenance entrance can be seen: "Silt Drainage Chamber". Shift Dash to Disrupt Timing Gate.
messages.半沉工头点名要的工牌。牌上的坑坑洼洼，都是工人自己敲的。: The semi-drowned foreman named the work badges he wanted. The marks on the badges were all caused by the workers themselves.
messages.半沉的暗河栈道: Lower your body; there's light ahead.
messages.半钟平台东角上方的梁缝透出一线光，有风从上面灌下来。: A line of light shines through the beam at the east corner of the Half-Bell Platform, with wind blowing down from above.
messages.单跳与可变跳高；敌人不进入断阶: Try single jumps of different heights. Enemies stay clear of the broken steps.
messages.南廊尽头的蜡壁缝里透出暖光。: Warm light shines through the wax wall crack at the end of the southern corridor.
messages.南边地床是长路，上面树冠是捷径。根笼亮起时换位置，别在同一块土上等它收紧。: The southern beds are the long way. There's a shortcut through the canopy above. Move when a root cage lights up. Don't wait in the same patch of soil for it to tighten.
messages.厅内卫兵密集，冲刺保命。: The guards in the hall are dense; dash to survive.
messages.历史应保留没有走到同一终点的旅途。: History needs room for journeys whose travellers never reached the same end.
messages.压页台上的屑末也得留一份，才知道纸为什么会薄。: Keep some of the shavings from the press too. They'll show why the paper grew thin.
messages.压页台上被刮去的字，让我更不敢只拿一页纸安排一个人。: The words scraped away at the page press make me wary of arranging a whole life on the strength of one page.
messages.压页台上那些屑末不能因为钟重新响，就被扫成无关的灰。: Those scraps at the page press aren't dust to sweep away just because the bells are ringing again.
messages.压页台仍能刮字，所以光换一张新纸还不够。: The page press can still scrape away a word. Changing the sheet alone won't be enough.
messages.压页台原本用来救受潮的书；刀后来有了另一种差事。: The page press was meant to save damp books. The blade was given a different task later.
messages.压页台能压平一页纸，压不平它已经带出去的命令。: A press can flatten paper. It can't flatten out an order that's already been carried abroad.
messages.压页台能压平纸，不能让一段没有说出口的话突然有了原文。: The press can flatten paper. It can't conjure up an original for words that were never spoken.
messages.压页台能让一页纸平些，却不能让被改过的字自动回来。: The page press can smooth out a sheet, but it can't bring back words that have been scraped away.
messages.压页的机器很响，有时站在旁边的人根本没有机会回答。: The press is loud. Sometimes the person next to it never had a chance to answer.
messages.原件和证词都在？这次别藏进柜子。让不同的人同时看见它们。: You have the original and the testimony? Don't hide them in a cabinet this time. Let people see them side by side.
messages.原文保管者；现任灰冠螳将是后来的契约执行者: The original keeper; the current Ash-Crowned Mantis Warlord is the contract executor later on
messages.原文还在我手里。钟又让旧的那一页生效，我不会替它把刮痕抹平。: I still have the original. The bell has put the old page back into force. I won't smooth its scrape marks away for it.
messages.原来军令真的换过。谢谢你让我知道，我当年不是唯一一个觉得不对的人。: So someone really did change the orders. Thank you. I know now I wasn't the only one back then who felt something was wrong.
messages.原约只约束自愿献心的人，后嗣却被写了进去。把各城证词带到王冠，问清谁改了约、代价: The original covenant bound only those who freely offered their hearts. Someone added their descendants. Bring the cities' testimonies to the Crown. Find out who changed the covenant and who pays the price.
messages.原页上留下了改字的痕迹。寻找其他独立证词，分清守潮与夺走名字之间的关系。: The original page bears traces of an alteration. Seek independent testimony about the link between guarding against the tide and taking people's names.
messages.原页上的字，也得有人下来挨近了看。你带到这里，它才补上我图上看不到的一截。: Someone had to climb down and look close to read the original page too. When you brought it here, it filled in something I couldn't see on the map.
messages.原页与压页台至少让我们知道，有些空白是后来留下的。: The original and the press at least tell us some of those blanks were made later.
messages.原页仍把问题指向更早的改写；战胜它不是改写从未发生的证明。: The original points to a much older alteration. Winning the fight doesn't prove the alteration never happened.
messages.原页的刮痕已经说明，受保护的纸也可能被改。: The scrape on the original shows that even guarded paper can be changed.
messages.原页的白边提醒我们，空处也可能是被人做出来的。: The white edge on the original reminds us that a blank may have been made by someone.
messages.原页能拿出来了，我也得把自己的抄本摆在旁边。: Now we can bring out the original, I'll have to put my copy beside it.
messages.去除束缚也要顾及仍依赖它的生命。: Undoing a binding means caring for the life that still depends on it.
messages.去雨渠先找孩子；高处的盐风口现在难走，泵井下面还有低路。走得通了再去，别为我抢那: Find the child at the canal first. The salt vent up high is a hard climb, but there's a low path under the pump well. Go when you can. Don't risk the jump for me.
messages.参观封存的水线层站厅。: Visiting the sealed waterline floor hall.
messages.参观封存的钟骨长梯站厅。: The Bellgap remnants left by the optional challenge. It doesn't block the main storyline, but it proves you entered the back secret compartment of the Crown.
messages.双层水位记录室保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的: The Double Water Level Record Room stores work records: the facility was once maintained by residents, later changed to transport contracts, military orders, and voices that have been erased.
messages.双层水位记录室：操作能力闩后沿独立检修路线登上证物台，收取记录与物资。: Double Water Level Record Room: After operating the ability lock, climb the independent maintenance route to the evidence platform, retrieve records and materials.
messages.双线跃可跨过盐雾，但落点要避开白刺。: The double thread jump can cross the salt fog, but the landing spot must avoid the white thorns.
messages.双线跃才能取到的可选探索奖励。: Double Thread Jump provides optional exploration rewards.
messages.双线跃接通高架线后，可先走黑曜巡礼路，或继续探索温室。: After connecting the Double Thread Jump to the elevated line, you can either continue on the Obsidian Pilgrim Road or explore the greenhouse.
messages.双线跃能到旧钟庭高处的风口。能回去就回去，别让等消息的人一直等着。: The Twin-Thread Leap can take you to the vent high in the old court. If you can go back, go. Someone's still waiting for news.
messages.双线跳与钟壳格挡: Double-line jump and Bell Shell Guard
messages.反抗删名不必变成无条件公开一切。: Opposing erasure doesn't require making every fact public without conditions.
messages.反页封面朝里，别按书名找路。: Reverse the cover; don't look for the book title.
messages.取下来不等于抹去；只是不能再让它发令。: Taking it down won't erase it. It only stops it giving orders.
messages.取得军册或黑曜证词: Obtained the military register or obsidian testimony
messages.取得控制力不等于取得永久代表权。: Gaining control doesn't mean gaining a permanent right to speak for others.
messages.取得既有回声钩索后可拉向检修铜环；环下是钟摆车间实地。: After obtaining the Broken-String Singer, you can pull towards the maintenance copper ring; below the ring is the Pendulum Workshop in the field.
messages.受伤且绯线足够时首次提示缝补，随后以苔灯图标引导休息: When hurt and carrying enough Crimson Thread, follow the first mending prompt. The moss-lamp icon then points to a place to rest.
messages.只画钟楼，整张图会像一根向上的箭；可城里还有人要取水、修衣、回家。: Draw only the bell tower and the whole map looks like an arrow pointing up. People in this city still need to fetch water, mend their clothes and go home.
messages.只记下工时能留下工人吗？: Will keeping the hours alone preserve a record of the workers?
messages.只追问已经找到的线索。回答可以中途离开，读完并记下后才进入人物旅记。: Ask about clues you've already found. You can leave midway. Finish the answer and record it to add it to the People section of your journal.
messages.只需出示信物，不消耗持有物。: Show the token. You keep it afterward.
messages.召唤两列巡礼军冲锋，玩家需用 lantern_phase 穿过影门或军阵空隙。: Summon two lines of Pilgrim soldiers to charge. Players need to pass through the lantern_phase to cross the shadow gate or gaps in the military formation.
messages.召回令我还收着，免得以后忘了自己曾经多怕。: I still keep the recall order. I don't want to forget how afraid I used to be.
messages.召集令断了，我把旗角留下作记号。营地现在是歇脚的地方。: The recall is broken. I've kept a corner of the flag as a marker. The camp is somewhere to rest now.
messages.召集线又绷紧了。我会留着那份军令，让人知道离队为何这么难。: The muster thread has pulled tight again. I'll keep that order so people can see why leaving was so hard.
messages.可一直泡在水里，背面的痕迹也会看不清。我不知道哪一种更好。: But leave them in the water and the marks on the backs will fade. I don't know which is better.
messages.可以回去，门不会因为你犹豫就替你作答。: Go back if you like. The door won't make your choice for you because you hesitate.
messages.可以敲门，也可以当面交接。钟便于让远处的人同时听见，没它也还能问人。: Knock on a door. Hand over face to face. Bells let people far apart hear the same thing at once. Without one, we can still ask.
messages.可以，但两种读法都得说清依着哪一道痕。含糊并不会让它们一样有凭据。: Yes, if each reading can point to the mark that supports it. Being vague won't make the evidence equal.
messages.可你带来的每一张纸上，都有人受过这样的苦。我不能装作没听懂。: But every page you've brought me tells of someone hurt that way. I can't pretend I haven't heard.
messages.可受伤的是搬苗的人，绕远的是你。蜡到手就给钱，别拿以后会便宜哄你。: But the people moving seedlings are the ones getting hurt, and it's you who'll take the detour. I'll pay when the wax arrives. No coaxing you with a cheaper deal someday.
messages.可我也不能把缝好的线结，说成世袭的扣子已经松了。: But I can't hold up a finished knot and say the clasp binding the next generation has come loose.
messages.可灯灭时，搬苗的人会拿手去摸根缝。少一条裂口没看见，明天就得有人包手。: But when the lamp goes out, the people carrying seedlings feel for the gaps with their hands. Miss a split in a root tonight and someone needs a bandage tomorrow.
messages.可若我们仍只听拿阀柄的人，旧事还会重来。: If we still listen only to the one holding the valve, the old story will happen again.
messages.可若连名字都不肯记，后来的人就只会看见空出来的工位，以为那里从来没人。: But if nobody even keeps their names, all anyone coming after will see is an empty workstation. They'll think no one was ever there.
messages.可被困住不能替他做过的事开脱；名册仍记着被带回队伍的人。: Being trapped doesn't excuse what she did. The roll still names the people dragged back into the ranks.
messages.可退出的承诺需要落实到日常的做法中。: A promise people can withdraw from needs a way to do so in everyday life.
messages.可选挑战留下的钟隙残响。不挡主线，却能证明你走进过冠后暗格。: The sentry guards will encircle quickly.
messages.可选支线的请求不应被写成情感勒索。: A favour someone can refuse shouldn't be asked through guilt.
messages.可选首领身上搜出的残页账册。记录被蜡封的名字借据，不挡主线。: Fragmented account books found on the optional boss. Records of wax-sealed name loans, not blocking the main storyline.
messages.可靠的陪伴来自如实回应，而非许下无法兑现的结果。: Honest words make better company than promising an outcome no one can deliver.
messages.台阶尽头是钟龛的灯。: At the end of the steps was the light in the Furnace Shrine.
messages.台阶间落差大，别贪跳。: The drop between the steps is large. Don't be greedy to jump.
messages.右上方苔丛里有一盏不该亮着的回声灯。: There is an echo lamp in the moss at the upper right that should not be lit.
messages.叶把钥匙握得很紧。我没有催她松手，只把工牌放在柜前。: Ye gripped the key tightly. I didn't ask her to let go. I just set the badge in front of the cabinet.
messages.号令会强化周围敌人。: The Ordering will strengthen the surrounding enemies.
messages.号令强化敌人，先杀指挥单位。: The Ordering strengthens the enemies, killing command units first.
messages.号码可以换着冲，手打铆钉却总会留下习惯。湛不肯只替炉边的人留一个号。: You can swap out a number stamp. A hand-set rivet keeps a trace of the hand that set it. Zhan wanted more than a number for the people at the furnace.
messages.司事记得一次被他拒绝的敲门。我还不知道那人后来去了哪里。: The sacristan remembers a knock he turned away. I still don't know what became of the traveller.
messages.司事说起那半夜时低下了头。我听见了门框上的三次敲击。: The sacristan lowered his head when he mentioned that half-night. I heard three knocks on the doorframe.
messages.吊锤毫无预兆地砸落。: The hanging hammer fell without warning.
messages.同一份记录可以被保存，却停止执行。: We can keep a record without continuing to enforce it.
messages.同一官衔不能吞掉不同时刻的不同人物。: A title held at different times shouldn't swallow the different people who held it.
messages.同一盏灯，怎么既能引路又能召兵？: How can the same lamp guide travellers and muster troops?
messages.同一种手艺，仍要一次次核对它服务的人。: However familiar the craft, I must keep asking whom it serves.
messages.同情他人的缺失，也要保留自己的边界。: I can feel someone else's loss without giving up my own boundaries.
messages.同行的边界应由被护送的人参与决定。: The person being escorted should help decide how far the escort goes.
messages.名册上写着归队，我便替他们应了。我的声音还响，他们自己的倒越来越远。: The roll said “return to ranks,” so I answered for them. My voice carried while theirs grew fainter and fainter.
messages.名册上的名字被划去又写回，像是人从来没有离开的资格。: Names were struck from the roll only to be written back in, as though no one had ever had the right to leave.
messages.名册上的死人为什么还在当班？: Why are the dead still on duty on the roll?
messages.名册上的针距是我们列队的距离。那些空位都曾经有人。: The stitches in the roll are as far apart as we stood on parade. Someone once stood in every one of those gaps.
messages.名册把两种动作写在一起，点名轮的钉孔却把用意露出来。: The roll wrote the two acts together. The nail holes in the muster wheel show what was meant.
messages.名单上也有你改过的字吗？: Are there words on the list that you changed yourself?
messages.名单上的名字我念了一遍，不再只用嘴形。: I read every name on the list aloud instead of just shaping the words with my lips.
messages.名单已经回到钟庭。别人再说那些名字没人认，我知道该请他去问谁。: The list has gone back to Bell Court. Next time anyone says no one knows those names, I can tell them whom to ask.
messages.名单带回来了。现在缝哪一个？: I've brought the list back. Which name will you stitch first?
messages.名单还有空处，我这回敢先留着了。你已经把能认出的带回来。: There are spaces left on the list. This time I dare leave them empty. You've brought the names you could recognize.
messages.名单送回钟庭。学徒念了阿禾、时岚、舟九，把认不清的字留成空框；我替他按着布角，等: I brought the names home to Bell Court. The apprentice said A-He, Shilan, Zhoujiu, leaving an empty square where the writing was unclear. I held down the corner of the cloth until the first stitch went through.
messages.名字到了手里。往后谁来认剩下的空处？: The names are in our hands. Who will come and read the rest of the gaps?
messages.名字可以被军令占用，也可以用来记住军令伤了谁。得看它被怎样读。: An order can take over a name. The name can also remind us whom that order hurt. It matters how it's read.
messages.名字已经缝回去，我们终于能把这件事放到身边，而不总挡在中间。: The names are stitched back in. At last we can keep this by our side instead of always having it stand between us.
messages.名字带回去的经历说明，记录要有能继续询问的人接着。: Bringing the names back taught us that a record needs people who will receive it and keep asking questions.
messages.名字带回来了，排班时就该叫得出人，也容得下他今天不能来。: Now that the names are back, we ought to know who we're asking to take a shift. We ought to hear them when they say they can't come today, too.
messages.名字念起来慢，有人在后头催。我以前也是催的那个。: Reading names takes time. Someone behind me wants me to hurry. I used to be the one hurrying people.
messages.名字我会缝。剩下的，得让懂那份契约的人看看；针不能当所有的钥匙。: Names I can stitch. For the rest, find someone who understands the covenant. A needle can't be every key.
messages.名字能叫出声了，也得有人腾出手搬挡潮板。我把名布先挂高，等回来的人认。: We can say the names now. Someone still has to lift the flood boards. I'll hang the name cloth up high for the people coming home.
messages.名字被带回去以后，你没有替我许下假的归期。: When you brought the name back, you didn't make up a date for me to expect them home.
messages.名字被抹掉是伤害，未经允许再把它示众，也未必就是偿还。: Erasing a name does harm. Putting it on show again without permission may not make that harm good.
messages.名字被送回去了，我仍会谨慎保管查验的来历。: The names have gone home. I'll still take care to preserve the sources we used to check them.
messages.名字送到了，我还要替你做什么？: The names are home. What else do you need me to do?
messages.后来加的外箍太齐整，倒让人忘了里面的根还会变。: The outer hoop they added was so neat it made people forget the roots inside could still change.
messages.后来只剩班次，名字从箱边退到了工牌背面。: Later there were only shift numbers. Names slipped from the side of the box to the backs of the badges.
messages.后来同一条管道把声音收了回去。管子没有换方向，换的是谁能决定开口。: Later those same pipes took the voices back. The pipes hadn't changed direction. What changed was who got to decide when to speak.
messages.后来园主装外箍，我劝她留缝。她说等这一季过去。我信了。: Later the Gardener fitted the outer hoop. I asked her to leave a gap. She said she would at the end of the season. I believed her.
messages.后来大家只管树有没有活，都不再问唱的人是谁。你问了，我想把名字再说一遍：徽。: In the end everyone asked if the tree was alive. No one asked who was singing. You did. I'd like to say the name again: Hui.
messages.后来有人拿我的副本来问，为什么他父亲从来没登记过。我认得自己的笔，没敢认他。: Then someone came with my copy to ask why their father had never been registered. I knew the handwriting. I didn't dare acknowledge the person before me.
messages.后来添的钉孔把离开的人也钉回去，你带来的名册正能对上这件事。: The later nail holes pinned even those who left back into the wheel. The roll you brought matches that history.
messages.后来管子只报轮班，我才发现能听见不等于有人在和我说话。: Later the pipes rang only for changes of shift. That's when I learned hearing something wasn't the same as someone speaking to me.
messages.后门的线为什么补了又断？: Why does the back gate thread keep breaking after you mend it?
messages.后门的钟又有人听不见。我负责敲钟，也得记住谁被它拿走声音。: The back gate bell is ringing beyond some people's hearing again. It's my job to ring it. I have to remember whose voices it took.
messages.向导肯承认自己带错过人。我先让他把回程也说了一遍。: The guide admitted to leading people astray. I asked to hear the way back as well.
messages.吞下最后一把钥匙，是为了挡住谁？: Whom was he trying to keep out when he swallowed the last key?
messages.吞下钥匙能证明最后的心意吗？: Does swallowing the key prove their last wish?
messages.吞钥告解让你看见总锁也曾拒绝一次转动。: The confession about the swallowed key showed you that once, even the master lock refused to turn.
messages.吞钥的告解留下一个动作，不能把每位前人的愿望都塞进那把钥匙。: The confession about the swallowed key preserves a single act. We can't fit the wishes of all who came before into that key.
messages.否则下一个翻书的人，还会把干净的页边当成清白。: Otherwise whoever turns the next page may mistake a clean margin for a clean conscience.
messages.听完雨渠孩子的证言: After hearing the testimony of the Rain Canal child
messages.听水轮节拍再跳，停顿平台会在第三拍下沉。: Listen to the waterwheel rhythm again, pause the platform will sink at the third beat.
messages.听潮暗室潮线旁的湿壳，可选探索奖励。: The wet shells beside the waterline of the Hidden Tide Room, an optional exploration reward.
messages.听潮暗室的水沿。: The water edge of the Hidden Tide Room.
messages.听见上面安静，我还是会先缩一下。你别从背后叫我。: Even when it goes quiet up there, I still flinch. Don't call to me from behind.
messages.听见并不让你欠一个答复。: Hearing doesn't put you in debt for an answer.
messages.听起来像人的声音就一定是人吗？: If a voice sounds human, must it be a person?
messages.告解里的钥匙也是能开门的，最后却留在肋骨里。: The key in the confession could open a door too. It ended up inside someone's ribs.
messages.告诉别人哪一种光可以放心跟，哪一种只是检修时的试亮。: Tell people which light is safe to follow and which one's only a test flash for maintenance.
messages.和失聪铁匠柳、管渠童子对话，取得水轮阀记线索。: Talk with Liu, the Deaf Smith and Canal Child to obtain clues about the waterwheel valve.
messages.哪一笔是我添的，哪一笔有原文，都标清。不能因为总官错了，我就永远不会错。: I'll mark which strokes I added and which are in the original. The High Registrar was wrong. That doesn't make me always right.
messages.哪怕没有替我做这件事，你也能去王冠；我不会把别人的命押成通行条件。: You could have gone on to the Crown without doing this for me. I won't make someone else's life the price of passage.
messages.商人先算能亮几盏，再算价钱。我看见他把灯往根缝下面挪了挪。: The merchant worked out how many lamps would burn before naming a price. I saw the lamp move lower, under the gap in the roots.
messages.商人把补过的检修灯挂到值守表旁。愿意接班的人带走灯，交班时再放回来；那一块花粉蜡: The merchant hangs the mended lamp beside the watch rota. Whoever volunteers takes it down and returns it at the end of their shift. At last that lump of pollen wax lights the work of someone who chose to take it up.
messages.嘘，纸船正要过闸。你别笑，它载的东西，比铁船还认真。: Shh, my paper boat's about to go through the gate. Don't laugh. It takes its cargo more seriously than any iron ship.
messages.囚徒在温室西门晒过太阳，才用自己的名字报名修补苗床。他也可以明天再来。打开根笼的: After some time in the sun at the Greenhouse's west gate, the former prisoner signs up in their own name to mend the seedbeds. They could come back tomorrow instead. Here is what followed the opening of the cage. They can answer without you.
messages.囚徒在西门灯旁留下一截能松开的线：今天我照这排苗，到天黑就停。: By the lamp at the west gate, the prisoner leaves a piece of thread that comes loose easily. “I'll tend this row today. When it's dark, I stop.”
messages.四方: The corridor is suspended, with copper moths hovering.
messages.回到印记中，留下不再颤动的弦。: Returns to the mark, leaving a string that no longer trembles.
messages.回到旧王都外环，面对被静音的巡礼军，取得沉默军令并学会灯影相位。: Return to the outer ring of the old capital, face the silenced Pilgrimage Army, obtain the Silent Military Order, and learn the Lantern Phase.
messages.回响诱铃为什么要从园工铃改来？: Why make the Echo Lure out of a gardener's bell?
messages.回声书记的盐刃从页缝里伸出。: The salt blade of the Echo Book extends from the page seam.
messages.回声室不可中途传送。: The echo chamber cannot be teleported midway.
messages.回声棘藤哨兵仍会缠脚。: The Echo Thorn Vine Sentinels still tangles around the feet.
messages.回声水轮骑士在骨板间巡行。: The Echo Tidechild knights patrol between the bone plates.
messages.回声渐轻，桌上留下两份新约。一份入柜，一份带出门；有人今后还会拿回来逐字相对。路: As the echo fades, two copies of the new covenant lie on the table. One goes into a cabinet. One goes out the door. Someday someone will bring it back to compare the words. The road didn't end at the signature line.
messages.回声第一次承认自己也在等一个接手的人。我把线端握回自己掌心。: For the first time the echo admitted to waiting for someone to take over. I drew the end of the thread back into my own hand.
messages.回声统帅的军阵比生前更密，棘哨在旗台上封路。: The army of the Echo Commander is denser than before, and the thorn sentinels block the path on the flagpole.
messages.回声钩索可打断蓄力水锤，水阀亮起时优先拉断钩环。: The Echo Hook can break the charged waterhammer. Priority should be given to breaking the hook ring when the water valve lights up.
messages.回声钩索才能取到的可选探索奖励。: Broken-String Singer provides optional exploration rewards.

messages.回头的人还算巡礼者吗？: Is someone who turns back still a pilgrim?
messages.回廊安全了一点，旧钟却仍催着下一代上路。: The passage is a little safer, but the old bell is already sending the next generation down it.
messages.回廊悬空，钟蛾游弋。: The gallery hangs suspended while bell moths drift through.
messages.回廊悬空，铜蛾游弋。: Light up the moss lamp in the root shelter to prepare for the Broken Bough Altar.
messages.回廊的轮值牌留了空位。来的人能签，走的人也能擦去自己的班。: There are empty spaces on the corridor's watch board. You can sign up when you arrive and wipe off your own shift when you go.
messages.回廊脚下是空的。: The ground at the bottom of the corridor was empty.

messages.回来应当是我走进来，而不是它把我拉回去。: Coming back should mean walking in myself. Not being pulled here by the roots.
messages.回来时若改了主意，重新把收益和代价看一遍。以前说过的话，不必拿来逼今天的你。: If you return with a different mind, read the benefits and the costs again. Something you once said needn't bind the person standing here today.
messages.回来的路为什么也要有人记？: Why does someone have to mark the way back?

messages.回温室根笼，与囚徒完整交谈；完成后可在西门重逢。: Return to the Greenhouse Root Cage to have a complete conversation with the prisoner; meet again at the West Gate after completion.
messages.回苔钟庭让学徒听完两处证言。: Return to the Moss Bell Court to have apprentices listen to the testimony from two places.
messages.回访时用钩索横越钟骨桥，落向东阳台。: When returning, use the broken string to cross the bell bone bridge and fall onto the east balcony.
messages.回雨渠找仍在等最后一班下工钟的孩子。: Go to the Rain Canal to find children who are still waiting for the last work bell.
messages.因为上面只多一块落脚处。我给你画的是路，没有本事画回记忆。: There's only a new foothold up there. I can draw a road for you. I can't draw your memory back.
messages.因为今天我想在这里帮人挡雨。能走以后，留下才终于能算我的决定。: Because today I want to shelter people from the rain. Only once I could leave did staying finally become my choice.
messages.因为名字一旦被划掉，后面的账就能装作从没欠过。压页台留下的屑末见过这种手法。: Once a name is crossed off, the debt after it can pass for one that never existed. The shavings on the press have seen that trick.
messages.因为后来的人可能想知道，这条路上不只有胜利的人。: Those who follow might want to know there were people on this road besides the ones who won.
messages.因为有人真的照它生活过。把副本烧了，只剩原页，会让受过的事像没有发生。: Because people really lived by them. Burn the copies and leave only the original, and what happened to those people will look as though it never did.
messages.因为有人问我能不能搬水。我说能，搬两桶。第三桶他先问了一声。: Someone asked if I could carry water. I said yes, two buckets. They asked again before the third.
messages.因为漏的是一座城，不是一枚凑数的印。五个人的话不能把第六人的经历顶上。: What's missing is a city, not a token to make up the count. Five voices can't take the place of what a sixth person lived through.
messages.园丁们一边把苗搬到朝阳的架子上，一边唱歌，唱跑了调也不停。冷是冷了些，声音是自己: The gardeners are moving seedlings onto shelves facing the sun, singing without stopping, even when their voices are off-key. It's colder now, but their voices are their own.
messages.园丁先说门，再说树。我记住了这个次序。: The gardener spoke of the door before he spoke of the tree. I'll remember that order.
messages.园丁守着西门。根系安稳下来，他没有把门重新扣上。: The gardener kept watch at the west gate. Even now the roots are settled, he hasn't latched it again.
messages.园丁扒开旧包布给我看。他把“我信了”说了两遍。: The gardener peeled back the old wrapping to show me. Twice he said, “I believed her.”
messages.园丁托我带的是退路。我没有答应替囚徒原谅他。: The gardener asked me to bring a way out. I didn't promise to forgive him for the prisoner.
messages.园丁舍不得苗，仍把西门的路让出来。我替他搬开挡脚的空盆。: It pained the gardener to leave the seedlings, but he cleared the west gate. I moved an empty pot out of the way for him.
messages.园丁轮流守弦，一人一个时辰。值守表上的名字一天比一天多，也有人划掉自己，写上“下: The gardeners take turns keeping the strings in place, one for a period of time. The names on the watch table increase day by day, and some people cross out their own names and write "Return next season."
messages.园丁问要不要挪盆，我说今天不要。他真的把盆搬走了，我才觉得自己出了笼。: The gardener asked about moving a pot. I said not today. When he really carried it away himself, I felt I'd finally left the cage.
messages.园主变成了主教，歌守徽呢？: The Gardener became the Bishop. What happened to Hui, the Songwarden?
messages.园主和唱歌的人有同一个愿望吗？: Did the Gardener and the singer want the same thing?
messages.园主害怕断掉的弦，因为那声音像旧王的命令。: The garden owner fears broken strings, because that sound resembles an old king’s command.
messages.园主舞台，左右弦柱控制藤蔓墙，中间有可下劈反弹的棘球。: On the Garden Master Stage, the left and right string pillars control the vine wall, with a spiky ball in the middle that can be lowered and bounced.
messages.园工原来靠铃互报剪枝的节拍，听见它会知道旁边有人要动手。: The gardeners used bells to signal the rhythm of pruning. When someone heard one they knew the person beside them was about to cut.
messages.在停摆的车间取回回声钩索。: Retrieving the Echo Hook in the shut-down workshop.
messages.在军墓里找到逃旗手与隐藏灯位。: Find a Deserter Standard-Bearer and a hidden light position in the Soldiers' Tomb.
messages.在前廊暖灯休整，哨兵驻守之后的Boss门前平台: Rest by the warm lamp in the front gallery. A sentry guards the platform before the boss gate beyond.
messages.在园丁旁观察西阶与树冠回访方向，再下探根须南廊: From the gardener, look for the west steps and the path back to the canopy, then descend to the southern root gallery.
messages.在根须庇护所点亮苔灯，为断枝祭坛整备。: Walk through the root entanglements; the path gets narrower with each step.
messages.在盐灯处休整，蜡枪兵领地与档案员分开，再越过法庭门槛: Rest by the salt lamp. The wax lancer guards a spot away from the archivist, before the court threshold.
messages.在盐白书库查找不结盐的木匣或契约原件残片。: Search the Saltwhite Archive for unrefined wooden boxes or fragments of contracts.
messages.在立管井顶点灯。: Looking at the light at the top of the Riser Shaft.
messages.在立管井顶点灯。 可选：双层水位记录室。: There is a light at the top of the riser shaft. Optional: double water level recording room.
messages.在缠根间穿行，路越走越窄。: The floor lies a lie. But beneath the lie lies the true memory of the courtyard.
messages.在苔庭回声里回望第一座庭院，找到黑潮童声的暗格。: Looking back at the first courtyard in Tai Chi echo and finding the dark side of the black-thirty child voice.
messages.在蜂蜡暗屋补给，找到藏在蜡壁后的暗灯。: Replenish in the Hidden Wax House and find the dark lamp hidden behind the wax wall.
messages.在蜂蜡暗屋补给，找到藏在蜡壁后的暗灯。 可选：蜂蜡影闩室。: In the Hidden Wax House, find the hidden lamp hidden behind the wax wall. Optional: Hidden Wax Locker Room.
messages.在配重块后找到藏起的地图残页。: Finding the hidden Map Fragment behind the counterweight block.
messages.在门前腾空，再按一次跳跃，接通双线锁。: Fly away from the door, then jump again to connect the double thread lock.
messages.在雨渠长大的引水童，能听懂红阀、水轮和暗管节拍。: Raised by the rain canal, this child knows the rhythms of its red valves, waterwheels and hidden pipes.
messages.在黑曜道查找军令，避开正在成形的军阵。: Look for military orders in the Obsidian Path, avoiding the military formations that are being formed.
messages.在黑曜道的影门路线取得灯影穿行。: Obtain the ability to move through the shadows on the Obsidian Path.
messages.地图上的秩序是一种选择，需要核对。: The order a map gives the world is a choice. I should check it.
messages.地图为何要标住处和工坊？: Why mark homes and workshops on a map?
messages.地图该画歇脚的地方，也该画危险。只画通路，拿着它的人会走得太孤单。: A map should show where to rest as well as where to take care. If all you draw are roads, it's a lonely thing to carry.
messages.地板说了谎。但谎言下面，藏着庭院真正的记性。: The floor lied. But below the lie lies the court's true memory.
messages.地面移动速度提高5%；不增加跳高。织线者留下的软底靴。: The fall is deep; short jumps keep the rhythm steady.
messages.坑底灰烬没过脚踝，退路要数好。: The ash pit is ankle-deep, so be careful with your retreat path.
messages.坠得比看起来深，稳住呼吸。: Fall deeper than it seems; keep your breath steady.
