messages.坠钟舌会从井口砸下。: The falling Tongue will smash down from the wellhead.
messages.垂直立管与检修蹬位: The vertical pipe and the maintenance ladder
messages.垂藤单向井: A one-way well for the vines.
messages.垂链与卡住的工牌: The hanging chain and the stuck work badge
messages.基础藤壳寄生体展示温室失控。: The basic vine shell parasite shows the greenhouse's loss of control.
messages.堆满松脂罐的库房: A warehouse filled with pine resin jars
messages.沿脚下缓坡向西走，可接上暗河走道。: Follow the slope west to the Underway.
messages.塔梯是单向的，可以从下方穿过。: The tower stairs are one-way, allowing passage from below.
messages.塔顶风口没有护栏。: There are no guardrails at the top of the tower.
messages.塔顶风大。: The wind was strong at the top of the tower.
messages.墙在这里，你也确实能上去；选择往上还是回头，要等你现在回答。: Here's a wall, and you can climb it. Whether you go up or turn back is a question for you now.
messages.增加最大生命。打了死结的绯线，攥紧就不冷。: Increase maximum health. Hold the twisted Crimson Thread tightly, it won't cool down.
messages.增加最大能量。半沉在暗室水里的纺锤仍在转。: Increasing the maximum energy. The spinning Energy Spindle in the semi-submerged water in the dark room was still moving.
messages.增加最大能量。沉在水窖深廊的纺锤仍在转。: Increase maximum energy. The spinning spindle in the Deep Cistern Hall remains active.
messages.声音工具的含义应由共同使用者核对。: The meaning of a signal belongs to the people using it together.
messages.声音归还众人；钟网停止，居民自建防潮工事。: The people regain their voices. The bell network stops. Residents build their own flood defences.
messages.声音是否存在，与人能否互相回应是两件事。: A sound may exist even when people can't answer one another.
messages.声音相似不足以证明身份，也不构成服从义务。: Two similar voices don't prove an identity. Neither one binds me to obey.
messages.壳碎了，我们离得近些了。你能不用贴着地，就听我说完一句吗？: The shell has broken. We're a little closer. Can you hear me finish a sentence now without putting your ear to the ground?
messages.复刻五章 Boss 的简化招式：冲撞、水锤、盐刃、藤鞭、军阵。: Simplified moves for the five chapters of the boss: collision, water hammer, salt blade, vine whip, and military formation.
messages.复刻五章 Boss 的简化招式：冲撞、水锤、盐刃、藤鞭、军阵。；王冠命令玩家重鸣: Simplified moves for the five Chapter Bosses: collision, water hammer, salt blade, vine whip, military formation. The Crown Command makes the player Retoll, and three doors appear in the field that can be rewritten with crown_resonance.
messages.复活旗会召回敌人。: The resurrection flag will recall the enemies.
messages.复考冲刺、钟隙和落钟。: Retaking the dash, bell gap, and falling bell.
messages.复考双线跃、钟壳格挡和迟影。: Retaking the double thread jump, bellshell guard, and late shadow.
messages.复考墙跳、钩索和水位。: Retaking the wall jump, rope and water level.
messages.复考棘线下劈和移动藤蔓。: Retaking the thorn downstrike and moving vines.
messages.复考灯影相位和军阵。: Retaking the lantern phase and military formation.
messages.外壳已破，三扇门待选。请再读一次清单，别让胜利替你做最后的决定。: The shell is broken. Three doors await. Read the list once more. Don't let your victory make this final decision for you.
messages.外壳碎了，我还在。谢谢你先问我，再去碰那扇门。: The shell has broken. I'm still here. Thank you for asking me first, before you touch that door.
messages.外庭盐风口在高处，双线跃够得着了。你要接回家的路，也可以先去试。: There's a salt vent high in the outer court. Your Twin-Thread Leap can reach it now, if you'd like to try the way home.
messages.外庭钟塔1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Outer Court Bell Tower 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.外庭钟塔2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Outer Court Bell Tower 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.外庭钟塔3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Outer Court Bell Tower 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.外庭钟塔4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Outer Court Bell Tower 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.外庭钟塔5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Outer Court Bell Tower 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.外庭钟塔6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Outer Court Bell Tower 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.多了一条冲刺的路，也请保留一条回来的路。后门会替你等着。: Now that you can dash along one more road, keep a road home as well. The back gate will wait for you.
messages.大事停下的空隙里，住在这里的人还得过夜。: Even in the pause between great events, the people who live here need to get through the night.
messages.大字说我祖母欠一班，页边却有她自己的小注：那天她替病人守夜。: The big print says Grandmother owed a shift. In the margin, in her own tiny hand, it says she watched by a sickbed that night.
messages.大树之心母株脚下（枯萎母株口径），真结局收集品；地图重做后迁至 thorn_do: At the foot of the Heartwood mother plant (caliber of the withered mother plant), the collectible of the true ending; after the map was redrawn, it was moved behind the thorn_downstrike door.
messages.大树之心母株脚下；获得棘丝下劈后检查根系封口，取证后返回枝台。: At the base of the Heartwood of the Great Tree; after obtaining the thorn wire penetration, check the root seal and return to the branch platform after collecting evidence.
messages.大树之心的常明灯，稳住中环节奏。: The constant light of the Heartwood, stabilizing the middle rhythm.
messages.大树之心的接弦伤口: The wound from the Heartwood of the Great Tree's stringing
messages.大树的根就在你头顶，记住它的位置。: The roots of the big tree are right above you. Remember its location.
messages.大殿谁都找得到。我收钱，是替人画出藏在大殿后面的路。: Anyone can find the great hall. What people pay me for is the road hidden behind it.
messages.天窗后还有一间暗室。: There was another dark room behind the skylight.
messages.天顶盐灯下的钟铃不响了，门上写着撤离路线。: The bell under the Skybridge Salt Lamp stops ringing, and the door reads the evacuation route.
messages.天顶盐灯下的钟铃重新报时。: The bell under the Skybridge Salt Lamp rings again to keep time.
messages.天顶盐灯旁订上了一页新页，空着等人签名。: A new page is attached next to the Skybridge Salt Lamp, waiting for someone to sign it.
messages.失去镇潮器，温室能扛住吗？: Without the tide ward, can the greenhouse hold?
messages.失聪铁匠柳守在井沿。: The deaf Smith's Oath Liu was standing by the well edge.
messages.失聪铁匠柳教学后开启首个墙面攀附井。: After Liu, the Deaf Smith teaches, open the first wall climbing well.
messages.失败不应自动转成服役的债。: Failure shouldn't turn automatically into a debt of service.
messages.失败巡礼者被强制编队，王冠会吞掉反抗者。: The defeated pilgrims are forced to line up, and the crown will swallow those who resist.
messages.失败巡礼者被重编为静音军队。: The failed Pilgrim is recreated as a silent army.
messages.失败的前代巡礼者，成为巡礼军后仍保留少量自我。: An earlier pilgrim who failed. Still holds on to a little of himself in the ranks of the Silent Legion.
messages.失败的巡礼者为什么还会归队？: Why do pilgrims who failed return to the ranks?
messages.头顶的裂口通向钟隙渡口。: The crack above leads to the Bellgap Crossing.
messages.头顶的钟摆车间在锤声停后开启。: The Pendulum Workshop above was opened after the hammer sound stopped.
messages.夹层决斗者保留虚晃与双刺；落脚后观察，再利用收招反击: The mezzanine duelist feints and thrusts twice. Watch after landing, then counter during recovery.
messages.夹层比地面安静，安静不等于安全。: The compartment is quieter than the ground; quiet does not mean safe.
messages.契约写明钟声一度压住黑潮，并非纯粹诅咒。: The covenant states that the bell sound once suppressed the black tide, not a pure curse.
messages.契约原本显示六枚印记曾是六位守门者心脏，第七签署者被系统删名。: The contract originally showed that the six markings were once the hearts of six Gatewardens, and the seventh signer was removed by the system.
messages.契约总官就是留下原页的人吗？: Was the High Registrar the one who left the original?
messages.契约改写后，我还守灯。变化的是谁需要光，不是光该不该留下。: When the covenant is rewritten, I'll still tend the lamp. Who needs the light may change. There should still be a light.
messages.契约法庭的副册燃成白盐，书库后门露出被藤蔓吞没的温室栈道。: The secondary copy of the Covenant Court burns into white salt, and the back door of the library reveals a greenhouse walkway swallowed by vines.
messages.契约法庭门前的稳定检查点，死亡回跑很短。: A stable checkpoint in front of the Covenant Court door; dying and running back is short.
messages.契约法庭，三色封蜡柱周期改变 Boss 招式和迟影速度。: The Covenant Court, where the three-color sealing wax pillars periodically change the boss's moves and the speed of the late shadow.
messages.契约碎页指向一座会呼吸的温室，盐白书库的活封面来自这里。: The contract fragment points to a breathing greenhouse, where the Living Bookcover of the Saltwhite Archive comes from.
messages.契约索引室所有目录都缺少第七签署者，空白页只留下绯色线痕。: All the catalogs in the covenant index room lack the seventh signer, with blank pages only leaving traces of crimson lines.
messages.契约还在自动复写谎言。: The contract continues to rewrite lies automatically.
messages.契约里留一句让花按自己的季节开。园丁可以修路，不能替每片叶子安排寿命。: Put in a line that lets a flower open in its own season. A gardener can mend paths. The span of every leaf isn't mine to decide.
messages.契约页藏在删名塔，不在索引室。索引只负责说谎。: The contract page is hidden in the Deleted Tower, not in the index room. The index is only responsible for lying.
messages.她倒下时，我险些说“终于还清了”。可门外还有孩子。: When she fell, I nearly said, “At last it's paid.” But there are still children outside the gate.
messages.她停下了，我却还站得像在等令。: She has stopped. I still stand as if waiting for orders.
messages.她停下来以后，谁接着照看母株？: Who looks after the mother plant once she stops?
messages.如今你能走到那三道门前。我很想告诉你该选哪一道。: Now you can reach all three doors. I'd dearly like to tell you which one to choose.
messages.如今名字带回来了，我还是想留住这条规矩。: Even now the names are home, I'd like to keep that rule.
messages.如今巷口没人举手，管子倒还通着。你若去井下，看看收声的线是不是也从那里过。: No hands go up there now, but the pipes still run. If you go below the well, see whether the voice-gathering thread goes that way too.
messages.如今我能把整段灯号重新试完。先停在安全台上，再给下一道光。: Now I can test the whole signal again. Stop on a safe ledge first. Then give the next light.
messages.如今灯号校正了，我还得向路过的人解释。: The signals have been corrected. I still need to explain them to the people passing through.
messages.如今能走的门多了，你也可以先回钟庭。: More doors are open now. You can go back to Bell Court first if you like.
messages.如今锤已落地，我们可以从容看那些后来添上的细线。: Now that the hammer lies on the ground, we have time to examine the fine lines added later.
messages.如果你愿意，把井里听见的那一声带回来。我想给它留两个音的位置。: If you like, bring me the sound you heard in the well. I'd like to leave two notes' worth of room for it.
messages.如果你选择断冠，记得先告诉我们为什么死。: If you choose Crownfall, remember to tell us why you died first.
messages.如果你选择重鸣，我会再次成为军队。: If you choose Retolling, I will become part of the army again.
messages.如果我找不到，你会怪我吗？: Will you blame me if I can't find them?
messages.如果捡到契约原件碎片，请让我看一眼。我欠目录一个诚实的更正。: If you come across a scrap of the original covenant, let me see it. I owe the catalogue an honest correction.
messages.如果没人叫得出我的名字，你怎么叫我？: If no one knows my name, what will you call me?
messages.如果路上捡到完整的心结，回来给我看看。我想知道城外的人怎么收针。: If you find an intact heart knot on the road, bring it back and show me. I'd like to see how they finish a stitch outside the city.
messages.委托出于具体的需要，不应被写成主角的先天义务。: The apprentice has a reason for asking. It wasn't my duty from birth.
messages.委托者的需要不能盖过被救者的选择。: What the person asking for help needs shouldn't outweigh the choice of the person we're trying to free.
messages.孢箱会炸；工头身边没有渠虫，可以放心交谈。: The spore box could explode; there were no canal insects beside the foreman, so he could talk with confidence.
messages.孢蜡烛台会突然炸开。: The spore candle table will suddenly explode.
messages.孢钟匠自高处泼洒孢云。: Spore Bellmaker scatters spore clouds from above.
messages.孤立庭兽，先看蜷头前摇，再利用收招挥刃: Face the court beast alone. Watch it tuck its head, then strike as it recovers.
messages.学习水流推力和低顶通道。: Learn about water flow thrust and the low ceiling passage.
messages.学习水流推力和低顶通道。 -> 找到第一座水轮升降机。: Learn water flow propulsion and low-top channels. -> Find the first water wheel elevator.
messages.学会灯影相位穿门。: Learn to pass through the Lantern Phase.
messages.学徒刚试着念出阿禾，水声就从低阶漫了上来。: The apprentice has barely tried saying A-He aloud when the sound of water rises from the lower steps.
messages.学徒听见了名字，我很高兴；我还是会想他们。: I'm glad the apprentice heard the names. I still miss my family.
messages.学徒已经接住两处消息，这件事终于不只留在一页纸上。: The apprentice has news from both places now. At last this lives somewhere besides a sheet of paper.
messages.学徒怕的不是针丢了，是有人凭这枚针认定他该留下。: The apprentice isn't afraid of losing the needle. He's afraid someone will take it as proof that he must stay.
messages.学徒把名单分成能认清与仍空着的两边，没有把空格算进轮值。: The apprentice sorts the list into names they can read and spaces still empty. None of the blanks goes on the watch rota.
messages.学徒把找回的名单压在重新响起的钟下：阿禾还在这儿，钟却依旧只认编号。: The apprentice weighs the recovered list down beneath the bell. It rings again. A-He is still here, but the bell knows only his number.
messages.学徒把阿禾的名字绣在线结里面，领扣留得能解开。孩子摸了摸那个“禾”字。学徒问有没: The apprentice embroiders A-He's name inside the knot and leaves the clasp loose enough to open. The child traces the last character. Any news? the apprentice asks. The child shakes their head and says Dad's name once more.
messages.学徒肯叫他的名字了吗？那你再去时，告诉他领口别缝太硬。: Has the apprentice said his name? Next time you go, tell him to keep the collar soft.
messages.孩子把工牌翻到背面才递来。我也照这个方向收好。: The child turned the badge over before handing it to me. I put it away that same way up.
messages.孩子记得我停下来过。我想起自己也有话可以慢慢说。: The child remembered that I stopped. I remembered I too could take my time finding words.
messages.孩子记得，柳认得，书记肯把原页拿出来。原来不在册上，不是从没活过。: The child remembers. Liu knew him. The scribe brought out the original page. So being left off the roll doesn't mean you never lived.
messages.它不必只在终点才有用。: It needn't wait until the end of the road to be of use.
messages.它不能替整个温室作决定，却能让下一次决定少一点盲目。: One lamp can't decide for the whole Greenhouse. It can make the next decision a little less blind.
messages.它守的泵井，不代表它就是沉在井里的铁匠。: Guarding the pump well didn't make the Apostle the smith lying at its bottom.
messages.它能认你的线，不能替你认完一个人。许多锁一插对钥匙，就显得很亲近。: It recognizes your thread. That doesn't mean it knows a whole person. Plenty of locks feel welcoming when you put the right key in.
messages.它若还能护住一个人，也许就有了新的用处。: If it can still keep someone dry, perhaps it's found a new use.
messages.它证明曾有一次主动不让门开。至于那一刻的每个念头，磨痕没有全部写下。: It shows that once someone deliberately kept the door shut. The wear marks don't record every thought they had in that moment.
messages.它还在叫。我这次不答，也不能替还被叫着的人说他们已经自由。: It's still calling. I won't answer this time. But I can't tell you that the ones it still calls are free.
messages.守军亡者点名者: The guards are counting the dead
messages.守到最后，他们不知道这里还藏着什么，我也不知道外面还剩谁。: In the end they didn't know what was still hidden here. I didn't know who was left outside.
messages.守卫的巢就在井底正中。: The guard's nest was right in the middle of the well bottom.
messages.守卫的巢就在祭坛正中。: The guard's nest is right in the center of the altar.
messages.守护可以是一天一天做的事。抵押却有人拿着凭据，要求你永远不能停。: You can decide to guard something day by day. With a pledge there's someone holding a paper that says you must never stop.
messages.守护需要休止，也需要重新询问。: A watch needs rests. It also needs fresh consent.
messages.守望者的桌上出现了空位。他没有立刻去找一个该填进去的人。: A space opened on the keeper's table. The keeper didn't immediately go looking for someone who ought to fill it.
messages.守望者逐份摆开证词。缺页所在的位置，也要留给我看见。: The keeper laid out each testimony separately. The space where the missing page belonged had to be visible to me too.
messages.守母不再守门之后，有些人会第一次走出自家那一层。: Some people will leave their own level for the first time now the Matriarch no longer guards the gate.
messages.守母不再拦路了，衣领却不会自己有字。我还得一针一针缝。: The Matriarch's out of the way, but names won't appear in collars on their own. I still have to sew every stitch.
messages.守母不再拦路，台阶也没变矮。明天我还得量。: The Matriarch no longer bars the way. The steps haven't got any lower. I'll measure them again tomorrow.
messages.守母倒下后，旧路会迎来回头的人。我把下行的拐角也记了一遍。: Now the Matriarch has fallen, people will come back along the old road. I marked the turns on the way down as well.
messages.守母停下了，我今天第一次把针别在外面。走到门边，又摸了摸。: The Matriarch has stopped. Today I pinned the needle on the outside for the first time. At the gate, I touched it just to check.
messages.守母停下以后，我先清了管口的苔。钟会不会再响，要等街里的人来。: Once the Matriarch stopped I cleared the moss from the pipe mouth. Whether the bell will ring again must wait for the people in the street.
messages.守母停下以后，我更怕大家急着替沉默的人写结论。: Since the Matriarch stopped, I've worried even more that everyone will rush to conclusions on behalf of people who can't speak.
messages.守母停下以后，这条路上会有更多不同的称呼。: Now the Matriarch has fallen still, you'll hear more than one name on this road.
messages.守母停下后，我也不一定还守这道门。到时候你可能得换个地方找我。: Now the Matriarch has stopped, I may not keep this gate either. You may have to look for me somewhere else.
messages.守母只同意押上自己的心，没有同意押上后人的嗓子。: The gatekeepers only agree to stake their hearts, not their descendants' voices.
messages.守母押上心的时候，知道后面会多出那些线吗？: When the Matriarch pledged her heart, did she know those lines would be added?
messages.守母的锤停了，今天我就挨家走了一趟，没有替大家敲下下一声。: With the Matriarch's hammer still, I went house to house today. I didn't sound the next toll on everyone's behalf.
messages.守母的门已开，证词却仍然值得带回去谈。: The Matriarch's gate is open. The testimony is still worth taking back to discuss.
messages.守母的震地与冲撞覆盖全场。: The mother guard's shock land and collisions cover the entire area.
messages.守母终于卸下钟冠了。我会敲一声息，不敲胜利。守庭的人也该歇一歇。: The Matriarch has laid down her bell crown. I'll sound a rest, not a victory. The one who guarded this court has earned some sleep.
messages.守母身后的门开了，并不说明每个人都必须穿过去。: An open gate behind the Matriarch doesn't mean everyone has to go through.
messages.守母还记得自己在等谁吗？: Does the Matriarch remember whom she's waiting for?
messages.守的不是后门，是「还愿意回来」这件事；等一个替全城摇响「鸣」的人。: Keeps watch for those who still wish to return. Waits for someone to sound a toll for the whole city.
messages.守这里还能让人来核对，守新的签署不被又合成一把只许一人转的总锁。: I'll keep this place open to anyone who comes to check. I'll guard against new signatures being joined into another master lock that only one person may turn.
messages.守钟的职分能传给孩子吗？: Can watching the bell be passed down to a child?
messages.守门人复刻五章首领的招式。: The gatekeeper replicates the moves of the five-chapter leader.
messages.守门人已经停了，你可以先听自己的呼吸。: The Gatekeeper has stopped. You can listen to your own breathing first.
messages.守门人的门已开，你有比照着旧回声走更多的时间。: The Gatekeeper's door is open. You have time to do more than walk to the beat of an old echo.
messages.守门的敌人与留下证词的人必须分辨。: I need to distinguish the enemy guarding the gate from the person who left the testimony.
messages.守门者心脏在藤壳里跳动。: The gatewardens's heart beats inside the vine shell.
messages.守门者既是执行者也是被抵押的人：记忆残存，行动仍被钟令驱动。: The gatekeepers are both executors and people who have been mortgaged: their memories remain, but their actions are still driven by the bell order.
messages.安全屋，稍作歇息。: Safety house, take a short rest.
messages.安全屋，风雨在外。: The safe house, with the wind and rain outside.
messages.安全工房无敌群；失足落回底层维护道，可重新起跳或原路退出。: Safe workshop with no enemies; falling lands you on the lower maintenance walkway so you can retry or exit the way you came.
messages.安全工房无敌群；高台失足仍落在维护底道。深井可从远侧升梯返回封板上层。: Safe workshop with no enemies; falling from the high platform lands you on the lower maintenance walkway. The far lift in the deep shaft returns you to the upper seal plate.
messages.安全折返本身不需要功绩作抵押。: A safe return shouldn't have to be earned.
messages.安全整备与回程识别: Prepare safely and find the way back
messages.安稳与公正并非同一项成果，应分别核对。: Stability and justice are two different outcomes. Each needs checking in its own right.
messages.完成本区钟龛契约取得，可交工匠用于永久改制；只登记一次，不可重复领取。: Complete the bell shrine contract in this area to obtain it for permanent modification by the artisan; it can only be registered once and cannot be collected again.
messages.完成见证后消散，线结交还主角。: Fades once the witnessing is done, returning the knot to the Pilgrim.
messages.完整听完囚徒确认退路: Listen to the prisoner's confirmation of a retreat route completely
messages.完整的歌未必说真话。我以前唱得很好，也替别人把求救盖住过。: A whole song can still tell a lie. I used to sing beautifully. Sometimes I sang over people calling for help.
messages.完美格挡封蜡枪兵的突刺可返还能量。: Perfectly blocking the sealing wax archer's thrust can return energy.
messages.完美格挡枪兵突刺，反弹封蜡打开重门。: Perfectly blocking the archer's thrust, the rebound sealing wax opens a heavy door.
messages.宏观稳定不能代替对具体束缚的检查。: A steady network doesn't tell us which individual bindings are still too tight.
messages.宝物可以放进柜里，名字却得先有人愿意念。你看过试音模，就知道听见也曾是一门手艺。: A treasure can go in a cabinet. A name needs someone willing to say it. You've seen the tuning mould. Listening was once a craft too.
messages.审判抄写室1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Tribunal Scriptorium 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.审判抄写室2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Tribunal Scriptorium 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.审判抄写室3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Tribunal Scriptorium 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.审判抄写室4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Tribunal Scriptorium 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.审判抄写室5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Tribunal Scriptorium 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.审判抄写室6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Tribunal Scriptorium 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.审判抄写室7：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Tribunal Scriptorium 7. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.室内的水声是假的，脚步声是真的。: The sound of water inside is fake, but the footsteps are real.
messages.家里修东西时，我靠墙听。相同的管子，敲的人换了，停顿就不一样。: When people mended things at home, I listened through the wall. Same pipe, different hands, different pauses.
messages.宽地面直通殿门；右侧烛台是观察台，不必攀登也能前进。: The wide floor leads directly to the hall door; the candlestick on the right is an observation platform, allowing progress without climbing.
messages.密室封存的东西不愿被读。: Things sealed in the secret room are not meant to be read.
messages.对。到了钟庭也这样念。查不到的地方也告诉学徒，别说爹明天就会回来。: That's right. Say it like that at Bell Court. Tell the apprentice what you couldn't find, too. Don't say Dad's coming home tomorrow.
messages.对不知道的保持诚实，对已经看见的负责；这也能成为开始。: Be honest about what you don't know. Take responsibility for what you've seen. You can start there.
messages.对过去的责任也要照见现在的生命。: In attending to the past, I must still see the lives being lived now.
messages.封印根门1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Sealed Root Gate 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.封印根门2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Sealed Root Gate 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.封印根门3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Sealed Root Gate 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.封印根门4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Sealed Root Gate 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.封印根门5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Sealed Root Gate 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.封印根门6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Sealed Root Gate 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.封存书堆上层书架（禁书夹层口径），真结局收集品；地图重做后迁至 double_t: The upper bookshelf of the Sealed Stacks (for forbidden books), collectables for the true ending; moved to behind the double_thread_jump door after map redraw.
messages.封存书堆上层书架；取得双线跃后回访，检查不结盐的页角。: On the upper shelves of the Sealed Stacks; return after obtaining the Double Thread Jump and check the corners of the unrefined pages.
messages.封存书堆上层的原页没有结盐；“自愿”旁边留着刮刀的白边，“后嗣”墨迹更深。: The original pages on the upper shelves of the Sealed Stacks are not refined; there is a scraper's edge next to "Voluntary," and the ink of "Descendants" is darker.
messages.封存书堆的改字页: Altered Page from the Sealed Stacks
messages.封存的站厅。这道竖井贯穿世界——线在往上指，也在往下指。: A sealed station. This shaft runs through the world. The thread points up as well as down.
messages.封档人承认两道封口都是自己补过的。我把那句“记不清”也记下来。: The archivist admitted to mending both seals. I recorded those words too: “I can't quite remember.”
messages.封死一个口子容易。若连它原先通向哪家门都忘了，以后只会再砌一道墙。: It's easy to brick up an opening. Forget whose door it once reached and the next thing you build will just be another wall.
messages.封蜡又盖在旧条款上。我保存的原页不会因此变成假的。: The wax seal has gone back onto the old terms. The original page I kept is still genuine.
messages.封蜡库余响: Remnants of the Sealing Wax Vault
messages.封蜡库本就是可选支路；不敲钟可拿走碎晶离开。封门只封西侧入口，可绕开、可回访。离: The Sealing Wax Vault is an optional branch; you can take the crystal fragments and leave without knocking the bell. The door only seals the western entrance, allowing bypass or Return. Leaving this room terminates this trial; open the door, reset the bell, and you can return at any time to knock again.
messages.封蜡库首清：取得封蜡账册证据，并得额外碎钱与盐晶碎片。: First clear of the Sealing Wax Vault: obtain evidence from the sealing wax ledger, and get extra coins and salt crystal fragments.
messages.封蜡是怕书坏，还是怕人看？: Was the wax supposed to protect the books or keep people from reading them?
messages.封蜡枪兵验证玩家是否理解契约防御。: The sealing wax archer verifies whether the player understands the covenant defense.
messages.封蜡究竟保护了谁？: Whom does the sealing wax really protect?
messages.封蜡突刺、盐刃横扫、错页召唤。: Sealing wax thrust, salt blade sweep, wrong page summon.
messages.封蜡突刺、盐刃横扫、错页召唤。；迟影加入，复制玩家最近一次攻击；完美格挡可让迟影: Wax thrust, salt blade sweep, wrong page summon. The Late Shadow joins, copying the player’s last attack; perfect blocking allows the Late Shadow to hit the Boss.
messages.封蜡还没干，靠边坐。封口能保住一张纸，也能把一句话关太久。: The wax hasn't set. Sit off to one side. A seal can save a piece of paper. It can also lock up a sentence for too long.
messages.小体型跳扑，配合迟影形成追击压力。: Small-sized jump and pounce, combined with the late shadow to create a pursuit pressure.
messages.小的维护也有独立于终局的意义。: A small repair matters whatever happens in the end.
messages.小路、工具架、能坐下的地方，都还等着补。: The small paths, the tool racks, the places to sit. All still need attention.
messages.小飞行群，逼玩家使用空中攻击。: Small flying groups force players to use aerial attacks.
messages.少一个就补一个，补的还是那个人的号。到后来，我自己也只报数字了。: If a worker was missing, we had to supply another under the same number. In the end I too reported only figures.
messages.少卖一点也行。亮给上面数的灯，我已经点得够多。: I can afford to sell a little less. I've lit enough lamps for someone above to count.
messages.少哪份，我把来路说给你；你可以回去，也可以先作别的选择。我不替空位签字。: Tell me the missing one and I'll give you the route. Go back or make another choice first, as you wish. I won't sign for the empty place.
messages.就是这份军令。失败者从名册上删去，又被暗令召回。: That's the order. They strike the fallen from the roll, then call them back in secret.
messages.就沿着能核对的走，记不起的地方不用急着缝满。: Let's follow what we can check. There's no hurry to stitch up every gap in your memory.
messages.尽头一跃可直落炉前钟龛。: One leap at the end could lead directly to the Furnace Shrine.
messages.尽头是直落枢纽的单向坠道。: At the end is a one-way drop road leading straight down.
messages.屋外蜂群会跟随玩家进入短走廊。: The bee swarm outside the house will follow the player into the short corridor.
messages.嵌着残页的配重块: The counterweight block with the embedded map fragment
messages.巡礼军不会说话，但他们会执行你不想听见的命令。: The Pilgrimage Army doesn’t speak, but they will execute commands you don’t want to hear.
messages.巡礼军基础阵型展示王冠命令。: Show the basic formation of the Pilgrim soldiers and the crown's commands.
messages.巡礼军墓挑战房留下的灯影残响。不挡主线，却能证明你敲响过军墓余响钟。: Pilgrim Camp's lights stabilize the rhythm on the mountain waist.
messages.巡礼军墓的重编名册: Revised Muster Roll from the Silent Legion Graves
messages.巡礼可以前进，也该允许返程。: A pilgrimage can go forward. It must also leave room for a return.
messages.巡礼池的白纱保存了名字；你从温室还是书库来，都能继续追查。: There are names in the white veil by the Pilgrim Pool. Whether you came from the Greenhouse or the Archive, you can still follow them.
messages.巡礼者用短句、等待与递还物件回应。旅记只写亲见、亲闻和自己的疑问；未知来历不凭能: Pilgrims respond with short sentences, waiting, and handing over items. Journals only record what they have seen, heard, and their own questions; unknown origins are not filled in based on ability, nor are conversations written as promises made on behalf of others.
messages.巡礼营地的常明灯，稳住山腰节奏。: Recall at night: Only a corner of charred fabric remains (collect) + Crimson Thread whispers (see 13.5); move to pilgrim_camp for free activities if the burning flag is completed.
messages.巡礼营地（跃下）: After the war, the military formation disperses, leaving only wind behind the door.
messages.工人拆下誓牌，钉成一排挡潮板，翻面刻着各自的名字。水位涨了一指，板子撑住了。: Workers remove the badges and nail them into a row of moisture barriers, with their names carved on the reverse side. The water level rises by an inch, and the barriers hold up.
messages.工人用手势交接班，誓牌照旧挂在胸前，编号朝外。水轮很稳，没人说话。: Workers hand over shifts by gesture, with the old badges still hanging on their chests, with the numbers facing outward. The water wheels are stable, and no one speaks.
messages.工头在找三枚工牌。 台侧有渠影残迹可循。: The foreman was looking for three work badges. There were Canal Shade tracks on the side of the platform.
messages.工头想留名字，留下的空位却继续要人填。我把他的原话记在工牌背面的空处。: The foreman wanted to keep the names. The spaces he left went on demanding workers. I put his own words in the space on the back of the badge.
messages.工房成长奖励：四片合成一件永久容量。: Workshop growth reward: four pieces combined into one permanent unit.
messages.工时会告诉你炉子烧了多久，不能告诉你是谁替同伴多守了那一刻。: Hours tell you how long the furnace burned. They won't tell you who took an extra turn for a friend.
messages.工牌上的号是后来压的，背面这个缺口不是。给书库的人看，叫他两面都认。: The number was stamped onto the badge later. That nick on the back was there before. Show it to the people at the Archive. Make them look at both sides.
messages.工牌保留的名字与原件刮去的字相互印证：被改掉的是人的身份，不是镇潮设施所需的编号: The names kept on the worker badges confirm with the words scraped off the original badges: it's the identity of the person who was changed, not the numbers required for the moisture barrier system.
messages.工牌的凹痕让名字有了别的凭据；你的事也得慢慢找这样的凭据。: Dents in a work tag gave us another way to trace a name. Look for evidence like that for your own story, little by little.
messages.工牌翻过来那一点凹，我以前以为只是敲坏了；现在知道有人认真敲过。: That little dent when you turn over the badge? I thought it was damage. Now I know someone hammered it in with care.
messages.工牌背面的铆痕为何各不相同？: Why do the rivet marks on the backs of the badges differ?
messages.工牌要看铆痕，人也得找真留下过的痕。哪天找到你的，我们再认。: A work badge needs a rivet mark. For a person too, we need a mark that was really left. Bring yours when you find one and we'll look.
messages.工牌这回按名字排了，阿禾那枚单独留着。不是空出来就要谁的孩子顶上。: The badges are sorted by name this time. We've set A-He's aside. One empty place needn't be taken by someone's child.
messages.工班按名字重排，退班也记清。不能再让孩子替父亲上工。: We'll draw up shifts by name and record who has left. Children mustn't have to take their fathers' shifts again.
messages.左上方书堆后透出一道盐灯的光。: A light from a salt lamp shines through the pile of books at the upper left.
messages.左右三连斩: Three strikes to the left and right
messages.左右交替落点，湿土会滑。: Alternating landing points from left to right. The wet soil will slide.
messages.左键是斩击，右键用能量缝回一格命。: The left button is for chopping, the right button uses energy to suture a row of hits.
messages.巨型水轮的剪影在腔底转动。: The silhouette of the giant waterwheel was rotating at the bottom of the cavity.
messages.巨大的出水铁口: The huge iron outlet for water
messages.巨窟中的断枝祭坛: The broken branch altar in the giant cave
messages.已完成；可以在相关城区重逢。: Complete. You can meet again in their district.
messages.已经有五份，为什么还不能当六份用？: I already have five testimonies. Why can't they stand for six?
messages.已获得的能力不构成必须使用的命令。: Learning a skill puts me under no order to use it.
messages.巷口以前有人替师父听钟。我想给那里也留一把椅子。: Someone used to listen for Master's bells from the lane. I'd like to leave a chair there too.
messages.师父留下针的时候，没说我还欠钟一副嗓子。可每次经过殿门，我还是会把针藏起来。: When Master left me the needle, he didn't say I owed the bell my voice. But I still hide the needle whenever I pass the hall door.
messages.师父的针能用了，我却一直没敢在衣领上缝名字。怕缝错，怕这里真的没有人记得了。: Master's needle works again. I still haven't dared stitch a name into a collar. What if I get it wrong? What if no one here remembers?
messages.师父的针能证明他答应了什么吗？: Can Master's needle prove what he agreed to?
messages.师父说，钟做好以前，得先问街里的人听不听得见。模子的口朝向住处，不是朝向殿门。: Master said a bell wasn't finished until people in the street could hear it. The mould faced the houses, not the hall door.
messages.希望主角学会利用迟影，而不是成为另一个被复写的人。: Hopes the Pilgrim can learn to use the Late Shadow without becoming another of its copies.
messages.希望自己的最后一版地图不再白画。: Wants the final edition of the map to lead someone somewhere.
messages.带一块花粉蜡给我，我替你编个心结。货换货，说话算数。: Bring a piece of pollen wax and I'll tie you a heart knot. A fair trade. You have my word.
messages.带一枚旧工人徽章给我。我能认出它的铆钉，就能认出那个人。: Bring me an old worker's badge. If I recognize its rivet, I'll know who wore it.
messages.带上工牌去书库。修管子的办法我有，账上被刮掉的字，要找拿笔的人。: Take the badges to the Archive. I can mend a pipe. To read the words scraped out of the ledger, ask someone who holds a pen.
messages.带到王冠前时，记得把保原文的人也念出来。别让拿刀的占满整段故事。: When you speak before the Crown, say who kept the words safe. The one holding the blade shouldn't get the whole story.
messages.带回契约原件的碎片吧。我的供述需要它，否则仍像一份写得漂亮的谎。: Bring back a fragment of the original covenant. Without it my confession still sounds like a beautifully written lie.
messages.带回来的刻痕也留着。有人若说这条路一直都开着，你就拿给他看。: Keep those carvings you brought back. If someone says the road was always open, show them.
messages.带着灯去最暗的支路。看到求救时别只照一下，要让人看见你停下来。: Take the lamp down the darkest side path. When someone calls for help, do more than shine it on them. Let them see you stop.
messages.帮助别人不该变成买一张改约通行证。: Helping someone shouldn't become the price of a ticket to rewrite the covenant.
messages.帮助玩家理解大地图回环。: Helps you find your way around the loops on the map.
messages.帮我带回那张地图残页。我不收走它，只想把断掉的路誊一遍。: Bring me that torn map page. I'll let you keep it. I just want to copy out the broken stretch of road.
messages.帮我找回无声军令。我不拿它洗罪，只想把自己的选择说完整。: Help me find the Silent Order. I don't need it to wipe my slate clean. I just want to explain the choice I made.
messages.帮我把布角按好吧。今天先把第一个名字缝完。: Hold down that corner for me. Let's finish the first name today.
messages.帮我烧掉三面复活旗，我把军令碎片给你。: Help me burn three resurrection flags, and I’ll give you the fragments of the military order.
messages.常明灯下可以喘息；回声骑士只守王座门前，盾波未散时别急着缝补。: You can catch your breath under the constant light; the Echo Knight only guards in front of the throne, don't rush to mend when the shield wave hasn't dispersed.
messages.干裂根丝往断弦辐桥坠去。: Dry and cracked root threads fall towards the Broken String Spoke Bridge.
messages.平台悬在中庭高处。: The platform hung high in the middle of the courtyard.
messages.年轻人，先看看门上那些凹痕。里面也有我留下的一道，撞门不是一条路。: Look at the dents in that gate, youngster. One of those is mine. Throwing yourself at a door doesn't make a road.
messages.年轻织线匠的残影，守在入庭钟门，确认新巡礼者是否还能感知绯线。: A young threadsmith's echo keeps watch at the bell gate, testing whether each new pilgrim can still feel the Crimson Thread.
messages.庇护所内没有敌人，准备好后再向断枝祭坛下行。: There are no enemies in the shelter, prepare to descend to the broken branch altar.
messages.库底向西可折回西环廊，向东通往王座前廊。: You can return to the West Ring Gallery by turning west, and go to the Throne Approach by turning east.
messages.库房再往东就是井喉。: Further east from the warehouse is the Well Throat.
messages.库房再往东就是井喉。 可见旧检修入口：「棘根深井」。站上裂纹封板，跳起后按下方向: Further east from the warehouse is the Well Throat. The old maintenance entrance can be seen: "Thorn Deep Well". Stand on the cracked sealing plate, jump, press the direction + attack, and chop down with a downward slash. Optional old path: "Root Sleep Bell". The old bell is waiting for a certain echo; perform Crown Resonance under the bell.
messages.库房狭窄，根笼囚徒的话别全信。: The library is narrow. Don't fully believe the words of the Root Cage Prisoner.
messages.库房里封蜡枪兵仍在换岗。: The sealing wax archers in the warehouse are still changing shifts.
messages.应当能。把名字从档案里删掉，与把每个名字都摊在门口，不是仅有的两条路。: They should be able to. Erasing people from the archive and displaying every name at the door aren't our only choices.
messages.庭里终于安静得能听见针落下。我想再缝一双鞋，留给下一位过门的人。: At last the court is quiet enough to hear a needle drop. I think I'll sew another pair of shoes for the next person through the gate.
messages.延续传统可以重新分配发声的位置。: A tradition can continue with other voices taking the lead.
messages.开门、停钟、放水本有不同的锁。把它们接到同一道铜轨以后，一次转动便能替许多人决定: The gates, bells and water each had their own locks. Connecting them to the same copper rail let one turn decide for many people.
messages.开门、停钟、放水，为什么全接进同一把锁？: Why does a single lock open the gate, stop the bells and release the water?
messages.开阔中庭利于机动，也利于敌人合围。: The open courtyard is conducive to mobility and also makes it easy for enemies to encircle.
messages.弃置的吊钟台与铜环: The abandoned bell tower and copper ring
messages.引路应当包含离开队伍的方向。: Guiding someone should include showing them a way out of the column.
messages.弦桥会在 Boss 拉弦后反相。: The string bridge will reverse after the Boss pulls the strings.
messages.弦桥断裂会把玩家送回前厅灯碑。: The broken string bridge will send the player back to the front hall lamp stele.
messages.弦终于不听钟令了。第一首歌先用来告诉低处的人，水位正在涨。: At last the strings no longer obey the bell. My first song will tell the people on the low ground that the water's rising.
messages.归乡是完成使命后的奖励吗？: Is coming home a reward for completing a mission?
messages.归井，井边留下第一次清晰的呼唤。: Returns to the well, leaving a clear call at its edge for the first time.
messages.归井；结局 C 后在 ch1 well_throat 井口保留「朝井口说话」交互: Return to the well; after ending C, there is an interaction easter egg of "Speak to the wellhead" at ch1 well_throat wellhead (reusing its true_ending_branch dialogue pool)
messages.归还名字也包括归还如何使用名字的选择。: Giving back a name also means giving back the choice of how to use it.
messages.归途记录未写入，选择尚未生效。可以重试或取消。: The journey record couldn't be saved. Your choice is still open. Try again or cancel.
messages.归途记录未能写入；本次心愿尚未确认，请重试。: The journey record couldn't be saved. This wish still awaits confirmation. Please try again.
messages.当夜被旗召回：原位只余一角焦布（拾取）＋绯线低语（见 13.5）；烧旗完成则迁至: Open the chapter battle marker of the Shadow Gate Corridor shortcut.
messages.当过枕头，也堵过漏。剪掉军号以后，它还是一块结实的布。: I've used it for a pillow and to plug a leak. Cut out the bugle call and it's still a strong piece of cloth.
messages.形名与职名需要逐一核实，不能套成一条规则。: A name given for appearance and one given for office still have to be checked case by case.
messages.影门只在灯亮时可相位，灯灭时停下等下一拍。: The shadow gate can only phase when the light is on. It stops when the light is off and waits for the next beat.
messages.影门后面，他认出的是我停下的那一步。我也看见了旗以外的他。: Beyond the shadow gate he recognized the step where I stopped. I saw him beyond the flag as well.
messages.影门回廊前的修女，守着灯影相位仪式。: Keeps the lanternshadow rite before the shadow gate gallery.
messages.往后有人问，我会把消息从哪里来讲清楚，也记得是谁愿意听。: If someone asks, I'll say where the news came from. I'll also remember who was willing to listen.
messages.往后的副本旁，我会留下这一段来历，不让安定代替核对。: I'll keep that history beside every future copy. Quiet streets aren't a substitute for checking a page.
messages.往后谁想守钟，可以来学；谁想走，也不该被线头绊住。: Anyone who wants to tend the bell can learn. As for those who want to go, don't let loose thread trip them.
messages.得由用水的人一起排，谁能来、能守多久，都当面说。: Those of us who use the water will have to draw up the shifts together. Say face to face who can come, and for how long.
messages.得让住在这里的人明白，这次光是在指路，不是在点名。: Everyone living here should know that this time the light shows a road. It isn't calling the roll.
messages.心愿已变化，请重新交谈。: The wish has changed. Speak to the person again.
messages.必经断桥，钩住铃环通过。: Must-pass broken bridge, hook the bell ring to pass through.
messages.忍住那句话比搬水难。我先把灯留下，等他自己说。: Holding my tongue was harder than hauling water. I'll leave the lamp here and wait for them to speak.
messages.忏悔环道1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Penitents' Circuit 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.忏悔环道2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Penitents' Circuit 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.

messages.忏悔环道4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Penitents' Circuit 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.

messages.怕。我从这里离开不是因为纸已经不会伤人。: Yes. I didn't leave this place because paper had lost its power to hurt people.
messages.怕跑得快的人只记得自己能跳过去。你看这一阶，空手能跨，背着伤员就不行。: I'm afraid a fast runner only remembers what they could jump. Take this step. You can clear it empty-handed. Try it carrying a wounded friend.
messages.总官不再守着书架了，更多人可以来验。: The High Registrar no longer guards the shelves. More people can come and check.
messages.总官不在了，散出去的副本却还有许多。: The High Registrar is gone. Plenty of the copies sent out remain.
messages.总官不在以后，可以请不同的人各存一份核对过的抄本。: With the High Registrar gone, different people can each keep a verified copy.
messages.总官从不许我把那行念完。现在我想一字一字念。: The High Registrar never let me read that line to the end. Now I want to read it word by word.
messages.总官倒下之后，我仍会问一句：这句话能从哪里读出来？: Even with the High Registrar down, I'll still ask, “Where do you read that on this page?”
messages.总官倒了，我可以少躲一阵。可要有人问这页从哪来，还是得从你走过的路讲起。: With the High Registrar down, I needn't hide quite so much. But anyone who asks where this page came from must still hear the route you took.
messages.总官的刀停了，我仍得把哪页被刮过标出来。: The High Registrar's blade has stopped. I still have to mark which pages were scraped.
messages.总官的印可以留在旁边；我要别人看清，那不是她的字。: The High Registrar's seal can stay beside them. I want people to see that those aren't her words.
messages.总有人劝我别在好日子翻旧事。我听见水退，也听见门外还有人叫不出声。: People keep saying not to drag up the past in these good times. I hear the water fall. I also hear the people outside my door who still cannot call out.
messages.总校书素保留被替换的原字，证明失声制度中的世袭条款来自篡改。: The Chief Librarian retains the replaced words, proving that the hereditary clause in the Silenced System comes from tampering.
messages.总锁在手的人就是新的王吗？: Does holding the master lock make you the new king?
messages.恢复秩序不会撤销追查其来历的必要。: Restoring order leaves the question of how that order came about.
messages.悬挂铁钟会坠落，坠落前有低频晃动。: The hanging iron bell will fall, with a low-frequency shaking before falling.
messages.悬满钩环的车间: The workshop filled with hook rings
messages.悼念与再次征召差在哪一声？: What sound separates remembrance from calling people back to serve?
messages.想不出答案时先歇着，手艺不会因为歇一天就收回去。: Rest if the answer won't come. A day's rest won't take the craft out of your hands.
messages.想保住真名碎片，同时用盐页交换逃亡机会。: Hopes to save a fragment of the true name and trade a salt page for a chance to escape.
messages.想保护书库秩序，但对自己维护的谎言已经产生动摇。: Wants to preserve order in the Archive. Has begun to doubt the lie that holds that order together.
messages.想停止压住所有声音，但也害怕黑潮失控。: Wants to stop suppressing every voice but fears what the Blacktide would do unrestrained.
messages.想找回三枚工牌，确认自己的工人不是无名材料。: Wants three work badges back as proof that his workers were people with names.
messages.想把短暂拒令的技巧传给主角。: Hopes to teach the Pilgrim how to slip a command, even for a moment.
messages.想烧掉复活旗，让自己和队友不再被无限召回。: Wants to burn the banner so he and his comrades will no longer be recalled again and again.
messages.想知道主角会恢复秩序，还是释放被秩序吞掉的人。: Wants to know whether the Pilgrim will restore order or free the people that order swallowed.
messages.想离开铸雨渠，却不敢越过泵井。: Wants to leave Rain Foundry Canal but hasn't dared cross the pump well.
messages.想被释放，或至少让主角替他证明根笼下方有暗道。: Hopes to be freed, or at the very least to have the Pilgrim see that a hidden passage runs beneath the cage.
messages.想让主角保持违抗能力。: Wants the Pilgrim to keep the ability to disobey.
messages.想让主角知道温室不是花园，而是六位守门者的病房。: Wants the Pilgrim to know that this is a sickroom for six Gatewardens, however much it looks like a garden.
messages.想让书库继续存在，但不愿契约官继续删掉活人历史。: Wants the Archive to survive without letting covenant officials erase the histories of living people.
messages.想赚钱，也想把温室里还能被带走的证据交给真正会用的人。: Wants a good price and a chance to get the evidence still left in the Greenhouse into hands that will use it.
messages.愿意听就听一段，想安静也可以往旁边坐。: If you want to listen, stay for a while. If you'd like quiet, there's a place to sit off to the side.
messages.愿意回来修园的人，我会另问；旧约不会替我问这一句。: I'll ask who wants to come back and mend the garden. The old covenant won't ask that question for me.
messages.愿意换班的人先坐下来，把能做多久说清。: Anyone willing to change shifts can sit down first and say how long they can manage.
messages.愿意来修阀的人，需要先知道这里缺什么。: Before volunteering to mend valves, people should know where help is needed.
messages.愿意来的人一起做，做不到的地方也得如实告诉大家。: We'll work with whoever wants to come, and tell everyone plainly what we can't manage.
messages.成排的青铜钩环: The rows of bronze hook rings
messages.成排的青铜闸锁: The rows of bronze gate locks
messages.我一握住钩就知道怎么用。以前也这样吗？: I knew how to use the grapple the moment I held it. Have I done it before?
messages.我一靠近军阵，脚就会跟着踩拍。嘴上说逃了，身体还认路。: As soon as I come near the ranks my feet fall into step. I say I've deserted. My body still knows the way.
messages.我上次说话，影子替我说完了。: The last time I spoke, the shadow spoke for me.
messages.我不保证路上没有危险，只保证指给你看的那条，是真有人走过的。: I won't promise a safe road. I can promise someone has walked the path I'm pointing out.
messages.我不回答时，你会替我写下去吗？: If I don't answer, will you write it in for me?
messages.我不打算拿她的沉默，替所有人说一句愿意。: I won't take her silence as a yes for everyone.
messages.我不是王，我只是被王戴成王冠的钟。: I am not a king, I am just a bell worn by a king.
messages.我不知道。我看见她抬锤，也看见钟口没有回声。不能替她说那就是愿意。: I don't know. I saw her raise the hammer. I heard no answer from the bell mouth. I can't tell you that meant she was willing.
messages.我不知道你那条路有多难，不能替你说值。: You know how hard your journey is. I can't tell you what it's worth.
messages.我不能保证。今晚先看水从哪边来，把怕涝的根托高，能帮忙的人先说自己能做多少。: I can't promise. Tonight we'll see which way the water comes in, prop up the roots that drown easily, and ask everyone who comes to help how much they can do.
messages.我不能替她挑一面说。那是我的统帅，我记得她，也怕她叫我。: I can't pick one side of her story for you. She was my commander. I remember her. I'm also afraid of hearing her call me.
messages.我不要赏钱。等有一天庭外的风吹进来，替我扶一下门就够了。: I don't want a reward. One day the wind will blow in from outside the court. Just hold the door for me then.
messages.我也想知道，哪天不带旗出来，还有没有人认得我。: I wonder whether anyone would recognize me if I came out without the flag one day.
messages.我今天用自己的名字来帮，明天累了就先停；这句话也该能写在名字旁边。: I'm helping under my own name today. If I'm tired tomorrow, I'll stop for a while. There ought to be room to write that beside my name.
messages.我从前把灯举得很高。后来才知道，有些人一直在灯照不到的脚边。: I used to hold the lamp very high. It took me a long time to see the people at my feet, beyond the light.
messages.我以为保住原页，就能不管自己抄出去的字。后来有人拿着副本来问，我没敢认那是我的笔: I thought keeping the original safe meant I wasn't responsible for the words I'd copied. When someone came to me with the copy, I couldn't admit the hand was mine.
messages.我以为学徒在等一份完整名单。他其实先要学会缝下一个无法再确认的名字。: I thought the apprentice was waiting for a complete list. First he needs to learn how to sew a name he can no longer check.
messages.我以前把师父每一针都当成不能改的样子。今天替阿禾缝领口，才想起该问穿衣服的人勒不: I used to think none of Master's stitches could ever be changed. Sewing A-He's collar today, I finally thought to ask the one wearing it whether it pinched.
messages.我以前替一处空白补过“同意”。老师说这样誊起来齐整，我就照做了。: I once filled a blank with “agreed.” My teacher said the copy would look neater that way, so I did.
messages.我们可以记住伤口，不必要求它永远敞开。: We can remember a wound without requiring it to stay open forever.
messages.我们校过的号已经有了共同的读法，能让这件事容易一点。: We worked out what the signals meant together. That should make it a little easier.
messages.我们认过那份军令，我能记得自己曾经把它合起来。: We identified that order together. I can remember closing its pages myself.
messages.我会从最近的柜子开始核对，再记下哪些地方尚未查到。: I'll start at the nearest cabinet, check what I can, then list the places we haven't reached.
messages.我会去把战冢里的枪扶正。契约改了，总得有人告诉没回来的人。: I'll go straighten the spears in the war graves. When the covenant changes, someone has to tell the ones who didn't come home.
messages.我会回去署名，不回去站队。新契约若容不下离开的人，就还不是新的。: I'll go back to sign my name. I won't go back into line. If people who leave have no place in the covenant, there's nothing new about it.
messages.我会在井边。不用保证很快回来，走得通了再来。: I'll be by the well. Don't promise you'll be quick. Come when the road lets you.
messages.我会把营地和能休息的地方重新说给来人听。: I'll tell the next travellers about the camp and the places they can rest.
messages.我会攀墙，是谁替我选了这条路？: I can climb walls. Who chose that path for me?
messages.我会数落下来的钟声了。可我更想学数脚步，数那些往回来看我的脚步。: I've learned to count the bell notes that fall down here. I'd rather learn to count footsteps. The ones that come back to see me.
messages.我会用钩。我第一次拿针时看过自己的手。先把知道的这两件事分开记下。: I can use a grapple. The first time I took a needle, I looked at my hand. For now I'll record those two facts separately.
messages.我会留下我愿意留下的那一页，别的先合起来。: I'll keep the page I want to keep. Close the rest for now.
messages.我会继续修能修的部分，再去请别人帮忙；不会拿今晚的黑暗全压在你肩上。: I'll keep mending what I can and ask others for help. You don't have to carry all of tonight's darkness on your shoulders.
messages.我会继续做手里的衣服，也请别的人打听。等你帮忙不该让你的整条路停在这里。: I'll keep making the coat in my hands. I'll ask other people for news. My waiting for your help shouldn't stop your whole journey here.
messages.我会继续缝，也会把怎么拆这道线教给穿衣服的人。: I'll keep sewing. I'll also teach the person wearing the coat how to unpick that seam.
messages.我会继续认那些空字，但这块布不能替别人的孩子答应旧约。: I'll keep trying to read the missing names. But this cloth can't bind anyone else's children to the old covenant.
messages.我会让来营地的人先听一遍，再请他们说有没有看懂。: I'll explain the signals to people coming to camp, then ask what they understood.
messages.我会记住你带回的消息。: I'll remember the news you brought back.
messages.我会问过守夜的人再敲钟。这次没人替后代答应。: I'll ask the people on night watch before I ring. This time no one has answered for their descendants.
messages.我保管签署，也保管撤回。任何一页都不能再自动算上后代。: I'll keep a record of signatures and withdrawals alike. No page should ever include someone's descendants automatically again.
messages.我偷了一面不会响的旗，结果它每天晚上命令我回队。: I stole a flag that wouldn’t ring, but it commands me to return to the team every night.
messages.我偷走了第七签署者的姓，只偷到一个偏旁。: I stole the surname of the seventh signer, only one radical.
messages.我先去试防潮回路。能走回来的路，比一声胜利更有用。: I'll test the flood route first. A road people can come back on is more use than a shout of victory.
messages.我先叫你巡礼者。你回了头，这次就够了。: I'll call you Pilgrim for now. You turned around. That's enough this time.
messages.我先守水，能守多少记多少。别急着找另一个会唱的人塞进去。: I'll tend the water first and put down the hours I can manage. Don't rush to find another singer to fill her place.
messages.我先把住处那一路写清楚。明天有人觉得不对，可以当面来找我。: First I'll label the line to the houses. If anyone disagrees tomorrow, they can find me here.
messages.我先记清谁托我保管，再谈怎样开放。: I'll record who trusted it to me first. We can talk about access after that.
messages.我准备让哪一种代价留下，又打算回谁那里听一声回答？: What cost am I prepared to leave behind? Whose answer will I go back to hear?
messages.我压住黑潮，也压住了每个求救声。: I suppress the Black Tide, and I suppress every cry for help.
messages.我原以为学徒认得我。他只是也需要有人迈出门。: I thought the apprentice recognized me. He just needed someone to step through that door too.
messages.我又把名字绣进衣领，可孩子的线还连着旧钟。修好名字没有拆掉世袭的扣子。: I'm stitching names into collars again. The children's thread still runs to the old bell. Mending a name hasn't undone the clasp that binds their heirs.
messages.我只核对证词，不核对你答应过多少委托。: I check your testimonies. The number of errands you've agreed to is no concern of mine.
messages.我只管把能走的路说清。是否完成了谁的使命，不该由这块石头审。: I tell people where they can put their feet. This stone can't judge whether they've finished an errand for someone else.
messages.我只能认出你回来时愿意停下来说话。哪一部分变了，要让你自己慢慢说。: I can tell it's you who comes back and stops to talk to me. You'll have to tell me in your own time which part has changed.
messages.我只认穿衣服的人亲口认下的名字。旧衣上有空白，也不能由我挑一个填进去。: I take the name from the person who'll wear the coat. Even if an old collar is blank, I don't get to choose a name to fill it.
messages.我可以用自己的名字选择留下修树，也可以离开。根笼不再替我答应。: I can sign my own name and stay to mend the tree. I can leave, too. The cage no longer answers for me.
messages.我听不到剪声了，但还记得谁没下班。你若继续走，别替他们把账划掉。: I can't hear the snipping now, but I still know who never clocked off. If you go on, don't cross them out for me.
messages.我听完了。现在把书合上，你说的那一页，应该由你来保存。: I've heard it all. Close the book now. The page you spoke aloud should stay with you.
messages.我听得懂号码，可他下工时从来不这样叫我。: I can understand the numbers. But when he came off shift he never called me that.
messages.我听见了恢复报时的钟，也看见学徒剪到一半停住的旧线。: I heard the bell keeping time again. I also saw where the apprentice had stopped halfway through cutting the old thread.
messages.我听见你停下来等我讲完。你听见自己什么，我得问你才知道。: I hear you stop and wait for me to finish. What you hear in yourself, I have to ask you.
messages.我听见有人嫌针钝。那句不怎么好听的话，陪着学徒把第一只袖口缝好。: I heard someone grumble about a blunt needle. Those rather ungracious words kept the apprentice company through the first cuff.
messages.我听见重新入队的钟令。若承诺过让我停下，就别让它被新一代背走。: I can hear the bell calling us back into line. If you promised I'd be allowed to stop, don't let another generation carry that promise on its back.
messages.我听过敲声，拿“等水槽接好”搪塞过自己。怕一过去就得承认，园子好好的时候也有人困: I heard the knocks. Told myself I'd go when the trough was fixed. I was afraid I'd have to admit the garden had looked perfectly healthy while someone was already trapped in it.
messages.我唤醒过一根线，没有权替后来的人接受世袭。你选择的安稳，我也会见证它的代价。: I woke a thread. That didn't give me the right to bind those who came after us. I'll bear witness to the cost of the peace you chose.
messages.我唱歌不是为了美，是为了让裂缝睡着。: I sing not for beauty, but to make the cracks sleep.
messages.我回井边把话喊清楚：水还会来，别把自由听成潮水已经消失。: I'll go back to the well and say it so everyone can hear. The water will come again. Don't mistake freedom for the end of the tide.
messages.我在工牌背面留了退班的扣。承重可以学，誓言不该传给没答应的人。: I've put a clasp on the back of each work badge so people can leave a shift. You can teach someone to carry a load. An oath shouldn't pass to anyone who never agreed.
messages.我在营地坐了一会儿。没得到新能力，也没把这段时间划掉。: I sat at camp for a while. I gained no new ability. I didn't cross that time out either.
messages.我坐下了。坐了很久，腿还在疼。: I sat down. I've been sitting a long time and my legs still hurt.
messages.我坐了好久，园丁没催。今天先不搬苗，我想从门外看看这间屋子。: I sat there a long time. The gardener didn't hurry me. No moving seedlings today. I'd like to look at this room from outside the door.
messages.我坐在学徒身边。今天不交东西，也不接下一件事。: I sat beside the apprentice. No delivery today. No new errand to take on.
messages.我大概会盯着门看，也可能问得太急。那不是你欠我的。: I'll probably watch the door. I might ask you too soon. That isn't a debt you owe me.
messages.我失败过，所以我听不见王冠命令的一小半。: I have failed, so I can’t hear a little of the Crown Command.
messages.我守久了，石头都磨出两只脚印。门若真开了，我倒该先练练怎么走。: I've stood here long enough to wear two footprints in the stone. If the gate really opens, I'd better practise walking again first.
messages.我守前半夜。后半夜还没说定，你别看我一眼就把自己填上。: I'll take the first half. The second half isn't settled. Don't look at me and put your own name in the space.
messages.我守着这扇门，最容易以为门一开，所有事就都过去了。: I've watched this gate so long, it's easy to think everything ends the minute it opens.
messages.我带回的证词应该先交给谁？: Who should get the testimony I brought back first?
messages.我开始在封签上留一小角。人想拆时，总该有地方把手伸进去。: I've started leaving a little corner loose on the seals. If someone wants to open one, there ought to be room for a finger.
messages.我当年劝园主留缝，她说等这一季过去。我信了。: I begged the Gardener to leave a gap. She said she would when the season was over. I believed her.
messages.我怎么知道你抄下的名字没有错？: How can I tell whether you've copied the names correctly?
messages.我怕一交出去就再也找不回。我把柜门守得很好，来求原页的人倒都被我挡在外面。: I was afraid that once it left I'd never get it back. I guarded that cabinet well. I kept everyone who came looking for the original outside.
messages.我怕一忙起来，又拿“等树养好”当借口。水稳是好事，门也得能推。: I'm afraid when I get busy I'll say “once the tree is better” again. I'm glad the water's steady. The gate should still open when pushed.
messages.我怕缝错。错在别人衣领上，还能拆；错在师父身上，好像就再也问不到他了。: I'm afraid of getting it wrong. If I make a mistake in someone's collar, I can unpick it. If I get Master's name wrong, who can I ask now?
messages.我怕自己一看见那种字，就又把它当成得立刻起身的号。你可以和我一起慢慢看。: I'm afraid one look at that hand will sound like a call to stand at once. You could sit and read it slowly with me.
messages.我怕自己又把催人回来的光，当成送人回去的光。以前就是这么看错的。: I'm afraid I'll again mistake a light hurrying people back to the ranks for one guiding them home. I've made that mistake before.
messages.我总想往前冲，停下来会不会错过什么？: I always want to dash ahead. If I stop, what will I miss?
messages.我总想着先修水槽，等腾出手再修门。等到门后换成根笼，我才知道自己等过了头。: I always meant to mend the trough first, then the gate when I had a hand free. When a root cage took its place, I knew I'd waited too long.
messages.我想先听外面一阵。你若要往回走，不必等我替你把话说完。: I'd like to listen to the world outside awhile. If you're going back, you don't need to wait for me to finish the story for you.
messages.我想先听清剩下的弦，再决定哪一根值得保留。: First I'd like to hear clearly the strings that remain. Then I'll choose which to keep.
messages.我想知道这页是不是你自己取出来的。转过几道手，来历就得多问几遍。: I want to know whether you took the page out yourself. With every hand it passes through, there's more about its origins to check.
messages.我想让它停止召我，不想让人以为我从没在这里站过。: I want it to stop calling me. I don't want anyone to think I never stood here.
messages.我想让灯只负责带路，不再召回已经离队的人。: I want the lamps to do nothing but show the way. No more calling back people who've left the ranks.
messages.我想请你把路说清，再听我把话说完。决定总得让我自己试着拿回来。: Show me the road clearly. Hear me out. I need to try taking the decision back myself.
messages.我愿意唱这一班，也能在唱不动时停下。接替的人要亲口答应。: I'll sing this shift. I can stop when my voice gives out. Whoever takes my place has to say yes themselves.
messages.我愿意帮的时候会帮，但若把离开换成另一份必须留下的工，那只是换了个笼。: I'll help when I want to. If the price of leaving is another job I'm bound to stay for, that's just a different cage.
messages.我愿意继续带路，但不再把每个走来的人都交给同一声号。: I'll keep guiding people. I won't hand everyone I meet over to the same bugle call again.
messages.我愿意让树活下去，可他们后来只记得树活没活。: I wanted the tree to live. In the end all anyone remembered was whether the tree was alive.
messages.我把下一趟的活划给自己。他不是从根笼换到我的班表里。: I marked the next trip against my own name. They didn't leave the cage just to end up on my rota.
messages.我把两盏灯改成检修信号。先在安全台练一次，再把它用在军阵之间。: I've changed two lamps to maintenance signals. Practise once on a safe ledge before you try them between the ranks.
messages.我把两种工具画在纸边：锤子留下接头，剪子留下断口。执剪者不是湛。: I sketched both tools in the margin. The hammer leaves a joint. The shears leave a severed end. The Apostle isn't Zhan.
messages.我把他的要求原样带走：留灯，留路，先别围过来。: I took the request exactly as it was given. Leave a light. Leave a way through. Don't crowd round yet.
messages.我把他递来的军令翻平，没有刮去任何一个名字。: I smoothed out the order he handed me. I didn't scrape a single name away.
messages.我把信折成船了。收信的人在上面，水却总往下面走。你说奇不奇怪？: I folded my letter into a boat. The person it's for is up above, but the water always runs down. Funny, isn't it?
messages.我把六份独立证词摊开：心、工牌、原字、活弦、军册与钥匙。每一份都指向一个人，谁也: I spread out six independent accounts: a heart, a badge, the original wording, a living string, a muster roll and a key. Each one points to a person. None can sign for another.
messages.我把原字描在空白处，没有替任何一个名字画押。: I traced the original word in a blank space. I made no one's mark for them.
messages.我把司铃绳改成了报潮绳。声音归来以后，警报得由活人传。: I've turned the sacristan's bell rope into a tide warning. Now our voices are back, it's the living who must pass on the alarm.
messages.我把名单展开收好。下一站要看的，是“供弦”这两个字在树根上变成了什么。: I put the list away unfolded. At my next stop I'll see what “strings supplied” has become in the roots of a tree.
messages.我把它放进匣里，是为了让人还能找到它。匣子不能替里头的字担保。: I put it in a case so people could still find it. The case can't vouch for the words inside.
messages.我把居民叫人回家的小铃交给你做回响诱铃，愿意调查的小怪会去看，守门者不会理它。: Take this little homecoming bell and use it as an Echo Lure. Curious smaller creatures will come looking. Gatewardens won't heed it.
messages.我把旧令抄在旗背面。这回不会再把它卷着藏好，谢谢你让我能把话说完整。: I've copied the old order onto the back of the flag. I won't roll it up to hide it now. Thanks for letting me say the whole of it.
messages.我把水轮阀记留在不会下雨的房间，别问我为什么那里还会长青苔。: I keep the water wheel valve in a room where it won’t rain, don’t ask why there’s moss growing there.
messages.我把灯号改作撤离讯号。黑潮不再被钟网压住，我们先让低处的人看见路。: I've changed the signals for evacuation. The bell network no longer holds back the Blacktide. First we light a way out for the people below.
messages.我把相异的说法分开收好。还没弄清的地方，不能为了凑成完整故事而擦掉。: I kept the differing accounts separate. I can't erase what I haven't understood for the sake of a tidy story.
messages.我把证词收回行囊。王冠就在前面，身后的路也仍然算数。: I put the testimonies back in my pack. The Crown is just ahead. The road behind me still counts.
messages.我把路钱问清楚才点头。帮忙可以商量，也可以拒绝。: I asked what the trip would pay before I agreed. I could bargain over a favour. I could turn it down.
messages.我把那件小事记在名单后面了，没写成你的功劳。: I wrote that little story on the back of the list. I didn't turn it into a deed to your credit.
messages.我把阿禾的名字记在最前面，旁边留了一双怕进水的鞋。: I wrote A-He's name first and left a pair of shoes beside it, kept carefully out of the water.
messages.我拆下封蜡救低处的书。没有钟网，我们得自己决定先保住什么。: I'm taking the wax seals off to save the books on the lowest shelves. Without the bell network we must decide for ourselves what to save first.
messages.我拆了又不敢全拆。外面水位退了，屋里有人劝我先别折腾。: I've started undoing it. I don't quite dare take it all out. The water's gone down outside. People inside are telling me to leave well enough alone.
messages.我拆开重来时，才发觉自己一直在等师父纠正我。他已经不在针旁了。: When I picked it out to start again, I realized I was waiting for Master to correct me. He's no longer here beside the needle.
messages.我指了枝台，等他把左脚放稳。救人比割开一根细根慢。: I pointed out the ledge and waited for him to plant his left foot. Freeing a person takes longer than cutting a thin root.
messages.我指路的时候也爱说“前面总会有人接你”。说得太顺，竟没想过那些人能不能走。: When I gave directions I used to say, “Someone will always be waiting for you ahead.” It came so readily I never wondered whether those people were free to go.
messages.我按住断弦，没有拉。线在手里，也可以只是让别人松开手。: I held the broken string without pulling. A thread in my hands can simply let someone else unclench theirs.
messages.我按原件复原这枚校录契印。删名记录不能再拿来抹掉人，只能帮助我们看见被遮住的痕迹: I've restored the Recordkeeper's Seal from the original. The erasures will show us what was hidden instead of rubbing people out. An Echo Needle leaves a Salt Mark. Saltbind Thread reads and spends it. A Salt Mist Flask disrupts ordinary ranged enemies' aim, but can't stop a shot already in flight. Take the Saltleaf Bookmark too. Use the Archive's Bellbone maintenance station or the needle rack by the wax seals to practise. Restoring a record doesn't settle what you should do with the covenant.
messages.我摸到木条后的旧钉孔。向导没有替“总有人接”找借口。: My fingers found the old nail holes behind the slats. The guide made no excuses for promising there would always be someone waiting.
messages.我数过。数到自己的年纪就不敢往下数了。: I counted them. When I reached my own age, I didn't dare count any further.
messages.我是唤醒你的那根线，不能替你说第七个名字。最后一句，由你自己决定。: I'm the thread that woke you. I can't speak the seventh name for you. The last words are yours to choose.
messages.我曾把错误的目录抄得很工整。工整没让它变对，只让更多人相信了。: I once made a very tidy copy of a faulty catalogue. Neatness didn't make it true. It only made more people believe it.
messages.我替学徒按住布角。名字带回来了，接下去还有一针一针的活。: I held the cloth for the apprentice. The names were home. There was still all the work of putting them back, stitch by stitch.
messages.我每缝好一个结，就记起一点旧事。今天记起的是姐姐的手，她总比我稳。: Every knot I finish brings back a little more. Today I remembered my sister's hands. Always steadier than mine.
messages.我没想就接住了一击。你能认出是谁教的吗？: I caught a blow without thinking. Can you tell who taught me?
messages.我没替歌者接下一句。园丁先去看水，我们得容得下这一阵安静。: I didn't take up the singer's next line. The gardener went to check the water. We'll have to make room for this silence.
messages.我没有对井里许诺。我先记下孩子亲眼看见的那把钥匙。: I made the well no promise. First I wrote down what the child had seen with their own eyes: a small key.
messages.我没有说他已经自由了。旧军号响时，他的脚先一步站直。: I didn't tell him he was free already. When the old bugle rang, his feet moved to attention first.
messages.我沿弦看见了两种接头。她守住母株的那个音，被新箍接去了钟网。: I followed the string to two different joints. The new hoop fed the note she held for the mother plant into the bell network.
messages.我沿旧弦看进树心，再沿新箍看向钟网。徽的声音留在树里，园主的铜箍没有留下停拍的位: I followed the old string into the heartwood, then traced the new hoop back to the bell network. Hui's voice stayed in the tree. The Gardener's copper band left no room for a pause.
messages.我爹叫阿禾。书库说没登记过，可柳叔替他磨过徽章，他嫌领口总被刮破。: My dad's name is A-He. The Archive says he was never registered, but Uncle Liu filed his badge smooth for him. Dad said it kept tearing his collar.
messages.我现在拆第二道，第一道仍留着。你若来核对，我会给你看拆下的蜡。: I'm taking off the second seal now. The first stays. If you come to check, I'll show you the wax I removed.
messages.我现在选了营地，明天也许想往另一边走。: Today I chose the camp. Tomorrow I might want to go the other way.
messages.我留下一份副本。新约会不会变样，还得有人回来逐字相对。: I left a copy. For us to know whether the new covenant changes, someone will still have to come back and compare its words one by one.
messages.我留下最后一格空白。规程里没教过，但我觉得“愿意”不能由别人代填。: I left the last square empty. It isn't in the procedure, but I don't think anyone else should fill in the word “willing.”
messages.我留下的是歌守徽的音。园主从外面调弦，后来变成铜根主教；不要再把我们叫成同一个人: What survives of me is the voice of Hui, the Songwarden. The Gardener tuned the strings from outside and later became the Copperroot Bishop. Please stop calling us the same person.
messages.我留在这里，不是因为做得对，是因为有人得记住第一份契约怎样被写坏。: I stayed because someone had to remember how the first covenant was spoiled. I didn't stay because I was right.
messages.我的弦只剩两根。别替我补好，先听听断了以后，还有什么声音留着。: I've only two strings left. Wait before you mend them. Listen to what's still sounding now that the others have broken.
messages.我的线除了割断，还能做什么？: What can my thread do besides cutting things?
messages.我的绯线是不是也只配用来封住什么？: Is sealing things shut all my crimson thread is good for?
messages.我看着还空着的后半夜。谁来接，得等一个清楚的答复。: I looked at the empty second half of the night. Someone needs to give a clear answer before we put down the next watcher.
messages.我看见了页边的小注。她替谁守过夜，我还没来得及问。: I saw the note in the margin. I didn't get to ask whom she had sat up with.
messages.我确实这样盼过。等得太久，人很容易把后来者当成自己的下一只手。: I did hope for that once. Wait long enough and it's easy to think of whoever comes next as another hand of your own.
messages.我第一次能把命令改成商量。先一起把低处的人带上来。: For the first time I can turn an order into a question. Let's bring the people on the low ground up together.
messages.我等到了。原来等待也得练，不能只练怎么把人叫回来。: I waited, and it came. You have to practise waiting too. You can't practise only calling people back.
messages.我答“不行，手疼”，他真自己去了。我到现在还有点不敢信。: I said, “No, my hand hurts.” And they really went themselves. I can hardly believe it yet.
messages.我答应带回查到的消息，没有答应把每一处空白都填满。: I promised to bring back what I learned. I didn't promise to fill every blank.
messages.我签下第七个名字，然后把名字藏进绯线。: I sign the seventh name, then hide it in Crimson Thread.
messages.我终于能读出声了。读完这页，还要把书搬离涨水的地面。: I can finally read aloud. Once I've read this page we still need to get the books off the flooded floor.
messages.我能下劈，是不是就该斩开每一道根？: If I can strike downward, should I cut through every root?
messages.我能为这一刻答应，不能替以后的每一次呼吸答应。: I can say yes to this moment. I can't answer for every breath to come.
messages.我能保原文，不能拿原文替今天的人按手印。这比守柜子难得多。: I can keep the original safe. I can't take today's people by the hand and press their thumbprints onto it. That's much harder than guarding a cabinet.
messages.我能修钟，不能给他定一个他爹回来的时辰。你去书库时，替我把这点说清。: I can mend a bell. I can't name the hour their dad will be home. When you visit the Archive, make that clear for me.
messages.我能做的是把名字缝回衣领。谁愿意继续守钟，要留给穿衣服的人回答。: I can stitch names back into collars. Whether to keep watch over the bell is for the wearers to say.
messages.我能叫你眼下愿意答应的称呼。它未必说明你的来处，却能让这次相见有个位置。: I can call you whatever you'd like to answer to today. It may not tell me where you came from, but it gives us a way to greet each other now.
messages.我能大声叫爹了。渠水却涨到门口，我们得一起搬高木板。: I can call out for Dad now. But the canal's up to the door. We have to lift the boards together.
messages.我能帮你核对，也会说出我核对不到的地方。: I'll check what I can for you. I'll also tell you what I can't.
messages.我能指出笔压、刮痕和新墨的先后，不能只凭一句相信我就把它定成原本。: I can show which came first: the pen marks, the scraping or the new ink. My saying “trust me” won't make this the original.
messages.我能替你保证有人会回来吗？: Should I promise you that someone will come home?
messages.我能给他们位置，不能替他们决定该去哪里。: I can show them where things are. I can't choose where they should go.
messages.我能让王冠共鸣，就该继承它吗？: If I can make the Crown resonate, should I inherit it?
messages.我自己的副本也摆着。错过的那一笔，不能只算在死去的总官头上。: My own copy is on display as well. The dead High Registrar doesn't bear all the blame for the stroke I got wrong.
messages.我自己走不开，才请你帮忙；这不是你欠我师父的事。: I asked you because I can't get away myself. You owe my master no such thing.
messages.我若不愿帮，灯会一直坏下去吗？: If I decide not to help, will the lamps stay broken?
messages.我若只给你看自己赞同的一页，这张桌子就同总官的柜子没什么分别。: If I showed you only the page I agreed with, this table would be no different from the High Registrar's cabinet.
messages.我补的是门绳。井下那根收声线，我碰都没敢碰。: It's the door rope I mend. I haven't dared touch the thread that gathers voices down in the well.
messages.我要把缺席写清楚，让人知道哪一格不该再催。: I'll mark the absences clearly so everyone knows which places should no longer be called for.
messages.我见到外面的人，要怎样说你爹？: When I meet people outside, how should I speak of your dad?
messages.我见过太多拿钥匙的人，最后只记得自己能锁什么。: I've known too many key holders who ended up remembering only what they could lock.
messages.我见过有人回头救同伴，也见过有人只想活着回家。称号不该拦在他们前面。: I've seen people turn back to save a friend. Others just wanted to get home alive. A title shouldn't stand in their way.
messages.我观察招式，你观察我还站不站得住。这样至少有两份记录。: I'll watch her moves. You watch whether I can still stand. At least that gives us two accounts.
messages.我认得这里的根，却未必还能走到每个裂口。你能走的地方比我多。: I know these roots. I can't reach every crack now. You can get to places I can't.
messages.我记下斥候量过的台阶。证词要带出来，人也得能回来。: I noted the steps the scout measured. The testimony has to come out. The person carrying it needs to come back too.
messages.我记下模子的裂缝。顺着送钟声的管子，也许能找到声音被收走的地方。: I noted the crack in the mould. Following the pipes that carried the bellsong may tell me where the voices were taken.
messages.我记住最后一道回光的位置。走散以后，不能只靠更快地往前跑。: I remembered where the last answering flash came from. If we get separated, running forward faster won't be enough.
messages.我记住阿禾倒鞋的样子。这件事不在工牌上，孩子却说得很清楚。: I remember how A-He emptied his shoes. No badge records that, but the child described it perfectly.
messages.我试着解开领扣，再把它扣好。纸上的退出，在学徒手里变成了一件要反复试的东西。: I tried undoing the clasp and fastening it again. In the apprentice's hands, the right to leave on paper became something you had to test more than once.
messages.我该替过去的人完成遗愿吗？: Should I fulfil the wishes of the people who came before?
messages.我说不出一日能让每株树都满意。有些活在后来添的根上，有些正被那些根勒住。: I can't name a day that would suit every tree. Some live on roots added later. Those very roots are strangling others.
messages.我说手疼，他就自己提走了。我坐了半天，没想明白原来一句“不行”能这么短。: I said my hand hurt. They took the bucket themselves. I sat there half the day, trying to get used to how short the word “no” could be.
messages.我说明天再看，园丁就把工具放回去了。没有叹气，也没数我欠多少顿饭。: I said I'd see tomorrow. The gardener put the tools away. No sigh. No count of the meals I owed.
messages.我读到的新约留着回答的地方。沉默可以是选择，不该是债。: The new covenant leaves room for an answer. Silence can be a choice. It shouldn't be a debt.
messages.我读大字会生气，读到小注又会想她。今天先读到这里。: The big print makes me angry. Her little note makes me miss her. That's as far as I'll read today.
messages.我跳上去了，为什么还是想不起自己？: I made the jump. Why can't I remember who I am?
messages.我还不知道过去的名字。我要做的这一件事，却不能再借别人的嘴回答。: I still don't know the name I used to bear. This one thing I mean to do must have an answer from my own lips.
messages.我还准备在自己补的字旁署名。不能只给别人留查我的办法，却把自己的手藏着。: I'll sign beside the words I've added, too. If I'm giving people a way to check my work, I can't hide my own hand.
messages.我还待在井里也可以。你们记得朝井口说话，不只扔封条；我会应到。: I don't mind staying in the well. Just remember to speak down to me sometimes, instead of throwing in seals. I'll answer.
messages.我还是会缝。钟声能让街里听见时辰，却没把旧约从孩子的衣领上解下来。: I'll keep stitching them. The bells can tell the street the hour. They haven't unfastened the old covenant from the children's collars.
messages.我还没想起自己，有资格在这里落针吗？: I still can't remember who I was. Do I have the right to set my needle here?
messages.我逃出来时只带了能藏进衣里的抄页。你拿来的原件，让我能把这句话说得更响。: When I fled, all I could carry was a copy small enough to hide in my clothes. With the original you've brought me, I can say that much out loud.
messages.我锁了一百道门，后来才明白，冠怕的也有人声。: I locked a hundred doors before I understood that the Crown was afraid of human voices too.
messages.我问的是值不值，他说的是谁会受伤。我看了看自己还够不够走一趟的力气。: I asked what it was worth. The merchant spoke of who would get hurt. I took stock of my strength for the journey.
messages.我陪他走到门外，工具留在原处。他还没有答应明天。: I walked outside with him. The tools stayed where they were. He hadn't agreed to tomorrow.
messages.我需要先想起自己，才能作决定吗？: Do I have to remember who I am before I choose?
messages.战后我想给两种版本分别作记号，不再把它们混进同一摞。: After the battle, I'll mark the two versions separately. No more mixing them into the same stack.
messages.战后玻璃仍在剥落。: Post-war glass is still peeling off.
messages.战后盐尘未定，脚下仍在结晶。: The salt dust after the battle is still crystallizing underfoot.
messages.战后空出的时间，应当留给理解和选择。: The time a battle frees up should leave room to understand and to choose.
messages.战后若只为湛立一块牌，却继续按无人的班次取水，那就只记住了一半。: If we put up a plaque to Zhan after the battle but keep drawing water for shifts no one works, we'll have remembered only half.
messages.战后要先点亮哪一盏？: Which lamp should we light first after the fighting?
messages.所以我先修针，修到它什么都能缝，偏偏不敢落第一针。: So I mended the needle until it could stitch anything. Still didn't dare put in the first stitch.
messages.所以我愿意下次还听你讲路上的事。: That's why next time I'll still want to hear what happened on the road.
