messages.手会用钩，就说明我记得过去吗？: My hand knows the hook. Does that mean I remember?
messages.手伸出去之前，先看看它是不是真的需要。: Before I reach out a hand, I'll see if it's really needed.
messages.手知道怎样拉住一处东西，不等于它能替你讲出从前发生了什么。: Your hand knows how to catch hold of something. That doesn't mean it can tell you what happened before.
messages.打倒守母以后，还要往井下查吗？: The Matriarch is down. Is there still reason to search the well?
messages.打开 Boss 前大捷径。: Open the shortcut in front of the Boss area.
messages.打开三岔泵井中层阀门。: Open the middle valve of the three-way pump well.
messages.打开回声核心捷径的章节战斗标记。: Mark the chapter battle marks for opening the Echo Core shortcut.
messages.打开弦桥温室捷径的章节战斗标记。: Open the chapter combat mark of the string bridge greenhouse shortcut.
messages.打开影门回廊捷径的章节战斗标记。: Pull down the cable car lever: After clearing the monster, the cable car shaft resumes operation, leading directly to the camp and unlocking the leader's path.
messages.打开盐晶书脊捷径的章节战斗标记。: The chapter battle marks opened the shortcut to the salt crystal spine.
messages.打开铸雨渠水轮捷径的黄铜战斗标记。: Open the brass battle mark of the Rain Foundry Canal shortcut
messages.打开集中控制的入口，还需辨认各条决定权。: Once we open the centre of control, we still have to untangle who decides what.
messages.打败它之后，重鸣、断冠与改写都将由你承担后果。: Once you defeat it, the consequences are yours, whether you choose Retolling, Crownfall or the Rewrite.
messages.打败守母就能替她解除承诺吗？: Does defeating the Matriarch release her from her promise?
messages.打赢他，证明不了我没写假字。这两件事别混着说。: Beating him doesn't prove I never forged a word. Don't confuse the two.
messages.托板一块接一块，落下前先看清下一块。: The plank boards come down one by one, make sure to see the next one before falling.
messages.执剪者不再堵着泵井，我仍得听水管有没有空响。: The Apostle no longer bars the pump well. I still have to listen for the hollow sound of an empty pipe.
messages.执剪者倒下了，工牌背面的凹痕并不会跟着消失。: The Apostle is down. Those dents in the badges haven't gone anywhere.
messages.执剪者倒下后，空班仍是空班。我不会拿一个不在的人补上去。: The Apostle has fallen. An empty shift is still empty. I won't fill it with an absent name.
messages.执剪者倒了，孩子还是会来问我下工钟什么时候响。: The Apostle is down, but the child still comes to ask me when the shift bell will ring.
messages.执剪者停了，旧班表也不该再被当成召人回来上工的命令。: The Apostle has stopped. No one should take the old rota as an order to send people back to work.
messages.执剪者只会一剪了事，我不想学它。: The Apostle wanted to settle everything with a snip. I won't learn that habit.
messages.执剪者已经不在这里，可人的顾虑不会一夜消失。: The Apostle is gone. People's fears won't vanish overnight.
messages.执剪者放下了手。我收好她的剪子，往后拿它裁衣，不裁名字。: The Scissor Apostle has lowered her hands. I'll put her shears away. Next time I'll use them to cut cloth, not names.
messages.执剪者没了，我们终于能慢慢拆，不必边修边躲剪口。: With the Apostle gone, we can take it apart carefully. No need to dodge the shears while we work.
messages.执剪者的剪线覆盖全场。: The scissorist's scissor line covers the entire area
messages.执剪者的战利品；钩环门从此为你打开。: The scissorist's loot; the hook ring door is open for you
messages.执剪者走后，我第一次听到水慢下来。: When the Apostle left, I heard the water slowing for the first time.
messages.扩展能量上限的章节支线奖励。: Chapter bonus reward for expanding energy limit.
messages.批判旧秩序也要如实面对替代方案的代价。: An honest reckoning with the old order must also face the cost of replacing it.
messages.找一份沉默军令让我认清召回条件。路上别靠近正在成形的军阵。: Find a Silent Order so I can see what triggers the recall. Keep clear of any ranks that are still forming.
messages.找到了。阿禾还在缺角下面，旁边有时岚、舟九。我的副本删得太齐，把空处也抄没了。: There. A-He, under the torn corner. Shilan and Zhoujiu beside him. My copy was too tidy. I even copied the gaps out of existence.
messages.找到军册或证词: Find the military records or testimony
messages.找到后带来让我看看。这个委托不影响你往黑曜道走。: Bring it here when you find it. You can take the Obsidian Road whether or not you do this errand.
messages.找到旧军令，就给逃旗的人也看一眼。他们不是都没胆量，有人只是看懂得更早。: If you find the old orders, show them to the ones who deserted too. Some simply understood earlier than the rest of us.
messages.找到暗格里的隐苔存档点。: Find the Hidden Moss Shrine in the hidden compartment.
messages.找到那间不下雨的房间。: Find the room where it doesn't rain
messages.找齐沉默军令碎片。: Gather the fragments of the Silent Military Order.
messages.找齐那些工人的消息吧。不用都带回来，带回来他们曾经在这里就够了。: Find out what became of the workers. You needn't bring them all home. Bring back word that they once stood here.
messages.承力线我替你铆回针架，司铸契印、守钟架势、钟鸣震波、绊线钉与铜背扣都能用了。钟龛: I've riveted the load-bearing thread back onto your needle frame. You can use the Foundry Seal, Bellguard Stance, Bell Shockwave, Tripwire Spike and Copper Back Clasp now. Change seals at a Bell Shrine and practise outside the pump maintenance bay. The stance won't stop every blow, and the shockwave takes time to recover from.
messages.抄书人把撤离路线写在每扇门上，字迹潦草却清清楚楚。没有钟令，他们就按门上的字走。: The book copyer writes the evacuation route on every door, with messy but clear handwriting. Without the bell order, they follow the words on the doors.
messages.抄写手不断补写假契约。: The scribe continues to fill in fake contracts.
messages.抄回去，只能让人看见被改走的字。已经过了这么多年，愿意的人也换了。: It will let people see which word was altered. So many years have passed. Even the people willing to serve have changed.
messages.抄本旁边要写出从哪一页抄来，别让副本再冒充无来历的真话。: Write which page it came from beside each copy. Never let another copy pass for a truth without a source.
messages.抄过总官批下的副本。那时我以为只要保住原页，手上做的就不算。: I copied the version the High Registrar approved. I thought if I saved the original, what I did with my own hand didn't count.
messages.把“自愿”抄回去，事情就能照原样办？: If we copy the word “voluntary” back in, can things go on as before?
messages.把三枚工牌带回休息间，我就告诉你哪根管子通向 Boss 后门。: Bring three Work Badges back to the rest room, and I’ll tell you which pipe leads to the Boss’ back door.
messages.把人叫回来商量，比把誓言刻得更深更难。: Calling people back to talk is harder than carving the pledge deeper.
messages.把六印接回钟网，让旧钟重新鸣响。: Reconnect the six marks to the network and let the old bell ring again.
messages.把六座城的证词带齐。我不催你，有人已经为赶着签字付过太长的代价。: Bring together the testimony of the six cities. I'll wait. Someone has already paid far too long for a signature made in haste.
messages.把原字抄回去就够了吗？: Is it enough to copy the original word back in?
messages.把原字抄回来以后，今天的人还需要怎样重新回答？: When we've copied back the original words, what answer will the people living here give?
messages.把名字带回来的人: The One Who Brought the Names Home
messages.把名字带回钟庭: Bring the Names Home to Bell Court
messages.把名字缝回去，就算救回他们了吗？: If you stitch their names back, have you saved them?
messages.把名字送到等它的人手里，不会耽误纸上的字成立。: Put the names in the hands of those waiting for them. The words on the page will still be true.
messages.把她当年押下的东西，与后来压到孩子身上的东西，分别问明白再回来。: Find out what she pledged herself, and what was laid on the children later. Ask about each in turn, then come back.
messages.把工牌翻过来，再看住处那路水是不是断了，才知道这张表漏掉多少生活。: Turn the badges over. Check whether the pipe to the houses still carries water. Then you'll see how much life the rota leaves out.
messages.把找到的看完，把不知道的留明白，再亲口说你准备做什么。能做到的，也就从这里开始。: Read what you found. Say clearly what you still don't know. Then say in your own voice what you're going to do. That's where you can begin.
messages.把歌页或工牌贴上钟舌锈面，听它说出被戴成王冠那夜的证词。: Stick the song page or work badge onto the Tongue rusty surface, and listen to it speak the testimony from the night it was worn as a crown.
messages.把每枚印记放回心口前，先问它是否愿意。: Put each marking back in front of your heart before asking if it wants to be there.
messages.把活壳脉络带回来让我摸摸。我想知道园子里的根还连着谁。: Bring back a living shell vein and let me feel it. I want to know who these roots are still joined to.
messages.把漏下的证词补齐。印记能证明你走过，证词能证明你听过。: Gather the missing testimony. A mark proves you passed through. Testimony proves you listened.
messages.把灯靠近些，别怕。影子有边，才能知道你站在什么地方。: Bring the lamp a little closer. Don't be afraid. A shadow needs an edge for you to see where you're standing.
messages.把灰抖掉再看路。灰会把平地和断崖涂成一个颜色，脚不信它就对了。: Shake off the ash before you look for the road. It paints flat ground and cliff edges the same colour. Your feet are right not to trust it.
messages.把证词带去王冠，不必先替我补上什么功劳。西门的事，我自己也得去面对。: Take the testimony to the Crown. There's no need to make me sound brave first. I'll have to face what happened at the west gate myself.
messages.把证词带回钟庭学徒: Bring the testimony back to the Moss Bell Court apprentices
messages.把证词看完就必须改写吗？: If I read all the testimony, am I bound to choose the Rewrite?
messages.把这两件事写清，别再让铁匠替剪线使背一遍名字。: Write that down clearly. The smith shouldn't have to bear the Scissor Apostle's name again.
messages.把遇见的人、留下的物件和亲手找到的证词对照起来，追查失声的缘故。: Compare the accounts of people you've met with the objects and testimony they left behind. Find out why their voices fell silent.
messages.把钟舌拔下来，我给你一个没有命令的世界。: Pull out the bell tongue, and I’ll give you a world without commands.
messages.把阿禾放第一行吧。后面的我一个个认，认不出的先空着，别拿号码补。: Put A-He on the first line. I'll identify the rest one by one. If I can't, leave it empty. No filling it with a number.
messages.抓取和定身，测试下劈逃脱。: Grab and immobilize, test the lower-bouncing escape.

messages.护送与押送怎样分辨？: How can you tell an escort from a guard marching someone under arrest?
messages.抬枪截空: Climb to the top of the watchtower, connect to Banner Bridge and the mountain top.
messages.抵押与守护差在哪里？: What's the difference between guarding something and standing as a pledge?
messages.抵押册失效，值守却不能空白。我先等六城自己商量新的防线。: The register has lost its force. The watch still needs people. I'll wait for the six cities to agree on their own defences.
messages.抵押册重新生效。我会把代价写在册首，不能只记潮水退去。: The register of pledges is binding again. I'll write the cost on the first page. The receding tide isn't the whole story.
messages.抵押清单注销了，你还坐在这里做什么？: The register of pledges is void. What are you still doing at this desk?
messages.抵押清单注销以后，你守什么？: Once the list of pledges is cancelled, what will you guard?
messages.抵达巨型水轮的底座，拉下捷径控制器。: Reach the base of the giant waterwheel and pull down the shortcut controller
messages.抵达被王冠纹章封死的井喉。: Arrive at the Well Throat sealed by the crown emblem.
messages.抵达锤炉的炉底，查看被铸渣封住的滑道口。: Reach the furnace floor of the hammer furnace and inspect the slag-sealed access hole
messages.拆除控制与维护生计需要分别处理。: Dismantling a means of control and keeping people alive are different jobs.
messages.拉下封蜡拉杆：清怪后盐门长开，首领之路解锁。: Pull down the sealing wax lever: after clearing the monster, the salt gate opens wide, and the leader's path is unlocked.
messages.拉下封蜡拉杆：清怪后盐门长开，首领之路解锁。 可选：钟壳格挡练习工房。: Pull down the sealing rod: After clearing the monster, the salt gate opens wide, and the leader's path is unlocked. Optional: Bell Shell Guard Practice Workshop.
messages.拉下根库拉杆：清怪后西辐桥接通，首领之路解锁。: Pull down the Root Vault lever: After clearing the monster, the West Spoke Bridge is connected, and the Leader's Path is unlocked.
messages.拉下钟舌拉杆：西环门长开，王座之路解锁。: Pull down the Tongue lever: The West Ring Gate opens wide, and the path to the throne is unlocked.
messages.拉下闸杆，接通回钟庭的后门升梯。: Lower the gate lever to connect the back ladder leading back to the Bell Hall.
messages.拉杆时留意残敌。: Be careful of remaining enemies while pulling the lever.
messages.拥有操作工具不等于拥有替人决定的权利。: Having the tool in hand doesn't give me the right to decide for others.
messages.拨闩后贴住竖向检修面，攀附并蹬墙跳；抵达上沿后沿台取回记录。: After opening the latch, stick to the vertical maintenance surface, climb and jump on the wall; retrieve the records from the platform after reaching the upper edge.
messages.拨闩后贴住竖向检修面，攀附并蹬墙跳；抵达上沿后沿台取回记录。 守钟架势：面对练针: After opening the latch, stick to the vertical maintenance surface, climb and jump on the wall; retrieve the records from the platform after reaching the upper edge. Bellguard Stance: Face the needle practice stand; after the precise window ends, you cannot continue with a hard attack. Practice · Bellguard Stance
messages.拨闩后贴住竖向检修面，攀附并蹬墙跳；抵达上沿后沿台取回记录。 断弦回斩：原地前后: After opening the latch, stick to the vertical maintenance surface, climb and jump on the wall; retrieve the records from the platform after reaching the upper edge. Broken-String Crosscut: Cut back and forth on the spot without moving; the line energy returning to the energy still remains lower than the consumption. Practice · Broken-String Crosscut
messages.拿你见过的工艺来核对，比把我的逃亡当成证据可靠。: Compare it with the workmanship you've seen. My having fled isn't evidence enough.
messages.拿到冲刺后，全庭的钟隙都为你打开。: After obtaining the Dash, all the Bellgaps open for you.
messages.拿剪刀的那个，就是沉井的铁匠吗？: Is the figure with the shears the smith who sank in the well?
messages.拿去核对名字的是人做过的活，不是你打赢的一场仗。: What identifies the names is the work people did, not the battle you won.
messages.拿同样的声音去引开危险，仍得记住那是一种彼此提醒的手艺。: Use the same sound to draw danger away, but remember it came from a craft of warning one another.
messages.持续的同意不能只在很久以前问过一次。: Continuing consent needs more than one question asked long ago.
messages.按封蜡颜色排序：灰、白、绯。: Sort by the color of the sealing wax: gray, white, crimson.
messages.按已收集证词判断三色门；证词不足时真结局门不会稳定。: Judge the three-color gate based on the collected testimony; if the testimony is insufficient, the true ending gate will not be stable.
messages.换契印要到钟龛。针架挡不住所有来击，钟压留给下一次真正打中的重击。: Change seals at a Bell Shrine. The needle frame won't stop every attack. Save the bell pressure for a heavy blow you know will land.
messages.排水计时闸保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的声音: The work records saved by the Bell Drainpipe: The facility was once maintained for residents, but later became a channel for contracts, military orders, and voices that were erased.
messages.排水计时闸：操作能力闩后沿独立检修路线登上证物台，收取记录与物资。: Bell Drainpipe: After opening the latch with the operating ability, climb onto the evidence platform along the independent maintenance route to collect records and materials.
messages.排水计时闸：操作能力闩后沿独立检修路线登上证物台，收取记录与物资。 门外练针架提: Bell Drainpipe: After opening the latch with the operating ability, climb onto the evidence platform along the independent maintenance route to collect records and materials. The needle practice stand outside the door provides special skill practice without consuming permanent exploration ability.
messages.排水钟管的出口铁唇: The iron lip of the Bell Drainpipe's outlet

messages.探索六区与能力路线: Explore the sixth district and ability routes
messages.探索温室母株，找到棘丝下劈并在安全工房练习。: Explore the greenhouse mother plant, find the thorn wire penetration, and practice in the safety workshop.
messages.接下寻找工人姓名的请求: Accepted the Search for the Workers' Names
messages.接弦与外箍为什么通向不同地方？: Why do the joined string and the outer hoop lead in different directions?
messages.接弦伤口留下了养护，外层铜箍留下了控制；不能只用照看两个字盖住它们。: The wound where the string was joined tells of care. The outer copper hoop tells of control. The word “care” doesn't cover both.
messages.提示主线、支线、捷径和奖励死胡同。: Ask about the main route, side paths, shortcuts and rewards at dead ends.
messages.提示绕路和清怪开路目标。: Tips for detouring and clearing monsters for the goal.
messages.援手不应变成新的强制承诺。: A helping hand shouldn't force someone into a new pledge.
messages.搜刮库房，听织线学徒的姐姐讲深井的事。: Scavenge the warehouse, listen to the Threadweaver's Apprentice's sister talk about the Deep Well.
messages.搜刮库房，听织线学徒的姐姐讲深井的事。 可选：棘根深井。: Scavenge the warehouse and listen to the sister of the Threadweaver's Apprentice talk about the Deep Well. Optional: Thorn Deep Well.
messages.搜刮沉在淤泥里的库房。: Scavenge the warehouse buried in silt
messages.搜刮沉在淤泥里的库房。 可选：淤泥排压室。: Scavenge the warehouse buried in silt. Optional: Silt Pressure Relief Room.
messages.携带军令与逃旗手完整交谈；之后在巡礼营地重逢。: Have a complete conversation with the military order and the Deserter Standard-Bearer; meet again at the Pilgrim Camp.
messages.携带原件与逃亡书记完整交谈。: Have a complete conversation with the original document and the Fugitive Scribe.
messages.携带复活旗逃离队列的旗手，仍被旗帜夜间召回。: Fled the ranks with a resurrection banner. It still calls him back at night.
messages.携带花粉蜡回蜂蜡商人处完整交谈。: Have a complete conversation with the pollen wax merchant when returning.
messages.攀上水塔，仰望通往盐白档案馆的雨溢立管。: Climb the water tower and look up at the Rain Overflow Spool leading to the Saltwhite Archive
messages.攀上秘阁暗格，找到逃亡书记与隐藏盐灯。: Climb into the Hidden Archive Niche, find the Fugitive Scribe and the hidden salt lamp.
messages.攀上秘阁暗格，找到逃亡书记与隐藏盐灯。 可选：删名契约暗柜。: Climb into the Hidden Archive Niche and find the Fugitive Scribe and the hidden salt lamp. Optional: Deleted Contract Locker.
messages.攀到秘阁后休整、询问书记，再取可选盐晶奖励: Climb to the secret stacks, rest and speak to the scribe. Then collect the optional salt crystals.
messages.攀升很长，别在中途松手。: Climb high, don't let go midway
messages.支线帮过的人会替我补齐证词吗？: Can the people I've helped fill in missing testimony for me?
messages.支线房有更多敌人，Boss 前 2-3 房保留短跑与存档。: Side Room has more enemies. Keep running and saving before the Boss in 2-3 rooms.
messages.支线的意义应独立于终局门槛。: What we do on the way matters independently of the final gate.
messages.改写王冠门和结局分歧。: Rewriting the crown gate and the ending divergence.
messages.改写留下的物理痕迹，与文字同样需要保存。: The physical marks of a rewrite deserve preserving alongside the words.
messages.改写那天，我愿敲第一声鸣。以后报时就报时，不再拿钟声压住人话。: The day you rewrite the covenant, I'll sound the first toll. After that, a bell can mark the hour without drowning out our words.
messages.改写需要持续可查，而非一次签署后的永久信任。: The Rewrite must remain open to inspection. Signing it once does not settle trust for all time.
messages.改变信号要先理解它曾经怎样被执行。: Before changing a signal, learn what people were once made to do when they saw it.
messages.改契约时别唱齐声。每个人各唱各的，才像一座终于能说话的城。: When the covenant changes, don't sing all in unison. A city finding its voice should sound like people singing their own songs.
messages.改过的字为什么还留着白边？: Why is there a pale edge to the changed word?
messages.敌人沿管直冲，先布绊线钉: The enemy rushes along the pipe, first setting up tripwires
messages.救援后的目标可以很小，而且属于被救者自己。: What a rescued person wants next can be small. It's theirs to choose.
messages.教学跳跃、冲刺、近战、清怪开路、跑酷段、捷径和 Boss 门。: Teaching jumps, dashes, melee combat, clearing monsters to create paths, acrobatics segments, shortcuts, and Boss doors.
messages.敲三下门框。以前我怕吵醒殿里的人，敲得太轻，接班的就多站半夜。: Three knocks on the doorframe. I used to tap too softly, afraid I'd wake someone in the hall. The watcher would stand another half-night.
messages.敲击声从墙那边来。: The tapping sound comes from the other side of the wall
messages.敲响我，城市会醒；拔掉我，井也会醒。: Strike me, and the city will wake up; remove me, and even the well will awaken.
messages.敲响旧王钟舌，黑潮退回井底，城市恢复道路，但巡礼军和守门者继续被系统维持。: Ring the old crown tongue, the black tide retreats to the bottom of the well, the city restores its roads, but the pilgrim army and gatewardens continue to be maintained by the system.
messages.断冠后的灯号既要指路，也要持续复核。: After Crownfall, the lamps still have to guide people, and their signals must be checked as the paths change.
messages.断冠归还声音，同时留下具体的生存工作。: Crownfall gives people their voices back. They still have work to do to stay alive.
messages.断冠：声音归还但黑潮涌出。: Crownfall: Voice returned but Black Tide surged out.
messages.断弦印记引来巡礼军号，但号声无声，只在地图和 UI 上震动。: The Broken-String Mark attracts the Pilgrim soldiers' bugle, but the sound is silent, only vibrating on the map and in the UI.
messages.断弦回斩与工匠线轴已经交过你，不用再拿东西来换。若只是来歇脚，也有地方。: I've already given you the Severed-String Riposte and the Artisan's Spool. No need to bring me anything else. There's room here if you just want to rest.
messages.断弦园主: Master of the Broken String Garden
messages.断弦园主战败后交出活封面根脉，黑曜巡礼军听见印记断裂并打开外环道路。: The defeated Master of the Broken String Garden surrenders the Living Bookcover Vein. The Obsidian Pilgrim Army hears the mark break and opens the outer ring road.
messages.断弦平台会突然塌断。: The Broken String platform will suddenly collapse.
messages.断弦歌者仍相信钟声能让裂缝睡去。: The Broken-String Singer still believes that the bell can make the cracks fall asleep.
messages.断弦歌者守在树心，听她唱完再走。: The Broken-String Singer stays in the heart of the tree, listening to her song before leaving.
messages.断弦歌者守在树心，听她唱完再走。 可见旧检修入口：「棘线下劈练习工房」。站上裂纹: The Broken-String Singer stays in the heart of the tree, listens to her sing until she finishes. The old maintenance entrance can be seen: "Thorn Downstrike Practice Workshop". Stand on the cracked sealing plate, jump, press the direction + attack, and chop down with a downward slash.
messages.断弦歌者承认六枚印记曾是守门者，她们被王冠变成维持封印的材料。: The Broken-String Singer admits that the six marks were once Gatewardens, and they were turned into materials to maintain the seal by the crown.
messages.断弦温室 自动生成灰盒: Broken String Greenhouse Automatically Generates Ash Box
messages.断弦温室 自动生成灰盒：自动生成灰盒入口。: Broken String Greenhouse Automatically Generates Ash Box: Automatically generates an entrance to the ash box.
messages.断弦温室入口: The entrance to the Broken String Greenhouse
messages.断弦温室曾给书库送来活的封面，那里知道印记原本是谁。: The Broken String Greenhouse once brought living covers to the library, where people knew who the original marks belonged to.
messages.断弦温室的活封面: The living cover of the Broken String Greenhouse
messages.断弦温室闭环完成：NPC、清怪、Boss门和章节奖励均已验证。: Broken String Greenhouse complete. NPC encounters, enemies, boss gate and chapter reward verified.
messages.断弦的震颤会暴露隐形的哨兵。: The tremor of the broken string will expose the invisible sentinels.
messages.断弦章节敌人掉落的材料。: Materials dropped by enemies in Broken-String chapters.
messages.断弦门廊1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Broken String Vestibule 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.断弦门廊2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Broken String Vestibule 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.断弦门廊3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Broken String Vestibule 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.断弦门廊4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Broken String Vestibule 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.断弦门廊5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Broken String Vestibule 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.断弦门廊6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Broken String Vestibule 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.断弦门廊7：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Broken String Vestibule 7. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.断枝祭坛精英战前最后的灯。: The last light before the elite battle at the Broken Bough Altar.
messages.断枝祭坛精英战奖励；解锁冲刺与全部钟隙门。: Elite battle rewards at the Broken Bough Altar; unlock the Dash and all the Bellgap doors.
messages.断裂的渡口横梁: The broken crossbeam of the crossing
messages.断钟舌吊在走廊尽头: The broken bell tongue hangs at the end of the corridor
messages.新制度的后果要靠持续参与和复核兑现。: The new arrangements will mean something only as long as people keep taking part and checking them.
messages.新图上既画轮值站，也画离开的路。退出的人不该被擦掉。: The new map shows the watch stations and the roads out. No one ought to be wiped off the map for leaving.
messages.新城第一笔生意，我想卖生日蜡烛。不是祭灯，生日，你知道的那一种。: For the first sale in the new city, I'd like to sell birthday candles. Not votive lamps. Birthdays. You know the kind.
messages.新契约由活人署名，旧契约留作公开副本。我想学会保管，不再替人决定。: Let the living sign the new covenant and the old one remain open to all. I'd like to learn how to keep something without making up anyone's mind for them.
messages.新契约第一天，休工。别跟我讲产量，我得让全城学会正常下班。: On the first day of the new covenant, we close the works. Spare me the production figures. This whole city needs to learn how to end a shift.
messages.新契约若能留一条，就留“门从里面也能打开”。余下的，我不挑。: If there's one line you can keep in the new covenant, make it this: the door opens from the inside too. I'll leave the rest to you.
messages.新契约让人可以离开，也可以回来。我要先离开一次，才知道什么叫回来。: The new covenant lets people leave. It lets them come back too. I'd like to leave once before I find out what coming back means.
messages.新娘不再守着结尾，回程也该重新有名字。: The Bride no longer guards the end. The homeward route deserves its own name again.
messages.新娘不再点名，旧路也还刻着行军的习惯。: The Bride no longer calls the roll. The old road still bears the habits of a march.
messages.新娘倒下后，灯不会自己忘记旧用途。: The lamps won't forget their old use just because the Bride has fallen.
messages.新娘停下了？那把盾替我放低一点。今天不用拿它替谁遮住脸。: The Bride has stopped? Lower that shield for me a little. Today it needn't hide anyone's face.
messages.新娘停了点名，我可以把旗放在营地当一块遮雨布。: Now the Bride has stopped calling the roll, I can spread the flag in camp as a shelter from the rain.
messages.新工牌可以写名字，也可以交回。我想等爹回来亲手写那一笔。: You can write your name on the new badge. You can hand it back, too. I want Dad to write his own name when he comes home.
messages.新的协作需要承担时间与分工成本。: Sharing the work takes time, and someone has to work out how it will be divided.
messages.新约下的衣领还要留线结吗？: Under the new covenant, will you still leave a knot in the collar?
messages.新约写好了，你怎么还把领扣改来改去？: The new covenant is written. Why keep adjusting the collar clasp?
messages.新约怎样避免再被刮掉一个字？: How do you stop a word from being scraped out of the new covenant, too?
messages.新约终于允许我用自己的名字回答。脚上的根扣还得割开，纸上的自由不能代替离开根笼的: The new covenant finally lets me answer in my own name. Someone still has to cut the root shackle on my foot. Freedom on paper won't get me out of this cage.
messages.新规矩能让纸船逆水吗？不能也没关系，让岸上的人肯收信就行。: Will the new rules let paper boats sail upstream? Never mind if they won't. I just want the people on the bank to take the letters.
messages.新路开放那天，我在第一个岔口站一天。不收钱，只告诉人可以往哪儿走。: When the new road opens, I'll spend the day at its first fork. No charge. I just want to tell people where they can go.
messages.新钟响的时候不用叫我出列。我会自己走过去，这次不穿甲。: Don't call me out of the ranks when the new bell rings. I'll walk over myself. Without armour this time.
messages.新钟鸣时，我会先打开救人的闸。仪式可以等，檐下的人不能再等。: When the new bell rings, I'll open the rescue sluice first. The rite can wait. The people under the eaves have waited long enough.
messages.新页也该如此：签的人能看，改的时候能问，不愿继续也能留下清楚的一笔。: The new page needs that, too. Let each signer read it, ask when it changes, and leave a clear mark if they choose to stop.
messages.旗上没有我的名字，军号却每夜把我叫回去。: My name's nowhere on the flag. The bugle still calls me back every night.
messages.旗在我手里，但我不想再让它代表别人一定跟着我。: It's in my hands. I don't want it to mean other people are bound to follow me anymore.
messages.旗枪三连: The end of Banner Bridge is a gap; fall back to the camp.
messages.旗桥尽头是断口，坠回营地。: After the warm light, the war chariot stands in front of the Mirrorpool; don't rush to mend the charred nails.
messages.旗桥西端的栏杆断了，西边的碑林里亮着灯。: The railing at the west end of the Banner Bridge is broken, and there is a light in the west side's stone forest.
messages.无名钟契库保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的声音: The work records saved by the Unknown Bell Contract Library: The facility was once maintained for residents, but later became a channel for contracts, military orders, and voices that were erased.
messages.无名钟契库：完成能力动作后穿过专属立体检修路线，收回两件物资并安全退出。: Unknown Bell Contract Library: After completing the ability action, pass through the exclusive stand-up maintenance route to retrieve two items and exit safely.

messages.无声冠核 自动生成灰盒：自动生成灰盒入口。: Silent Crown Automatically Generates Ash Box: Automatically generates an entrance to the ash box.
messages.无声王冠不是城堡，而是倒扣在深井上的巨型钟体；五枚印记依次点亮终章门。: The Silent Crown is not a castle, but a giant bell body inverted on the deep well; five marks light up the final chapter gate in sequence.
messages.无声王冠掉落的章节奖励。: Chapter rewards for the fall of the Silent Crown
messages.无声王冠既镇潮也锁住人声；吞下的第一百零一把钥匙说明它曾主动拒绝开门。: The Silent Crown both prevents moisture and locks down voices; the tenth set of keys that was swallowed indicates that it once actively refused to open.
messages.无声王冠闭环完成：NPC、清怪、Boss门和章节奖励均已验证。: Silent Crown complete. NPC encounters, enemies, boss gate and chapter reward verified.

messages.无敌群压力；高台可从边缘安全落回工房入口。: No enemy pressure; you can safely drop from the high ledge back to the workshop entrance.
messages.无敌群压迫；失足落在原有底层维护道，可重新尝试并原路返回。: No enemy pressure; falling lands you on the lower maintenance walkway so you can retry or return the way you came.
messages.无需替所有居民完成心愿；打败王冠仍可选择重鸣或断冠。改写需要六份原话。: You needn't grant every resident's wish. Once the Crown falls, Retolling and Crownfall are open to you. The Rewrite takes all six first-hand accounts.
messages.既想赎罪，又害怕主角放出被水声压住的黑潮回流。: Wants to make amends but fears the Pilgrim will release the Blacktide held beneath the sound of running water.
messages.既然铜管在收声，为什么不砸掉？: If the copper pipes take voices away, why not break them?
messages.旧令还会找人，我听见熟悉的声也仍会绷紧。: The old order still comes looking for people. I still tense up when I hear a familiar note.
messages.旧军号又能沿灯路传远。我还会给想回头的人指路。: The old bugle carries along the lantern road again. I'll still show the way to anyone who wants to turn back.
messages.旧切口为什么一直没有遮起来？: Why hasn't anyone covered the old cut?
messages.旧图上的中心就一定最重要吗？: Is what's at the centre of an old map always the most important?
messages.旧契约布缠成的小偶，胸口的绯线结承载回响；以短足行走，用缝锥接续被遗忘的名字。: The old contract is wrapped into a small puppet, with Crimson Thread knots on the chest, carrying echoes; walking on short legs, using sewing cones to continue forgotten names.
messages.旧巡礼军攻城车残骸仍按命令冲锋。: The remains of the old Pilgrim soldiers' siege car still charge according to the command.
messages.旧弦只要我停一拍，幼根就会颤。新铜箍没有停拍的地方。: With the old string, if I rested for a beat the young roots would quiver. The new hoop leaves no room for a rest.
messages.旧弦是我接向母株的。外面的新箍不是，那里没有让我停一拍的地方。: I fastened the old string to the mother plant. The new hoop outside wasn't mine. It left no room for me to miss a beat.
messages.旧弦有接续的地方，也有该停下的断口。: The old string has places to join it. It also has breaks where it's right to stop.
messages.旧弦进了树心，新铜箍又接到哪里？: The old string enters the heartwood. Where does the new copper hoop lead?
messages.旧抵押清单已经注销。新页上每个名字都能签，也能撤回。: The old register of pledges is void. On the new page, everyone can sign their name or withdraw it.
messages.旧王冠把六座失声之城缝进沉默里。主角是能看见绯色命线的巡礼者，需要找回六枚失声印: The old crown sewed six silent cities into silence. The protagonist is a pilgrim who can see crimson life lines. They need to retrieve six silent marks to determine whether the crown is sealing a disaster or swallowing the city's own voice.
messages.旧王朝建立在一口倒扣巨钟之上。巨钟压住深井黑潮，也吞掉活人的声音、誓言和未完成愿: The old dynasty was established on a collapsed giant bell. The bell presses down on the Deep Well Black Tide, also swallowing the voices, vows, and unfinished wishes of living people.
messages.旧王钟舌就吊在你头顶。 余响钟可开启挑战房。: The old Crown Tongue is hanging over your head. The Resonating Bell can be opened in the Challenge Room.
messages.旧目录封存，新页留着空白。谁愿签、何时退出，都不许再被我代写。: The old catalogue is sealed. The new pages have room. I won't fill in anyone's signature or withdrawal date again.

messages.旧记录里写着找到过，不等于眼下已经把六份都带到这里。: An old record that says they were found doesn't mean all six are here now.
messages.旧钟不再替我们作答。线结还在，守潮的责任要交回活人商量。: The old bell will never answer for us again. The knot remains. How to keep the tide watch is for the living to decide together.
messages.旧钟在等某种回声；在钟下施展王冠共鸣。: The old bell awaits an echo; cast Crown Resonance beneath the bell.
messages.旧钟板应和共鸣松开了，上面的壁龛永久敞开。: The old bell plate answers the resonance and gives way; the alcove above is now permanently open.
messages.旧钟稳住根系，也把下一代的声音押回去。我记得这份安稳的价钱。: The old bell steadied the roots. It also pledged the next generation's voices all over again. I know what that steadiness cost.
messages.旧钟铭记：书船卸货时，钟声会替无名抄书人留下一次签到。后来名册比人活得更久。: The old bell remembers: when the book-barge unloaded, its toll logged each nameless scribe. In time, the ledger outlived the people.
messages.旧钟铭记：军中的归途钟只为回营者鸣响。最后一道军令，却要求它永远保持沉默。: The old bell remembers: the army's homecoming bell rang only for those who returned to camp. The final military order commanded it to stay silent forever.
messages.旧钟铭记：这里曾替归家的织工报时。王冠收走了钟声，留下没有夜晚的工时。: The old bell remembers: it once rang the hour for weavers heading home. The Crown took away the toll, leaving shifts with no night.
messages.旧铸坊幸存铁匠，因长期听见钟壁人名而主动刺聋双耳。: A survivor of the old foundry. After years of hearing the names in the bell walls, Liu pierced his own ears to end the sound.
messages.旧铸工证物柜保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的声: The work records stored in the old Caster's Object Cabinet: the facility was once maintained for residents, later used to store contracts, military orders, and erased sounds.
messages.旧铸工证物柜：操作能力闩后沿独立检修路线登上证物台，收取记录与物资。: Old Caster's Object Cabinet: The operating capability locks it up, allowing independent access to the object platform for records and materials.
messages.旧镇潮器失效，黑潮不再受它压制；居民必须撤离、筑堤并共同应对风险。: The old tideworks fail. With nothing holding the Blacktide back, people will have to evacuate, raise dikes and face the danger together.

messages.明天还来修苗床吗？: Will you come back tomorrow to mend the seedbeds?
messages.昨天有人没跟上灯，我差点补回召集的那一拍。手已经举起来了，又放下。: Someone fell behind the lights yesterday. I nearly added back the beat that calls people to muster. My hand was up before I lowered it.
messages.显示全文与翻页只改变当前文字的阅读位置。交谈、记录与交付仍使用原按钮。: Reveal the line or turn the page to change your reading position. Use the conversation buttons to advance, make a record or give an offering.
messages.暖灯之后，战车守在镜池门前；灰钉未熄时不要急着缝补。: The Pilgrim's Tombstone array forms a high platform, which is a collectible for the true ending; after the map is redrawn, it is moved behind the lantern-phase Shadow Gate.
messages.暗室里的水声不对劲。: Something is wrong with the sound of water in the dark room
messages.暗格狭窄，退路只有原路。: The niche is narrow, with only the original path as a retreat.
messages.暗格藏在半钟平台东上方。: The hidden compartment is located above the Half-Bell Platform.

messages.替我找一枚工人徽章。我想知道父亲以前穿的衣服到底是什么颜色。: Find me a worker's badge. I want to know what colour Dad's work clothes used to be.
messages.最后一枚印记在百钥守门人身上。六份证词齐全才有改写的路；缺哪份就回哪座城。: The final mark rests with the Hundred-Key Gatekeeper. All six testimonies are needed for the Rewrite. Go back to the city that holds the one you're missing.
messages.最早怕水，后来怕人。两道封口用的是同一种蜡，我每天补，补得比谁都齐。: Water first. People later. Both seals used the same wax. I mended them every day, neater than anyone.

messages.月镜掠袭: The old military order in the Pilgrim's Tomb can be handed over to the deserter for verification.
messages.有一字我不敢认，先留个空框。你带回钟庭时，别把空框描成一个看起来像的字。: There's a character I can't make out. I've left an empty square. Don't turn it into something that looks close on the way to Bell Court.
messages.有一班迟迟没来，我只顾把水压下去，没往住处看。后来工牌从下面浮上来，我才去找名单: One shift was late. I kept my eyes on the water and never looked toward the houses. Only when the badges floated up from below did I go for the roll.
messages.有了攀壁，你能去檐上的支路。扶好墙，雨总比看起来更滑。: You can reach the paths above the eaves with the Wall-Cling Knot. Keep hold of the wall. Rain makes it slicker than it looks.
messages.有些话我得自己去说。你不必替我站在中间。: Some things I need to say myself. You needn't stand between us.
messages.有些问题只有翻回前一页，才知道自己漏看了什么。: Sometimes only turning back a page shows you what you missed.
messages.有人不想再上路，我也得给他留营地的位置。: If someone doesn't want the road again, I need to keep a place for them in camp too.
messages.有人今天不接，就留到明天。引路的灯不能借轮值重新学会召兵。: If no one takes it today, leave it till tomorrow. A guide light mustn't learn to muster troops again in the name of the watch.
messages.有人再刮掉一个字，你怎么发现？: If someone scrapes out another word, how will you know?
messages.有人叫我，我回了头。我还不知道来处，却已经有了一次相见。: Someone called and I turned. I still don't know where I came from, but already there has been a meeting.
messages.有人愿意同行很好，没有人也该给我留个能自己走的口。: I'd welcome company. Even if no one comes, leave an opening I can walk through myself.
messages.有人把告别敲得像命令。我每天来这里，就是想教旧钟分清这两件事。: Some people knock out a farewell as if it were an order. I come here every day to teach the old bell the difference.
messages.有人把守井的差事也叫成他的名字，叫久了，竟把看守与被守者混在一起。: Someone started calling the guard's job by his name. In time people confused the one keeping watch with the one being watched.
messages.有人把没有走到终点算成欠下一班军役，归途就这样被改成了队列。: Someone counted falling short of the destination as a shift of military service owed. That turned the homeward road into a marching column.
messages.有人撤签，我就把空位留下，等别人来。今天先学会不拿旧印补上。: When someone withdraws a signature, I'll keep the space till someone else comes. Today I'm learning to leave the old seal off it.
messages.有人来接班，我得看见他到了，才肯放开手。: Before I let go, I want to see the next watcher standing here.
messages.有人记得的，与纸上不同，先信谁？: When memory differs from what's on the page, whom do I believe first?
messages.有人记得获救，有人记得被留下。两句都可能是真的；分钥架就是把这些不同关进了一把锁: One remembers being rescued. Another remembers being left behind. Both can be true. The key rack locked all those differences behind a single lock.
messages.有时是忘了擦，有时是有人不肯承认一班已经没人。看表面分不清。: Sometimes someone forgot to rub them out. Sometimes no one would admit a shift was empty. You can't tell by looking at the surface.
messages.有时等不到会难过。可若我因此拿走你开口的选择，难过就又被交给另一个人了。: Sometimes it hurts to wait for an answer that never comes. But if I take away your choice to speak because of it, I've just handed that hurt to someone else.
messages.有时身体会先往前走，心里才想起今天不用赶一声号。: Sometimes the body is already on the march before you remember there's no bugle to hurry after today.
messages.朝圣者冢的重编名册: The recompiled roster of the Pilgrim Cemetery
messages.朝圣者冢碑列高台，真结局收集品；地图重做后迁至 lantern_phase 影门: The wooden beam is one-way, allowing passage from below.
messages.朝圣者冢碑列高台；用灯影穿行越过影门，查看高台名册，回程循同一影门。: The high platform of the Pilgrim Cemetery stele; use the shadow to cross the shadow gate, check the high platform roster, and return along the same shadow gate.
messages.朝圣者冢里的旧军令，可交给逃旗者核实。: The spacing of the wooden beams varies; check carefully before jumping.

messages.木条可以取下来收好，谁说离队就一定要烧掉？: You can take a slat off the wheel and keep it. Who said leaving the ranks meant burning it?
messages.木条被重新钉回点名轮时，大概也有人这样替沉默作了结论。: Someone probably drew just such a conclusion from silence when those slats were nailed back onto the muster wheel.
messages.未完成章节会触发门禁回声战。: Unfinished chapters will trigger an echo battle at the gate.
messages.本章取得丝壁攀附后，ch1 苔壁竖井 wallshaft 门（心结）即可回访开启: After obtaining the Silk Wall Grip in this chapter, the Heart Knot in the ch1 Channelshade tracks wall shaft door can be revisited for the first cross-chapter Return economy reward
messages.松了。等一下，让我自己把左脚放出来。: It's loose. Wait. Let me take my left foot out myself.
messages.枕木间距不一，看准再跳。: Climb east along the Upper Stone Road towards the watchtower.
messages.枪阵横扫、盾阵推进、军令定身圈。: Archers sweep, Shield Bearers advance, and the Military Order forms a standing circle.
messages.枪阵横扫、盾阵推进、军令定身圈。；召唤两列巡礼军冲锋，玩家需用 lantern_: Guns were swept, shields pushed and military orders set in circles; two patrol teams were called on and the player was required to use Lanten_phase to cross the window of a film door or army.
messages.柜门可以开了。我先拿两份相同的抄本，一份留柜里，一份让人带出去。: I can open the cabinet now. I'll make two matching copies. One stays here. The other can go out into the world.
messages.查。如今执行的仍是旧约，更该把它如何改过写清。: I will. We're still enforcing the old covenant. All the more reason to write down exactly how it was changed.
messages.查不到的仍写查不到，不再用完整的封口冒充完整的记录。: If I can't trace something, I'll say so. I won't pass off an intact seal as a complete record again.
messages.查找工具不能代替被查找的生命。: A means of looking up a life can't stand in for that life.
messages.查找沉默军令，或检查巡礼池白纱的夹层。: Search for the Silent Military Order, or check the interlayer of the white gauze in the pilgrimage pond.
messages.查明哑钟缘故，找到仍在等候的人。: Find out why the bell is silent and who is still waiting.
messages.查看巡礼愿板上钉着的求助。: Inspect the help nailed on the pilgrimage board
messages.查看旧王钟舌留下的线索；冠下回声碎片可选，不影响主路。: Review the clues left by the old crown tongue; the fragments of the crown echo can be chosen without affecting the main path.
messages.查看温室蜂房支路，先观察虫群再取蜡。: Observe the insect groups in the greenhouse bee hive branches, then collect the wax.
messages.查看透出灯影的黑曜裂缝。: Inspect the obsidian cracks that cast light.
messages.柳听着恢复的节拍，把工牌翻到背面，又翻回来。旧班表送到炉前，姓名那一栏仍没有位置: Liu feels the returning beat, turns his badge over, then turns it back. The old rota arrives at the furnace. Still no place for a name. The Greenhouse warms. At camp, the lamps fall into line with the bugle.
messages.柳把工牌逐枚翻面。炉火等着，旧班表也等着。: Liu turned the work badges over one by one. The furnace could wait. So could the old rota.
messages.柳没有替我编一个师父。他看出我今天的手腕收得太急。: Liu didn't invent a master for me. He saw that today I was pulling my wrist back too sharply.
messages.柳认出的是自己修过的东西。工牌上的编号盖不住那道磨痕。: Liu recognized his own repair. The number stamped on the badge couldn't cover that file mark.
messages.柳让我顺着每个接头看。我要切断什么，得先认清它接去了哪里。: Liu had me trace each joint. Before I cut anything, I need to know where it leads.
messages.栈梯脚下伏着一条渠虫，落地前先看清。: A canal worm lies at the foot of the ladder; look closely before it lands
messages.树冠正下方就是大树的心。: Right below the crown of the tree is the heart of the great tree.
messages.树冠西枝绕回弦心，往东才是根穹顶。主教举杖后留意地面，根刺不全从他脚边来。: The west branch of the canopy leads back to the string heart. The root dome is east. When the Bishop raises his staff, watch the ground. The thorns don't all rise at his feet.
messages.树冠（跃入树心）: Jump into the heart of the tree
messages.树心开阔，也开阔给敌人。: The heart of the tree is open, and it is also open to the enemies.
messages.树心接弦伤口: String Graft Scar in the Heartwood
messages.树心留下那道伤口，我一听就会接着唱。今天我想先不唱。: When I hear the scar in the heartwood, I always want to start singing again. Today I'd rather wait.
messages.树心的弦仍在响，旁边挂起了守弦的值守表。: The string of the Heartwood is still ringing, with a watch table for keeping the strings in place hanging nearby.
messages.树心的弦松了，温室慢慢冷下来。: The string of the Heartwood is loose, and the greenhouse is slowly getting colder.
messages.树心的弦随钟声一起颤动，温室又暖了。: The strings of the tree core tremble with the sound of the bell, and the greenhouse becomes warmer again.
messages.树心的枝桠是单向的，可以再爬回树冠。: The branches of the heart of the tree are one-way, allowing you to climb back to the crown.
messages.树心需要的音与钟网索取的声，已经被你看见有多不同。: You've seen how different the note the heartwood needs is from the voice the bell network demands.
messages.校录契印已照原件复原，盐记只是证据的索引，不是给人定罪的名字。: I've restored the Recordkeeper's Seal from the original. A Salt Mark points you to evidence. It can't pronounce anyone guilty.
messages.核对时把刮痕也记下，免得下一位只抄新墨。: When you check the text, record the scrape too. Otherwise the next reader may copy only the new ink.
messages.核对第一份换班。旧册一划就能要人来，新册多了来问的人，反而慢。: Checking the first change of watch. With the old book, a stroke could summon a person. With the new one, people come and ask. It takes longer.
messages.根不再摇得那么厉害是好事，可箍勒在哪里，还是得逐处看。: It's good the roots aren't shaking so hard. We still have to check each place the hoops are digging in.
messages.根不晃了，你为什么还守着西门？: The roots are steady. Why are you still at the west gate?
messages.根刺线和钟波会覆盖地面，跳跃和冲刺错开预警。: Root Threads and Bell Waves will cover the ground, with jumps and dashes spacing out warnings.
messages.根据选择进入重鸣、断冠或绯线真结局。: Depending on the choice, players can enter the Retolling, Crownfall, or Crimson Thread endings.
messages.根牢下面有支路，上方的封根能用下劈打开。打开后先退开，别连自己也困进去。: There's a branch path beneath the root prison. Open the seal above it with a downcut. Step clear when it opens or you'll be caught here too.
messages.根笼下方有一条回前厅的暗道。: There is a secret passageway below the root cage leading back to the foyer.
messages.根笼猎手会短暂定身。: The Root Cage Hunter will immobilize briefly.
messages.根笼猎手在苗床间巡行。: The Root cage hunter patrols between the seed beds.
messages.根笼猎手收集失败巡礼者。: The Root Cage Hunter collects failed pilgrims.
messages.根笼猎物留下的根网爪痕。不挡主线，却能证明你循迹敲响过根库余响钟。: Root cage prey leaves root net claw marks. It doesn't block the main path, but it can prove that you have tapped the Root Vault's residual bell with your trail.
messages.根笼的人已经能离开，我不会因为眼下缺人就把他又拴回来。: The man from the root cage is free to go. I won't tie him up again just because we're short of hands.
messages.根笼裂开就算能走了吗？: If the root cage cracks, does that mean you can leave?
messages.根笼那个人有了退路，我更不能把所有留下都叫作愿意。: The man in the root cage has a way out now. All the more reason not to call everyone who stays willing.
messages.根笼里的人还在敲两下。学会棘丝下劈后，回去听他确认解缚、落脚点与西门的灯；等他站: The people in the root cage are still making two short knocks. After learning how to strike the spines downward, go back and listen to him confirm the binding, the landing point, and the lamp of the west gate; wait until he stands steady.
messages.根笼里还有人。敲两下的时候，我以前总说等水槽修好再去。: There's someone in the root cage. When I heard the two knocks I used to say I'd go after I'd mended the trough.
messages.根系失了钟律，我要和留下的人一起接水。能说话以后，总得学会商量。: The roots have lost the rhythm of the bell. I'll take in water with the people who stayed. Now we can speak, we'll need to learn how to come to terms.
messages.根系检修灯缺了蜡封。支路的蜂房里有花粉蜡，靠近前先看清虫群。: The root maintenance lamps need wax seals. There's pollen wax in the hive off the side path. Watch the swarm before you go in.
messages.根网首清：取得根网爪痕证据，并得额外碎钱与花粉蜂蜡。: First clear of the root net: Obtain evidence of the root net claw marks and get extra coins and pollen wax.
messages.根须包住的钟碑与断石凳: The bell stele and broken stone bench covered by roots
messages.根须封住旧碑，却留下可供朝圣者停歇的苔灯。: The roots had to be sealed, leaving a moss light for pilgrims to rest.
messages.根须撕开的门洞: The door hole torn open by roots
messages.根须沉睡钟已经苏醒，回程通路永久接通。: The Root Sleeping Bell has awakened; the return route is now permanently open.
messages.根须蓄水井1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Root Cistern 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.根须蓄水井2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Root Cistern 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.根须蓄水井3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Root Cistern 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.根须蓄水井4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Root Cistern 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.根须蓄水井5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Root Cistern 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.根须蓄水井6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Root Cistern 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.根须蓄水井7：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Root Cistern 7. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.格挡钉兵开门，再利用迟影撞碎盐封。: Block the nail soldiers with the gate and then use the late shadow to break the salt seal.
messages.格栅漏雨的一线缝: A crack in the grille that leaks rain
messages.档案能提出一个说法，最好还附着能查的来历；它不能提前把你往后的事写成已经发生。: A record can offer an account, and ought to tell you where you can check it. It can't write your future down as something already done.
messages.档案能替我决定该成为什么人吗？: Can the archive decide who I ought to become?
messages.档案舱的两层工牌: Double-Layered Work Badge from the Records Bay
messages.桥下影门通回哨站，别错过灯影开窗。: The bridge under the shadow gate leads back to the sentry station. Don't miss the Lantern Window.
messages.桥板半朽，别停在中段。: The bridge boards are half decayed, don't stop in the middle.
messages.桥面结晶易碎，风从穹顶灌下。: The crystallization on the bridge is fragile, with wind pouring down from the dome.
messages.检修灯又按钟令亮了。我卖蜡，也会记下是谁一直没法开口讨价。: The maintenance lamps are lit on the old bell's orders again. I sell wax. I'll remember who's never had a voice to bargain with me.
messages.检修灯是给根系还是给人用的？: Are maintenance lamps for the roots or for the people tending them?
messages.检修设施返回pump_atrium: Maintenance Facility Returns to Pump Atrium
messages.检修设施返回riser_shrine: Maintenance Facility Returns to Riser Shrine
messages.检修设施返回root_vault: Maintenance Facility Returns to Root Vault
messages.检修设施返回salt_gate_walk: Maintenance Facility Returns to Salt Gate Walk
messages.检修设施返回secret_nook: Maintenance Facility Returns to Secret Nook
messages.检修设施返回silt_vault: Maintenance Facility Returns to Silt Vault
messages.检修设施返回threadmakers_cache: Maintenance Facility Returns to Threadmakers Cache
messages.检修设施返回tide_listening_cell: Maintenance Facility Returns to Tide Listening Cell
messages.检修设施返回tree_heart: Maintenance Facility Returns to Tree Heart
messages.检修设施返回wax_seal_vault: Maintenance Facility Returns to Wax Seal Vault
messages.棘墙会从左右推进。: The spiky wall will advance from both sides.
messages.棘根深井保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的声音。: Records preserved at the Thorn Deep Well: The facility was maintained for residents, later converted to transport contracts, military orders, and voices that were erased.
messages.棘根深井：完成能力动作后穿过专属立体检修路线，收回两件物资并安全退出。: Thorn Deep Well: After completing the ability action, follow the exclusive maintenance route to retrieve two items and exit safely.
messages.棘线下劈练习工房保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去: Records preserved at the Thorn Down Strike Practice Workshop: The facility was maintained for residents, later converted to transport contracts, military orders, and voices that were erased.
messages.棘线下劈练习工房：完成能力动作后穿过专属立体检修路线，收回两件物资并安全退出。: Practice Workshop for Thorn Downstrike: After completing the ability action, follow the exclusive maintenance route to retrieve two items and exit safely.
messages.棚架横木承得住你，但承不住犹豫。: The shed rafters can hold you, but they can't hold back your hesitation.
messages.模子的口为什么朝着街里？: Why does the mould open toward the street?
messages.横向冲锋精英，训练 Boss 前相位躲避。: Elite in horizontal charge. Train to avoid phase when approaching the Boss.
messages.横廊连接上下庭，竖井藏着支路。M 打开地图；别把桥中间的井口当作缺了一块地。: The gallery links the upper and lower courts. There are side paths in the shaft. Press M for the map. That hole in the middle of the bridge is a well, not a missing bit of floor.
messages.横贯旗桥: Climb westward along the Lower Stone Road in a zigzag pattern.
messages.横锤、跳锤、水波震退。: Horizontal hammer, jumping hammer, water wave retreat.
messages.横锤、跳锤、水波震退。；水位升高，Boss 敲响三枚钩环；玩家用 echo_ho: Horizontal hammers, jumping hammers, water waves repel. As the water level rises, the Boss hits three hook rings; players use Echo Hook to break the hook rings and make them stiff.
messages.歇好再走，或者回头，都比为了一个称号摔下去强。: Rest and carry on, or turn back. Either is better than falling for the sake of a title.
messages.歇脚、构筑与观察钟门；守卫不进入钟龛: Rest, adjust your build and inspect the bell gate. The guard stays outside the shrine.
messages.歌守徽以自身的音守住母株，园主却把活弦接进王冠钟网。: The Song Guard Emblem holds the mother plant with its own sound, but the garden master connects the living strings into the crown bell network.
messages.歌守徽是第四守门者；园主异化的铜根主教是看守者: The Song Guard Emblem is the fourth Gatewarden; the deformed Copperroot Bishop of the garden master is the guardian.
messages.歌守徽的残留人格是断弦歌者；铜根主教是园主的异化形态，二者不是同一人。: The remaining personality of the Song Guard Emblem is the Broken-String Singer; the Copperroot Bishop is the alienated form of the garden master. The two are not the same person.
messages.歌者把“徽”念得很轻。我把她和园主分别记下，免得再认错一次。: The singer said “Hui” very softly. I wrote her name and the Gardener's down separately, so I wouldn't confuse them again.
messages.正文告诉我纸上准许读什么，页边告诉我有人怎样拿过它。: The main text tells me what I'm allowed to read. The edges tell me how someone handled the paper.
messages.正门被旧钟锁住。绕下庭和钟廊，清掉守路敌群，再回来开后门；别堵在这儿。: The old bell has locked the main gate. Go round by the lower court and the bell gallery. Clear the guards and come back through the rear gate. Don't get stuck here with me.
messages.正门被锈钟封死，别从正面硬闯。: The main door is sealed by a rusty bell. Do not try to break through from the front.
messages.此处可以喘息，东面的钟隙仍需要绯线冲刺。: Here you can catch your breath, while the Bellgap on the east still requires Crimson Thread Dashes.
messages.此处无敌人，可整理地图和支线。: There are no enemies here, you can organize the map and side quests.
messages.此门尚未回应。你仍可以离开，寻找已知线索。: The gate hasn't answered yet. You can still leave and follow the leads you have.
messages.步道半沉，湿盐板一踩就塌。: The walkway is half-submerged, and the wet salt boards collapse with a step.
messages.死人还在轮班表上，是悼念吗？: Are the dead still on the rota as a memorial?
messages.残影淡去；教学三句由 npc_bellway_weaver 缝入 bellbon: The remaining shadows fade; the three sentences of teaching are sewn into the bellbone_station bell rope by npc_bellway_weaver (environmental interaction)
messages.殿前这一格可以换颜色了。等我补完下方排水管，你就有第二座城的入口。: I can change the colour of this square by the hall. Once I've drawn in the drainpipe below, you'll have an entrance to the second city.
messages.殿前钟龛旁的回廊斥候，记满三十页观武录才敢站在守母门前。: A scout by the shrine outside the hall. It took thirty pages of combat notes to find the courage to stand before the Matriarch's door.
messages.殿里的锈味很旧，旧得像一句守了太久的诺言。: The hall smells of old rust. Old as a promise kept too long.
messages.母株仍有人照看，但值守可以更换。树不该靠没答应过的人活着。: There are still people tending the mother plant, but they can hand over their shift. A tree shouldn't live on the backs of those who never agreed.
messages.母株深处留着接弦的伤口。看过那里，再回来问我想不想继续唱。: Deep in the mother plant you'll find the scar where the string was joined. See it first. Then ask me if I want to keep singing.
messages.母株脚下的旧弦接进树心，外层铜箍却通向钟网。树木需要一个音，钟令索取的却是一代代: The old strings under the mother plant's feet are connected to the tree core, while the outer copper hoops lead to the bell network. The tree needs a sound, but what the bell order demands is generations of throats.
messages.母株那道旧切口也是这样，接上去以后还得承得住。: The old cut on the mother plant is the same. Once you've made the join, it still has to bear weight.
messages.母株里的证词仍得由你亲手带走；救了一个人，不能替别处的人作证。: You'll still have to take the testimony from the mother plant yourself. Saving someone doesn't let us speak for the people elsewhere.
messages.每一份说明一处承诺怎样被延长、改写或挪用。一处人的话不能替另一处补签。: Each tells where a pledge was extended, altered or taken over. A voice from one place can't fill in a missing signature from another.
messages.每一道都是自己写的。钟仍在响，这一次能听出是谁在守，也能听出谁已经交了班。: Each one is written by oneself. The bell still rings, and this time it is possible to hear who is guarding and who has already taken their turn.
messages.每完成两个回声室打开一段环门，回到中心可存档。: Open a ring gate for each two completed echo chambers and return to the center to save the file.
messages.每条路都有要承担的事，不能因为旧制有罪，就把下一步的代价写成空白。: Every road has its cost. The wrong the old system did doesn't make the price of the next step disappear.
messages.每章 Boss 守着一段被篡改的钟声记忆。玩家击败它们后得到能力，也得到一段互相: Each chapter's Boss guards a piece of altered bell memory. After defeating them, players gain abilities and contradictory testimonies.
messages.水下巡逻者守住上行井壁。: Underwater patrols guard the upper well wall.
messages.水会沿分流箱走，人却不一定照我们盼的路回来。: Water follows the junction pipes. People don't always come home along the road we hoped they would.
messages.水位上涨会压缩安全平台。: The rising water level will compress the safe platform.
messages.水位上涨会封路。: Rising water levels will block the path.
messages.水位刻线只能告诉我水到哪里，不能证明谁的沉默换来了哪一寸。: A gauge line tells me where the water reaches. It can't prove whose silence paid for which inch.
messages.水位升高，Boss 敲响三枚钩环；玩家用 echo_hook 拉断钩环使其硬直。: As the water level rises, the boss knocks three hook rings; players use echo hook to break the hook rings and make them stiff.
messages.水声盖过一切脚步。: The sound of water overpowers all footsteps
messages.水幕后面不是墙。: Behind the water curtain is not a wall
messages.水往右走，人不一定。: Water flows to the right, but not everyone is sure.
messages.水流会把玩家推入刺管。: The water flow will push players into the spigot.
messages.水渠上段是路，下段是机器。先开锈泵捷径，再去炉前；剪口张开时绕侧面。: The canal is a road above and a machine below. Open the rust pump shortcut before going to the furnace. When the shears open, circle round the side.
messages.水渠生物啃食铸钟残渣，说明钟壁里混有活人名字。: Canal creatures eat the remains of the casting bell, indicating that there are names of living people mixed in the bell wall.
messages.水稳下来以后，工牌能翻到正面了吗？: Now the water's steady, can we turn the work tags face out?
messages.水稳了，你为什么还没开炉？: The water is steady. Why haven't you lit the furnace?
messages.水窖深廊冲刺门后。取走纺锤后可沿铜踏板返回水窖环廊。: Beyond the Dash Gate in the Deep Cistern Hall. Take the spindle, then climb the bronze steps back to the Cistern Ring.
messages.水窖淹没旧钟，只剩基座与遗留纺锤。: The water cellar floods the old bell, leaving only the base and the remaining spindle.
messages.水能淹一间库，命令也能封一扇门。留一处，就把所有人的记忆押在同一把锁上。: One vault can flood. One door can be sealed by an order. Keep everything in one place and all our memories depend on one lock.
messages.水轮停在半圈。柳说守前半夜，后半夜还空着。门上的撤离字迹未干，温室先把人的路腾开: The waterwheel stops halfway round. Liu offers to watch the first half of the night. The rest is open. The evacuation notice is still wet on the door. In the Greenhouse someone clears a path. People finding their voices begin to argue. They begin to ask questions, too.
messages.水轮内部，冲刺门后。: Inside the waterwheel, behind the Dash Door
messages.水轮背后有回到管工休息间的捷径门。: There is a shortcut door behind the waterwheel that leads back to the canal worker's rest room.
messages.水轮转起来，接班前有人先叫名字。温室的值守表少了一人，园丁把那段活留给自己。钟庭: The waterwheel turns. Someone calls the next worker by name. One name has gone from the Greenhouse rota. The gardener takes that piece of work on himself. The new clasp in Bell Court takes too long to undo. The apprentice picks out a stitch and sews it again.
messages.水轮齿隙深不见底。: The gap between the waterwheel teeth is deep and bottomless
messages.池边那层白纱不是婚衣。若能穿过影门，去看它的夹层。: The white gauze by the pool isn't a wedding dress. If you can cross the shadow gate, look between its layers.
messages.沉没档案舱冲刺门后的记录；先确认冲刺落脚点，再检查舱内工牌。: Records behind the Dash Door of the Sunken Archive Cabin; first confirm the landing point of the dash, then check the work badges inside the cabin.
messages.沉没档案舱冲刺门后，真结局收集品。: Behind the Sunken Archive Cabin Dash Door, the true ending collection items
messages.沉没档案舱的工牌上层冲着编号，翻面的手铆凹痕却各不相同。生产记录留下了钟令不肯叫: The work badges on the upper layer of the Sunken Archive Cabin face the numbers, while the indentations on the reverse side are different for each. The production records leave names that the bell order refuses to reveal.
messages.沉渠尽头: The end of the sunken canal
messages.沉炉大厅侧廊的前工头，半截身体被水轮和铁渣固定。: Once foreman of the drowned furnace. A waterwheel and iron slag pin half his body to the side gallery of the great hall.
messages.沉眠于水轮下；原位留「半枚锈工牌」拾取点与一段绯线低语: Sleeping under the waterwheel; leaving a "half a work badge" collection point and a whispering Crimson Thread
messages.沉睡根核1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Sleeping Root Core 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.沉睡根核2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Sleeping Root Core 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.沉睡根核3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Sleeping Root Core 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.沉睡根核4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Sleeping Root Core 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.沉睡根核5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Sleeping Root Core 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.沉睡根核6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Sleeping Root Core 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.沉钟基座上的遗留纺锤: The remaining spindle on the base of the sinking bell
messages.沉锤铁匠与执剪者是同一个人吗？: Are the Sunken Hammer Smith and the Scissor Apostle one person?
messages.沉锤铁匠交出铁匠誓牌和回声钩索，要求主角去盐白书库寻找王冠契约原文。: The Sunken Hammer Smith gives you the Smith's Oath Plate and the Echo Hook, and asks you to find the original Crown Covenant in the Saltwhite Archive.
messages.沉锤铁匠把工人的名字铸进誓牌，沉井守候有人敲出名字。: The blacksmith of the sunken hammer casts the workers' names into the oath plates, and the well waits for someone to call out the names.
messages.沉锤铁匠留下的印记，可作为进入盐白书库的凭证。: The mark left by the sunken hammer blacksmith can be used as a credential to enter the Saltwhite Archive
messages.沉锤铁匠的旧炉: The old furnace of the sunken hammer blacksmith
messages.沉默军令碎片三枚: Three fragments of the Silent Military Order
messages.沉默军令背面有拒令条款，终章可用王冠共鸣让巡礼军停战。: The back of the Silent Military Order contains a clause of refusal. The final chapter can use Crown Resonance to halt the Pilgrim Army.
messages.沉默的读者怎样反对一页书？: How can a silent reader object to a page?
messages.沉默读者的迟影会复写你的直线。: The late shadow of the Silent Reader will copy your straight line.
messages.没有人召你了，为什么还留在营地？: No one's calling you back. Why stay in camp?
messages.没有人逼我应声以后，下一步往哪儿走，还得让我慢慢学。今夜我先守这里。: Now no one's forcing me to answer, I need time to learn where to go next. Tonight I'll keep watch here.
messages.没有回声，也该算这一声已经结束。: Even if there is no echo, let the call be over.
messages.没有回应应先被理解，而非立即被惩罚。: Before punishing someone for silence, find out why there was no answer.
messages.没有完整来历会让人犹豫，可现在站在这里、看见这些人，也是真实的一段你。: Not knowing your whole story might give you pause. Standing here now, seeing these people, is a real part of you as well.
messages.没有执剪者逼人闭嘴，问清楚应该容易些。: Without the Apostle silencing anyone, we should be able to ask more easily.
messages.没有敌人了，只剩选择。: There are no enemies left, only choices.
messages.没有旧钟网，水阀由谁守？: Without the old bell network, who keeps watch on the valves?
messages.没有留下反对的声音，不能被倒算为同意。: The absence of a recorded objection can't be counted backward as consent.
messages.没有钟声，换班怎么开始？: Without a bell, how will a new shift start?
messages.没有钟替我们下令了。我愿在营地帮忙，却不再替别人答应归队。: There's no bell to give our orders now. I'll help at camp. I won't promise on anyone's behalf to rejoin the ranks.
messages.没跟上灯号的人会怎样？: What happens to someone who misses the signal?
messages.沿上段砌道向东爬向瞭望塔。: Cross Banner Bridge westward, overlooking the camp and the way back.
messages.沿下层继续东行；上层观雨台可单跳登上，向西落回原路。: Continue east along the lower level; the upper rain platform can be jumped onto, and return to the original path to the west.
messages.沿下段砌道向西之字爬升。: Ash Flag Remains · Old Foothill Road
messages.沿东冠肩下行，进入雨渠回声室。: Walk down along the East Crown shoulder, and enter the Rain Canal Echo Chamber.
messages.沿东墙藤蔓一路向上。: Climb up along the vines on the east wall.
messages.沿东环廊走到核心井口。: Walk along the East Ring Gallery to the core wellhead.
messages.沿东琉璃台离开温室。: Leave the greenhouse along the East Glass Terrace.
messages.沿之字踏板垂直攀上钟塔。: Climb vertically up the bell tower along the zigzag steps.
messages.沿书塔逐层辨认左右阅览廊与上层反页廊，不固定全井中心: Follow the reading galleries on either side of the book tower, then look for the reversed-page gallery above.
messages.沿冠肋单向攀回王冠前厅。: Climb back to the Crown Foyer along the Crown Ribs in one direction.
messages.沿升梯一路爬回钟骨站厅。: Climb back to the bell bone station hall along the ascending stairs.
messages.沿南廊向东穿过根须与苗床，直到蜂蜡暗屋。: Walk east along the south corridor through the roots and seed beds until you reach the Hidden Wax House.
messages.沿双层溢流庭探索沉渠。: Explore the sunken canal along the double overflow court
messages.沿双层环廊探索水窖。: Explore the water cellar along the double-layered corridor.
messages.沿可攀苔壁跳上竖井。: Jump onto the vertical shaft along the climbable moss wall.
messages.沿吊架蹬位攀上钟摆车间。: Climb to the Pendulum Workshop along the riser steps
messages.沿回廊横越钟庭上层。: Cross the upper level of the moss court along the corridor.
messages.沿垂藤逐级坠入井底。: Fall into the bottom of the shaft step by step along the hanging vines.
messages.沿封存书堆逐级下到东侧地面。: Descend level by level along the Sealed Stacks to the eastern ground.
messages.沿断弦辐桥向西，直通温室西门上层。: Walk west along the Broken-String Spoke Bridge, leading directly to the upper layer of the Greenhouse West Gate.
messages.沿断阶东行，寻找进入钟庭的路。: Move east along the broken steps, looking for the way into the moss court.
messages.沿暗河西行，寻找闸厅。: Move west along the dark river, looking for the sluice hall.
messages.沿暗渠西行到最深处。: Travel west along the dark canal to the deepest part
messages.沿树冠步道向西横越温室顶层。: Walk west along the crown walkway across the top layer of the greenhouse.
messages.沿水表回廊横越中庭上层。: Cross the gauge gallery along the water meter at the upper level of the atrium
messages.沿泄洪栈梯一路爬回泵房中庭。: Climb back to the pumphouse atrium along the flood ladder
messages.沿渡槽东行，读懂闸口的水位刻度。: Travel east along the aqueduct to read the water level scale at the sluice gate
messages.沿湿墙一路蹬墙攀上立管井。: Climb up the riser shaft along the wet wall
messages.沿白盐码头离开书库。: Leave the library along the White Salt Docks.
messages.沿盐门步道向西，直通中庭塔底。: Walk west along the Salt Gate Walk, directly to the bottom of the Atrium Booktower.
messages.沿盐门步道向西，直通中庭塔底。 可选：盐脊碎板井。: West along the Salt Gate Walk, leading directly to the courtyard tower bottom. Optional: Salt Ridge Split Well.
messages.沿西环廊爬回上层，穿过黑曜与盐白回声。: Climb back to the upper level along the West Ring Gallery, passing through the Obsidian and Saltwhite Echoes.
messages.沿西阶之字下到温室底层。: Descend along the zigzagging steps to the bottom layer of the greenhouse.
messages.沿钟冠向西横越，从裂缝一跃坠回钟庭。: Cross to the west along the bell crown, and jump back into the moss court from the crack.
messages.沿长廊向东，找到烛台夹层的登梯。: Walk east along the corridor, find the ladder to the Candlelit Mezzanine.
messages.沿雨渠进入旧铸坊，找到被水声藏起的铁匠印记，解锁墙面攀附与回声钩索。: Enter the old foundry along the rainwater channel, find the ironware marks hidden by the sound of water, and unlock the wall climbing and Echo Hook.
messages.泄洪梯打通后长期有效。: The flood ladder is valid for a long time after being opened
messages.注销归档（告别戏）；原位余一页盖了「齐」字的空白清单（纯场景）: Log out of the archive (farewell scene); leave a blank list with the character "Qi" at the end in the original position (pure scene).
messages.注销抵押清单，留下六城可自行签署的新页。: Voids the register of pledges and leaves a fresh page for the six cities to sign for themselves.
messages.泵又随钟开工了。我磨圆了徽章，没能磨掉传给后人的号。: The pumps are working to the bell again. I rounded the edge of the badge. I couldn't file away the number their children inherit.
messages.泵启动了，名册还是老编号。柳认得的名字，我会再写一遍。: The pump has started. The roll still uses the old numbers. I'll write down those names Liu remembers again.
messages.泵房上检修舱保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的声: Records preserved at the Maintenance Cabin on the Pump Room: The facility was maintained for residents, later converted to transport contracts, military orders, and voices that were erased.
messages.泵房上检修舱：操作能力闩后沿独立检修路线登上证物台，收取记录与物资。: Maintenance Cabin on the Pump Room: After operating the ability bolt, climb to the evidence platform along an independent maintenance route to collect records and items.
messages.泵房上检修舱：操作能力闩后沿独立检修路线登上证物台，收取记录与物资。 门外练针架: Maintenance Cabin on the Pump Room: After operating the ability bolt, climb to the evidence platform along an independent maintenance route to collect records and items. The needle practice rack outside provides special skill practice, not consuming permanent exploration abilities.
messages.泵王殿，左右各一组水阀，中间平台随水位上下浮动。: Pump King's Hall, with a pair of water valves on each side, the middle platform floats up and down with the water level.
messages.泵钟复响，旧誓仍在。我会给那些不能回答的人留一盏灯。: The pump bell rings again. The old oath holds. I'll leave a lamp for the ones who can't answer.
messages.活封面根脉与盐白书库偏旁拼出第七签署者名的一半。: Match the Living Bookcover Vein with the snippet of the Saltwhite Archive to form half of the seventh signer's name.
messages.活封面证词补全第七签署者名字第二段，黑曜巡礼道开放。: The living cover testimony completes the second paragraph of the seventh signer's name, and the Obsidian Pilgrim Road is open.
messages.活弦与点名册都被接进钟令：照看树木、悼念亡者的办法，被改成了持续征用。: The living strings and the roster are both connected to the bell order: the way to care for the trees and mourn the dead has been changed to continuous requisition.
messages.活弦重新接进钟令，苗床回温。园丁的歌只在心里唱，手上的活一刻不停。: The living strings are reconnected to the bell order, and the seedbed warms up again. The gardener's song is sung only in his heart, and his work never stops.
messages.测量水位变化，帮助判断管道路线。: Measure the water level changes to help determine the pipeline route
messages.消散；true_ending_branch 三句即告别戏，原位余一缕悬停的绯线（: Disappear; the true_ending_branch ends with three lines of farewell scene, leaving a thread of Crimson in the original position that cannot be picked up (pure scene).
messages.淤泥排压室保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的声音: Records preserved at the Silt Pressure Release Chamber: The facility was maintained for residents, later converted to transport contracts, military orders, and voices that were erased.
messages.淤泥排压室：操作能力闩后沿独立检修路线登上证物台，收取记录与物资。: Silt Pressure Release Chamber: After operating the ability bolt, climb to the evidence platform along an independent maintenance route to collect records and items.
messages.淤泥排压室：操作能力闩后沿独立检修路线登上证物台，收取记录与物资。 门外练针架提: Silt Pressure Release Chamber: After operating the ability bolt, climb to the evidence platform along an independent maintenance route to collect records and items. The needle practice rack outside provides special skill practice, not consuming permanent exploration abilities.
messages.添线的人，后来把谁也算了进去？: When someone added those lines, who else did they count in?
messages.清完苔钟庭三处敌群，打开后门捷径，击败苔钟守母。: Clear three enemy groups in the Moss Bell Court, open the back door shortcut, and defeat the Moss Bell Matriarch.
messages.清掉齿轮哨卫，登上殿前台地。: Clear the gear sentry and climb to the ground of the palace approach.
messages.清点守母守了一生的东西。: Count the things that the Matriarch has guarded all her life.
messages.清点守母守了一生的东西。 可选：无名钟契库。: Checking out what the mother has been holding for life.
messages.清理半钟平台的伏击。: Clear the ambush on the Half-Bell Platform.
messages.清理夹层的索引卫兵，向东接入中庭书塔。: Clear the index guards in the mezzanine and access the Atrium Booktower east.
messages.清理钩环回廊的伏击，再从西沿坠回阀顶眺台。: Clear the ambush in the hook ring gallery and then fall back to the Valve Lookout along the west side
messages.清理阅览廊，尽头有人影在暗阁上方晃动。: Clear the reading corridor, and there is a shadow moving above the hidden niche at the end.
messages.清理阅览廊，尽头有人影在暗阁上方晃动。 可选：运书吊篮仓。: Clean the reading corridor, with shadows moving above the dark pavilion at the end. Optional: Book Transport Basket Storage.
messages.清理雨渠回声，取回第二枚印记的证词。: Clean up the Rain Canal Echoes and retrieve the testimony of the second mark.
messages.清理黑曜回声，取回第五枚印记的证词。: Clean up the Obsidian Echoes and retrieve the testimony of the fifth mark.
messages.渠影残迹 · 愿板侧: Channelshade tracks · Side of the prayer board
messages.渠影首清：取得渠影爪痕证据，并得额外碎钱与湿锈甲片。图样可带给雨铸匠制作「逆潮线: First clear of the channelshade: Obtain channelshade claw evidence and get extra coins and wet rust armor pieces. The pattern can be given to the Rain Foundry Smith to make the Countertide Spool. The evidence will not be taken away
messages.渡槽下的苔灯: The moss lamp under the aqueduct
messages.渡槽夹层——不下雨的房间。: Aqueduct mezzanine - the room where it doesn't rain
messages.温室前厅、弦桥苗圃、蜂蜡小屋等区域: Greenhouse Foyer, String Bridge Nursery, Beeswax Cottage, and other areas
messages.温室前厅的老园丁，曾修剪活封面和守门者根系。: The old gardener in the Greenhouse vestibule once pruned living book covers and the roots of the Gatewardens.
messages.温室根须影管需要灯影相位；黑曜巡礼路与温室可按不同顺序探索。: The Greenhouse Root Filament Pipe requires the Lantern Phase; the Obsidian Pilgrim Road and the Greenhouse can be explored in different orders.
messages.温室的西门有了灯，你往回走时也能辨认落脚台。: There's light at the Greenhouse's west gate. You'll be able to see the landing on your way back.
messages.温室的证词让这一区别更清楚了。: The greenhouse testimony makes the distinction clearer.
messages.湛在工牌背面留手痕，就是不愿让这些事全部磨成一个数。: Zhan left the marks of his hands on the backs of the badges because he wouldn't have it all worn down to a number.
messages.湛沉在井底。有人借他的工坊发号施令，久了，连来修东西的人都把他们叫成一个。: Zhan lies at the bottom of the well. Someone issued orders in his workshop's name. In time, even the people coming in for repairs called them one and the same.
messages.湿墙试炼间守卫身后；解锁蹬墙跳与全部湿墙门。: Behind the guard of the Wetwall Trial, unlock the wall-climbing jump and all Wetwall doors.
messages.湿苔打滑，坠口无回头路。: Wet moss is slippery; there is no way back at the fall entrance.
messages.湿铜上的名字还能看清。你读一遍，我点一次头，我们把这班人点齐。: The names are still legible on the wet copper. You read, I'll nod. Let's call the whole shift in by name.
messages.满足真结局证词才开放绯线改写阶段。: Only when the true ending testimony is met can the Crimson Thread rewrite stage be opened.
messages.潮影检修室保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的声音: Records preserved at the Shadow Maintenance Room: The facility was maintained for residents, later converted to transport contracts, military orders, and voices that were erased.
messages.潮影检修室：完成能力动作后穿过专属立体检修路线，收回两件物资并安全退出。: Shadow Maintenance Room: After completing the ability action, follow the exclusive maintenance route to retrieve two items and exit safely.
messages.潮湿铜墙可短暂停留，攀附超过一秒会滑落。: The damp copper wall can be briefly stayed on, but staying on for more than one second will cause slipping.
messages.潮要来了，温室先搬人还是搬苗？: The tide is coming. Will the Greenhouse move people or seedlings first?
messages.灌满水的青铜档案舱: Filled with water, the bronze archive chamber
messages.灯亮时穿门，灯灭时别把自己留在石头里。: When the light is on, pass through the door; when the light is off, do not stay in the stone.
messages.灯亮时若还困，就再睡。我会先去看看路，不会掀你被子。: If you're still sleepy when the lamp goes on, sleep some more. I'll look at the road first. I won't pull off your blanket.
messages.灯亮穿门，灯灭等；军阵旗帜指向冲锋路线。: The light passes through the gate, the light goes out, etc.; the military formation's flag points to the charge route.
messages.灯号又接回召兵钟。安稳回来了，旧命令也跟着回来了。: The lights are tied to the muster bell again. The old order came back with the peace.
messages.灯号只通知愿意轮值的人。没有签名的名字，不再被灯召走。: The signals go only to volunteers for the watch. A lamp can't summon anyone who hasn't signed.
messages.灯号没看见的人，你会去找吗？: If someone misses the signal, will you look for them?
messages.灯塔上层藏着灯影相位，取得后能穿过暗封。镜池预警出现时先记住地面，不只盯着她。: Lanternshadow Passage is hidden in the upper tower. Use it to cross the dark seals. When Mirrorpool gives warning, remember what the ground looks like. Don't fix your eyes on her alone.
messages.灯影修女怕把引路误成召集。找到军册或证词，取得灯影穿行，再回来与她校正信号。: The Sister of the Shadow fears that she will be mistakenly convoked. Find a military book or testimony, get the light through and come back to correct her signal.
messages.灯影修女教学后首通。: The first one to pass after learning from the Lantern Sister.
messages.灯影的信号已接好。灯明是安全层，灯暗时停在石阶上，不必追着队伍跑。: The lantern signals are linked. When the light is on, that level is safe. When it goes out, wait on the stone steps. You don't have to chase the column.
messages.灯影相位不是隐身，是向命令请半秒假。: Lantern Phase is not invisibility; it gives a half-second pause to obey the command.
messages.灯影相位练习工房保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去: Records preserved at the Lantern Phase Practice Workshop: The facility was maintained for residents, later converted to transport contracts, military orders, and voices that were erased.
messages.灯影穿行能越过影门，却不能替人拒绝军令。去找修女，让她确认信号。: Lanternshadow Passage will get you through a shadow gate. It can't turn down a muster order for anyone. Find the sister and have her check the signals.
messages.灯影能带你过封路的暗层。先看好出口，别在灯快灭时才问自己要去哪儿。: Lanternshadow will take you through the dark layer across the road. Find the exit before you go in. Don't wait for the lamp to flicker to ask where you're headed.
messages.灯恢复了，目录却仍拿后嗣抵押。保存原件，至少还能证明它被改过。: The lamps work again, but the catalogue still takes our children as collateral. Keeping the original will at least prove someone altered it.
messages.灯是让人看见路；有人不走这条路，灯也不该追着他。: A lamp is there to show a road. If someone takes another road, it shouldn't chase after them.
messages.灯照亮归途，为什么也会召兵？: How can a light on the way home also muster soldiers?
messages.灯现在要照着哪里撤离？: Where should the lamps point people fleeing now?
messages.灯的位置和明灭能被读成号。有人需要方向，有人却拿相同的光催人归队。: Where a lamp hangs and how it flashes can be read as a call. One person needs directions. Another uses the same light to hurry people back to the ranks.
messages.灯路先改作撤离线。能开口以后，更要把警报送到每个人面前。: We'll make the lantern road an evacuation route first. Now we can speak, we must make sure the warning reaches everyone.
messages.灰冠停下了，原页没有跟着变成他的遗物。: The Ash Crown has fallen. That doesn't make the original page his relic.
messages.灰冠战台1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Ash Crown Arena 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.

messages.灰冠的刀停了，档案却不能封箱。现在才轮到我们说为什么有人拔刀。: The Ash Crown's blade has stopped. The records can't go into storage yet. Now we must say what made anyone draw a blade.
messages.灰冠螳将不再巡看，我可以把两本书摊在一起。: Now the Ash-Crowned Mantis Warlord no longer patrols here, I can open both books side by side.
messages.灰冠螳将不是目录里的怪物。他守的是删改过的命令，我替他抄过。: The Ash-Crowned Mantis Warlord was never the monster in the catalogue. He guards an altered order. I copied it out for him.
messages.灰冠螳将倒下以后，我先给这些空处留了查找标记。: Once the Ash-Crowned Mantis Warlord fell, I put markers against those gaps so people could find them.
messages.灰冠螳将倒下后，原页仍得有人保管。倒下一位总官不会让被改过的副本自动变回去。: Even after the Ash-Crowned Mantis Warlord falls, someone has to keep the original. Defeating a High Registrar won't restore every altered copy.
messages.灰冠螳将倒下，也没有把这种决定交给我。: The Warlord's fall didn't leave that decision to me either.
messages.灰冠螳将停了，书库还需要有人来查。: The Warlord has stopped. The Archive still needs people to come and check.
messages.灰冠螳将战败后，契约原本显出一句话：六枚印记曾是六个守门者的心脏。: After the Ash-Crowned Mantis Warlord was defeated, the original covenant revealed a sentence: The six marks were once the hearts of six gatewards.
messages.灰冠螳将掉落的章节奖励。: The chapter rewards dropped by the Ash-Crowned Mantis Warlord
messages.灰冠螳将的门开了，我会把开过哪些匣记在外面。: The Warlord's gate is open. I'll mark on the outside which cases we've opened.
messages.灰旗残迹 · 营地: Clear the first ash flag: Obtain evidence of the ash flag's traces and receive additional coins and obsidian fragments. The pattern can be given to the Threadweaver's Apprentice to make the "Ash Banner Needle Ring"; the evidence will not be taken away.
messages.灰旗追踪: Ash Pit prey's ash flag traces. It does not interrupt the main storyline, but it can prove that you have sounded the tomb's remaining bell by following the trace.
messages.灰旗首清：取得灰旗爪痕证据，并得额外碎钱与黑曜碎片。图样可带给织线学徒制作「灰旗: The pattern can be given to the Threadweaver's Apprentice to make the "Ash Banner Needle Ring"; the evidence will not be taken away.
