messages.灰钉阵: The charred flag fragments drift towards Pilgrim Camp.
messages.灾后生活需要具体维护，不靠战绩自动恢复。: After disaster, everyday life takes actual repairs. Victory alone can't restore it.
messages.炉前不再响那把剪子了。把闸开小些吧，城该慢慢醒，不能再被冲醒。: No more shears ringing by the furnace. Open the sluice a little at a time. Let the city wake gently this once.
messages.炉底铸渣滑道口，单向坠向 ch5 巡礼路中段；对端建成前保持封存。: The slag exit at the furnace floor, one-way descent to the middle of the ch5 pilgrimage path; remain sealed until construction is completed at the opposite end.
messages.炉渣余温未散。: The remaining heat of the slag has not dissipated.
messages.点亮入渠后的第一座钟龛。: Light up the first bell shrine after entering the canal.
messages.点亮殿前苔灯，再沿下层进入锈冠殿。: Light the Palace Approach Moss Lamp, then enter the Rustcrown Hall along the lower level.
messages.点亮炉前苔灯，准备面对执剪者。: Light up the furnace moss lamp, ready to face the Crimson Thread Scissor Apostle.
messages.点亮第一座苔灯钟龛。: Light the first moss lamp niche.
messages.点亮第一座苔灯钟龛。 可选：排水计时闸。: Light up the first moss Bell shrine niche. Optional: Drain Time Gate.
messages.点名声又响起来，应答的仍然只有铃。灯排得很齐，像在等一支还没回来的队伍。: The roll of names sounds again, and the only response is the bell. The lamps are arranged neatly, as if waiting for a team that has not yet arrived.
messages.点名时有人应“在”，也有人应“这一轮我不守”，没人拦他。灯照常亮，名单照常往下念: During the roll call, some respond with "present," while others say "I won't guard this round." No one stops them. The lamps remain lit, and the list continues to be read.
messages.点名轮上的木条为什么能拆？: Why can the slats on the muster wheel be removed?
messages.点名轮上被钉回的木条，我已经见得太多。: I've seen too many slats nailed back into that wheel.
messages.点名轮上钉回的木条提醒我，替人站在同一面旗后面有多容易。: The slats nailed back onto the muster wheel remind me how easily we can put people under one banner for them.
messages.点名轮会把离开又回来的人当成同一个兵额，人却未必还愿意站在原槽里。: The roll-call wheel puts someone who returns into the same soldier's slot. The person who comes back may no longer want to stand in it.
messages.点名轮可以记下谁愿意值夜，不必再把拿下的木条钉回去。: The roll-call wheel could record who wants the night watch. No need to nail back a slat someone's taken off.
messages.点名轮和名册让我知道，不能只说灯亮着就是好事。: Seeing the wheel and the muster roll taught me a lit lamp isn't a good thing in itself.
messages.点名轮已经让太多人只剩一个必须到场的空位。: The muster wheel has already reduced too many people to a vacancy they had to show up to fill.
messages.点名轮把木条钉死，我不想换个人替我挑一个槽。: The wheel nailed its slats down. I don't need someone else choosing a new slot for me.
messages.点名轮把离开的人算成缺额，路才变得只许向前。: It was the wheel counting everyone who left as a vacancy that made the road one-way.
messages.点名轮把许多人留在那种赶路里，我不想也这样带你。: The roll-call wheel kept so many people hurrying like that. I don't want to lead you the same way.
messages.点名轮教我，若先照着一张表，可能就又忘了表外的人。: The muster wheel taught me that if you start by lighting up the roster, you may forget everyone outside it again.
messages.点名轮的旧槽本来留得下空位；钉死木条以后，路就不再容人缺席。: The old grooves in the muster wheel allowed gaps. Once the slats were nailed fast, the road had no room for anyone to be missing.
messages.点名轮的旧钉孔会提醒我，不要又把疏散的人排成不能离开的队。: Those old nail holes in the roll-call wheel remind me never to line up the people fleeing in ranks they can't leave.
messages.点名轮的木条不会因为钟声好听，就忽然不再被钉住。: The slats on the roll-call wheel don't shed their nails just because the bell sounds sweet.
messages.点名轮的钉孔把这件事留得很清楚：光后面也可能牵着一张表。: The nail holes in the wheel tell that story clearly. A roster can be hidden behind a light.
messages.点名轮证明，同一个名字被重新钉上，就会又成一个兵额。: The muster wheel shows what happens when you nail a name back into place. It becomes an army vacancy again.
messages.烛台夹层的旧签署者线轴。单跳阶梯可达，取得后回访苔钟庭盐风门。: Old Signatories' Spins in the Candlelit Mezzanine. A single jump ladder is available, and after obtaining it, return to the Moss Bell Court Salt Wind Gate.
messages.烧掉复活旗得到的材料，可换护符拒令灰。: Materials obtained by burning the resurrection flag can be exchanged for a talisman to resist the Ashes of Refusal.
messages.焦黑旗屑往巡礼营地飘去。: The crucifix headed for the tour camp.
messages.照料不应把生命缩成照料者的计划。: Care shouldn't reduce a living thing to its keeper's plan.
messages.照料的人若只问树有没有照着长，不再问它还能往哪里长，就很容易这样。: It happens easily if the gardener asks only whether the tree grew as planned, and never asks where else it might grow.
messages.照料的办法为什么会变成束缚？: How does care become a restraint?
messages.照看一株树的人，也可能害怕树发出他不熟悉的声音。: Even someone who tends a tree can be frightened when it makes an unfamiliar sound.
messages.照看三岔泵井的修女商人，收集防潮线结和旧工匠祷文。: A sister and merchant who tends the three-way pump well. Collects damp-proof knots and old workers' prayers.
messages.熟练动作可以被承认，未知来历不必被虚构。: I can acknowledge a practised movement without inventing a teacher for it.
messages.爪痕沉向树心下的根库。: Claw marks sink towards the Root Vault below the heart of the tree.
messages.爪痕沉向档案舱深处。: Scars sink deep into the archive chamber.
messages.爪痕沉向缆井底的灰烬坑。: The claw marks sink into the ash pit at the bottom of the cable well.
messages.爬行近战，配移动平台考验站位。: Crawling close combat, paired with a mobile platform to test positioning.
messages.爹最嫌刮脖子。柳叔知道，你可以问他。: Dad hated anything scratching his neck. Uncle Liu knows. You can ask him.
messages.爹这枚我想多看一眼。看完给你，你要拿给真的肯翻页的人。: Let me look at Dad's a little longer. Then it's yours. Take it to someone who'll actually turn the pages.
messages.物件可以保留，代表权却需要重新取得。: I can keep an object. I would need fresh consent to represent anyone with it.
messages.牵住吊龛铜环，松开上方封匣。: Hold the hanging chamber copper ring and release the seal above.
messages.状态已变化，请重新核对后再次确认。\n: Things have changed. Check the details before confirming again.
messages.王冠倒下后，你能保留镇潮设施，把世袭条款改回可退出的自愿契约。: Once the Crown falls, you can keep the tideworks and change that hereditary clause back to an agreement that people may enter or leave.
messages.王冠共鸣可改写一扇钟门状态，优先处理回声锁。: Crown Resonance can rewrite the state of one bell gate, prioritizing the echo lock.
messages.王冠共鸣才能取到的可选探索奖励。: Optional exploration rewards that can be obtained through Crown Resonance ability.
messages.王冠共鸣练习工房保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去: Work records saved in the Practice Room for Crown Resonance: The facility was maintained by residents, but later became a place for transporting contracts, military orders, and erased voices.
messages.王冠共鸣练习工房：完成能力动作后穿过专属立体检修路线，收回两件物资并安全退出。: Practice Room for Crown Resonance: After completing an ability action, walk through a dedicated repair route to retrieve two items and exit safely.
messages.王冠前厅（冠肋攀回）: Crown Foyer (climb back along the Crown Ribs).
messages.王冠吃掉声音，我吃掉沉默。你觉得谁更像怪物？: The crown eats up sound, I eat up silence. Who do you think is more like a monster?
messages.王冠命令玩家重鸣，场地出现可用 crown_resonance 改写的三扇门。: The crown commands the player to retoll, and three gates that can be rewritten with crown resonance appear in the venue.
messages.王冠回声守卫碎片: Fragments of the Guard of the Crown Echoes.
messages.王冠回应我的时候，我差点以为它在叫我。: When the Crown answered, I nearly thought it was calling me by name.
messages.王冠在上面安静地守着，像从来没有人来过。黑潮在井下，名字在钟里。: The crown stands quietly above, as if no one has ever come here. The black tide is beneath the ground, and the names are in the bell.
messages.王冠复刻苔钟庭教学，证明回声室会读取记忆。: The crown re-creates the Moss Bell Court, proving that the echo chamber will read memories.
messages.王冠将契约的自愿改为世袭，书库删去反对者姓名，雨铸工牌与巡礼军令延续这一篡改。: The crown changes the voluntary from the contract to hereditary, the library removes the names of those who oppose, and the rain-cast work badges and the pilgrimage military order continue this alteration.
messages.王冠已经停下。回看亲手取得的证词，决定六城今后如何守潮、谁有权拒绝。: The Crown has fallen silent. Read the testimony you collected and decide how the six cities will keep watch and who has the right to refuse.
messages.王冠把自愿改成世袭后，后人的声音成了抵押物。你要查清这一步，不只是敲碎眼前的冠。: When the Crown changed a voluntary pledge into a hereditary duty, it took the voices of the unborn as collateral. Find out how it came to that. Shattering the Crown before you won't tell you.
messages.王冠是一口倒扣巨钟。: The crown is a collapsed giant bell.
messages.王冠核心的锁门告解: The lock door confession of the crown core
messages.王冠核心，中央钟舌、两侧黑潮井、上方五枚印记环。: The crown core, the central tongue, the black tide wells on both sides, and the five marks above.
messages.王冠监察相位能力的黑影。: Shadows of the Black Shadow Phase ability of the Crown's monitoring phase.
messages.王冠种子库1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Crown Seed Vault 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.

messages.王冠种子库6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Crown Seed Vault 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.王冠空在身后。没人戴上它，潮也没有因此消失。远处有人喊绳子不够长，你解开行囊上的: The Crown lies empty behind you. No one puts it on. The tide doesn't vanish. In the distance someone calls that the rope won't reach. You untie the spare from your pack and head toward them.
messages.王冠空着，没有人去捡。裂缝里的潮声很近，六城得自己想办法挡住它。: The crown is empty, and no one comes to pick it up. The sound of the tide in the cracks is very close, and the six cities must find a way to block it.
messages.王冠章节敌人掉落的材料。: Materials dropped by enemies in the Crown chapter.
messages.王冠第一次被称作一口倒扣在城市上的钟。: The crown was first called a bell that fell into the city.
messages.王冠要的不是服从，是每个人自愿忘记自己曾经答应过什么。: What the crown does not want is obedience. It wants everyone to voluntarily forget what they once promised.
messages.王冠门体倒下后，也不要急着选一句最方便的话盖过别的。: Even after the Crown gate falls, don't hurry to cover every account with whichever line is most convenient.
messages.王冠门体倒下后，选择怎样留下后果，仍可以回到那些地方核对。: After the Crown gate falls, you can revisit those places and see what your decision has left there.
messages.王冠门体已开，仍要实际持有全部原始证词，才能核对改写那条路。: The Crown gate may be open. To examine the way of the Rewrite, you still need all six original accounts in hand.

messages.王座门前的检查点，死亡回跑很短。: Checkpoint in front of the Throne Gate, short death run back.

messages.王都外环桥: The Outer Bridge of the Royal Capital
messages.王都外环桥高危支线奖励。: High-risk side rewards of the Outer Bridge of the Royal Capital
messages.玩家发现盐晶会复写最近一次动作，迟影机关让书库像在模仿活人。: Players discover that salt crystals can copy the most recent action, and the late shadow mechanism makes the library seem like it's imitating living people.
messages.玩家发现黑曜巡礼军并非怪物，而是前几代失败巡礼者被王冠重新编队。: Players discover that the Obsidian Pilgrim Army is not monsters, but former failed pilgrims reorganized by the Crown.
messages.玩家在三岔泵井发现铁匠印记不是失踪，而是自愿沉在井底，防止黑潮沿水声回流。: Players find that the iron mark in the three-way pump well is not missing, but voluntarily sinking to the bottom of the well to prevent the black tide from flowing back along the water sound.
messages.玩家学习弦桥和花粉风节奏，发现温室会根据声音移动房间。: Players learn the rhythm of the string bridge and pollen wind, discovering that the greenhouse will move the room according to sound.
messages.玩家镜像精英，测试全能力组合。: Player mirror elites, testing the full ability combination.
messages.环庭悬廊: The hanging corridor of the courtyard
messages.环廊内侧就是核心竖井。: The Core Shaft is inside the ring corridor.
messages.环廊湿苔板上有一段颜色发暗，踩上去发空。: There is a dark-colored patch on the mossy wall of the corridor; stepping on it feels empty.
messages.环门打开后，这里直通前厅。: Once the gate is opened, it leads directly to the foyer.
messages.现在想起来，他没来骂我，我竟以为他不累。: They didn't come to scold me. To think I took that to mean they weren't tired.
messages.现在我先把两边的落脚处说清。你选哪边，我送到能自己走的地方。: These days I'll describe both landings first. Whichever you choose, I'll go with you until you can manage on your own.
messages.现在我请你去，不能再拿修园当先后。先学会棘丝下劈，再和他确认解缚和退路；底下枝台: I'm asking you to go now. I can't keep putting the garden first. Learn the Thornthread Downcut, then make sure they're ready and you both know the way out. There's a branch ledge below.
messages.现在有了退路，我最先做的还是坐一会儿。: Now I have a way out. The first thing I still want to do is sit a while.
messages.现在没人催我报数，我反倒一时不知道从谁念起。: No one's pressing me for a count now. Funny, I don't know whose name to read first.
messages.现在能从守母那边绕回来了，我得重新量，不能在旧图上随便添一笔。: Now there's a way back by the Matriarch, I have to measure it again. I can't just draw another line on the old map.
messages.现在能慢慢修了，我反倒想把报酬算得更清楚。: Now there's time to mend things properly, I'd rather be clearer about what I owe you.
messages.现在能自己喊疼，也得和大家一起加固西门。自由没有替我们挡住潮水。: I can cry out when it hurts now. I've got to help shore up the west gate too. Freedom hasn't stopped the tide.
messages.现在能说话了，第一件衣服缝给谁？: Now that everyone can speak, whom will you sew for first?
messages.现在认清了召集线，我能把军令合起来，先去营地。: Now I recognize the recall thread. I can fold away the order and go to camp first.
messages.现在轮到我等你的回答，才知道那两个字有多重。你不说，我就停笔。: Now it's my turn to wait for your answer. I know how heavy those words are. If you don't speak, my pen will stop.
messages.现在锤落下也不会替守母完成旧礼。我得重新问谁愿意接班。: Now a hammer blow can't complete the old rite on the Matriarch's behalf. I'll have to ask again who wants the watch.
messages.玻璃穹顶漏下的光会指路。: The light leaking from the glass dome will guide you.
messages.玻璃穹顶漏下的光会指路。 可选旧路：「藤架铜环索道」。瞄准上方铜环施展钩索，牵开: The light coming through the glass dome can guide you. Alternative path: "Cork Cable Ladder". Aim at the upper copper ring and use the hook rope to open the cable latch.
messages.理解人物的困局，同时保留其责任。: I can understand a person's predicament without setting their responsibility aside.
messages.生产记录需要保留人的缺席和原因。: The works ledger should record when someone is missing and why.
messages.生意最好的时候，没人赶着走。那会儿我多送半勺蜂蜜，不催人付款。: Business was at its best when no one was in a hurry to leave. I'd give them another half spoonful of honey and forget to ask for the money just yet.
messages.用下劈棘球反弹到高层。: Use the spiky ball bounce to reach the higher levels.
messages.用丝壁攀附上行，打开中段捷径。: Use the Silk Wall to climb up and open the middle shortcut.
messages.用回声钩索越过断桥。: Cross the broken bridge with the Echo Hook.
messages.用灯影相位拨开下层闩门，沿两级检修台登上灯廊，取回旧操作手册与物资。: Use Lantern Phase to open the lower latch, then climb up the two-story maintenance platform to retrieve the old maintenance manual and items.
messages.用王冠共鸣重接旧契约闩，再沿错层档案台登上记录层；落回底道可返回入口。: Use Crown Resonance to reattach the old contract latch, then climb up the layered archive platform to reach the recording level; returning down the bottom path allows you to return to the entrance.
messages.用相位打开 Boss 前大捷径。: Use the phase to open a shortcut before the Boss.
messages.用绯线冲刺穿钟隙，落钟前会有锈色闪光。: Use the Crimson Dash to pass through the bell gap, and there will be a rusty flash before falling the bell.
messages.用观武录赎罪；守母倒下之日笔记作废，转赴黑曜路改记名字。: Makes amends by keeping combat notes. When the Matriarch falls, the scout plans to leave the notebook behind and record names on the Obsidian Road.
messages.用诱铃引开走动的敌人: Use the Echo Lure Bell to distract moving enemies.
messages.用钟壳格挡打开重门。: Use bellshell guard to open the heavy door.
messages.用钟壳脉冲拨开封蜡闩，再沿分层证物柜登高；落回底部便可返程。: Use the Bell Shell Pulse to open the wax latch, then climb up the layered storage cabinet; returning down to the bottom allows you to return to the entrance.
messages.用钟壳脉冲拨开练习闩，再沿两层高柜登上证物台；落回底道返回入口。: Use the Bell Shell Pulse to open the practice latch, then climb up the two-story high cabinet to reach the storage platform; returning down the bottom path allows you to return to the entrance. Salt Snare: The number of threads is limited; recording consumes salt records, extending this control. Practice Salt Snare.
messages.用钟壳脉冲拨开练习闩，再沿两层高柜登上证物台；落回底道返回入口。 盐印缚线：线阵: Use the shell pulse to open the drill stubble and then board the evidence counter along two high-story cabinets; fall back to the bottom lane and return to the entrance.
messages.画图的人站在哪里，中心常常就落在哪里。印得久了，人会忘记那是画法。: The centre often falls wherever the mapmaker stood. Print it long enough and people forget that's just one way to draw it.
messages.留50像素起跳缝，让84像素高的巡礼者沿烛台阶梯登上夹层。: Leave a 50-pixel gap to jump, allowing the 84-pixel-high Pilgrim to climb up the interlayer steps.
messages.留下原页的素，和契约总官是什么关系？: What was Su, who saved the original page, to the High Registrar?
messages.留下来、离开过，都算这个人的事。不是哪一栏空了，就能把他从头删掉。: Staying and leaving are both part of someone's life. An empty column doesn't give anyone the right to erase them from the beginning.
messages.留下的回声只能告诉你曾有人走过。脚落在哪里，还得由现在站着的人确认。: An echo can tell you someone once passed this way. The person standing here now must find where to put their foot.
messages.留下真名会让人更容易被找到吗？: Will leaving a true name make it easier for someone to be found?
messages.留恋一个地方不等于同意继续受困。: I can love a place without consenting to stay trapped in it.
messages.留意落点和前方敌人。: Pay attention to the landing point and the enemies ahead.
messages.登上升殿，走进你选定的结局门。: Ascend to the upper hall and enter the ending door of your choice.
messages.登上穹顶前廊直达裂纹穹顶，死亡回跑很短。: Climb to the Dome Approach to reach the Cracked Dome. It's short to run back if you die.
messages.登记里没有，是否就是从未有人在这里活过？: If the register is blank, does it mean no one ever lived here?
messages.登顶钟塔，俯瞰整座苔钟庭。: Climb to the top of the bell tower and overlook the entire moss bell court.
messages.登顶钟塔，俯瞰整座苔钟庭。 可选：钟冠双线仓。: Reach the top of the bell tower and overlook the entire Moss Bell Court. Optional: Bell Crown Dual Line Storage.
messages.白书脊回廊的封蜡档案员，半商人半守门者。: Part merchant and part gatekeeper, the archivist tends the wax seals in the White Bookspine Gallery.
messages.白冠观象台1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: White Crown Observatory 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.白冠观象台2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: White Crown Observatory 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.

messages.白弦可站，黑弦会在踩下后断开。: White strings can be stood on, while black strings will break when stepped on.
messages.白纱上有名字，为什么军册上只剩号？: There are names on the white veil. Why only numbers on the muster roll?
messages.白纱上的名字是军令吗？: Are the names on the white veil a military order?
messages.白色封蜡门会响应铁匠誓牌，靠近后按交互确认。: The white sealing wax door will respond to the Smith's Oath Plate. Press interact to confirm when approaching.
messages.白边在纸上，为什么你先看我的手？: The pale edge is on the page. Why look at my hand first?
messages.百钥守门人倒下，只把眼前的选择交到你这里。: The Hundred-Key Gatekeeper's fall only put the choice before you.
messages.百钥守门人停止吞咽名字，三道结局门在第七根绯线上同时亮起。: The Hundred-Key Gatekeeper stops swallowing names, and three ending doors light up on the seventh Crimson thread at the same time.
messages.百钥守门人已经停了，你不必把我的脚步当作接下来的鼓点。: The Hundred-Key Gatekeeper has stopped. My footsteps needn't become the drumbeat for what you do next.
messages.百钥守门人掉落的章节奖励。: Chapter rewards dropped by the Hundred-Key Gatekeeper.
messages.百钥守门人的门体已经打开，线路却仍留在这里。: The Hundred-Key Gatekeeper's gate has opened. The lines are still here.
messages.百钥的壳碎了，你却没有立刻伸手。我想这就是我们之间最重要的不同。: The Hundred-Key Gatekeeper's shell broke and you didn't reach out at once. That may be the most important difference between us.
messages.盐晶坠落会把玩家击回塔底。: The falling salt crystal will knock players back to the bottom of the tower.
messages.盐晶尖刺会慢速生长，停留越久通路越窄。: The salt crystal thorns will grow slowly, and the longer they stay, the narrower the passage becomes.
messages.盐晶门厅、反页阅览层、静音阅览井等区域: Salt Crystal Foyer, Reverse Page Reading Floor, Silent Reading Well, and other areas
messages.盐晶门厅先辨认书脊长廊与低台阶，管理员身旁不进入交战: At the Salt Crystal Foyer, find the spine gallery and the low steps. The space beside the keeper is safe.
messages.盐桥尽头先看到下落书架，坠入滑页井时跟随落脚高度: Look for the falling bookshelf at the end of the salt bridge. Watch for your landing as you drop into the sliding-page shaft.
messages.盐洼回路通往印契厅下方，柜后的支路有遗物。战斗前看清落脚处，别把盐坑当书页。: The salt hollow loops beneath the covenant hall. There's a relic down the side path behind the cabinet. Check your footing before a fight. A salt pit isn't a page you can turn.
messages.盐白书库保存着第一份契约，可他们说纸早就结晶了。: The Saltwhite Archive preserves the first contract. They say paper has already crystallized.
messages.盐白书库的改字原文: The original text of the Saltwhite Archive's changes
messages.盐白书库闭环完成：NPC、清怪、Boss门、灰冠螳将和章节奖励均已验证。: Saltwhite Archive complete. NPC encounters, enemies, boss gate, Warlord trial and chapter reward verified.
messages.盐白契约删掉第七签署者。: The Saltwhite Contract removes the seventh signatory.
messages.盐白契约官战败后，契约原本显出一句话：六枚印记曾是六个守门者的心脏。: When the Saltwhite Covenant Officer falls, a line appears in the original covenant: the six marks were once the hearts of six Gatewardens.
messages.盐白档案馆 自动生成灰盒: Saltwhite Archive Automatically Generates Ash Box
messages.盐白档案馆 自动生成灰盒：自动生成灰盒入口。: Saltwhite Archive Automatically Generates Ash Box: Automatically generates an entrance to the ash box.
messages.盐白沉睡钟已经苏醒，回程通路永久接通。: The Saltwhite Sleeping Bell has awakened, and the return path is permanently connected.
messages.盐白章节敌人掉落的材料。: Materials dropped by the enemies of the Saltwhite chapter
messages.盐脊碎板井保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的声音: Work records saved in the Salt Ridge Broken Plank Well: The facility was maintained by residents, but later became a place for transporting contracts, military orders, and erased voices.
messages.盐脊碎板井：完成能力动作后穿过专属立体检修路线，收回两件物资并安全退出。: Salt Ridge Broken Plank Well: After completing an ability action, walk through a dedicated repair route to retrieve two items and exit safely.
messages.盐门步道 / 契约索道厅: Salt Gate Walk / Covenant Cableway Hall
messages.盐门阅览阶1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Salt Gate Reading Steps 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.盐门阅览阶2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Salt Gate Reading Steps 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.盐门阅览阶3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Salt Gate Reading Steps 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.盐门阅览阶4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Salt Gate Reading Steps 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.盐门阅览阶5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Salt Gate Reading Steps 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.盐门阅览阶6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Salt Gate Reading Steps 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.盐门阅览阶7：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Salt Gate Reading Steps 7. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.盐页管理员叶: Ye, Keeper of the Salt Pages
messages.盐风中保存的反证：第七个名字不是缺席，而是被从契约中抹掉。: Evidence preserved in the Salt Wind: The seventh name is not absent, but has been erased from the contract.
messages.盐风能力门后的回访证词；右侧归庭索道永久接回入口。: Testimony of the Return behind the Salt Wind ability door; the right-side return path is permanently connected to the entrance.
messages.目录不再勒住喉咙。我先抄一份防潮告示，签谁的名字，由谁自己决定。: The catalogue's grip on our throats has loosened. I'll start by copying out a flood notice. Each person can decide whether to put their name to it.
messages.盲钟骑士保留一小半自我，告诉主角每次重鸣失败都会多一支沉默小队。: The Blind Bell Knight retains a small portion of himself and tells the protagonist that every failure in Retolling will result in an additional Silent Squad.
messages.盲钟骑士守着营火，听他讲完再走。: The Blind Bell Knight guards the campfire, listening to his story before leaving.
messages.盲钟骑士愿意让钟声恢复秩序，但担心自己再次失去自我。: The Blind Bell Knight is willing to restore order with the bell, but is worried about losing himself again.
messages.相位审查者守着转角。: The Phase Examiner guards the corner.
messages.相位耗能，能量空会跌出影门。: Phase consumes energy, and the energy will drop out of the shadow gate if empty.
messages.相位躲军令横扫，二阶段看旗帜方向判断军阵。: Phase dodges the Military Order Sweep, and the second phase judges the military formation by looking at the direction of the flag.
messages.相位躲军阵，Boss 前终考。: Phase away from the military formation, final test before the boss.
messages.相连的线路也可能承担不同的意志。: Even connected lines can serve different wills.
messages.盾卫守在东端，进入吊运口附近可先停下。: The shield guards are at the east end; you can stop near the lifting entrance.
messages.看不见以后，我开始听那些以前不算作战报的声音：喘气、犹豫，还有放下武器。: When I lost my sight, I began to hear what no one used to put in a battle report. Breath. Hesitation. A weapon set down.
messages.看到反插的旗，请替它扶正。旗正了，迷路的人才能知道那里有人等过。: If a flag was planted upside down, turn it upright for me. Then lost travellers can see someone waited there.
messages.看完两栏再落针。落了，也别把另一栏撕掉。: Read both before you put your needle down. Once you've chosen, don't tear the other column off.
messages.看得更远与看得更准，是两件要分别练的事。: Seeing farther and seeing clearly take different kinds of practice.
messages.看潮往哪里逼，再把光留给能落脚的路。灯不召兵以后，仍然要有人看懂它。: See where the tide is pressing in. Leave the light on a road where people can find their footing. Even when a lamp no longer calls up soldiers, someone still has to read it.
messages.看见黑曜路的旧军旗时，替我问一声：那些名字还有没有被记着。: If you see the old banners on the Obsidian Road, ask for me whether anyone still remembers those names.
messages.真到水涨时，你会先关哪一路？: If the water really rises, which line will you shut first?
messages.真结局路线奖励护符。: The true ending route rewards amulets.
messages.眺台边缘只有半块玻璃。: There is only half a piece of glass at the edge of the lookout platform.
messages.眼下没有可以继续追问的已知线索。: There are no known clues to follow up on here yet.
messages.瞄准上方铜环施展钩索，牵开索道闩。: Aim at the upper copper ring and use the hook rope to open the cable latch.
messages.知道得更多，是让你看清选择；不是让你欠下另一道必须执行的命令。: Knowing more lets you see the choice more clearly. It doesn't put you under another order you must obey.
messages.短窗口防御并返还能量。: Defend with a short window and return energy.
messages.短距离水平冲刺。苔钟庭断枝祭坛的战利品，随行至铸雨渠。: Short horizontal dash. Take the loot from the moss bell court altar and follow to the rain foundry canal.
messages.短距离水平冲刺，可穿过钟隙与窄刺阵。断枝祭坛的守卫曾用它护住整条苔脉。: Sprint horizontally for a short distance, and you can pass through the bell gap and the narrow thorn array. The guards of the Broken Bough Altar once used it to protect the entire moss vein.
messages.砌道外沿有旧旗杆能落脚。: There is an old flagpole at the edge of the masonry path where one can stand.
messages.破坏脆弱地板进入 Boss 前。: Destroy the fragile floor to enter the Boss area.
messages.破坏脆弱地板进入 Boss 前区域。: Destroy the fragile floor to enter the Boss area's front region.
messages.破开湿墙封条，取回暗室里的纺锤。: Break through the wet wall seal, retrieve the spindle from the hidden room.
messages.破开湿墙封条，取回暗室里的纺锤。 可选：旧铸工证物柜。: Break through the wet wall seal and retrieve the spindle from the dark room. Optional: Old casting storage cabinet.
messages.破旗路: The path to break the flag
messages.破铃训练院1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Broken Bell Training Yard 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.破铃训练院2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Broken Bell Training Yard 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.破铃训练院3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Broken Bell Training Yard 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.破铃训练院4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Broken Bell Training Yard 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.破铃训练院5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Broken Bell Training Yard 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.破铃训练院6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Broken Bell Training Yard 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.确保主角知道自己收集的是心，不是普通战斗标记。: Wants the Pilgrim to understand that each mark they collect is a heart.
messages.确认囚徒解缚与退路: Confirm the binding of the prisoners and their retreat routes
messages.确认移动藤蔓和花粉风的基础节奏。: Confirm the basic rhythm of moving vines and pollen winds.
messages.确认移动藤蔓和花粉风的基础节奏。 -> 通过断续弦桥并取得花粉过滤器。: Confirm the basic rhythm of moving vines and pollen winds. -> Obtain the Broken String Mark through the intermittent string bridge and the Pollen Filter.
messages.碑上被悼念的人，又以新号站回军册。骑士点名时停了一拍，没有替他们回答。我也没有。: The dead we mourn at the monument stand on the muster roll again under new numbers. The knight paused when he called their names. He didn't answer for them. Neither did I.
messages.碑列高台上的名字与军册编号重复出现；死者被划去，又以新号归队，点名由悼念变成了征: The names on the high platform and the military register appear repeatedly; the dead are crossed out, and then re-assigned with new numbers. The roll call has changed from mourning to conscription.
messages.碰了。你还没开口，我已经把脚并齐。: It did. You hadn't said a word and I'd already brought my heels together.
messages.祈愿碑失声，守母仍守着门后的旧殿。: The prayer stele is silent; the Matriarch is still guarding the old hall behind the door.
messages.祈祷没把锈洗掉，扳手倒洗掉一点。我现在两样都带。: Prayer didn't shift the rust. My wrench took a little off. I carry both now.
messages.离场；原位留《守母观武录》拾取点（late_game 两条即笔记文本）；ch5: Leave the game; leave the "Matriarch's Martial Record" pick-up points in place (two notes in late game); ch5 war_graves reunites after playing true_ending_branch
messages.离开书库前，你还要我带什么？: Is there anything else I should take before I leave the Archive?
messages.离开书库前，最该带走哪一句？: What single line should I take from the Archive?
messages.离开以后，你想让谁来接？: Who would you like to meet you when you're out?
messages.离开根笼以后，我才知道再走回来和从没能走开有多不同。: Only after I left the root cage did I learn the difference between coming back and never being able to walk away.
messages.离开根笼后，你最先想做什么？: What's the first thing you want to do out of the root cage?
messages.离营后进入锁门战。: After leaving the camp, enter the locked-door battle.
messages.秘阁暗格（上） / 回到书塔: Hidden Archive Niche (top) / Return to the Booktower
messages.称呼可以慢慢学，别把第一次见面的地方当成谁都不能走的地方。: We can learn names slowly. No one should have to stay forever in the place where we first met them.
messages.穴内没有灯火，只有身边近处可见；离开假苔穴后恢复正常视野。: There is no light in the hole, only visible nearby; restore normal vision after leaving the False Moss Hollow.
messages.空战廊道，脚下是空的。: The air battle corridor, with nothing beneath your feet.
messages.空槽曾经表示人不回来了。后来上面嫌空槽难看，叫我们钉满。: An empty groove used to mean someone wasn't coming back. Then those above us disliked the sight of gaps and told us to nail them all shut.
messages.空白祈祷台1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Blank Prayer Dais 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.空白祈祷台2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Blank Prayer Dais 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.空白祈祷台3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Blank Prayer Dais 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.空白祈祷台4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Blank Prayer Dais 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.空白祈祷台5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Blank Prayer Dais 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.空白祈祷台6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Blank Prayer Dais 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.穿越会移动的藤蔓温室，取得断弦印记，并确认六枚印记曾经都是活人守门者。: Cross through the moving vine greenhouse, obtain the Broken String Mark, and confirm that all six marks were once guarded by living people.
messages.穿过前庭直达镜池，死亡回跑很短。: Passing through the front yard leads directly to the Mirrorpool. The death run is short.
messages.穿过前廊直达王座，死亡回跑很短。: Pass through the front corridor to the Throne, short death run back.
messages.穿过反页廊，向东攀上天顶盐桥。: Cross the reverse page corridor and climb up to the Skybridge of Salt.
messages.穿过山根古道，找到之字砌道的登口。: Crossing the Old Foothill Road, find the entrance to the zigzagging masonry path.
messages.穿过弦室回声，向下接入东环廊。: Pass through the String Chamber Echoes and descend into the East Ring Gallery.
messages.穿过影门以后，我还是原来的我吗？: When I walk through a shadow gate, am I still the same person?
messages.穿过影门出来，你还认得我吗？: Do you still recognize me on the far side of a shadow gate?
messages.穿过无声门离开巡礼道。: Leave the Pilgrim Road through the Silent Gate.
messages.穿过旧吊运露台，辨认铜蛾栖廊的入口。: Cross the old lifting terrace and identify the entrance to the Copper Moth Roost.
messages.穿过旧吊运露台，辨认铜蛾栖廊的入口。 可选：钟骨吊运台。: Cross the old hoisting platform and identify the entrance to the Copper Moth Roost. Optional: Bell Bone Hoisting Platform.
messages.穿过盐白回声，向上接近苔庭回声。: Pass through the Saltwhite Echoes and approach the Hidden Moss Court Echo Lamp upwards.
messages.穿过矮洞就是钟庭。高处有钟塔，西面的苔脉通向断枝祭坛；要歇脚，就找亮着的苔灯。: The low tunnel opens into Bell Court. The tower is above you. Follow the moss veins west to the Broken Bough Altar. If you need a rest, look for a lit moss lamp.
messages.穿过第一段枪兵阵。: Pass through the first phase of the archer formation.
messages.穿过索道厅直达契约法庭，死亡回跑很短。: Cross the cableway hall directly to the Covenant Court, death runs are very short.
messages.穿过自动生成的大体量银河城灰盒：主线推进、支线奖励、捷径回环、Boss 前短跑。: Explore the generated region. Follow the main route, seek side rewards, connect loops and shorten the run back to the boss.
messages.突破重怪把守的前庭。: Break through the front courtyard guarded by heavy monsters.
messages.突破重怪把守的炉前长堤。: Breaking through the hard-core frontal embankment.
messages.窄径难以腾挪。: The narrow path is difficult to move through.
messages.立管井顶的钟龛，攀墙支线的犒赏。: The bell shrine at the top of the riser shaft, reward for the wall-climbing branch.
messages.立管内壁太湿；沿雨栅长堤寻找检修者留下的丝壁攀附，再回来。: The inner wall of the pipe is too wet; search for the Silk Wall Grip left by maintenance workers along the Rain Grate Embankment, then return.
messages.立管口封存；需要丝壁攀附与回声钩索才能回访。: The riser mouth is sealed; requires Silk Wall Grip and Echo Hook to return.
messages.立管旁的水轮停在半圈，誓牌钉成了挡潮板。: The water wheel next to the stand is stopped halfway, and the oath plates are nailed into tide-blocking boards.
messages.立管旁的水轮又按钟点转起来了。: The water wheel next to the stand turns again according to the bell time.
messages.立管旁的水轮照常转，誓牌翻到了刻名的一面。: The water wheel next to the stand turns as usual, and the oath plates are flipped to the side with the engraved names.
messages.站上天顶盐桥，俯瞰契约法庭与东侧滑页井。: Stand on the Skybridge of Salt, overlooking the Covenant Court and the eastern Slipping Page Shaft.
messages.站上裂纹封板，跳起后按下方向 + 攻击，下劈破开。: Stand on the crack seal, jump, press the direction + attack, and smash down with a downward strike.
messages.站上裂纹封板，跳起后按下方向 + 攻击，下劈破开。旧区有两处检修目标。: Stand on the crack seal, jump, press the direction + attack, and smash down with a downward strike. There are two maintenance targets in the old area.
messages.站上西眺台，隔着玻璃看清东北的裂纹穹顶。: Stand on the West Lookout platform and see the Cracked Dome in the northeast through the glass.
messages.站厅只有滴水声。: There is only the sound of dripping in the station hall.
messages.站厅安静得过分。: The station hall is too quiet.
messages.站在王冠前厅，认出六枚印记的方向。: Stand in the Crown Foyer and recognize the direction of the six marks.
messages.站在王冠前厅，认出六枚印记的方向。 可选：王冠共鸣练习工房。: Stand in the Crown Foyer and recognize the direction of the six marks. Optional: Practice Room for Crown Resonance.
messages.笑完还得赶工。潮没因为我们能说话就停。: Then back to work. The tide hasn't stopped just because we can speak.
messages.第1区守门者战后: After the Moss Bell Court Gatewarden
messages.第2区守门者战后: After the Rain Foundry Canal Gatewarden
messages.第2章：铸雨渠。你从苔钟庭的排水钟管落入雨渠入口。: Chapter 2: Rain Foundry Canal. You fall from the moss bell court to the entrance of the canal.
messages.第3章：盐白书库。契约索道把你送到被盐晶封住的档案塔。: Chapter 3: Saltwhite Archive. The Covenant Cableway takes you to the archive tower sealed by salt crystals.
messages.第4区守门者战后: After the Broken String Greenhouse Gatewarden
messages.第4章：断弦温室。书库后门之后，是被藤蔓吞没的温室栈道。: Chapter 4: Broken-String Greenhouse. Behind the book storage back door is the greenhouse walkway swallowed by vines.
messages.第5区守门者战后: After the Obsidian Pilgrim Road Gatewarden
messages.第5章：黑曜巡礼道。温室外墙裂开，旧王都外环的号角在雾里回响。: Chapter 5: Obsidian Pilgrim Road. The outer wall of the warm room cracks open, and the horn of the old royal city echoes in the fog.
messages.第6章：无声王冠。黑曜军令打开王冠核心的无声门。: Chapter 6: Silent Crown. The Obsidian Order opens the Silent Gate of the Crown Core.
messages.第一个名字缝好了。我怕刮脖子，拆了一针，又补了一针。: The first name's sewn in. I thought it might scratch his neck, so I picked out one stitch and sewed it again.
messages.第一份在苔钟井喉，第二份在雨泵侧室，其余四份分散在书库、母株、白纱和跪行小门。: The first is in the throat of the moss bell well. The second is in a side room by the rain pump. Look for the rest in the Archive, the mother plant, the white veil and the crawl door.
messages.第一声穿过试音模的细管。井边的水位往下退，一只打水的手松开绳。巷口的人抬头，张了: The first note travels down the narrow tube of the tuning mould. The water by the well falls. A hand drawing water loosens its grip. Someone at the end of the lane looks up, mouth open. Only the bell can be heard.
messages.第一座钟龛，教学末尾的稳定归处。: The first moss niche, a stable destination at the end of the teaching.
messages.第一次做能解开的扣子，怕走着就散，又怕系上太难松。: It's the first clasp I've made that can come undone. I'm afraid it'll fall open while someone walks, or be too hard to loosen once it's fastened.
messages.第一次救下了人，往后再没人拆。如今连开一扇小门，都得等这把锁准许。: It saved lives the first time. No one took it apart afterward. Now even a little door has to wait for leave from this lock.
messages.第一百零一把钥匙没有坏。谁站在门外，我仍不知道。: The hundred-and-first key was intact. I still don't know who stood outside that door.
messages.第一百零一把钥匙被主动吞下。告解没有写门外来者的名字，我暂且把那一格留白。: Someone chose to swallow the hundred-and-first key. The confession doesn't name the one who came to the door. For now I'll leave that square blank.
messages.第一章印记传出雨水敲铁的回声，主角从苔钟庭后门坠入一条一直下雨的地下水渠。: In the first chapter, the echo of rain hitting iron is heard, and the protagonist falls into a continuously rainy groundwater canal behind the Moss Bell Court.
messages.第一章节奏强化，冲刺和落钟组合。: The rhythm of the first chapter is strengthened, combining the dash and falling bell.
messages.第一章闭环完成：苔钟庭清怪、Boss门和苔钟守母均已验证。: Chapter 1 complete. Moss Bell Court's encounters, boss gate and Matriarch trial have been cleared.
messages.第一行写着守母的名字，后面跟着一串新签的名字，每个名字旁都写着“可退出”。: The first line reads the name of the Matriarch, followed by a string of new names, each with the option "can be exited" next to it.
messages.第一道是谁教的，我记得。第二道什么时候开始，我总说记不清。: I remember who taught me to make the first seal. Whenever anyone asks when the second began, I say I can't quite remember.
messages.第七个名字最后一笔，留给活人。我会松手；这次不是把责任递给你，是让你选择。: Leave the last stroke of the seventh name to the living. I'll let go. This time I'm giving you a choice instead of handing you a burden.
messages.第七个名字留一笔给我。我不替谁代签，只签我自己做过的事。: Leave one stroke of the seventh name to me. I'll sign for my own deeds. No one else's.
messages.第七签署者把改写契约的后门藏进绯线。: The seventh signatory hides the backdoor of the rewritten contract in Crimson Thread.
messages.第七签署者留下的绯线回响，能看见命线、契约线和被删掉的名字残痕。: The Crimson Thread echoes left by the seventh signatory, showing traces of life lines, contract lines, and deleted names.
messages.第七签署者的回声，也是第一位发现契约被篡改的巡礼者。: The echo of the Seventh Signatory. The first pilgrim to discover the covenant had been altered.
messages.第七绯线前厅: Foyer in front of the seventh Crimson thread.
messages.第三章书库识别契约页。: In the third chapter, identify the contract page in the library.
messages.第三章能力返场奖励。: Reward for returning the ability from Chapter 3.
messages.第二条线不是让你忘掉第一条路。: A second thread doesn't mean you have to forget the first road.
messages.第二枚失声印记，记录水声被王冠改写的证词。: The second Silent Mark, recording the testimony that the sound of water was rewritten by the crown.
messages.第二章 Boss 掉落的铁匠誓牌作为进入书库的剧情凭证。: The iron smith's oath plate dropped by the boss in Chapter 2 serves as a plot confirmation for entering the library.
messages.第二章主题能力：用回声确认水轮机关和钩环路线。: Chapter 2 theme ability: Use echoes to confirm the waterwheel mechanism and hook loop routes.
messages.第二章守卫被王冠重新编译成回声。: The guards in the second chapter are recompiled by the crown into echoes.
messages.第二章闭环完成：铸雨渠水轮捷径、Boss门和绯线执剪者均已验证。: Chapter 2 complete. The waterwheel shortcut, boss gate and Scissor Apostle trial in Rain Foundry Canal have been cleared.
messages.第六枚失声印记，击败 Boss 后获得。: The sixth silent mark, obtained after defeating the boss.
messages.第六章揭示旧王并非单独的反派，六座城市曾共同请求封印。玩家最终选择重铸钟声、切断: Chapter six reveals that the old king was not a single villain. The six cities once requested to seal the mark. Players ultimately choose to remake the bell sound, cut off the crown, or keep silence and enter a second playthrough.
messages.第四位守门者残留人格，歌声维持温室上方裂缝沉睡。: What remains of the fourth Gatewarden. Their song keeps the fissure above the Greenhouse asleep.
messages.笼开了以后，你打算怎么下去？: How will you get down once the cage opens?
messages.等了很久，那边才回一闪。他自己走过来的，我没有把他叫回队里。: I waited ages for a single flash from the far end. They walked over of their own accord. I didn't call them back into line.
messages.等你查到什么就告诉我。查不到，也回来告诉我。: Tell me what you find. Even if you find nothing, come back and tell me.
messages.等待能集齐六处证词的人改写契约。: Waits for someone to gather testimony from all six places and rewrite the covenant.
messages.等得很难受，可我没补那一拍。你看，这才是我得修的地方。: It hurt to wait. But I didn't add that beat. See? That's the part I need to mend.
messages.等我也走出这道门，再去问剩下的人。: When I can get out of this door too, I'll ask the rest myself.
messages.等新契约落地，我想做一份谁都能拿的目录。连没名字的人也有一栏。: When the new covenant takes effect, I'd like to make a catalogue anyone can take. Even people with no name will have a space in it.
messages.等盾兵举枪后绕背，正面硬打会被枪阵顶回。: After waiting for the shield soldiers to raise their guns, circle behind them. A direct attack from the front will be repelled by the gun formation.
messages.等腿不抖了，我想去西门坐着。先坐，不替谁搬苗。: When my legs stop shaking I'd like to sit by the west gate. Just sit, before anyone asks me to carry seedlings.
messages.等辐条转到位，冲进水轮内部。: When the irradiation is moved to position and washed into the water wheels.
messages.箍松了，不等于根今天就长好。我会留着这些旧痕。: The hoop is loose. That won't heal the roots in a day. I'll leave the old scars visible.
messages.管内潮湿铁声隆隆。: The iron inside the pipe makes a loud sound due to moisture.
messages.管工尸壳还在按旧班表巡逻。: The canal worker's shell is still patrolling according to the old schedule.
messages.管洞后是泵庭，两岸之间留着水窖入口。拉杆通了升梯，再爬上方钟廊。: Beyond the pipe tunnel is the pump court. Between the banks you'll see the cistern entrance. Connect the lift with the lever, then climb to the bell gallery.
messages.管渠童子会替你数水滴的拍子。: The Canal Child will count the beats of water droplets for you.
messages.精英加远程组合战，压迫空间管理。: A combination of elite and remote combat, oppressing space management.
messages.精英战与能力获取: Defeat the elite and gain an ability
messages.素与总官分列两行。我沿着原页的刮痕，继续往改约的人那里追。: I wrote Su and the High Registrar on separate lines. I'll follow the scrape on the page back to whoever altered the covenant.
messages.索台是单向的，只能向下。: The cable platform is one-way, only able to go down.
messages.索引上没有的名字还算存在吗？: Does a person still exist if their name isn't in the index?
messages.索引只是一条找书的路。路被划掉，不会让那个人从过去消失。: An index is only a way of finding a book. Strike out the path and you haven't made the person vanish from the past.

messages.纺锤上崩下的一段轴。集齐四段，合成一个能量纺锤：绯线上限 +20。: A section of shaft that collapses from the spindle. Gather four sections to form an Energy Spindle: Crimson Thread limit +20.
messages.线断时，有人先喊了一声，像试一件陌生的工具。第二声才叫出邻居的名字。井边的人都回: When the thread snaps, someone tries out a sound as if testing an unfamiliar tool. Their next cry is a neighbour's name. Everyone by the well turns. Just then the tide passes its lowest mark.
messages.线索条件已经变化，请重新选择问题。: The clues have changed. Choose a question again.
messages.线结补好了，缝名契印也能接上连续针击。这记断弦回斩与工匠线轴给你；先到钟庭排水计: The knot's mended. The Name-Stitch Seal can follow one needle strike with another. Take the Severed-String Riposte and the Artisan's Spool. Practise the recovery at the needle rack outside Bell Court's timed drain gate.
messages.线绷直了。从今往后，「够不着」要重新丈量。: The thread is taut. From now on, take a fresh measure of what's out of reach.
messages.组织沿路灯号与撤离，灯不再用于召兵。: Coordinates the lantern signals and evacuation. The lamps no longer muster soldiers.
messages.织线学徒把找回的名字缝进衣领。孩子仍念着父亲的名字，新的下工钟却照旧只叫编号；这: The apprentice sews the recovered names into a collar. The child still says Dad's name. The new shift bell still calls only his number. The bell hasn't erased that small victory. Nor has it changed the whole city.
messages.织线暗室，冲刺门后。: Hidden Weaving Room, behind the Dash Door.
messages.织线者的断机: The broken machine of the weaver
messages.终局变化应当落到具体人的日常需要。: What changes at the end should reach the daily needs of actual people.

messages.终点为什么仍让人回去？: Why is there still a way back at the end?

messages.终章中段获得，改写钟门状态。: Obtain the middle of the final chapter, rewrite the state of the bell gate.
messages.终章入口凭证，并提供拒令条款线索。: The entrance credential for the final chapter provides clues to the clause of refusal.
messages.终章有一扇门只认沉默军令，但它也会认出拒绝命令的人。: The final chapter has a door that only recognizes the Silent Military Order, but it will also recognize those who refuse the command.
messages.终章隐藏支线: Hidden side storyline in the final chapter
messages.结局的制度代价需要在人物处境中继续可见。: The price of keeping the old order is still here in the lives of the people who bear it.
messages.绕柱双层溢流廊: Double-layer overflow corridor around the column
messages.绕柱双层环廊: Circle around the double-layered corridor of the pillar
messages.绘图者把纸留给不好找的地方。钟殿很大，人的落脚处却更容易漏掉。: The cartographer saves space on the page for places that are hard to find. The bell hall is huge. Where a person can set a foot is easier to overlook.
messages.给你修路的报酬。蜡不必交给我销毁，沿路还会有人用到它。: Here's your pay for mending the road. Keep the wax. Someone along the way will still have a use for it.
messages.给停在断桥那边的人。他们看见我了，还没敢动，我再等一阵。: The people waiting across the broken bridge. They can see me but they don't dare move yet. I'll wait awhile.
messages.给我一点工夫。我答应过守这儿，得想清楚是还想守，还是只怕走。: Give me time. I agreed to stand watch here. I need to learn whether I still want to stand or I'm simply afraid to go.
messages.统帅不是坏人，他只是从没被允许停下。: The commander is not a bad person. He just never had the chance to stop.
messages.统帅也会被自己的军令困住吗？: Could the commander be trapped by her own orders?
messages.统帅以点名保存阵亡者，军令却将失败者重新编入无声军队。: The commander saves the names of the fallen through the roll call, but the military order reassembles the losers into a silent army.
messages.统帅停了，手还会自己去摸旗杆。摸到半截，我把它放下了。: The commander has stopped, but my hand still goes to the flagstaff of its own accord. Halfway up, I lowered it.
messages.统帅停了，路口不会立刻都有人。我得把空位标出来。: The commander has stopped. That won't put someone at every crossroads overnight. I'll mark the empty posts.
messages.统帅每次点名都慢半拍，像在等阵亡者回答。: The commander is always half a beat late at roll call. It's as if he's waiting for the dead to answer.
messages.统帅没有忘记他们，钟令却只允许他把人再编回军阵。把这段证词带去王冠。: The commander never forgot them. The bell's order let him do nothing but muster them again. Take that testimony to the Crown.
messages.统帅短暂恢复自我，交出沉默军令，承认王冠核心会把所有失败者重新编入军队。: The commander briefly regains himself, hands over the Silent Military Order, and admits that the core of the crown will re-register all failures into the army.
messages.继续向西，直到西眺台。: Continue west until you reach the West Lookout platform.
messages.继续重鸣能保住城市秩序，却延续活人声音作为封印材料；切断王冠能归还声音，却可能放: Continuing the Retolling can preserve urban order, but it continues the voices as sealing materials; cutting off the crown can return voices, but it may release the Black Tide. The true ending requires gathering six testimonies and rewriting the contract with Crimson Thread.
messages.绯线执剪者交出铁匠誓牌和回声钩索，要求主角去盐白书库寻找王冠契约原文。: The Crimson Thread Scissor Apostle hands over the Smith's Oath Plate and the Echo Hook, asking the protagonist to go to the Saltwhite Archive to find the original contract of the crown.
messages.绯线执剪者倒下后，冷却水漫过契约索道，通往盐白书库的升降井开始运转。: After the Crimson Thread Scissor Apostle falls, the cooling water overflows the contract cableway, and the lift shaft leading to the Saltwhite Archive begins to operate.
messages.绯线执剪者承认自己把一批活人的名字缝进王冠，只有盐白书库保存谁下令的原文。: The Crimson Thread Scissor Apostle admits that he sewed the names of a group of living people into the crown, and only the Saltwhite Archive preserves the original text of who ordered it.
messages.绯线真结局：钟声只封黑潮，不再吞人声。: True ending of Crimson Thread: The bell only seals the Black Tide and no longer absorbs voices.
messages.绯线门印: Seal of the Crimson Thread Gate.
messages.维护旧庭院升台图例的绘图师，身体半嵌进齿轮升降机。: A cartographer who maintains the key to the old court's lift maps. Half their body is caught in the gears.
messages.维护的视线需要落在日常使用者身上。: Maintenance should attend to the people using a place every day.
messages.维护还包括解释与核对，不只是点亮设备。: Maintenance includes explaining and checking a signal as well as lighting the lamp.
messages.维持泵井最后的秩序，同时确认主角是否值得知道书库入口。: Keeps what order remains at the well while deciding whether to trust the Pilgrim with the entrance to the Archive.
messages.缄声能让水不再上涨吗？: Can falling silent keep the water from rising?
messages.缄；游戏内称巡礼者。继承绯线回响，不是拥有替所有人签字的王。: Sealed; called Pilgrim in the game. Inheriting the Thread Echo is not having a king who signs for everyone.
messages.缓追钟珠: Slow pursuit of the bell bead
messages.编号是后来压上去的。认编号的人会认错班，我认这道缺口不会。: The number was stamped on later. Go by the number and you could get the wrong shift. I wouldn't mistake that nick.
messages.编号朝外，磨圆的手铆朝里。柳认出修过的缺口，孩子记得阿禾倒鞋里的水。我要把这枚牌: Number facing out, rounded hand-set rivet facing in. Liu recognized the notch he'd mended. The child remembered A-He tipping water from his shoes. I'll bring both faces of the badge to the Archive.
messages.编号能把家里的人叫回来吗？: Can a number call my family home?
messages.缝名是在替钟继续收声吗？: Does stitching names mean gathering voices for the bell again?
messages.缠根压顶的窄径: The narrow path wrapped around the root and pressing the top
messages.聊今天修了哪件衣服，或者街口谁第一次听懂试音。: Which coat I mended today. Or who in the lane recognized the test note for the first time.
messages.肋板是单向的，可以从下方穿过。: The rib plate is one-way, allowing passage from below.
messages.肋板窄，风从冠顶灌下。: The rib plate is narrow, and wind blows down from the top of the crown.
messages.能先坐一会儿，就是我今天想要的生活。: Being able simply to sit awhile is the life I want today.
messages.能冲得更远，会更难停下来吗？: If I can dash farther, will I find it harder to stop?
messages.能力回访反证；可选，不代替六区主线证词。: The sound of water beneath suddenly becomes empty, as if there is another room below.
messages.能力成长应当增加判断，而非自动扩大破坏。: With a new ability comes more to consider before I strike.
messages.能力提供行动的可能，不替代对身世的证据。: A skill tells me what I can do. It isn't proof of where I came from.
messages.能回应一套机关，是你眼下持有的能力；谁有权决定六城，还得另问。: Answering a mechanism is something you can do today. Who gets to decide for six cities is another question.
messages.能坐着把一句话听完，是今天才慢慢学回来的。: Only today am I slowly learning again to stay seated long enough to hear someone out.
messages.能开口不是潮会停。今天先把人和苗都抬高，哪盆先搬，我自己来挑。: Being able to speak won't stop the tide. Today we need everyone and every seedling up high. I'll choose which pot to move first.
messages.能拿出来看，仍不等于名字就不再被拿去抵押。旧约还在，工牌上多一道公开的字也替不了: We can show them. That doesn't mean the names can no longer be pledged. The old covenant stands. An extra line of writing in plain sight can't undo it.
messages.能改正的先改正；改不回的，也要有人知道原因。: Correct what can be corrected first. Where the damage can't be undone, someone should know why.
messages.能松开的就慢慢松，别把所有支撑一口气拔掉。: Ease loose what will come free. Don't pull every support out at once.
messages.能核对的逐项核对，不能核对的保留疑问。: Check each thing you can. Leave a question beside what can't be checked.
messages.能说话以后，第一件衣服给谁缝？: Now people can speak, who gets the first coat you sew?
messages.脉络里还传来人声。把耳朵贴近一点，这一段，别急着记成一句漂亮的话。: There are voices in those veins yet. Put your ear closer. Don't hurry to make a pretty phrase out of what you hear.
messages.脚下的水声忽然变空，像下面还有一间屋。: After soaring, press the jump again to pull out a second life line. The old Saltwind Gate can be accessed from here.
messages.脚下的雨声没有停过。有一座城，在下面淋着。: The rain beneath your feet never stops. A city down there is getting wet.
messages.腾空后再次按跳跃，拉出第二条命线。旧盐风门由此可通。: Vine Cage Bronze Ring Tram · Return

messages.自愿参与需要被允许暂停和撤回。: To volunteer means being free to pause or withdraw.
messages.自愿抵押的刻痕与主动吞钥的告解同时存在。王冠既挡潮，也曾选择不让人离开。: The indentations of voluntary tide suppression and the confessions of those who voluntarily swallow the key exist simultaneously. The crown both blocks the tide and chooses not to let people leave.
messages.自愿镇潮的最早抵押者: The earliest mortgagor of voluntary tide suppression
messages.自由以后为什么还留在营地？: Why stay in camp now that you're free?
messages.自由包含主动留下，也包含以后改变主意。: Freedom includes choosing to stay. It also includes changing my mind later.
messages.自由的获得，也可能需要身体逐渐适应。: Sometimes a body needs time to grow used to freedom.
messages.至于原字，你带着去看温室吧。书里叫“供弦”，我想知道树根上究竟接着谁。: Take the original words with you to the Greenhouse. The book says “strings supplied.” I'd like to know who's actually connected to the roots.
messages.至少有人能在夜里看清裂口，不必摸着发烫的铜边猜。: At least someone can see a split at night without feeling their way along hot copper.
messages.至少要让用那一路水的人知道。阀柄在我手里，不等于水只属于我。: At least let everyone who uses that water know. Holding the valve handle doesn't make the water mine alone.
messages.舞台两侧棘墙推进，玩家用 thorn_downstrike 下劈棘球反弹到安全层: Advance along the thorn walls on both sides of the stage. Players use thorn_downstrike to slash down thorn balls, which bounce back to the safe layer.
messages.舱里的名单不愿被读。: The list in the cabin is not willing to be read.

messages.花粉蜡的钱已经结清。检修灯还要试，我得看它有没有照到搬苗人的手。: The pollen wax is paid for. I still need to try the lamp and see whether it lights the hands of someone carrying seedlings.
messages.花粉蜡能稳住灯芯。你愿意去取，我付路钱；不愿意，我少点几盏，先看紧有人走的地方。: Pollen wax steadies the wick. Fetch some if you like and I'll pay your way. If not, I'll light fewer lamps and tend the paths still in use first.
messages.花粉过滤器便宜，死在花粉里很贵。: The Pollen Filter is cheap, but dying in the pollen is expensive.
messages.花粉过滤器可减少雾遮挡，但不是主线必需。: The Pollen Filter can reduce fog obstruction, but it is not essential for the main storyline.
messages.花粉雾会遮挡下一段落点。: Pollen fog will block the next landing point.
messages.苔、雨、盐、弦、曜，五枚已归，最后一枚在你要打碎的东西里。: Moss, rain, salt, string, obsidian, five of them have been returned. The last one is in something you want to break.
messages.苔壁竖井，丝壁攀附回访奖励。: Mosswall Shaft, Silk Wall Grip reward for retrying.
messages.苔庭回声暗灯旁的冠下残响，可选探索奖励。: Remnant echoes under the Hidden Moss Court Echo Lamp, optional exploration rewards.
messages.苔板塌出的石穴: The moss slabs have collapsed, creating a stone hole.
messages.苔灯在中央宽地面；西侧断石凳可短跳登上，返回竖井仍沿原路。: Moss lamps are placed on the central wide ground; a short jump can be made to the west side stone bench, and returning to the shaft follows the original path.

messages.苔钟庭的自愿抵押: The voluntary mortgage of the Moss Bell Court
messages.苔铃外庭 自动生成灰盒: Moss Bell Outer Court Automatically Generated Gray Box
messages.苔铃外庭 自动生成灰盒：自动生成灰盒入口。: Moss Bell Outer Court Automatically Generated Gray Box: Automatically generated gray box entrance.
messages.若井底有人敲三下，不要回答第四下。那是黑潮在学人说话。: If someone is knocking at the bottom of the well three times, don't answer the fourth time. That's the Black Tide learning to speak like humans.
messages.若他以后愿意来，我给他留把空椅子。: If they do want to visit later, I'll keep an empty chair for them.
messages.若他们仍会害怕，先听他们怕的是哪一种亮法。: If people are still afraid, listen to which pattern frightens them first.
messages.若以后想起新的疑问，再回来翻；离开不等于已经读完。: Come back and turn the pages if another question occurs to you. Leaving doesn't mean you've finished reading.
messages.若伤还疼，就先顾它疼不疼。不能为了让人看懂历史，故意不让它长好。: If the wound hurts, see to the pain first. You can't keep it from healing just to make history easier to read.
messages.若你今天只想到营地，我就把到营地的路说完。: If camp is as far as you want to go today, I'll give you directions that end at camp.
messages.若你以后改了主意，再来找我。这次我会标上是哪一天听你亲口说的。: If you change your mind, come and find me. This time I'll record the very day I heard it from your own lips.
messages.若你再来，先问我今天想去哪儿。: If you visit again, first ask where I'd like to go that day.
messages.若你只想歇脚，也能进来，不必每次带点能卖的东西。: Come in even if you only want a rest. You don't have to bring something to sell every time.
messages.若你带着铁匠誓牌，就别问我它为什么缺角。: If you have the Smith's Oath Plate, don't ask me why it lacks a corner.
messages.若你缺少证词，我不会阻止你，但结局会少一种颜色。: If you lack testimony, I will not stop you, but the ending will lack one color.
messages.若你还要去别的城区，就沿检修道回去吧。下次见面也不用先问我有没有上工。: If you're heading to another district, take the maintenance path back. When we meet again, you needn't ask if I've started work yet.
messages.若六城都醒来，我想改画一张普通的路图：市场、茶铺，还有不赶路的长椅。: If all six cities wake, I'd like to draw an ordinary street map. Markets, tea shops. Benches for people who aren't in a hurry.
messages.若只在你带东西回来时开口，我们的相识就也像一张班表。: If I only spoke when you brought something back, our friendship would start to look like a shift rota too.
messages.若只记炉温，不记住处的水位，迟早会把缺水的人说成偷懒。: Record the heat of the furnace but never the water level in the houses, and someday you'll call a thirsty worker lazy.
messages.若后来愿意说，再说；别为了填满这里就把所有声音交出来。: If you want to speak later, speak then. Don't give up every sound you have simply to fill this place.
messages.若后来有人想退出，也得把那一笔当成新记录，不能当作污点刮去。: If someone wants to withdraw later, that stroke must be entered as a new record. It isn't a blemish to scrape off.
messages.若哪一天我不来了，先问问我过得怎样，别先问缺了谁的工。: If I don't come in one day, ask how I'm getting on before asking whose shift is empty.
messages.若哪天我真回去了，别当成你白跑。来问问是不是我自己要走。: If I really do go back one day, don't think your journey was wasted. Come and ask if I chose to go.
messages.若声音说不清，就先指给我看你找到什么。: If you can't find the words, start by showing me what you found.
messages.若她不愿意，我就再找办法。不能只因她最熟，就让她永远站在那儿。: If she doesn't want to, I'll find another way. Knowing the task best needn't bind her to that place forever.
messages.若念完名字能让人安息，那是悼念；若念完还等他站起来，就是命令。: Speak a name and let its owner rest. That's remembrance. If you still expect them to stand after it, you've given an order.
messages.若情况变坏，我会说出来，不能因为门开过就装作一切正常。: If things get worse, I'll say so. An open gate isn't reason to pretend all's well.
messages.若我暂时找不到，你会一直等吗？: If I can't find anything yet, will you just go on waiting?
messages.若找不到，就把卡在哪儿告诉我。别为了一句“找到了”，带回来一个不认识的人名。: If you can't find them, tell me where the trail ran cold. Don't bring a stranger's name back just so you can say you found one.
messages.若收集五章证词，可输入第七真名，Boss 进入契约改写阶段。: If you collect the testimony of the five chapters, you can enter the seventh true name, and the boss will enter the contract rewrite stage.
messages.若新发现推翻了我的判断，也要连同这次判断一起留下。: If new evidence proves me wrong, keep that evidence and a record of what I thought today.
messages.若明天我改主意，也希望营地的人仍愿意听我说完。: If I change my mind tomorrow, I hope the people at camp will still hear me out.
messages.若有一天你不回头，我会问是不是叫错，不会追着把这个称呼套上。: If one day you don't turn, I'll ask if I got it wrong. I won't chase you to pin a title on you.
messages.若有人不愿把名字留在这里，我也给他留一条能拆的边。: If someone doesn't want a name to stay here, I'll leave a seam that can be unpicked.
messages.若有人从这里返回，也请把他那一段留下。: If someone turns around here, keep their part of the journey too.
messages.若有人愿意听，就从我们看见的刮痕说起。: If someone's willing to listen, I'll start with the scrape we can both see.
messages.若有人拿旧印来问，我会说是我开的。你不用替我挡着。: If someone comes carrying the old seal, I'll tell them I opened it. You needn't shield me.
messages.若没人能叫出我的名字，我是谁？: If no one can speak my name, who am I?
messages.若没有人来，今天就没有这一班；不能拿孩子补空。: If nobody comes, there's no shift today. You don't fill the gap with a child.
messages.若留下这一段，就把确定看见的地方和仍不确定的地方分开。: If you record this, keep what you've seen for certain separate from what you haven't.
messages.若看见熄灭的管灯，请替它添一点光。它照的是回来的脚，不是进城的脸。: If you see a pipe lamp gone out, give it a light. It shines on the feet coming home, not the faces entering the city.
messages.若终章让钟重鸣，请记得给我们一个不用继续守门的早晨。: If the epilogue causes the bells to ring, remember to give us a morning without continuing to guard.
messages.若要记他的事，就把他怎样照料、又怎样束住它都写上。: If you write about her, tell how she tended the tree and how she bound it.
messages.若要记她，请把她做过的和我们猜的分开写。: If you write about her, keep what she did separate from what we guessed.
messages.若还有别的版本出现，请再带来；完成过一次，不代表从此不必查。: If another version turns up, bring it here too. Having checked once doesn't mean the work is done forever.
messages.若遗愿说得清，可以听它；若只剩一句被磨损的回声，别急着替它添完。: If a wish was clearly spoken, hear it. If only a worn echo remains, don't rush to finish its sentence.

messages.营地名册有了退值的一栏。这次留下，是我自己说的。: There's a place on the camp roll for leaving the watch. I chose to stay this time.
messages.营地安全，可补给和整理支线。: The camp is safe, and you can replenish supplies and organize side quests.
messages.营地的军号不再拽他的肩，他却还会在相同的拍子醒来。: The bugle no longer tugs at his shoulder in camp, but he still wakes on the same beat.
messages.营地的灯改作了撤离信号。: The lamps in the camp have been changed to evacuation signals.
messages.营地的灯照常点，点名有人应“在”。: The lamps in the camp remain lit as usual, and someone responds with "present" during the roll call.
messages.营地的灯随钟令一盏盏亮起。: The lamps in the camp light up one by one according to the bell order.
messages.落下去就没有原路。: There is no way back if you fall down.
messages.落地后无法原路爬回。: Unable to climb back the original path after landing.
messages.落水后回到井底，且重置水轮节拍。: After falling into the water, return to the bottom of the well and reset the waterwheel rhythm.
messages.落点干净，但号角一响枪兵就列阵。: The landing point is clean, but as soon as the horn sounds, the archers line up.
messages.落点干净，但回声会模仿你的脚步声。: The landing point is clean, but the echoes will mimic your footsteps.
messages.落点干净，但盐屑会掩住书蠹的前摇。: The landing point is clean, but salt fragments will cover the front shock of book worms.
messages.落点干净，但花粉会盖住藤蔓的前摇。: The landing point is clean, but the pollen will cover the sway of the vines.
messages.落点干净，但苔藓机关和敌人前摇仍会要命。: The drop point is clean, but the moss mechanism and enemy anticipation can still be deadly.
messages.落点干净，湿石打滑。: The landing point is clean, but the wet stones slip.
messages.落针时记得他们。落完以后，也回去听他们说你有没有做错。: Remember them when you set the stitch. When it's done, go back and listen to whether they think you got it wrong.
messages.落钟节奏比第一章更快。: The falling bell rhythm is faster than the first chapter.

messages.藏在二层阅览廊上方的暗格，奖励高路线探索。: A hidden compartment above the Second-Floor Reading Gallery offers high-reward exploration routes.
messages.藏在听潮暗室，奖励向下的好奇心。: Hidden in the Hidden Tide Room, a reward for curiosity towards the downward direction.
messages.藏在巡礼军墓碑后，奖励旗桥探索。: Hidden behind the Soldiers' Tomb, the reward is the Banner Bridge exploration.
messages.藏在苔庭回声苔灯后，黑潮童声就在旁边。: Hidden behind the Hidden Moss Court Echo Lamp, The Tidechild is nearby.
messages.藏在蜂蜡暗屋蜡壁后，奖励下环探索。: Hidden behind the wax wall of the beeswax hidden house, rewards for exploring the lower ring.
messages.藏在顶阁暗格，奖励高路线探索。: Hidden in the Hidden Loft Compartment, a high-reward exploration area.
messages.藤台是单向的，可以从下方穿过。: The vine platform is one-way and can be passed from below.
messages.藤条只接得住一次。: The vine can only be caught once.
messages.藤架铜环索道已经苏醒，回程通路永久接通。: Vine Cage Bronze Ring Tram Traction Ring
messages.藤蔓先颤再动，颤动两次后平台会位移。: The vines first tremble and then move. After two trembles, the platform will shift.
messages.藤蔓先颤，再动。急着跳的人会被温室记住。: The vines first tremble, then move. Those who rush to jump will be remembered by the greenhouse.
messages.藤蔓先颤，再动；急着跳的人会被温室记住。: The vines tremble first, then move; those who rush will be remembered by the greenhouse.
messages.藤蔓平台反相。: The vine platform is the opposite of the reflection.
messages.藤鞭横扫、花粉风、弦桥断续。: Vine whips sweep, pollen winds, and string bridges are intermittent.
messages.藤鞭横扫、花粉风、弦桥断续。；舞台两侧棘墙推进，玩家用 thorn_downst: The vine whip sweeps across, the pollen wind blows, the string bridge is intermittent. On both sides of the stage, the thorn walls advance, and players use the thorn down strike to slash the thorns back to the safe layer.

messages.蛾群怕光也怕刃。: Moths are afraid of light and also of blades.
messages.蜂巢里有一枚盐页，但我不建议你用脸去拿。: There is a salt page in the hive, but I don’t recommend you reach for it with your face.
messages.蜂蜡丘过后是树冠回路。脚下长路走得稳，高处枝桥看得远，你不用一路都跳。: Beyond the beeswax mound the path loops through the canopy. The low road is steady underfoot. The branch bridge gives you a view. You needn't jump the whole way.
messages.蜂蜡商人要补照看根缝的检修灯。到蜂房支路找花粉蜡，回来谈清这一次的报酬。: The Wax Merchant wants to repair the maintenance lamps that watch the root seams. Go to the Wax Path to find pollen wax, and return to discuss this compensation.
messages.蜂蜡商人驱赶失败的蜂群。: The Wax Merchant drives away failed bee colonies.
messages.蜂蜡地板黏脚，撤退要提前。: The wax floor sticks to the feet, retreating should be done in advance.
messages.蜂蜡小屋商人，靠收集花粉过滤器、盐页和蜡封护符生存。: The merchant in the beeswax hut makes a living collecting pollen filters, salt pages and wax seal charms.
messages.蜂蜡影闩室保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的声音: Beeswax Shadow Lock Room: After completing an ability action, pass through a dedicated inspection route to retrieve two items and exit safely.
messages.蜂蜡暗屋挑战房留下的蜡膜残响。不挡主线，却能证明你敲响过暗屋余响钟。 图样可带给: The wax film residue left by the beeswax hidden house challenge room. It does not block the main storyline, but it can prove that you have struck the hidden house's residual bell. The pattern can be given to the wax merchant to make "Beeswax Stitch Brace"; the evidence will not be taken away.
messages.蜂蜡蛾贴着墙面俯冲。: The wax moth dives against the wall.
messages.蜂蜡首清：取得蜂蜡余响证据，并得额外碎钱与材料。图样可带给蜂蜡商人制作「蜂蜡缝托: Wax head clean: Obtain evidence of the wax residual and get extra coins and materials. The pattern can be given to the wax merchant to make "Beeswax Stitch Brace"; the evidence will not be taken away.
messages.蜜岚在补灯的班次后面画了一格空白：缺人时先来问，别替谁写满。: Milan leaves a blank after the lamp-mending shift. “If you're short a hand, come and ask first. Don't fill anyone in.”
messages.蜜岚把检修灯挪到高一点的路口，试着喊住还往低处走的人。: Milan moves the maintenance lamp to higher ground and calls out to the people still heading downhill.
messages.蜜岚检查补好的灯芯，旧钟恢复节拍，灯却仍照着她选的那道根缝。: Milan checks the mended wick. The old bell has found its rhythm again, but the lamp still lights the gap in the roots she chose.

messages.蜡先留给报潮灯。大家可以说话了，补灯的手却不能歇下。: The flood beacons get the wax first. Everyone can speak now, but we still need hands to mend the lamps.
messages.蜡灯廊适合歇脚；长架后有落井支路。螳将交刃时先停手，等他把架势放下。: Rest in the wax lamp gallery. There's a path down a well behind the tall shelves. When the Warlord crosses his blades, hold your attack until he drops his guard.
messages.蜡能挡潮，也能挡手。要看钥匙在谁那里，开匣的规矩写给谁看。: Wax can keep out water. It can also keep out hands. Ask who holds the key and who gets to see the rules for opening the case.
messages.蜡色正好。来，心结编好了，往后记得在灯下收针。: That's just the right colour of wax. There, your heart knot is tied. Finish your stitching under a lamp, now.
messages.蜡补上以后，我能让灯多稳一会儿。: With the fresh wax I can keep the lamps burning steadily a little longer.
messages.蜷壳扑身: Curled shells pounce on the body.
messages.螳将倒下了？那这一柜终于能解封。来的人多也好，我会慢慢分发。: The Warlord fell? Then at last I can unseal this cabinet. Let people come. I'll hand the contents out a little at a time.
messages.螳将的盐刃与封蜡突刺覆盖全场。: The salt blade of the mantis and the seal wax stab cover the entire area.
messages.行动成长与自我理解可以保持不同步。: I can grow more capable faster than I grow to understand myself.
messages.衣领上的名字由谁来定？: Who decides which name goes in a collar?
messages.衣领里留一点空白，也比缝上一个方便的答案好。: A little space in a collar is better than a convenient answer sewn in.
messages.补一盏灯，值得绕那么远吗？: Is mending one lamp worth coming all that way round?
messages.补全断弦歌者支线。: Complete the Broken-String Singer side story.
messages.补全王冠契约原文。: Complete the original text of the crown covenant.
messages.补好一盏灯能改变什么？: What difference can mending one lamp make?
messages.被你救出的囚徒留在温室西门。他已经离开根笼，仍能在钟令间隙决定今天把哪盆苗搬到光: The prisoner you freed stays by the Greenhouse's west gate. They're out of the root cage. Between the bell's commands, they can decide which seedling to move into the light today.
messages.被删名：暗格只余白盐衣拾取点＋绯线低语（见 13.3）；后续状态永久缺席，真名偏: Deleted name: The hidden compartment only has a white salt vest collection point + Crimson Thread whispers (see 13.3); the subsequent state is permanently absent, and the true name is supplemented by sealed_stacks testimony.
messages.被刮去的“自愿”补了回来。原页旁订了一页新页，只有标题，没有名字：要守潮的人自己: The "voluntary" that was scraped back in. A new page is attached to the original page, with only the title and no names: those who want to block the tide should sign themselves.
messages.被刮去的字仍然空着，抄书人照旧不敢落笔；钟铃一响，他们低头，把空白抄得很整齐。: The scrapped text remains blank, and the scribe dares not write down anything; when the bell rings, they lower their heads and copy the blanks neatly.
messages.被召唤的散页会在半空聚形。: The summoned slip pages will gather in the air.
messages.被困在正门前的老巡礼者，曾经试图硬闯锈钟门失败。: An old pilgrim stranded at the main gate after trying to force the rusted bell door.
messages.被救的人必须留下来修园吗？: Must someone who was rescued stay to mend the garden?
messages.被旧王戴成王冠核心的钟舌意识，既是封印部件，也是受害者。: A living bell tongue worn by the old king as the core of his crown. Part of the seal and one of its victims.
messages.被根笼困住的失败采集者，身体被温室当成警示。: A gatherer caught in the roots. The Greenhouse keeps their body on display as a warning.
messages.被水声困住的小钟魂围着断桥徘徊。: The little bell souls trapped by the water sound wander around the broken bridge.
messages.被迟影夺走声音的读者，靠手势和短句提醒后来者。: A reader whose voice was stolen by the Late Shadow. Gestures and short phrases warn the people who follow.
messages.裂纹穹顶门前的检查点，死亡回跑很短。: Checkpoint in front of the Cracked Dome, death runs are short.
messages.裂缝里的灯影在动。: The shadow of the lamp in the crack is moving.
messages.裂谷悬桥1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Ravine Suspension Bridge 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
