messages.西井落地先看到铁匠，潜兵守在更西侧，推进后再交战: The smith is visible as you land in the western shaft. The ambusher waits farther west.
messages.西侧吊运口可以回访；沿地面交锋，或跳上东侧铜台观察守卫。: The west side suspension port can be retried; confrontations along the ground, or jump onto the east side copper platform to observe the guards.
messages.西侧封死的朝圣阶通往黑曜巡礼路，机关在对侧。: The west side sealed pilgrimage steps lead to the Obsidian Pilgrim Road, with mechanisms on the opposite side.
messages.西侧裂口是单向下坠——想好再跳。: The west side crack is a single downward fall—think carefully before jumping.
messages.西沿是钟冠悬廊的起点。: The west side is the starting point of the Bell Crown Gallery.
messages.西沿是钟冠悬廊的起点。 可见旧检修入口：「钟冠双线仓」。在门前腾空，再按一次跳跃: Unlock the old supply tram → Rain Foundry Canal
messages.西门的囚徒，为什么你没先去找？: Why didn't you go to the prisoner by the west gate first?
messages.西门的灯: The lamp of the west gate
messages.西门的灯没灭，囚徒已经能自己把苗盆挪开。旧钟每响一次，他仍会停一下。: The west gate lamp still burns. The prisoner can move the pots himself now. He still pauses whenever the old bell rings.
messages.西门还亮着: A Light at the West Gate
messages.西门那盏灯我看得到。若中间枝台能落脚，你指给我看，我自己试。: I can see the lamp at the west gate. If that branch ledge between us will hold me, point it out. I'll try it myself.
messages.西阶下面是根须南廊，沿苗床走到尽头才到蜂蜡暗屋。东藤壁能爬上树冠；若从树心回来，: Below the west steps is the Southern Root Gallery. Follow the seedbeds to the hidden beeswax room. Climb the east vine wall into the canopy. On your way back from the heartwood, look for the lamp that's still warm.
messages.西高台暗室，湿墙门后。: West Platform Hidden Room, behind the Wetwall Door.
messages.要保住树，是否一定得让同一个人永远唱下去？: Must one person sing forever to keep a tree alive?
messages.要把所有工牌都拿走吗？: Should I take all the badges away?
messages.要看谁还在用改过的字办事。只修书页，门口的人仍会按旧抄本发令。: Find out who's still using the altered word. Mend only the page and the people at the door will still issue orders from the old copy.
messages.要，留给愿意守夜的人自己系，也让想停下的人能解开。: Yes. Let the ones who want the night watch tie it themselves, and let those who want to stop undo it.
messages.观察与门前交战: Survey the area and fight at the gate
messages.观察低位书螨的纸壳前摇，再越过高书架进入烛台夹层: Watch the book mite below ready its paper shell. Cross the high shelves to the candlelit mezzanine.
messages.观察到的变化要与许诺分开记录。: What I observe changing belongs in a different record from what someone promised.
messages.观察封蜡颜色读招，绯色封蜡表示会接迟影攻击。: Observe the color of the sealing wax when reading moves. Crimson sealing wax indicates that a late shadow attack will follow.
messages.观雨拱倾斜，铸雨渠仍在东面运转。: The rain observation arch is tilted, and the Rain Foundry Canal is still running in the east.
messages.解开三份索引页顺序。: Unlock the order of three index pages.
messages.解开束缚要连同离开的条件一起确认。: When we undo a bond, we must check whether there's a way to leave.
messages.解释地图和房间目标。: Explain the map and room objectives.
messages.解除一份命令，不等于删除它所占用的名字。: Revoking an order needn't erase the names it took for itself.
messages.誓板还在。好，我没白把那块铜留厚；总得有东西经得住别人改口。: The oath plate's still there. Good. I didn't leave that copper thick for nothing. Something has to outlast a change of tune.
messages.认不出。手上起茧的人很多，我不能看见一副好架势，就往你身上安一个师父。: No. Plenty of hands have calluses. One good stance gives me no right to invent a teacher for you.
messages.认不出也别硬挡下一击。活到明天，才有工夫继续问。: If you don't recognize the next blow, don't try to block it by force. Live till tomorrow and you'll have time for more questions.
messages.认字、守潮，都得听见人自己的回答。今天没答的人，我明天还可以再问。: To read a name or put someone on tide watch, I need to hear their answer. If they haven't answered today, I can ask tomorrow.
messages.认得你停在门外，没有把我往前推。至于你自己觉得哪儿变了，要问你。: I recognize the way you stopped outside the gate without pushing me on. If you feel something's changed, you're the one to ask.
messages.认清以后再动手，比为了证明有力气而动手更难。: Waiting to understand before you act is harder than striking to prove your strength.
messages.认识影门和巡礼军阵型。: Get familiar with the shadow gate and the formation of the Pilgrim Army.
messages.认识影门和巡礼军阵型。 -> 穿过第一段枪兵阵。: Recognize the shadow gate and the pilgrimage military formation. -> Cross the first section of the spearman formation.
messages.认识迟影机关。: Get familiar with the late shadow mechanism.
messages.让书记核对删去的名字: Let the secretary check the names that were deleted
messages.让他们先选谁能看见，再谈怎么留下。: Let them decide who can see their names first. Then ask how to keep them.
messages.让商人确认补灯材料: Let the merchant confirm the materials for repairing the lamps
messages.让我以后只报时吧。早晨、傍晚，谁晚了就晚了，不要再拿钟声决定谁能说话。: Let me just mark the hours after this. Morning, evening. If people are late, let them be late. A bell shouldn't decide who may speak.
messages.让我先坐一会儿。她照看过这里，也把这里勒得太紧，我现在说不成一句整话。: Let me sit first. She cared for this place. She also tightened it until it hurt. I can't put that into a whole sentence yet.
messages.让我打最后一个铆钉。声音再小，这一次我也会知道它敲的是谁的未来。: Let me drive the last rivet. However faint the sound, I'll know whose future that hammer is shaping this time.
messages.让我把这句话忍住。这是我还能替你腾出的最后一点地方。: Let me hold those words back. It's the last bit of room I can make for you.
messages.让持副本的人能回来说“不一样”。柜里这一份要留，带出去的那份也要认。: Whoever holds a copy must be able to come back and say it doesn't match. Keep the one in the cabinet and recognize the one carried outside as well.
messages.让更多人能查，让每次改动留下谁提出、谁同意的来历。没有纸能替人永远守住这些。: Let more people inspect it. With every change, record who proposed it and who agreed. No sheet of paper can keep watch for us forever.
messages.让歌在几个人之间传一传，看看能不能有新的节拍。: Let the song pass from one person to another. See if a new rhythm comes.
messages.让线索可以重访，比留下口号更长久。: A clue someone can revisit will outlast a slogan.
messages.让逃旗手辨认召集线: Let the Deserter Standard-Bearer identify the summoning line
messages.让首访巡礼者在书墙与烛台之间有足够身体宽度起跳，避免顶头夹缝。: Remember this place; all water eventually returns to the pump room. The old inspection entrance can be seen: "Pump Room Upper Inspection Cabin." Press the jump while sticking to the door wall, and the wall jump opens the inspection lock. There is a bronze ring hanging in a hanging niche on the high side of the east bank; you cannot jump up; you need to hold the bronze ring to open the box. There is an old bell plate sealed above the western inspection pedal; it does not ring, as if waiting for some echo.
messages.记下接弦与外箍的不同，已经能给后来的人一条查问的路。: Record the difference between the joined string and the outer hoop. That already gives the next person a way to ask.
messages.记住亡者不需要向亡者索取回应。: Remembering the dead needn't demand an answer from them.
messages.记住这里；所有水最终都绕回泵房。: Remember this place; all water eventually returns to the pump room.
messages.记住这里；所有水最终都绕回泵房。 可见旧检修入口：「泵房上检修舱」。贴住门壁按跳: Remember this place; all loops will return to the Bell Court. There is a niche embedded above the ground on the east bank; a jump is just half a body away.
messages.记住这里；所有环路都会绕回钟庭。: Remember this place; all loops will return to the Bell Court.
messages.记名应当能由被记下的人决定。: The person whose name is recorded should get to choose it.
messages.记名是接住别人留下的事实；救援还需要另一种行动。: To record a name is to keep hold of a fact someone left behind. Rescue takes a different kind of action.
messages.记录已探索房间的破损镜片。: Record the damaged lenses of the explored rooms.
messages.记录应当揭示缺口，而不是把缺口填成假人。: A record should show a gap openly rather than fill it with a person who isn't there.
messages.记录未写入，信物与回礼保持原状。请重试或取消。: The record couldn't be saved. You still have your token and the reward hasn't been claimed. Try again or cancel.
messages.记忆回收井1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Memory Reclamation Well 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.记忆回收井2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Memory Reclamation Well 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.记忆回收井3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Memory Reclamation Well 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.记忆回收井4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Memory Reclamation Well 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.记忆回收井5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Memory Reclamation Well 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.记忆回收井6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Memory Reclamation Well 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.证明第三章完成并解锁断弦温室入口。: Prove that Chapter 3 is completed and unlock the entrance to the Broken String Greenhouse.
messages.证明第二章完成并解锁盐白书库入口。: Prove that Chapter 2 has been completed and unlock the entrance to the Saltwhite Archive.
messages.证明第五章完成并解锁无声王冠入口。: Prove that Chapter 5 has been completed and unlock the entrance to the Silent Crown.
messages.证明第四章完成并解锁黑曜巡礼道。: Prove that Chapter 4 is completed and unlock the Obsidian Pilgrim Road.
messages.证词上没有神的签名，只有工人的手印。这一次，我信这些手。: There's no god's signature on that testimony. Only the workers' handprints. This time I put my trust in those hands.
messages.证词不需要我的印章。我给它做个封套，留着开口；这回不封死。: That testimony needs no stamp of mine. Here, a sleeve for it with an open end. No sealing it shut this time.
messages.证词为什么不能只存一处？: Why not keep the testimony in one place?
messages.证词也需要封套？来，拿这一张。收我一声早安就够了。: Need a sleeve for that testimony too? Here. A good morning will cover it.
messages.证词可以从任何城区带来，支线的承诺不会替你决定主线。: You can bring testimony from the cities in any order. The promises you make on the way won't decide the ending for you.
messages.证词在母株另一段根系。你可以先去取，不必接这件请求才有资格过路。: The testimony lies along another root of the mother plant. You can fetch it first. This request isn't the price of passage.
messages.证词应当接受复核，不靠见证人的立场免检。: Testimony should withstand a second examination, regardless of where the witness stands.
messages.证词或世界状态已变化，请重新核对。: Your testimony or world state has changed. Check it again.
messages.证词提到我铸成以前的山。原来我也有一段不用负责关住什么的日子。: The testimony mentions the mountain before I was cast. There was a time even I had nothing to lock away.
messages.证词的意义也能在沿途交谈中发生。: A conversation along the road can give testimony meaning too.
messages.证词讲的是一个铁匠，还是整座工坊？: Is this a smith's testimony, or the whole workshop's?
messages.证词里一颗心、一根新线，也不是同一时候留下的。你的手或许也要一点点查。: The heart and the new thread in the testimony weren't left at the same time either. Your hand may have a history that needs tracing bit by bit.
messages.证词里有我？念那一行，再慢一点。我想知道，他们怎么写一个没上过岸的人。: Am I in the testimony? Read that line again, slower. I want to hear how they describe someone who's never set foot on shore.
messages.证词里每个名字，我都添一滴灯油。油会烧尽，但点过这件事不会。: For every name in the testimony, I add a drop of oil. The oil will burn away. The fact that a light was lit will remain.
messages.试音模为什么朝着街巷开口？: Why does the tuning mould open onto the lanes?
messages.试音模也保留旧槽，旧槽能说明做过什么，却不会自己把全部故事说完。: The tuning mould still has its old grooves. They show what someone once did. They won't tell the whole story on their own.
messages.试音模也该留下原来的用途。这样孩子才知道，街里的声音曾经可以向钟提出要求。: Keep the tuning mould's original use on record too. Children ought to know there was once a time the street could ask something of a bell.
messages.试音模有许多街口，我也该给消息留不止一条路。: The tuning mould has openings onto many streets. I ought to leave more than one route for news to come by.
messages.试音模朝向街巷，提醒我路的尽头应当有人住，不只是有一扇门。: The tuning mould faces the lanes. It reminds me there should be a home at the end of a road, not just a door.
messages.试音模朝着住处开口，我现在更想知道住在里面的人愿意怎样回答。: The tuning mould opens toward the homes. What I want to know now is how the people who live there would like to answer.
messages.试音模终于又像一个问题：街里的人听到了吗，愿不愿意再听一声？: The tuning mould feels like a question again: did the street hear us, and do they want to hear another note?
messages.试音模说明街里曾参与听钟；它不是只有钟楼单向发令的口。: The tuning mould shows the street once helped test the bells. It wasn't only an opening for one-way orders from the tower.
messages.试音的管口曾朝着许多家门，熟悉一条路不意味着只剩那条路。: The tuning pipes once opened onto many doorsteps. Knowing a way by heart doesn't make it the only way left.
messages.试音管的另一头曾经是住家，后来才成了收声口；手艺不能替用途作保。: The far end of the tuning pipe used to be someone's home. Only later did it become a mouth that took voices. Skill alone doesn't guarantee a good use.
messages.该留下树心的伤痕吗？: Should we keep the scar on the heartwood?
messages.诱导主角切断钟舌，同时质问王冠与黑潮谁更像怪物。: Urges the Pilgrim to sever the tongue and asks which seems more monstrous, the Blacktide or the Crown.
messages.说我还在这里，记得家里的人怎样敲管子；别替我说我已经不难过。: Say I'm still here and remember the way my family knocked on the pipes. Don't tell them I've stopped being sad.
messages.说话时面对我。耳朵听不清，嘴和手上的动作还看得清。你的针刃也一样。: Face me when you speak. My ears don't work well, but I can still read lips and hands. I can read that needle blade of yours too.
messages.说阿禾。要是只来得及说一句，就说这个。: Say A-He. If you only have time for one thing, say that.
messages.请回到这位人物身旁，重新打开当前心愿。: Return to the speaker and reopen this wish.
messages.请把沿路沉默的钟龛都点亮。没有客人的钟，也是钟。: Light the silent shrines you pass. A bell is still a bell when no guest comes.
messages.请把脚上的盐抖一抖。书页最怕潮，读者最怕只听见一个版本的事。: Shake the salt off your boots. Damp is a page's worst enemy. Hearing only one version of things is a reader's.
messages.请读完当前线索对应的回答，再记下追问。: Finish reading the answer to this clue before recording it.
messages.请那边的人也来。认字的人和认得名字的人，都该在桌旁。: Ask the people there to come too. The ones who can read the writing and the ones who knew the names both belong at the table.
messages.读法本身也可以抵抗单一结论。: The way we read can resist being led to a single conclusion.
messages.读者所在书架留出交谈空间，索引书吏守在东端: There is room to speak beside the reader's shelf. The index scribe guards its eastern end.
messages.读者把笔抬了起来。纸上仍有空处，我没有急着填。: The reader lifted the pen. A space remained on the page. I wasn't in a hurry to fill it.
messages.谁有资格决定先关哪一路？: Who has the right to shut off a water line first?
messages.谁能证明原页不是后来伪造的？: Who can prove the original page wasn't forged later?
messages.谁补过、谁拆过，都该留个名字。先从我开始。: The one who mended it and the one who opened it should each leave a name. I'll go first.
messages.贯穿三层的升梯井: The lift shaft that runs through three layers.
messages.贯穿三层的泄洪栈梯: Flood ladder that penetrates three levels
messages.贯穿世界的长梯尚未通电，记住它的位置。: The long ladder that penetrates the world has not been powered on yet, remember its location.
messages.贯穿世界的长梯尚未通行，记住它的位置。: The long ladder that runs through the world is not yet accessible. Remember its location.
messages.贴住湿墙短暂减速下滑并蹬墙跃起。铁匠柳说：湿墙认茧，不认胆子。: Climb along the wet wall to slow down briefly and then use the wall-climbing jump. Smith's Will says: The wet wall recognizes the cocoon, not the courage.
messages.贴住门壁按跳跃，墙跳拨开检修闩。: After jumping, attack downward to break the seal and fall into the deep well; jump from the bottom of the well to the recording platform, and then pull open the return ladder from the far side.
messages.贴住青铜湿墙，线会替你抓住一瞬；别贪，湿墙也会甩开你。: Stick to the bronze wet wall; the line will catch you for a moment; don’t be greedy, the wet wall will also throw you away.
messages.贴住青铜湿墙，绯线会替你抓住一瞬。: Climb along the bronze wet wall, and the Crimson Thread will catch you in that moment.
messages.贴地双钟波: Two bell waves touching the ground.
messages.沿检修坡道下到泵房。: Follow the service ramps down to the pump room.
messages.贴顶匍匐挤过窄缝。: Crawling over narrow gaps on the top.
messages.赢了？把最后一页借我改一改：“可避，可等，可胜。”这比阵亡名单好看。: You won? Let me amend the last page: “Can be dodged. Can be waited out. Can be beaten.” I like that better than a list of the fallen.

messages.赤锈熔桥3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Redrust Smelting Bridge 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.

messages.赤锈熔桥7：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Redrust Smelting Bridge 7. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.走一步，停半拍，再跳。: Take one step, pause for half a beat, then jump.
messages.走一步，停半拍，再跳。让影子撞在你昨天的位置。: Take one step, pause for half a beat, then jump. Let the shadow hit the spot where you were yesterday.
messages.走一步，停半拍，再跳；让迟影撞在你昨天的位置。: Take one step, pause for half a beat, then jump; let Chiying collide with your position from yesterday.
messages.走到最后，还能先回去一趟吗？: Once I reach the end, can I go back before choosing?
messages.走到死路时先找奖励，再看有没有从背面开的捷径。: At a dead end, look for a reward. Then see if there's a shortcut you can open from the far side.
messages.走廊重怪硬吃不亏——绕背打。: The corridor's heavy monsters are hard to defeat—circle around them.
messages.越往上盐晶越厚，落差越深。: The thicker the salt crystals, the deeper the drop.
messages.越过冠肋去钥座。核心击破后还有选择：重鸣、断冠，或带着完整证词改写。: Cross the Crown ribs to the Key Seat. When the core is broken you still have a choice. Retolling, Crownfall, or the Rewrite if you hold all the testimony.
messages.越过冲刺门，登上沉钟基座取回能量纺锤。: Cross the Dash Gate, climb to the base of the sinking bell to retrieve the Energy Spindle.
messages.越过闸齿后休整，镜头同时保留苔灯与检修缝入口: Rest beyond the gate teeth. From here you can see the moss lamp and the maintenance entrance.
messages.越靠近山顶，风越接近命令。: The closer you get to the mountain top, the closer the wind gets to the command.
messages.跃入时留意断枝。: Be aware of broken branches when jumping in.
messages.跟随歌声停顿前进，花粉风在副歌时转向。: Advance with a pause following the song. The pollen wind turns during the chorus.
messages.跟随玩家相位后追击，惩罚乱穿门。: Follow the player's phase and pursue, punishing the chaotic door.
messages.跨区入渠先观察渡槽落点与雨声，不安排入口追击: As you enter the canal, look for your landing spot on the aqueduct and listen for the rain. The entrance is safe.
messages.跪像弩手守桥，像还在等待最后一道命令。: Kneel like crossbowmen guarding the bridge, as if waiting for the last order.
messages.跪射手的弩线贴着砌道。: The archer's crosshair follows the masonry path.
messages.跪行小门后有我的告解。不要把打败我当作已经知道真相。: My confession lies behind the crawl door. Defeating me doesn't mean you know the truth.
messages.路上留下的号和名册里的号一样，可有些人早已不在。: The numbers on the road match the muster roll. Some of the people are long gone.
messages.路变了还得再校，不能把上一次看懂当成永远看懂。: If the route changes, we'll set the signals again. Understanding one once doesn't mean understanding it forever.
messages.路打开以后，也回来看看孩子；他等的不是工具，是消息。: When the path opens, come back and see the child. What they're waiting for is news, not tools.
messages.路标旁写着轮值与退出的办法。去守潮和回家，都该有路。: Beside the signpost are instructions for joining the watch and leaving it. There should be a road to the watch and a road home.
messages.路边的破旗记得每一次巡礼。: Remember every visit to the broken flag by the road.
messages.路还接着。先回去看看名字交到谁手里，灯是不是真的照到脚下。: The roads still meet. Go back and see who received the names and whether the lamps really light the ground.
messages.路通了，终于有人能把那根线看清。: Now the road is clear, someone can finally get a proper look at that thread.
messages.跳得更高以后，过去就更清楚了吗？: Does jumping higher make the past any clearer?
messages.跳起后向下攻击破开封板，落入深井；从井底跃上记录台，再从远侧拉开返程升梯。: Book Transport Lift Tram → Broken Pilgrim Steps
messages.踏板交错向上，注意坠锤。: The pedal interlaces upward, pay attention to the falling hammer.
messages.踩在根床边，别踩嫩芽。它们不认识战场，长出来就只顾着向上。: Mind the edge of the root bed. Don't tread on the shoots. They know nothing of battlefields. They just grow toward the light.
messages.身世记录需要查证，也不支配未来的行动。: A record of my origins needs checking. It cannot govern what I do next.
messages.身份可以从当下相识开始，不必等候完整身世。: Someone can begin to know me as I am today, even with parts of my past missing.
messages.身份疑问可以保持开放，当下责任仍能逐步形成。: I can leave questions about my identity open and still begin to take responsibility for things today.
messages.身体会格挡，是谁教过我吗？: My body knows how to guard. Did someone teach me?
messages.身后的低路仍然通着。钟能替六城报时，不能把被添进旧约的名字放出来。你带着原件离开: The low road behind you is still open. The bell can keep time for six cities. It can't free the names added to the old covenant. You take the original out through the Crown gate and head for someone still waiting for news.
messages.转动的轮毂内腔: The rotating inner cavity of the hub
messages.轮值的人自己来领灯，退值的人交回灯架。灯火不再默认属于一个家族。: People on watch come to collect their own lamps. Those leaving hand back the stands. The light no longer belongs to one family by default.
messages.轮值表挂在泵边，答应才写，离开就划掉。灯不该替人宣誓。: The roster hangs by the pump. Names go on with consent and come off when people leave. A lamp can't swear an oath for anyone.
messages.轮到谁之前先问谁；我记得根笼里没人问过我。: Ask people before you put their turn down. I remember how no one asked me in the root cage.
messages.轮毂随时会转。: The hub can turn at any time.
messages.轮盾与返刃保持双招式；利用收招窗口调整位置，再取攀墙能力: Watch for the wheel shield and returning blade. Move during recovery, then collect the wall-climbing ability.
messages.轻一点碰。我压住黑潮的时候，也压住过人声，两者不能因为听起来像就算作一样。: Touch me lightly. I held the Blacktide down. I held people’s voices down too. Sounding alike doesn't make them the same.
messages.辨清军令以后，我知道怎么让那一页停止发令。: Once I'd identified the order, I knew how to stop that page from giving commands.
messages.迁居 ch1 court_hub（东侧苔阶）；late_game / true_: Move to ch1 court_hub (eastern moss steps); late_game / true_ending_branch plays in the new location
messages.迁至 west_gate 门口；after_boss 起在新位置播放: Move to the entrance of west_gate; after_boss plays at the new location
messages.运书吊篮仓保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的声音: Book Transport Hanging Basket Storage: After operating the ability lock, climb to the evidence platform along an independent inspection route to retrieve records and materials.
messages.运书吊篮仓：操作能力闩后沿独立检修路线登上证物台，收取记录与物资。: Book Transport Hanging Basket Storage: After operating the ability lock, climb to the evidence platform along an independent inspection route to retrieve records and materials. The needle rack outside the door provides special skill practice, not consuming permanent exploration abilities.
messages.运书夹层在阶梯口留真实开口，玩家不能穿过实心桥底登楼。: Book Transport Bronze Ring Tram · Return
messages.运书铜环索道已经苏醒，回程通路永久接通。: Book Transport Bronze Ring Tram Traction Ring
messages.近门相位开闩 → 两级跳台 → 上层双奖励 → 落回出口: Phase through the latch → Jump two ledges → Collect both rewards above → Drop back to the exit
messages.返场宝箱和半沉工头支线收束。: Return to the treasure chest and the Half-Drowned Foreman side quest ends.
messages.返程不需要借终点的名义获得正当性。: The journey home needs no excuse borrowed from the destination.
messages.还没查清就先歇一会儿。我一听脚步就问名字，问得你都不敢空手进门了。: It's all right to rest before you've found them. I've asked for names every time I hear footsteps. No wonder you're afraid to come in empty-handed.
messages.还要看脚能落在哪里，下一口气从哪里来。出口只是退路的一头。: I need somewhere to put my feet and a way to draw another breath. An opening is only one end of an escape route.
messages.这一晚是我答应的，不是从前那张军令替我答应；天亮以后，你们再问。: I said yes to tonight. That old order didn't say it for me. Ask me again when day breaks.
messages.这一次你若想停下，我就把这一段留白。: If this is where you'd like to stop, I'll leave the rest blank.
messages.这一次我会记下交给谁，不会只写“已归档”。: This time I'll write down who I give it to, instead of simply saying “filed.”
messages.这不代表从此不缺材料，也不代表你欠下一次交货。: We may run short of supplies again. That doesn't mean you already owe another delivery.
messages.这些工牌都带去书库吗？: Should I take all these work badges to the Archive?
messages.这些木条明明能拆，为什么又钉回去？: These slats come off. Why nail them back on?
messages.这件小衣的领口。名字缝好了，旧线却从扣子里绕了过去，往后一拉还是紧。: This little coat's collar. The name's in, but the old thread runs right through the clasp. Pull it from behind and it still draws tight.
messages.这份署名的抄页你带走，原页在这里留一份。你若发现不一样，回来找我。: Take this signed copy. I'll keep a record of the original here. If anything doesn't match, come back to me.
messages.这份记忆至少能让我在起身之前，再问今天是谁在叫。: At least that memory gives me time, before I get up, to ask who's calling today.
messages.这份证词该放在原件旁边。若两份不一样，请让读者看见不一样。: That testimony belongs beside the original. Where they differ, let the reader see the difference.
messages.这份证词里也有被根抱住的人吗？有的话，告诉他们，伸手的人还没放弃。: Does that testimony tell of others the roots held? If it does, tell them the one reaching out hasn't given up.
messages.这会比一声令慢，但慢一些也得学会。: It'll be slower than giving an order. We'll have to learn to do it anyway.
messages.这副钩索还带着潮气。找准铁环再收线，别拿绳长赌自己的臂力。: Your grapple is still damp. Find an iron ring before you reel it in. Don't wager your grip on the reach of a rope.
messages.这句话先别刻在碑上。去书库查查，到底是谁把后面的线添上去。: Don't carve that on a stone yet. Ask the Archive who drew those later lines.
messages.这回你帮上了，我会记得这是你愿意做的事。: You helped this time. I'll remember it was something you chose to do.
messages.这回我先开后门，再问来处。床还是那么几张，挤一挤吧。: This time I'll open the rear gate first and ask where people came from afterward. Same number of beds. We'll squeeze up.
messages.这回我署名。你带去钟庭，认得名字的人也该看见我做过什么。: I'll sign this time. Take it to Bell Court. Whoever knows those names deserves to see what I did.
messages.这回灯亮后有人没来，我等他自己回光。: Someone didn't come when the lamp went on this time. I waited for their own light to answer.
messages.这回衣领里绣的是愿意守夜的人。愿意离开，也能把线结解开。: The names inside these collars belong to people who volunteered for the watch. If they want to leave, they can untie the knot.
messages.这块湿铜里装着谁的话？念慢一点，我想把它折成能浮起来的形状。: Whose words are in that wet copper? Read them slowly. I want to fold them into something that floats.
messages.这张名单。阿禾旁边还有时岚和舟九，别因为先找到了一个，就把后面折进纸缝。: This list. Beside A-He there are Shilan and Zhoujiu. Don't fold the other names into a crease because you found the first one.
messages.这很好。我守原件，不替它们投票，也不把声音小的压到最底下。: Good. I keep the originals. I don't vote for them or bury the quietest at the bottom.
messages.这批蜡我用来补检修灯，不会再把人封进书皮。: I'll use this wax to mend the maintenance lamps. No more sealing people between book covers.
messages.这是单向坠道——回程走后门升梯。: This is a one-way drop path—use the back door of the ladder for the return journey.
messages.这是单向坠道——回程走水轮泄洪梯。: This is a one-way descent path—the return journey takes you through the waterwheel flood discharge ramp.
messages.这是水窖与迷园唯一的回程。: This is the only way back from the water cellar and the maze garden.
messages.这是沉渠唯一的回程。: This is the only return path for the sink canal.
messages.这束光现在肯跟着你了。穿暗层时把线收稳，出口亮起才松手。: The light will follow you now. Hold the thread steady in the dark layer. Let go when the exit lights up.
messages.这条地面步道是打通后最快的回环。: This ground path is the fastest loop after being opened.
messages.这条支脉通向迷园深处。: This branch leads to the depths of the maze garden.
messages.这条活脉还认得我的手。好，我就当它肯再给园丁一次机会。: This living vein still knows my hand. Good. I'll take it as a second chance for the gardener.
messages.这条缺路终于接上了。收下这只线轴，算我替下一张地图留的路费。: There. The missing stretch of road joins up at last. Take this spool as travelling money toward my next map.
messages.这条辐桥是打通后最快的回环。: This radial bridge is the fastest loop after being cleared.
messages.这枚静钟碎片原来垫在灯架底下。它只让治疗完成后的负面状态积累暂缓，不能抹掉已经受: This Quiet Bell Shard was a shim under a lampstand. It slows status buildup for a while after you finish healing. It won't undo damage you've already taken.
messages.这根送水，那根散热，贴着它的细线才收声。砸下去很快，接回来得有人爬到下面。: This one carries water. That one vents heat. It's the fine thread against it that takes the voices. A pipe breaks in a second. To mend it someone has to climb down there.
messages.这次不把“等下季”刻在门上了。: I won't carve “next season” on this door again.
messages.这次你走过来，线没有拖在地上了。冲刺时留意落脚处，绷直的线不会替你落地。: Your thread didn't drag when you walked up this time. Watch where you'll land before you dash. A taut line can't put your feet on solid ground.
messages.这次我亲口答应守一班。下一班的名字，必须由那个人自己报。: I've agreed to take this shift myself. Whoever takes the next one must give their own name.
messages.这次我只记录签下的名字。注销也要留底，免得退出的人又被编回去。: This time I'll record only the names people sign. I'll keep withdrawals on file too, so no one who leaves gets put back on the roll.
messages.这次抄本我署了名。若还有错，能有人找回我这里。: I've signed the copy this time. If there's a mistake, someone can trace it back to me.
messages.这次的花粉蜡和报酬已经算清；明天谁守灯，明天再谈。: That batch of pollen wax is paid for. Tomorrow we can talk about who tends tomorrow's lamps.
messages.这次追问已记入行囊的「人物」分类。: This exchange is now in your pack under People.
messages.这片区域不是直线，记住回来的门。: These paths loop. Remember which gate leads back.
messages.这盏只告诉人路况；是否往前走，不能由灯替他答。: This lamp tells people how the road lies. It can't decide whether they take it.
messages.这趟取蜡，究竟给谁省了工钱？: Whose wages will this wax errand really save?
messages.这道圆铆是我磨的。阿禾拿坏鞋来找我，说省下的钱得先把孩子的衣领换了。: I rounded off that rivet myself. A-He brought me his worn shoes. Said the money he saved would buy his child a new collar.
messages.这道旧弦出自歌守徽，新箍是园主加的。两样都碰过树心，做的却不是同一件事。: That old string belonged to Hui, the Songwarden. The Gardener added the new hoop. Both touched the heartwood, but they did very different things.
messages.这里是作决定的一处，不是让六城停止生活的句号。: Here is one place to decide. It isn't a full stop on the lives of all six cities.
messages.这里最安静，暗格灯下可以久留。: This place is the quietest, and you can stay under the dim light in the dark compartments for a long time.
messages.这里的歌最终该由谁接下去？: Who should take up the song here in the end?
messages.这里的路只给还会违抗命令的人走。: The path here is only for those who still dare to disobey orders.
messages.这页经过谁的手，又让谁变得不敢报名字？: Through whose hands did this page pass? Who became afraid to give their name because of it?
messages.这颗种子是我唯一能带走的东西。我给它讲外面的路，希望它别再长成笼子。: This seed is all I can take with me. I tell it about the roads outside. I hope it never grows into another cage.
messages.进入竖井后用二段跳穿过盐雾窗口。: Enter the shaft and use a double jump to pass through the salt fog window.
messages.进入被盐晶封住的档案塔，找到王冠契约原本，确认沉默钟声的法律来源。: Enter the archive tower sealed by salt crystals, find the original Crown Contract, and confirm the legal source of the silent bell sounds.
messages.远程压制移动平台。: Remote suppression of the moving platform.
messages.远程和影子混合，复考格挡和迟影。: Remote and shadow mixture, retaking the guard and late shadow.
messages.远程墨弹和召唤页，惩罚错误解谜。: Remote ink bullets and summoning pages, punish incorrect puzzles.
messages.远程弧线投掷，压制狭窄平台上的移动。: Remote arc throwing, suppress movement on the narrow platform.
messages.远程音波会把玩家推离平台。: Remote sound waves push players away from the platform.
messages.远程音波改变空中节奏。: Remote sound waves change the rhythm in the air.
messages.远道的客人，叩一下就好。钟很老，听得见礼貌，听不懂着急。: A single knock will do, traveller. The bell is old. It understands courtesy better than hurry.
messages.连续的身份不要求永远承担同一种角色。: I can still be myself without holding the same post forever.
messages.迟影会在二阶段复制玩家攻击。: Chiying will replicate the player's attacks in the second stage.
messages.迟影会复制上一段移动。: Chiying will replicate the movement from the previous step.
messages.迟影会复制攻击。: The late shadow will copy the attack.
messages.迟影加入，复制玩家最近一次攻击；完美格挡可让迟影击中 Boss。: Chiying joins in, replicating the player's last attack; perfect blocking allows Chiying to hit the Boss.
messages.迟影复写你上一段动作，走折线。: The Delayed Shadow repeats your previous actions and leads you along the broken line.
messages.迟影守着中段之字台，顶层光核会隔空落圈。: The Delayed Shadow guards the middle-shaped platform, and the light core at the top will fall into the circle from afar.
messages.追踪狩猎取得的锈湿爪痕拓片。循着残迹才显形的猎物，不挡主线。 图样可带给雨铸匠制: Rusty wet claw prints obtained from tracking hunts. Follow the traces of prey that are only visible after the prey is destroyed. The pattern can be given to a Rain Foundry Smith to make the "Countertide Spool." The evidence will not be taken away.
messages.追问尚未写入旅记；可以重试，或先离开。: This conversation couldn't be saved to the journal. Try again or leave for now.
messages.退出制度可以与保存经历并存。: Leaving a system can go hand in hand with preserving what happened there.
messages.逃亡书记给出第七签署者真名的一段偏旁。: The Fugitive Scribe provides a snippet of the seventh signer's true name.
messages.逃出来时我带了空纸。后来才明白，空纸也可以是一种证据。: I carried blank paper when I fled. Only later did I realize a blank page can be evidence too.
messages.逃旗手听见旧军号，手指碰到衣角又放下。他留在营地帮人搬水，因为今天有人开口请他，: The deserter hears the old bugle. His fingers touch the hem of his coat, then fall away. He stays in camp to help carry water. Someone asked him today. The muster roll didn't answer for him.
messages.逃旗手在营地听见旧军号，手指摸到已经断开的召回线，又松开。: The deserter hears the old bugle in camp. His fingers find the severed recall thread and let it go again.
messages.逃旗手在轮值旁写了自己的名字，没有把旧军号旁的空位填上。: The deserter signs his own name beside the watch rota. The place beside the old bugle call stays blank.
messages.逃旗手把危险说在请求前面。我先确认自己的退路，没有催他跟上。: The deserter told me of the danger before asking the favour. I checked my retreat first and didn't urge him to follow.
messages.逃旗手把旗卷在膝上。我没有请他举起来给我看。: The deserter kept the flag rolled on his knees. I didn't ask him to lift it up for me.
messages.逃旗手走近军阵仍会踩回旧拍。找到沉默军令交给他辨认，让他自己决定怎样处置召回线。: The Deserter Standard-Bearer approaches the military formation but still steps on the old patterns. Find the Silent Military Order and give it to him to identify, allowing him to decide how to deal with the recall line.
messages.逃离队伍以后，旗还算你的吗？: After deserting, is the flag still yours?
messages.逃走那晚我把旗卷起来了。不是怕被认出，是怕它看见我哭。: I rolled up the flag the night I ran. I wasn't afraid of being recognized. I didn't want it to see me cry.
messages.逆生竖井支线奖励，提高生命或能量成长。: Reward for the Reverse Life Shaft side story, increasing health or energy growth.
messages.选择五个回声室顺序。: Choose the order of five echo chambers.
messages.选择重鸣或断冠；集齐六区证词后可改写契约: Choose Retolling or Crownfall; the contract can be rewritten after collecting the testimony from the six districts
messages.逐层观察藤壁两侧落脚枝，镜头跟随当前高度: Watch for branches on both sides of the vine wall as you climb.
messages.逐层跟随吊架落脚点，不以全井中心固定镜头: Follow the suspended landings one level at a time.
messages.通关后开启二周目红线变体。: After completing the game, the second-round Crimson Thread variant is opened.
messages.通过断续弦桥并取得花粉过滤器。: Obtain the intermittent string bridges and the Pollen Filter.
messages.遗物提供线索，不替主人作证全部人生。: A possession offers clues. It doesn't testify to its owner's whole life.
messages.遗留动作不能单独证明当事人的心愿。: A gesture carried on from the past can't tell me on its own what someone wanted.
messages.那一栏是我没划。我想留住名字，谁知道上面照着人数继续要工。: I never crossed out their names. I meant to keep them. Up above, they kept demanding labour to match the headcount.
messages.那些被删掉的人确实在这里读过书。我关过灯，也记得他们的脸。: The people we erased did read here. I put out the lamps myself. I remember their faces.
messages.那人也在搬东西，我怕他是不好意思拒绝。他说今天只搬这一趟。: That person's moving things too. I was afraid they felt unable to refuse. They said they'd make just this one trip today.
messages.那人坐在门外时，我想问他明天能帮多少活，话到嘴边咽回去了。: When that person sat outside the door, I wanted to ask how much work they could do tomorrow. I swallowed the question.
messages.那份井喉证词，你自己收好。我记性坏，怕把求救的人说成命令的人。: Keep the well-throat testimony safe yourself. My memory's going. I might turn someone crying for help into someone giving an order.
messages.那份召回令我没扔。想站起来时就拿出来，把“离队”两个字再读一遍。: I kept the recall order. When I feel like standing up, I take it out and read “left the ranks” again.
messages.那把椅子不按你带回多少东西算。: You don't have to bring anything back to earn that chair.
messages.那颗心旁边后来多出的人形，就是有人把一天变成了后人的一生。: Those figures added beside the heart are where someone turned a day into a lifetime for the children who came after.
messages.配重暗格挑战房留下的水轮残响。不挡主线，却能证明你敲响过暗格余响钟。: The waterwheel residual sound left by the counterweight compartment in the challenge room. It does not block the main path, but it can prove that you have sounded the chamber's residual sound.
messages.配重暗格，水轮内部上方。: Counterweight compartment, above the waterwheel inside.
messages.配重随水位起落。: Counterweights rise and fall with the water level.
messages.配重首清：取得配重余响证据，并得额外碎钱与材料。: First clear of counterweights: Obtain evidence of the counterweight's residual sound and get extra coins and materials.
messages.重新入队，等待有人兑现让他停下的承诺。: Rejoins the ranks to wait for someone to keep their promise and let him stop.
messages.重新入队；若玩家在终局区域遭遇，须践约将其击败——掉落「未锈的钟壳」（纪念物）: Rejoin the team; if the player encounters them in the final area, they must fulfill the promise to defeat them - drop the "unrusted bell shell" (memorial).
messages.重新成为印记；消失前播告别句：「钟重鸣了；我回去了。别道歉——只是下次路过温室，: Rebecome a mark; say goodbye before disappearing: "The bell rang again; I'm gone. Don't apologize—just be careful when passing by the greenhouse next time." One more string remains in place that no longer trembles (pick up)
messages.重甲盾兵，必须下劈破甲。: Heavy Armored Shield Bearers must slash through armor.
messages.重鸣、断冠、或绯线真结局。: Retolling, Crownfall, or true ending with the Crimson thread.
messages.重鸣了，原页要收回柜里吗？: Now that the bells sound again, will the original page go back in the cabinet?
messages.重鸣以后还查改字的旧案吗？: Will you still investigate the altered wording after the Retolling?
messages.重鸣会救城，断冠会救人，改写契约才会让他们都记得自己是谁。: Retolling can save the city, Crownfall can save people. Only rewriting the contract can make them remember who they are.
messages.重鸣恢复镇潮，也保留了需要继续面对的旧约。: The Retolling holds back the tide again. The old covenant still has to be faced.
messages.重鸣：城市安全但名字仍在钟里。: Retolling: Urban safety but names still in the bell.
messages.针只能证明他做过针线。磨损告诉我常握在哪里，不能告诉我最后一句话。: The needle proves he sewed. Its wear tells me where he usually held it. It can't tell me his last words.
messages.针线可以接回散掉的东西，也可以把人绑住。师父教我先看线的另一头。: Thread can join what fell apart. It can also bind someone tight. Master taught me to look at the other end first.
messages.针脚还没收好，但能等。给我讲一件路上没用的事吧，什么都没换来的那种。: The stitches need finishing, but they can wait. Tell me something useless that happened on the road. Something you got nothing in exchange for.
messages.钉书兵会连段冲撞。: The Bookkeeper will collide in segments.
messages.钉满湿纸的愿板: Wishing boards covered with wet paper
messages.钟不再报时，井口垒起湿沙袋。有人第一次大声喊出邻居的名字，喊得太响，自己先笑了。: The bell no longer reports the time, and wet sandbags are built around the well. Someone loudly calls out the names of their neighbors for the first time, calling too loudly, and they laugh themselves.
messages.钟仍在响，但这一次，每个名字都能回答。: The bell is still ringing, but this time, every name can be answered.
messages.钟仍在响，但这一次，每个名字都能回答。六份证词将世袭改回自愿，镇潮的代价由有名之: The bell still rings. This time, every name can answer. On the strength of six testimonies, hereditary duty becomes voluntary again. The people who now bear their own names will decide how to share the cost of the watch.
messages.钟令恢复，我仍听见被吞下的声音。秩序回来了，条款没有变。: The bell's orders have resumed. I still hear the voices it swallowed. Order has returned. The terms are the same.
messages.钟冠双线仓保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的声音: The work records kept in the double-line warehouse of the bell crown: the facilities were maintained for residents and later changed to transport contracts, military orders and erased voices.
messages.钟冠双线仓：操作能力闩后沿独立检修路线登上证物台，收取记录与物资。: Bell Crest Double Line Warehouse: After operating the ability lock, climb the independent maintenance route to the evidence platform to collect records and materials.
messages.钟又响了，我还认得根扣勒过的地方。不能让下一代再替我们被绑一次。: The bell is ringing again. I still know where the root shackle bit. The next generation can't be bound there in our place.
messages.钟响以后，你还在拆哪一针？: Now that the bell rings, which stitch are you still unpicking?
messages.钟哑了六十五年。先沿能走通的路去雨渠，问清那个等下工钟的孩子在等谁；查到名字，再: The bell has been silent for sixty-five years. Find a way to the rain canal and ask the child at the shift bell who they're waiting for. Once you have a name, return to Bell Court.
messages.钟坠从渠顶松脱。: The bell pendant has come loose from the top of the canal.
messages.钟壁铸入过活人名字。: Names of living people are cast into the bell wall.
messages.钟声到达巷口: A Bell at the End of the Lane
messages.钟声回来了，名字还在钟里。: The bell sound returns, and the names remain in the bell.
messages.钟声回来了，名字还在钟里。你恢复了镇潮秩序，也让旧契约继续生效。: The bells ring again. The names remain inside them. You restored the tideworks and renewed the old covenant.
messages.钟声回来后，你又得站回去吗？: Now the bells are back, do you have to take your place again?
messages.钟声把那根弦又拉紧了。镇潮还在，留给后人的嗓子却仍被抵押。: The bell pulled that string tight again. The tide is still held back, but our children's voices are still pledged.
messages.钟声盖过了翻页声。书里那句自愿，仍没成为我们的日子。: The bell drowns out the turning pages. That word “voluntary” still only exists on paper for us.
messages.钟壳格挡不是盾，是让敌人的誓言撞回自己身上。: The shell is not a shield. It is an oath that the enemy will crush itself.
messages.钟壳格挡练习工房保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去: Work records saved in the Bell Shell Guard Practice Workshop: The facility was once maintained for residents, later converted to transport contracts, military orders, and voices that were erased.
messages.钟壳格挡练习工房：完成能力动作后穿过专属立体检修路线，收回两件物资并安全退出。: Bell Shell Guard Practice Workshop: After completing an ability action, traverse the exclusive inspection route to retrieve two materials and exit safely.

Bell Shell Guard Practice Workshop: After completing an ability action, traverse the exclusive inspection route to retrieve two materials and exit safely. The needle stand outside the door provides special skill practice without consuming permanent exploration abilities.
messages.钟壳滚撞: Bell shells roll into each other.
messages.钟摆车间，执剪者倒下后开启；解锁钩环门。: Pendulum workshop, the cutter falls and opens the door; unlock the Hookchain Chamber.
messages.钟摆随时可能复摆。: The pendulum may swing back at any time.
messages.钟火墓坡1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Bellfire Burial Slope 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.钟火墓坡2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Bellfire Burial Slope 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.钟火墓坡3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Bellfire Burial Slope 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.钟火墓坡4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Bellfire Burial Slope 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.钟火墓坡5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Bellfire Burial Slope 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.钟火墓坡6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Bellfire Burial Slope 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.钟火墓坡7：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Bellfire Burial Slope 7. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.钟管所有人的时辰，我只答应补这一盏。蜡的用处不能替我多签一回。: The bell keeps everyone's time. I agreed to mend this one lamp. You can't take the wax as my signature on another.
messages.钟网停下，泵只能轮班手摇。开口说话的人也得先商量谁守夜。: The bell network's down. We'll have to take turns working the pump by hand. Now that we can speak, the first thing to settle is who takes the night watch.
messages.钟网停了，我把低架的书搬高。能说话以后，更要把失去的东西记清。: With the network down, I'm moving the books off the low shelves. Now that we can speak, we need a careful record of what we've lost.
messages.钟网停了，旧试音管还在；我们得商量它还能怎样传消息。: The bell network has stopped, but the old tuning pipes are still here. We'll have to decide together how else they might carry news.
messages.钟网稳定了，外箍就能放心留着吗？: The bell network is stable now. Is it safe to leave the outer hoops on?
messages.钟网重新稳定，黑潮退回井下，后人仍被旧契约束缚。: The bell network steadies. The Blacktide retreats beneath the well. The covenant still binds those yet to come.
messages.钟舌停了，声音归人。潮水不会因我们自由就自行退去。: The clapper has stopped. Our voices are ours again. The water won't retreat just because we're free.
messages.钟舌库地面留着一枚可选的冠下回声碎片；拿走不影响前路。库底向西可折回西环廊，向东: There's an optional Crown Echo Shard on the floor of the Bell Tongue Vault. Taking it won't affect the road ahead. From the bottom, head west to the ring gallery or east to the throne vestibule.
messages.钟舌库挑战房留下的钟舌残响。不挡主线，却能证明你敲响过库底余响钟。 图样可带给雨: Bell Clapper Remnants left by the Challenge Room in the Bell Clapper Vault. It does not block the main storyline, but it can prove that you have struck the remaining bell in the vault. The pattern can be given to the Rain Foundry Smith to make the Clapper Tuning Weight. The evidence will not be taken away.
messages.钟舌库没有敌人，灯下可以缝补；库底黑潮的声音最近。: The Bell Clapper Vault has no enemies; one can mend here under the light. The sound of the Black Tide is nearby in the vault.
messages.钟舌库的常明灯，下环与王座的支点。: The constant light in the Bell Clapper Vault, the support for the lower ring and the throne.
messages.钟舌首清：取得钟舌余响证据，并得额外碎钱与材料。图样可带给雨铸匠制作「冠舌调线坠: Bell Clapper First Clear: Obtain evidence of Bell Clapper Residues, gain extra coins and materials. The pattern can be given to the Rain Foundry Smith to make the “Clapper Tuning Weight.” The evidence will not be taken away.
messages.钟轮守着营地东口；听完骑士的话，再越过石台迎战。: The Crown Tongue guards the east entrance of the camp; after listening to the knight's words, cross the stone platform to face the battle.
messages.钟还会响，却不能再替一个未出生的人签字。每次轮值都得重新答应。: The bell can ring. It can no longer sign for an unborn child. Every watch shift needs a fresh yes.
messages.钟重新响了，衣领里的名字呢？: The bells are ringing again. What about the names inside the collars?
messages.钟隙深不见底。: The bell gap is deep and bottomless.
messages.钟骨吊运停摆，铜环仍连接旧检修支线。: The bell bone suspension has stopped working, and the copper ring is still connected to the old maintenance branch line.
messages.钟骨吊运台保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的声音: Work records saved on the Bell Bone Lifting Platform: The facility was once maintained for residents, later converted to transport contracts, military orders, and voices that were erased.
messages.钟骨吊运台：操作能力闩后沿独立检修路线登上证物台，收取记录与物资。: Bell Bone Lifting Platform: After operating the ability lock, climb the independent maintenance route to the evidence platform to collect records and materials.
messages.钟髓封蜡室保存的工作记录：设施曾为居民维护，后来改为输送契约、军令和被抹去的声音: Work records saved in the Bell Marrow Wax Chamber: The facility was once maintained for residents, later converted to transport contracts, military orders, and voices that were erased.
messages.钟髓封蜡室：操作能力闩后沿独立检修路线登上证物台，收取记录与物资。: Bell Marrow Wax Chamber: After operating the ability lock, climb the independent maintenance route to the evidence platform to collect records and materials.
messages.钟龛为何还保留旧试音的口子？: Why keep the old tuning opening in the shrine?
messages.钟龛会记录你的归处。: The bell shrine will record your destination.
messages.钟龛会记录你的归处。 可见旧检修入口：「排水计时闸」。Shift 冲刺拨开计时栅: The niche records your return. The old maintenance entrance can be seen: "Drain Time Gate". Shift Dash to open the time gate lock.
messages.钟龛内可整备；门后才是守母的领域。: The niche can be prepared inside; behind the door is the domain of the matriarch.
messages.钥位为什么原来分成几列？: Why were the key positions originally in separate rows?
messages.钥匙的磨痕能留在硬处，声音却会在管子里变得像另一段声音。: Wear marks stay on a hard key. In a pipe one voice can come to sound like another.
messages.钥匙能让你转动一处机关，不能替所有被它牵住的人同意。: A key lets you turn a mechanism. It can't consent for everyone bound to it.
messages.钩住钩环与雨溢立管的回访路线。钟摆车间停摆后留下的战利品。: Route back to the Hookchain Chamber after hooking the hookchain and the rain overflow riser. Trophies left after the pendulum workshop stops swinging.
messages.钩住铃环，不要太早钩飞行敌人。: Hook the bell ring, don't hook flying enemies too early.
messages.钩是不是旧习惯，得找别的凭据。你若愿意，下次把不会的也拿来，我们一起试，别总挑会: Old habit or not, you'll need more evidence. Bring something you don't know how to use next time. We'll try it together. Don't always choose what you're good at to prove who you are.
messages.钩环链暗室，钩索门后。: Hookchain Chamber, behind the hookchain door.
messages.钩索打断和水位压迫复考。: Hooked Snares Break and Water Pressure Retake
messages.钩索能带你越过水轮缝，也能挂住远处的环。别把我的船当环。: Your grapple can carry you across the waterwheel gap or catch a ring a long way off. Don't mistake my boat for a ring.
messages.钩过链隙取回工牌。: Get the work badge by passing through the chain gap.
messages.钱结清了，灯也补了。这回算清，下一回你才敢再来。: The bill is settled and the lamp is mended. Settle it properly now and you won't dread coming back next time.
messages.钻入排水钟管，前往铸雨渠。: Drill into the Bell Drainpipe and head to the Rain Foundry Canal.
messages.铁匠印记在泵王心口，不在旧柜里。: The blacksmith’s mark is on the Pump King’s heart, not in the old cabinet.
messages.铁匠承认自己把一批活人名字铸进王冠，只有盐白书库保存谁下令的原文。: The blacksmith admitted that he cast the names of some living people into the crown. Only the Saltwhite Archive preserves the original text of who ordered it.
messages.铁匠誓牌打开盐晶门厅，白色封蜡在门上拼出缺角的王冠徽记。: Smith's Oath Plate opens the Salt Crystal Foyer, and white sealing wax forms a missing-crown emblem on the door.
messages.铁匠誓牌记录第七个签署者的徽记，但名字被盐刮掉。: The Smith's Oath Plate records the emblem of the seventh signer, but the name has been scraped off by salt.
messages.铁匠说钟声本该把黑潮压回井底。: The blacksmith said that the bell sound should have pressed the black tide back to the bottom of the well.
messages.铁水浮渣会周期上升，站太久会被烫回平台边缘。: The iron slag will rise periodically, and staying too long will burn you back to the edge of the platform.
messages.铃护的裂纹很漂亮，说明它已经替你接过一次坏消息。不要只把它当新工具。: What a lovely crack in your bell guard. It means the guard has already taken a piece of bad news for you. It's more than a new tool now.
messages.铃护能让你多等一拍。那一拍不是给敌人的，是给你看清下一刀的。: Bell Guard buys you an extra beat. That beat is yours to see the next cut coming.
messages.铃锤可以传，换班时辰也可以教；答应献出的东西，不能夹在工具里一并交下去。: Pass on a bell hammer. Teach the change of watch. But you can't tuck what you agreed to give up among the tools you hand down.
messages.铆钉还认得锤面。我会把名字记回账上；这只防潮结你带着。: The rivet still knows the face of my hammer. I'll put the names back in the ledger. Take this damp-proof knot.
messages.铜墙还认得你的脚。别急着往炉底去，先沿检修路看看上游。: The copper wall still knows your tread. Leave the bottom of the furnace for now. Follow the maintenance path upstream first.
messages.铜徽章修好了，工人的名字仍要带回钟庭。司铸契印不是谁赐下的权力，是他们留下的承力: The copper badge is mended. The workers' names still need to go home to Bell Court. The Foundry Seal is how they learned to bear a load. No one bestowed that power on them.
messages.铜根不再催拍，我还是会自己接上下一句。: The copper roots no longer hurry the beat. I still find myself starting the next line.
messages.铜根主教倒下，外箍不会自己松开。: The Copperroot Bishop has fallen. The outer hoop won't open by itself.

messages.铜根主教战败后交出活封面根脉，黑曜巡礼军听见印记断裂并打开外环道路。: After the Copperroot Bishop is defeated, he surrenders the Living Bookcover Vein. The Obsidian Pilgrim Army hears the broken mark and opens the outer path.
messages.铜根主教掉落的章节奖励。: Chapter rewards dropped by the Copperroot Bishop.
messages.铜根主教沉入根井后，温室外墙裂开，黑曜巡礼道的号角从雾里传来。: After the Copperroot Bishop sinks into the root well, the wall outside the greenhouse cracks, and the bugle of the Obsidian Pilgrim Road comes from the fog.

messages.铸坊最后的水轮守卫守着沉炉大厅。: The last waterwheel guard of the casting workshop guards the Sunken Furnace Hall.
messages.铸渣滑道通向黑曜巡礼路——现在还封着。: The slag slideway leads to the Obsidian Pilgrim Road—it is still closed.
messages.铸钟时，工匠们把自己的名字留在水声里。: When casting bells, the artisans leave their names in the sound of water.
messages.铸钟材料包含活人名字，封印建立在牺牲上。: The materials for casting bells contain the names of living people, and the seals are established on sacrifices.

messages.铸雨外渠: The outside canal of the rain foundry
messages.铸雨外渠低桥: Cast rain outer canal low bridge
messages.铸雨外渠的水轮仍按旧班表转动，NPC 说明旧王朝曾把人的名字和声音铸进钟壁。: The water wheel of the rain foundry outside canal still rotates according to the old schedule. NPC explanations indicate that the old dynasty once cast the names and voices of people into the bell walls.
messages.铸雨渠 自动生成灰盒: Rain Foundry Canal Automatically Generated Gray Box
messages.铸雨渠 自动生成灰盒：自动生成灰盒入口。: Rain Foundry Canal Automatically Generated Gray Box: Automatically generated gray box entrance.
messages.铸雨渠怪物身上脱落的湿冷甲片。: Wet and cold armor pieces fallen off the monsters in the Rain Foundry Canal.
messages.链隙下就是深渊。: The abyss lies below the chain gap.
messages.锈冠守卫体内仍带余温的金属碎片。: The rusty crown guards still have metal fragments that retain warmth inside.
messages.锈冠殿后方的排水钟管被打开，潮湿铁声把你带向铸雨渠。: The Drainpipe behind the Rustcrown Hall has been opened, and the damp iron sound leads you to the Rain Foundry Canal.
messages.锈泵修女编的防潮线结，地面移动速度提高5%；不增加跳高。: The Rustpump Sister's damp-proof knot increases the ground movement speed by 5%; does not increase the high jump ability.
messages.锈湿爪印往水表回廊去。: Rusty wet claw prints head towards the Gauge Gallery.
messages.锈蚀的仪仗残骸: Rusted remains of the ceremonial equipment.
messages.错页会召出抄写手。: The wrong page will summon the scribe.
messages.锤声停了，吊架才肯静止。: The hammer sound stops, and the suspension is finally still.
messages.锤子不会替人后悔。所以每一锤前，我都再看一眼握着什么。: A hammer can't feel regret for you. I look at what I'm holding before every blow.
messages.镇潮与封声的最后执行者: The last executor of tide suppression and sealing sounds
messages.镇潮与锁住人声能分开吗？: Can holding back the tide be separated from locking up people's voices?
messages.镇潮仍需要劳动和维护。新约必须不断得到同意，不能靠巡礼者一次签字永远成立。: The tideworks still need labour and upkeep. The new covenant needs continuing consent. A single signature from the Pilgrim can't bind everyone forever.
messages.镜刃斜射后侧移影刺，半血后的迟影留在旧落点。: After the mirror blade is slanted, the late shadow remains at the old landing point with half a blood level.

messages.镜池安静之后，这条规矩更得说清。: Now Mirrorpool is quiet, we need to make that rule clearer still.
messages.镜池安静了，今晚还会有人怕黑。: Mirrorpool is quiet. Tonight someone will still be afraid of the dark.
messages.镜池安静了，山路还很长。现在经过她的门，可以放轻脚步，不用再握紧刀。: Mirrorpool is quiet. The mountain road is still long. You can tread softly past her door now, with your hand off your blade.
messages.镜池新娘交出沉默军令，说明王冠核心需要愿意拒绝命令的人才能进入。: The Mirrorpool Bride hands over the Silent Military Order, indicating that the Crown's core requires someone willing to refuse orders to enter.
messages.镜池新娘倒下以后，我们终于不必靠下一声命令结束上一声。: With the Mirrorpool Bride down, at last it needn't take another order to end the last one.
messages.镜池新娘倒下，终于能把记录与命令分开。: With the Mirrorpool Bride down, we can finally separate a record from an order.
messages.镜池新娘倒下，路口仍要有人说明哪里能回头。: The Mirrorpool Bride has fallen. Crossroads still need someone who can point out the way back.
messages.镜池新娘停下了，我可以只念完，不再等一句到。: Now the Mirrorpool Bride has stopped, I can read the names to the end without waiting for a “present.”
messages.镜池新娘掉落的章节奖励。: The chapter rewards dropped by the Mirrorpool Bride.
messages.镜池新娘的军令化作黑曜钥纹，王冠核心的无声门终于张开。: The Mirrorpool Bride's military order turns into a Obsidian key pattern, and the Silent Gate at the core of the crown finally opens.
messages.镜池的军令停了，我还会逐盏核对灯号。: The orders at Mirrorpool have ceased. I'll still check the signals lamp by lamp.
messages.镜池的命令断了，我仍得练习不在每一声响里立刻起身。: The order at Mirrorpool is broken. I still need to practise not springing to my feet at every sound.
messages.镜池的门开了，我也得学着少替人选一条路。: Mirrorpool Gate is open. I have to learn to choose a little less of other people's roads for them.
messages.镜池门前的检查点，死亡回跑很短。: The checkpoint in front of the Mirrorpool Gate has a short death run.
messages.镜池门开了？我想把这面旗拿去洗一洗。上面留下的不该只有胜败。: Mirrorpool Gate is open? I'd like to wash this flag. There's more than victory and defeat that ought to remain on it.
messages.镜面不再替她争辩。我把灯留在池边，等她终于愿意看见水里的自己。: The mirror is done arguing her case. I'll leave a lamp by the pool for when she's ready to look at herself in the water.

messages.长坠之前最后的休息位。: The last rest position before the long fall.
messages.长堤遭遇后在炉前休整，先辨认Boss入口再封门: Rest before the furnace after the fight on the embankment. Locate the boss entrance before the gate shuts.
messages.长堤重怪硬吃不亏——绕背打。: The long embankment monsters can handle the heavy hit—hit from behind.
messages.长按相位拨开影闩，再沿两层维护台取回记录；落回底道可返回入口。: Long-press Phase to open the shadow lock, then retrieve the record along the two-layer maintenance platform; falling back to the bottom path allows returning to the entrance.
messages.长枪压制，要求绕背或相位前置。: Long spear suppression requires covering the back or pre-positioning the phase.
messages.长的是水位，短的是换班。别混在一起，我以前就混过。: The long ones are water levels. The short ones are shift changes. Don't mix them up. I did that once.
messages.长眠；原位替换为「完整庭院图」拾取点（全图揭示，兑现地图残页描述效果）: Long sleep; replaced with "Complete Courtyard Map" pick-up point (revealed throughout the map, fulfilling the description of the Map Fragment).
messages.门体倒下后，仍可以回去完成未尽的事。: Even once the gate falls, you can go back to things you've left unfinished.
messages.门体倒下后，你仍然可以不回答下一声。: Even with the gate down, you can let the next call go unanswered.
messages.门体倒下后，你有机会选择怎样继续。: With the gate down you have a chance to choose what to do next.
messages.门体倒下后，我想让回声继续有回头的部分。: Now the gate is down, I'd like the echo to keep the part that turns back.
messages.门体已开，猜测仍是猜测。: The gate is open. A guess is still a guess.
messages.门体已开，能够核对的路就在前面。: The gate stands open. The roads you can now examine lie before you.
messages.沿左侧铜踏板向上，穿过顶端栅桥回到水窖环廊。: Climb the bronze steps on the left and jump through the top grate to reach the Cistern Ring.
messages.在冲刺门前沿铜踏板左右侧跳，可从顶部缺口返回水窖环廊。: Before the Dash Gate, jump from side to side up the bronze steps. The opening above leads back to the Cistern Ring.
messages.门前又按旧钟放行。我会记下那些没有资格回答的孩子。: The gate opens to the old bell again. I'll keep a record of the children who never had a say.
messages.门后安全落脚，短跳取宝: Land safely beyond the gate and make a short jump to the treasure.
messages.门后就是执剪者的领域。: Behind the door is the cutter's domain.
messages.门后的空处我会补进去，但不会把所有路都画成朝它跪下。: I'll fill in the space behind the gate. I won't make every road on the page kneel toward it.
messages.门已开，重鸣和断冠都能由你明确选。若要改约，空着那一处仍得找回来。: The gates are open. You can choose Retolling or Crownfall. To rewrite the covenant, you still need to bring back the missing testimony.
messages.门已经能过。我仍把井壁的新刻痕带在身上，准备去问书库里的人。: The gate is passable now. I still carry a copy of the newer marks to ask about in the Archive.
messages.门开了，可以让更多人来看，不必只靠你带一片出去。: The gate is open. More people can come to see them now. They needn't depend on you taking one away.
messages.门开了，潮水也没有人替我们挡。我留下来帮行人垫高路面。: The gate is open, and no one's holding back the tide for us. I'll stay and help the travellers raise the road.
messages.门开以后我仍会在这里看路，但今天是我自己决定留下。: I'll still watch the road after the gate opens. Today I'm here because I chose to stay.
messages.门开以后，我想出去问问还记得他的人。也许只问得到一件小事。: When the gate opens, I'd like to go and ask people who still remember him. I might only learn one small thing.
messages.门开以后，潮声更近了。你答应谁，就得记得回哪一个身边。: The tide sounds closer now the door is open. Whoever you make a promise to, remember whom to return to.
messages.门开的声音很轻。我以为它会责备我，原来只是锈在说话。: The door opened so quietly. I thought it might have words for me. Turns out it was only the rust talking.
messages.门是我走出来的。钟里还有别人的约，我不能说他们也已经出来。: I walked out that door myself. There are other people's promises in that bell. I can't say they've walked out too.
messages.门边的朝圣者没有替守母作答。我也只记下井壁上能看见的两次刻痕。: The pilgrim by the gate would not speak for the Matriarch. I recorded only the two different cuts I could see on the well wall.
messages.闩门只封住下层通道；开启后先跳上低台，再登高台。奖励台可原路落回出口。: The lock only seals the lower channel; after opening, first jump onto the lower platform, then onto the higher platform. The reward platform can return to the exit via the same route.
messages.问一句他能不能改道，再看我会不会放他走，差别就出来了。: Ask whether they can change direction. Watch whether I let them go. There's your difference.
messages.问得好。我原来打算把你的路钱压进下一笔买卖里，听起来像谁也不欠谁。: Fair question. I meant to fold your travel costs into our next trade and make it sound as if no one owed anyone.
messages.问这一句，也包括问你和我。: That question goes for you and me too.
messages.闸厅拉杆能接通后门升梯。先清水窖的守卫，再开捷径；歇处就在钟龛。: The sluice lever connects the rear lift. Clear the cistern guards before opening the shortcut. There's a place to rest at the Bell Shrine.
messages.闸口上沿的检修缝可以跳进去。: The maintenance slit on the gate edge allows jumping in.
messages.闸齿锈刺外露。: The gate teeth are rusted and exposed.
messages.闸齿间歇开合。: The gate teeth open and close intermittently.
messages.闻闻这块蜡，像不像暖天？这城里少见暖天，所以我把它们做成一小罐一小罐。: Smell the wax. Remind you of a warm day? We don't get many here, so I put them up in little jars.
messages.阀上刻了两种记号，正因为活人和炉火都需要水。: The valve has two sets of marks precisely because living people and the furnace both need water.
messages.阀边的划痕，是你记的水位？: Are those scratches by the valve your water marks?

messages.队列冲锋覆盖半场。: The queue charge covers half of the field.
messages.防潮柜还用，第二道封蜡不补。旧约正在执行，原字更得有人看。: We'll still use the damp-proof cabinet. I won't renew the second wax seal. While the old covenant is in force, people have all the more need to see the original words.
messages.阿禾、时岚、舟九。我先念一遍，你听听有没有漏。: A-He. Shilan. Zhoujiu. I'll say them once. Tell me if I miss anyone.
messages.阿禾、时岚、舟九。还有一个字我认不准，留了空框。别替我描成一个像的字。: A-He, Shilan, Zhoujiu. There's one character I can't make out. I've left a square for it. Don't fill it with something that looks close.
messages.阿禾嫌它刮破领口，来找我磨了两回。第二回没带钱，给我堵了半天漏水的管。: A-He said it tore his collar. I filed it down for him twice. The second time he couldn't pay, so he spent half a day patching my leaky pipe.
messages.阿禾的名字就在旁边，我不肯拆错。你带回来的那张纸，我每天还要看。: A-He's name is right beside it. I won't risk picking the wrong stitch. I still look at the sheet you brought back every day.
messages.阿禾的名字已经缝好。新来的人想照这个样子做，我先问他自己的名字。: A-He's name is finished. Someone new wanted the same design. First I asked for their own name.
messages.阿禾的孩子也能念。可我不叫他来干活抵这一声，工位缺人是我们另要商量的事。: A-He's child can say them too. I won't ask them to work to pay for that voice. An empty workstation is something else we have to settle together.
messages.阿禾那枚不用再猜。剩下有认不准的，我会去找人，不拿新号压住。: No guessing needed for A-He's. For the rest, if I'm unsure, I'll find someone who knows. No new number stamped over it.
messages.阿禾？我抄过一份名单，上面没有这个名字。你说雨渠还有孩子记得他？: A-He? I copied a list once. That name wasn't on it. You say a child at the canal remembers him?
messages.降低盐刺和迟影机关的容错压力。: Reduce the fault tolerance of the salt spines and Chiying mechanisms.
messages.陪伴等待的人，也要允许不知道答案。: To sit with someone who's waiting, I must be willing not to know the answer.
messages.隐藏存档点藏在回声苔灯后。: Hidden save points are hidden behind the Echo Moss Lamp.
messages.隐藏存档点藏在墓碑后。 余响钟可开启挑战房。: The hidden save point is hidden behind the tombstone. The Echoing Bell can be opened in the Challenge Room.
messages.隐藏存档点藏在暗格书堆后。: Hidden archive points are hidden behind the Sealed Stacks.
messages.隐藏存档点藏在蜡壁后。 余响钟可开启挑战房。: Hidden save point hidden behind the wax wall. The residual bell can be used to open the challenge room.
messages.隙底即深渊。: The bottom of the crack is the abyss.
messages.集齐五枚失声印记与沉默军令后进入王冠核心，补全第六枚印记，决定钟声命运。: Gather five Silent Markings and the Silent Military Order to enter the Crown core, complete the sixth marking, and decide the fate of the bell sounds.
messages.集齐五章证词和第七真名后，用王冠共鸣改写契约，让钟声只封黑潮、不再吞人声。: Gather five testimonies and the seventh true name, then use Crown Resonance to rewrite the contract, so the bell only seals the Black Tide and no longer absorbs voices.
messages.雨从这里入渠；整章的路就是水的路。: Rain enters the canal from here; the entire path is a path of water.
messages.雨会偷走你的跳跃，买一枚防潮线结会轻松些。: Rain will steal your jumps. Buying a Damp-Proof Knot will make things easier.
messages.雨栅长堤检修台；首访无需自身能力。回到渡槽立管可进书库。: Rain Grate Embankment Maintenance Platform; the first visit does not require your own ability. Return to the canal stand to enter the library.
messages.雨棚廊桥1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Covered Rain Bridge 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.雨棚廊桥2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Covered Rain Bridge 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.雨棚廊桥3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Covered Rain Bridge 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.雨棚廊桥4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Covered Rain Bridge 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.雨棚廊桥5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Covered Rain Bridge 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.雨棚廊桥6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Covered Rain Bridge 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.雨棚廊桥7：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Covered Rain Bridge 7. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.回渡槽钟龛时，在坡顶向左跳回检修缝。: For the Aqueduct Shrine, jump left at the top of the ramp into the service passage.
messages.雨渠入口: The entrance to the rain canal
messages.雨渠入口、铸雨外渠、管工休息间等区域: Areas such as the rain canal entrance, Cast Rain Outer Canal, and Pipe Worker Rest Room
messages.雨渠的孩子记得阿禾，书库的登记却说没有这个人。把孩子的证言与契约原件交给书记核对: The child by the canal remembers A-He, but the Archive has no record of him. Take the child's account and the original covenant to the scribe. Bring the names you find back to Bell Court.
messages.雨还没停，你先站进檐下。这里的规矩很简单：湿的人有地方坐。: Still raining. Come under the eaves. The rule here is simple: if you're wet, there's a seat for you.
messages.雨铸渠的工匠名字: The names of the craftsmen of the Rain Foundry Canal
messages.需要丝壁攀附（铸雨渠）。: Silk Wall Grip is required for the Rain Foundry Canal.
messages.需要丝壁攀附；井顶通向水塔。: Need Silk Wall Grip; the top of the well leads to the water tower.
messages.需要双线跃（盐白档案馆）才能跃上风口。: Double Thread Jump is needed to jump to the windy area of the Saltwhite Archive.
messages.需要棘线下劈（断弦温室）。: Thorn Downstrike is required for the Broken String Greenhouse.
messages.需要灯影相位（黑曜巡礼路）。: Lantern Phase is necessary for the Obsidian Pilgrim Road.
messages.需要王冠共鸣（寂冠核心）；门后是深井黑潮与第一份证词。: Crown Resonance is required for the Silent Crown Core; behind the door is a Deep Well Black Tide and the first testimony.
messages.需要绯线冲刺。 可见旧检修入口：「纺线检修仓」。贴住门壁按跳跃，墙跳拨开检修闩。: Crimson Dash is required. The old maintenance entrance can be seen: "Thread Maintenance Warehouse". Press against the door wall and jump, wall jump to open the maintenance lock.
messages.需要绯线冲刺。 循齐残迹后可敲响猎物余响钟。: Need Crimson Thread Dash. Follow the remaining traces to sound the prey's residual sound.
messages.需要绯线冲刺；机械本身是路。: Need Crimson Dash; the machinery is part of the path.
messages.需要绯线冲刺；渡过后可直落冠后宝库。: Crimson Dash is required; after crossing, you can directly reach the Crown Treasury.
messages.青色是你，金色改为战利品提示，琥珀色是机关，红色是首领。: Blue is you, gold is changed to loot prompts, amber is mechanisms, and red is the leader.
messages.青铜长梯与水线刻度: Bronze ladder and water line scale
messages.静音校场，多层破旗平台，左右各有短时影门。: Silent Training Ground, multiple layers of flag-breaking platforms, with short shadow gates on both sides.
messages.静音统帅交出沉默军令，说明王冠核心需要愿意拒绝命令的人才能进入。: The Silent Commander hands over the Silent Military Order. Only someone willing to disobey an order, the commander explains, can enter the Crown's core.
messages.静默外壳、王冠前厅、钟庭回声室等区域: Silent Shell, Crown Foyer, Bell Court Echo Chamber and other areas
messages.面对共同危机仍要保留个体退出的边界。: A danger that faces us all still leaves each person the right to step away.
messages.页上的人能要求不被公开吗？: Can someone named on a page ask to keep it private?
messages.顶上的根越来越低——快到了。: The roots above are getting lower—we're almost there.
messages.顶着雨幕横越长堤。: Cross the embankment under the rain curtain.
messages.顶阁暗格里积着的苔壳，可选探索奖励。: The Bell Loft Compartment is filled with Moss Shells, which can be explored for optional rewards.
messages.顶阁边缘狭窄，风势不稳。: The edge of the Bell Loft is narrow, and the wind is unstable.
messages.顺出水口东行，前往盐白书库。: Head east along the water outlet, towards the Saltwhite Archive.
messages.顺序不影响真假。每一处都留有回去的路。: Their order has no bearing on their truth. From each place there's a road back.
messages.顺核心竖井受控下坠，直到钟舌库。: Controlled descent along the Core Shaft towards the Bell Clapper Vault.
messages.顺水跑，逆水用冲刺补位；水面有亮线时代表下一段推流即将增强。: Run with the current, use a dash to compensate for the reverse direction; bright lines on the water surface indicate that the next section of the flow will be enhanced.
messages.顺滑页井坠入封存书堆。: Slipping page shaft falls into the Sealed Stacks.
messages.顺石渠缓坡到锈泵中庭。河两岸的桥可以走，管洞要低头；下层还有一条回路。: Follow the stone channel down to the Rust Pump Court. You can cross between the banks on the bridges. Duck in the pipes. There's another way round below.
messages.顺缆车枕木一路向上，爬回巡礼营地。: Follow the cable car sleepers upwards, climbing back to the Pilgrim Camp.
messages.顺缆降索道逐级坠回山根。: The Descent Cableway descends step by step back to the mountain path.
messages.顺闸锁逐级下行。: Descend step by step through the sluice lock.
messages.顺阶下落时保持脚下下一块苗床可见: As you drop down the steps, keep the next seedbed in sight.
messages.须先在另一端唤醒旧机关。: You must first awaken the old mechanism at the other end.
messages.预先揭示一个区域的房间轮廓。残页背面画着水轮的剖面。: A room outline of a region is revealed in advance. The back of the fragment depicts a cross-section of a water wheel.
messages.预先揭示一个区域的房间轮廓。残页边缘写着看不懂的钟文。: A room outlines a region that has been revealed in advance. The fragment edges have unreadable bell script.
messages.风从冠上来。跳下去吧，线会接住你——它记得这条路。: The wind comes off the Crown. Jump. The thread will catch you. It remembers this way.
messages.风切尖塔1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Windshear Spire 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.风切尖塔2：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Windshear Spire 2. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.风切尖塔3：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Windshear Spire 3. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.风切尖塔4：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Windshear Spire 4. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.风切尖塔5：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Windshear Spire 5. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.风切尖塔6：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Windshear Spire 6. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.风切尖塔7：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Windshear Spire 7. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.
messages.飞行干扰钩索时机，逼玩家先处理空中威胁。: Timing of the flying interference hook rope, forcing players to deal with aerial threats first.
messages.首次取得无需自身能力。站上裂纹封板，跳起后按下方向 + 攻击，下劈破开。: The first acquisition does not require your own ability. Stand on the cracked sealing plate, press the direction + attack after jumping, and strike downward to break through.
messages.首领门前的稳定检查点，死亡回跑很短。: A stable checkpoint in front of the boss door, with a short death runback.
messages.香灰落圈: Incense ash falls into a circle
messages.驻守闸厅的后门司铃人，以钟礼三法「鸣、叩、息」归类庭院里的一切动作。: The sacristan at the sluice hall sees every act in the court through three bell rites: toll, knock and rest.
messages.骑士没有继续往下念。我在那一声停顿里，听见了他不敢承认的回答。: The knight stopped reading out the names. In that single pause I heard the answer he couldn't admit.
messages.骑士说到“怕”时，把白纱攥得更紧。我没有伸手替他解开。: At the word “afraid” the knight gripped the white veil more tightly. I didn't reach for his hand to undo it.
messages.高书架之间留有跳距，别踩碎散页。: There is a jump space between the high bookshelves. Don't crush the slip pages.
messages.高位水塔顶的封存立管口，ch3 湿书地窖重做后开通。: The sealing pipe at the top of the Upper Water Tower, opened after reworking the wet book cellar.
messages.高位水塔顶，湿墙门后。: Behind the wet wall door at the top of the Upper Water Tower.
messages.高兴和想念可以一起在，不用挑一个给你当答复。: I can be glad and miss them at the same time. I don't have to choose one for my answer to you.
messages.高处没有等着我想起的脸。我先把脚下的台沿记进图里。: There was no face waiting for me to remember up high. I marked the lip of the ledge on my map instead.
messages.高处看不到的细痕，还得落下来慢慢看。: For the fine marks you miss from up high, you'll have to come back down and take your time.
messages.高处风大，花粉成浪。: The wind is strong at high altitudes, and the pollen forms waves.
messages.高灯与低灯都接上了。以后往返只要认灯，不必跟着军号。: Both the high and low lamps are connected. From now on, travellers can follow the lights in either direction and leave the bugle alone.
messages.高空悬廊风大，落点狭窄。: The high-altitude suspension bridge has strong winds, and the landing area is narrow.
messages.高血盾兵，钩索打断后露出硬直窗口。: High-sanguine shield soldiers, showing a stiffening window after being interrupted by the hook rope.
messages.黑曜哨站、破旗路、盲钟营地等区域: Obsidian Outpost, Broken Flag Road, Blind Bell Camp and other areas
messages.黑曜哨站的匿名向导，可能是未完全编队的前代巡礼者。: A nameless guide at the Obsidian Watchpost. Perhaps an earlier pilgrim never fully drawn into the ranks.
messages.黑曜巡礼道入口: Entrance to the Obsidian Pilgrim Road
messages.黑曜巡礼道的点名册: Black Obsidian Pilgrim Road's Roll Call
messages.黑曜巡礼道闭环完成：NPC、清怪、Boss门和章节奖励均已验证。: Obsidian Pilgrim Road complete. NPC encounters, enemies, boss gate and chapter reward verified.
messages.黑曜影门会吃能量，别空着心穿过去。: The Obsidian Shadow Gate consumes energy. Don’t pass through it empty-handed.
messages.黑曜朝圣路 自动生成灰盒: Obsidian Pilgrim Road Automatically Generates Ash Box
messages.黑曜朝圣路 自动生成灰盒：自动生成灰盒入口。: Obsidian Pilgrim Road Automatically Generates Ash Box: Automatically generates an entrance to the ash box.
messages.黑曜沉睡钟已经苏醒，回程通路永久接通。: The Obscure Sleeping Bell has awakened, and the return path is permanently connected.
messages.黑曜碑林1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Obsidian Stelae 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.

messages.黑曜章节敌人掉落的材料。: Materials dropped by the enemies in the Obsidian chapter.
messages.黑曜路上不卖东西，那里的人只收沉默。: There’s nothing sold on Obsidian Road. The people there only accept silence.
messages.黑曜道不是去王冠的单行军路。侧向检修道还能回到书库和温室。: The Obsidian Road is more than a march to the Crown. The side paths still lead back to the Archive and the Greenhouse.
messages.黑潮在这里学人敲击；隐藏钟龛也在这里。: Black Tide learns human tapping here; hidden Bell shrine niches are also here.
messages.黑潮拟人化童声，可能是被王冠吞掉的所有声音聚合。: A child's voice rising from the Blacktide. Perhaps it holds all the voices the Crown has swallowed.
messages.黑潮水面与隐苔龛: Black Tide water surface and hidden moss niche
messages.黑潮退回井下，六城重新得到稳定的镇潮设施。: The Blacktide retreats beneath the well. The six cities can depend on the tideworks again.
messages.鼠标右键消耗60点能量，恢复1点生命。: Mouse 2 consumes 60 energy points and restores 1 life point.
messages.齿轮泵房1：按自动生成灰盒推进，识别主线、支线、捷径和回访门。: Gear Pump House 1. Follow the marked route and look for side paths, shortcuts and return gates.

messages.残影淡去；教学三句缝入钟骨旧站的垂绳（环境交互）: The echo fades; the three tutorial lines remain woven into the hanging bell-cord at Old Bellbone Station.
messages.贯穿旧城的钟骨长梯早已停运，仅余静默站厅。: The Bellbone Lift that once crossed the old city has long been decommissioned, leaving only a silent platform.
messages.贯穿旧城的钟骨长梯早已停运，仅余滴水的站厅。: The Bellbone Lift that once crossed the old city has long been decommissioned, leaving only a dripping platform.
messages.通往旧矿层的铸渣滑道早已在停炉后塌封。: The slag chute to the lower mine collapsed and sealed shut after the foundry furnaces went cold.
messages.高位水塔顶的雨溢立管通道，借丝壁攀附可前往盐白书库。: The rain-overflow riser at the top of the high water tower; use Silk Wall Grip to reach Saltwhite Archive.
messages.炉底废弃铸渣滑道口，停炉后已塌封。: Abandoned slag chute at the furnace floor; collapsed and sealed since the furnaces shut down.
messages.钟骨旧站水线层站厅，已停运封存。: Waterline platform of Old Bellbone Station, decommissioned and sealed.
messages.主教的藤鞭横扫与棘球封锁覆盖全场。: The Bishop's vine whips and thorn orbs sweep across the entire hall.
messages.蜂蜡小屋商人，靠收集蜂蜡护符、盐页与温室旧物生存。: Merchant of the Beeswax Hut, making a living from beeswax charms, salt pages, and greenhouse relics.
messages.确认移动藤蔓与棘藤平台的节奏。 -> 穿越断续弦桥，取得棘线下劈并直面铜根主教。: Learn the rhythm of moving vines and thorn platforms. -> Cross the broken string bridges, claim Thorn Downstrike, and face the Copper-Root Bishop.
messages.藤鞭横扫、棘球齐射、弦桥断续。；舞台两侧棘墙推进，玩家用 thorn_downs: Vine sweeps, thorn-orb volleys, and shifting string bridges; thorn walls close in from both sides while you rebound off thorn orbs with Thorn Downstrike to reach safety.
messages.蜂蜡护符便宜，在温室里硬闯很贵。: Beeswax charms are cheap; forcing your way through the greenhouse costs much more.
messages.纸页贴在锈面上很凉。被铸成王冠那一夜，我听见整座城一起屏住呼吸。: The page feels cold against the rust. On the night I was cast into a crown, I heard the whole city hold its breath at once.
messages.疼的不是熔铜灌进嘴里，是此后每一次敲响，都只准替活着的人签下沉默。: What hurt was not the molten bronze poured into my mouth, but that every toll thereafter could only sign silence in the name of the living.
